Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The Role

AI is changing what it means to deploy enterprise software. Configuring a customer's procurement workflows used to mean weeks of manual setup, integration by integration, edge case by edge case. Increasingly, that first-draft build work can be directed rather than done by hand: AI agents can generate workflow configurations, draft integration mappings, and produce the initial pass on a customer's setup.

The job shifts with it. Instead of building every workflow yourself, you specify exactly what needs to exist, direct AI to build it, and apply the judgment AI can't: is this the right configuration for this customer's approval policy, will Legal and Finance actually sign off on it, does it hold up once real spend starts flowing through it. In practice, that might mean catching that the approval chain AI just drafted works perfectly for HQ, but misses a regional delegation-of-authority rule that would fail an audit in the customer's APAC entity.

As Omnea's AI Solutions Lead, you own deployment of the Omnea platform end to end - typically running 3-5 enterprise deployments concurrently - for some of Europe's most recognisable companies. You advise customers on the best-fit configuration, direct AI-assisted build work to get there fast, and validate every output against what the customer actually needs. You'll also deal with the politics that come with every enterprise rollout: the Legal team wanting one more sign-off, the Finance stakeholder who doesn't trust the new approval flow, the exec sponsor who's gone quiet. You become the internal voice of the customer, and you're judged on outcomes you can point to: time to launch, post-go-live CSAT, and whether that customer becomes a case study or reference.

This is an early hire on Omnea's customer team, working directly with our sales, customer, product, and engineering leadership. The future shape of the role is yours to define!

What You'll Do

Discover and design

  • Run discovery with customer stakeholders across Procurement, Finance, Legal, and IT, and translate their process into an Omnea configuration

  • Design the target workflow: approval chains, routing logic, integrations, and the edge cases that make procurement hard

  • On a deployment with a dozen-plus integrations, you own the sequencing - what has to land first, what blocks what - and the harder calls underneath it: which system is the source of truth for a given entity, and how records reconcile when two systems key that entity differently

  • Define success criteria and a realistic path to go-live with the customer's project sponsor

Build with AI, not instead of it

  • You're not just directing AI to draft your own deliverables faster - you're configuring the specialized agents Omnea's customers rely on every day: an intake agent that knows how to ask a procurement analyst the right follow-up question, a risk agent that flags what actually matters to this customer's Legal team

  • The real leverage comes from chaining agents together - an intake agent that hands clean, structured requests to a risk agent, which in turn routes into approvals with the right context already attached. You design how those agents work as a system, not just individually

  • Writing a spec for one agent is a skill. Writing one that holds up across a chain of agents - where one agent's output becomes another's input - is the actual bar here

  • Validate every AI-generated output against the customer's actual process, policy, and edge cases before anything ships

  • Handle what AI can't: judgment calls on ambiguous requirements, custom logic, and anything that needs a human read on internal politics

Deploy and prove value

  • Present configured workflows to stakeholders, from procurement analysts to CFOs, working through the pushback and internal politics that come with any enterprise rollout, and win their buy-in

  • Run multi-day onsite workshops with customers, coordinating dozens of stakeholders across multiple workstreams at once - a different muscle than a single stakeholder meeting

  • Project-manage the deployment: timelines, blockers, stakeholder alignment, and a clear path to launch, acting as an extension of the customer's team

  • Track adoption after go-live and keep the configuration working as the customer's process evolves

  • Work with Product and Engineering during the design phase, not just after something breaks in the field - you're often the earliest signal on whether a new module will hold up for an enterprise customer, and that shapes what gets built next

What's Different About This Role

  • You'll spend more time specifying and validating than building from scratch. AI produces the first draft; you make sure it's right for this customer

  • Writing instructions AI can act on precisely is a skill you'll build fast here. Vague requests produce vague configurations

  • Judgment matters more, not less. AI speeds up the build, but you decide whether the output is right for this contract, this Board, this customer

  • You'll keep experimenting as our AI tooling evolves, and share what works with the rest of the team

About You

We don't expect you to know how to do all of this on day one. TL;DR: you're ambitious and hard-working, as comfortable directing an AI agent through a tricky configuration as you are presenting a project plan to an exec. You make up for any gap in experience with hunger and a genuine growth mindset. You derive energy from building relationships, shipping projects, and making customers succeed.

  • 4-8 years in a fast-paced, high-bar environment: a startup, scale-up, consulting, banking, or something you built yourself

    • Less experience? Check out our Solutions Associate role

  • Comfortable directing AI tools to produce first-draft work, and confident enough in your own judgment to catch what's wrong. Prior use of tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or Cursor is a strong plus. What matters most is your ability to write clear, specific instructions and evaluate what comes back

  • Client-facing experience, or the natural gravitas to be excellent at it. You can point to a time you went well beyond what a client expected

  • A track record of doing something exceptionally well, whether that's work, academia, sport, or anything else you've put your mind to

  • Comfortable reasoning about system architecture - how data models, primary keys, and integration sequencing interact across a dozen enterprise systems. You don't need to write the integration code, but you need to know why it breaks and be able to reason with the people who do, and you'll need to become an Omnea product expert

  • You build real relationships with people at any level, from a junior procurement analyst to a CFO, and know how to handle pushback and stakeholder politics, not just build rapport

  • Comfortable running rooms of stakeholders across a genuinely cross-functional tool - on a single project you'll interface with the CPO, Legal, Finance, AP, InfoSec, and Compliance, plus each of their technical resources, often all with competing priorities on the same decision

  • Comfortable moving between the detail and the big picture: configuring a workflow in the morning, presenting a project plan to an exec in the afternoon

  • Entrepreneurial, have high ownership, and want to be part of building something. We've signed up to the Future Founder Promise

  • An excellent communicator: clear and concise, verbal and written, even when the subject is complicated

  • Highly organised: comfortable running 3-5 enterprise deployments concurrently, each at a different stage, without dropping any of them

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

title: AI Tutor/Lehrkraft (all genders)
descriptionHtml:

Du bewertest Lernfortschritte, führst Abschlussprüfungen durch und gibst strukturiertes, konstruktives Feedback.   • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation in einem quantitativen, analytischen oder technischen Fachbereich

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse moderner KI-Konzepte – insbesondere GenAI mit Fokus auf LLMs, inkl. Grundverständnis von Trainingsdaten, Modellen, Evaluierung und typischen KI-Limitierungen (Machine Learning und Deep Learning sind ein Plus)

  • Praktische Erfahrung in der Nutzung von LLMs (z. B. Prompt-Engineering, Workflow-Integration, Agenten) sowie mit No-/Low-Code-KI-Tools

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit (einfachen) API-Clients (z. B. Postman, curl); gute Python-Kenntnisse sowie Erfahrung mit SQL, Power BI oder Excel sind von Vorteil

  • Bewusstsein für ethische, rechtliche und organisatorische Aspekte von KI-Anwendungen sowie Interesse an aktuellen Entwicklungen im KI-Sektor

  • Didaktische Erfahrung in der Vermittlung technischer oder fachlicher Inhalte an nicht-technische Zielgruppen sowie Verständnis für Konzepte der Erwachsenenbildung und Online-Weiterbildung

  • Hohe Kunden- und Serviceorientierung, Empathie, klare Kommunikation und konstruktive Feedbackkultur

  • Hands-on-Mentalität, Teamgeist, Belastbarkeit und Flexibilität

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1)

Das bieten wir Dir

Arbeitskultur
Dich erwartet eine lösungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, eine offene Feedbackkultur sowie ein starker Teamspirit. Zwei vom gesamten StackFuel-Team gewählte Trustees unterstützen Dich bei Fragen und Anliegen als neutrale, vertrauliche Anlaufstelle.


Ownership
Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit.

Workation
Bis zu 10 Tage pro Jahr kannst Du von überall aus der EU, dem EWR und der Türkei arbeiten.

Raum für Austausch
Regelmäßiger Austausch im Team, saisonale Feiern und eine immer gut gefüllte Küche sorgen für ein lebendiges Miteinander.

Weiterentwicklung
Absolviere unsere Online-Trainings, um Deine fachlichen Fähigkeiten auszubauen und Dich zur Expert:in für Daten und KI zu entwickeln.

title: AI Video Editor für Social Ads (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Mission

Kurz vorab: Wir suchen jemanden, der richtig Lust hat. Auf Tempo, auf Qualität und auf neue Werkzeuge. Wenn du Verantwortung magst, schnell lernst und AI als Chance für deine Kreativität siehst, bist du hier richtig. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam im Office im Herzen Münchens, weil gute Creatives im Team entstehen und wir zusammen am schnellsten sind.

Du schneidest Video-Ads, die im Feed hängen bleiben, und bringst sie mit Motion zum Leben. AI nutzt du dabei so selbstverständlich wie dein Schnittprogramm: für Bilder, Szenen, Stimmen, Varianten und alles, was dich schneller und besser macht. Du setzt nicht nur um. Du baust auch die Abläufe, mit denen unser Team morgen arbeitet.

Konkret

  • Du schneidest Short-Form-Ads für Meta, TikTok und YouTube: Hooks, Pacing, Sound und Untertitel.
  • Du baust aus einem Konzept viele Varianten, schnell und sauber.
  • Du animierst Typo, Produkte und Übergänge in After Effects.
  • Du setzt AI-Tools im Schnitt und in der Animation ein und probierst laufend neue aus.
  • Du entwickelst eigene Workflows, hältst sie fest und zeigst sie dem Team.
  • Du siehst die Zahlen deiner Ads und lernst daraus, was funktioniert.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Videoschnitt, am besten mit Short Form oder Social Ads.
  • Du bist schnell und sicher in Premiere Pro oder DaVinci Resolve und in After Effects.
  • Du arbeitest bereits mit AI-Tools für Video, Bild oder Ton und kannst zeigen, was du damit gemacht hast.
  • Du hast ein Gespür für Hooks, Timing und Rhythmus.
  • Du willst wissen, warum eine Ad funktioniert, und nicht nur, ob sie gut aussieht.
  • Du nimmst Feedback an, gibst selbst welches und lieferst zuverlässig.
  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse.
  • Du wohnst in München oder ziehst für den Job her. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam im Office.

Diese Rolle ist für dich, wenn

  • du ehrgeizig bist und zu den Besten in deinem Fach gehören willst.
  • du lieber heute etwas Neues ausprobierst, als es dir morgen erklären zu lassen.
  • du im Team besser wirst und andere besser machst.
  • du Tempo magst und trotzdem auf Details achtest.

Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung mit generativen Video- und Bild-Tools im Produktionsalltag.
  • Erfahrung mit E-Commerce Brands (Food, Beauty, Lifestyle).
  • Verständnis für Performance Marketing und Creative Strategy.

Warum wir?

  • Du arbeitest mit aktuellen AI-Tools. Wir bauen bei ADMKRS eigene AI-Workflows und probieren Neues sofort aus.
  • Du siehst, welche deiner Ads gewinnen, und lernst jede Woche dazu.
  • Ein starkes Creative-Team, das dich fordert und von dem du lernst.
  • Motiviertes High-Performance-Team, keine Politik, flache Hierarchien.
  • Spannende E-Commerce- und Leadgen-Brands (Food, Beauty, Lifestyle).
  • Benefitpaket mit Sachbezug, Wellpass, Mittagessen und Deutschlandticket.
  • Modernes, zentrales Office am Gärtnerplatz in München.
  • Team-Events, Workshops und Weiterbildungen.

Darauf schauen wir

Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns stattdessen:

  • deinen Lebenslauf
  • einen Link zu deinen drei besten Videos oder Ads, mit je einem Satz dazu, was dein Anteil war

Den Link kannst du im Bewerbungsformular eintragen oder in deinen Lebenslauf schreiben.

So geht es danach weiter: Videocall, eine kurze Case-Aufgabe, ein Probetag bei uns im Office mit persönlichem Gespräch, dann unsere Entscheidung.

title: Alternant(e) en Cybersécurité H/F
descriptionHtml:
Lieu : Fontenay-sous-Bois (94)
Type de contrat : Contrat d’apprentissage – 24 mois
Temps de travail : 35 h/semaine
Rémunération : selon l’âge et l’année de contrat (grille légale de l’apprentissage)
Début : dès que possible

Protégez un système d’information réel et préparez un titre Bac+5 en cybersécurité reconnu par l’État, gratuitement et en étant payé(e).

Qui sommes-nous ?
KAISCHOOL est une école supérieure spécialisée en Intelligence Artificielle, Data, Cybersécurité et Commerce IT. Elle forme du Bac+3 au Bac+5 en alternance, en mode hybride. Pour renforcer la sécurité de son système d’information, KAISCHOOL recrute un(e) alternant(e) Analyste Cybersécurité. Vous protégerez nos données, nos utilisateurs et nos outils numériques tout en préparant votre diplôme dans notre école.

Votre formation : Mastère Cyber – Expert en renseignement et investigation sur les cybermenaces
Il s’agit d’un titre Bac+5 de niveau 7 enregistré au RNCP. La formation part de la menace réelle : vous apprenez les méthodes des attaquants pour construire des défenses efficaces. Elle couvre toute la chaîne de la cybersécurité, de l’analyse des risques jusqu’au renseignement sur les menaces et à l’investigation numérique avancée.

Blocs de compétences :

  1. Analyser les menaces et les vulnérabilités des systèmes d’information.

  2. Détecter les incidents de sécurité et mener l’investigation numérique.

  3. Piloter la sécurité et la conformité réglementaire de l’organisation (RGPD, NIS2).

  4. Conduire des opérations de renseignement sur les cybermenaces (CTI).

Vous apprendrez à :

  • repérer les vulnérabilités et modéliser les menaces pour savoir quoi sécuriser en priorité ;

  • superviser les flux de sécurité et coordonner la réponse aux incidents et aux crises ;

  • analyser des postes et des logiciels malveillants (forensic, malware) pour comprendre une attaque ;

  • collecter et exploiter du renseignement sur les menaces (OSINT, MISP) ;

  • appliquer les exigences réglementaires et les normes au sein d’une organisation.

Outils et référentiels : MITRE ATT&CK, EBIOS RM, Splunk, Wireshark, OpenCTI, MISP.

Les + de KAISCHOOL :

  • formation 100 % gratuite pour vous, financée par l’OPCO, et salaire versé pendant toute l’alternance ;

  • pédagogie hybride : cours sur place à Fontenay-sous-Bois et plateforme en ligne avec replays 24h/24 ;

  • 15 projets concrets par étudiant, sur de vrais outils cyber ;

  • école certifiée Qualiopi ;

  • 95 % d’insertion à 6 mois (promotion 2024, donnée déclarative de l’école).

Vos missions :

  • surveiller les événements de sécurité du système d’information ;

  • repérer et analyser les vulnérabilités et les risques ;

  • participer au traitement et au suivi des incidents de sécurité ;

  • contrôler la sécurité des postes, des applications et des outils (Microsoft 365, plateforme e-learning, CRM…) ;

  • participer à la gestion des accès et des habilitations des utilisateurs ;

  • contribuer à la mise en conformité RGPD et à la protection des données des étudiants et des partenaires ;

  • rédiger des procédures, des comptes rendus et des rapports de sécurité ;

  • sensibiliser les équipes aux bonnes pratiques (phishing, mots de passe, MFA) ;

  • suivre l’actualité des menaces et des vulnérabilités.

Profil recherché :

  • vous pouvez aussi postuler sans Bac+3 si vous avez 2 ans d’expérience en informatique, ou 1 an si vous êtes spécialisé(e) en systèmes et réseaux ;

  • un projet personnel est un vrai plus (CTF, TryHackMe, Root-Me, homelab…) ;

Rythme : 4 jours en entreprise et 1 jour en formation.

title: Analyst M&A (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wir sind seit +25 Jahren international präsent und beraten Mandanten in den Bereichen M&A und Debt Financing bei Transaktionen auf der Sell- und Buy-Side, bei Kapitalerhöhungen und Finanzierungen.

Mit 600+ erfolgreich abgeschlossenen Transaktionen verfügen wir industrieübergreifend über detailliertes Branchen-Know-how. Wir verbessern uns stetig darin, mit unseren Kollegen in Berlin, München, Frankfurt und Zürich zielgenaue Lösungen für Mandanten zu entwickeln und umzusetzen. Als exklusiver Partner eines internationalen M&A-Netzwerks mit weiteren Büros in 32+ Ländern beraten wir regelmäßig bei grenzüberschreitenden Transaktionen.

Bei Mergermarket zählen wir seit vielen Jahren zu den Top 10 der aktivsten deutschen M&A-Beratungshäuser. Zu unseren Kunden gehören mittelständische Unternehmen und Unternehmer genauso wie Private Equity und Venture Capital Gesellschaften als auch internationale Corporates wie Fortune100 Konzerne oder börsennotierte Gesellschaften. Wir sind leidenschaftliche Dealmaker und Unternehmer mit einem klaren Client-First-Ansatz.

Mit einem dynamischen Team und einem klaren Fokus auf M&A gestalten wir die Zukunft unserer Branche aktiv mit. Dafür suchen wir zum 1. Januar 2027 ambitionierte und strategisch denkende M&A Analysts und Associates (m/w/d) für unseren Standort München.

Bereit, Großes zu bewegen? Wir suchen Macher, die mehr wollen als nur irgendeinen nächsten Karriereschritt.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission:

  • Deal Support: Du bist ein wichtiger Baustein in der Abwicklung unserer Transaktionen und übernimmst die Erstellung relevanter Projektdokumente wie Teaser, Long Lists, und Information Memoranda, unterstützt bei Due Diligence Aktivitäten und arbeitest an der Erstellung von Unternehmens-, Branchen- oder Wettbewerbsanalysen
  • Modelling Expert: Du erstellst, analysierst und plausibilisierst Financial Models und Unternehmensbewertungen mithilfe der gängigen Bewertungsverfahren und Rechnungslegungsstandards
  • Communication Talent: Du wirst aktiv in die Kommunikation mit Mandanten, Investoren und weiteren Projektansprechpartnern einbezogen und betreust Prozesse eng mit unseren Senior-Teammitgliedern
  • Reliable Counterpart: Du bist zuverlässig, treibst Themen aktiv voran und verfügst über hervorragende Projektmanagementfähigkeiten, um auch bei mehreren Projekten und Tasks einen kühlen Kopf zu bewahren
  • Knowledge Transfer: Du hast Freude daran, dein erlerntes Wissen weiterzugeben, Teammitglieder anzuleiten und erste Erfahrungen in der Führung von Mitarbeitern zu sammeln

Qualifikation

title: Analyste en investigation numérique judiciaire H/F
descriptionHtml:
Les affaires criminelles vous intriguent ?

Vous aimez enquêter, comprendre, relier des faits et révéler la vérité à partir de données numériques ?

Nous recrutons un·e analyste en investigation numérique pour renforcer notre équipe et intervenir sur des dossiers sensibles confiés par les autorités judiciaires.

Qui sommes-nous ?

LE LERTI est un laboratoire privé spécialisé dans l’analyse de données numériques dans un cadre judiciaire, et reconnu au niveau national.

Nous intervenons en qualité d’experts judiciaires, principalement sur des affaires pénales complexes, pour le compte de juges d’instruction et de forces de l’ordre.

Notre mission : extraire, analyser, comprendre et contextualiser des éléments numériques susceptibles de constituer des preuves dans le cadre d’enquêtes et de procédures pénales.

Vos missions

Votre mission

Au sein d’une équipe pluridisciplinaire (analystes, informaticiens, juristes…), vous analysez des données issues de supports numériques (smartphones, ordinateurs, supports de stockage, etc.) afin d’en extraire des informations pertinentes pour une instruction ou un procès pénal.

Vos responsabilités principales :

Analyse et investigation

  • Comprendre les enjeux judiciaires d’un dossier et identifier les axes d’investigation
  • Analyser, croiser et interpréter des données numériques parfois volumineuses et complexes
  • Surmonter les contraintes techniques inhérentes aux investigations numériques

Rédaction et communication

  • Vulgariser des résultats techniques auprès de publics non spécialistes
  • Rédiger des rapports clairs, structurés et compréhensibles
  • Mettre à jour et documenter les dossiers dans les outils internes

Interaction avec les parties prenantes

  • Répondre aux sollicitations des magistrats et enquêteurs
  • Témoigner devant les juridictions, y compris en Cour d’assises
  • Assister techniquement les commissaires de justice, le cas échéant

Veille, amélioration et transmission

  • Participer à l’évolution des outils, méthodes et processus internes
  • Contribuer à la veille technologique et juridique
  • Partager les connaissances (formations, conférences, retours d’expérience)
  • Remonter les anomalies et besoins d’évolution aux éditeurs d’outils

Vos compétences

Compétences clés

  • Maîtrise des environnements Windows et des outils bureautiques
  • Bonne connaissance des applications mobiles courantes (WhatsApp, Messenger, Signal, etc.)
  • Capacité à analyser, croiser et interpréter des données complexes
  • Excellentes compétences rédactionnelles (fond et forme)
  • Aisance orale et posture professionnelle face à des interlocuteurs variés

Profil recherché

  • Formation supérieure en sciences humaines, sociales, ou expérience significative en environnement judiciaire (police, gendarmerie, justice…)
  • Esprit d’analyse, rigueur, méthode et autonomie
  • Curiosité technique, capacité d’apprentissage et sens aigu de la confidentialité
  • Résilience émotionnelle face à des dossiers sensibles
  • Casier judiciaire vierge obligatoire
  • Lettre de motivation obligatoire (nous accordons une réelle importance au sens de votre démarche)

Avantages

  • Horaires flexibles (dans un cadre raisonnable et compatible avec les missions)
  • Tickets restaurant
  • Un poste à fort impact, au cœur de dossiers judiciaires complexes et exigeants
  • Télétravail possible sous condition d’ancienneté, selon les modalités en vigueur

👉 Si vous souhaitez mettre vos compétences au service de la Justice et donner du sens à votre travail, rejoignez-nous.

title: Analytics Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Als global tätiges EnerTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Energieversorgung, Technologie und Services. Unser Ziel ist es, mehr Menschen Zugang zu modernen Energielösungen zu ermöglichen. Dafür bieten wir Stromtarife aus 100% erneuerbaren Energien an, installieren Wärmepumpen und entwickeln smarte Tarife. Dabei sind unsere Ökostromtarife nur die Basis. Bereits seit 2022 installieren wir Wärmepumpen-Komplettlösungen mit eigenen Fachkräften. Außerdem arbeiten wir aktiv an der flächendeckenden Einführung von Smart Metern, Elektromobilitätslösungen und der eigenen Stromerzeugung aus Wind- und Sonnenenergie. Das schaffen wir allerdings nicht alleine, sondern dazu brauchen wir dich! Werde Teil unseres Teams und fordere den Status Quo heraus. Mit Energie, die gut für den Planeten ist und gut für dein Karma. 💚 Finde jetzt deinen Traumjob und werde Teil der Energierevolution von Octopus Energy Germany.

Für unseren Bereich Costing suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen engagierten Analytics Engineer, der/die unsere Datenarchitektur im Bereich der direkten Kosten (Netzentgelte, Umlagen, Steuern) auf das nächste Level hebt. In dieser Schlüsselposition bist du das Bindeglied zwischen komplexen regulatorischen Anforderungen, energiewirtschaftlichen Forecasts und unserer Pricing-Strategie. Du liebst es, skalierbare Daten-Pipelines zu bauen, behältst bei wechselnden regulatorischen Vorgaben den Überblick und hast den Anspruch, unsere Systeme durch eine moderne Neuarchitektur zukunftssicher zu machen.


Deine Aufgaben:
Datenarchitektur & Pipeline Architektur
  • Du verantwortest die Neuarchitektur unserer Datenlandschaft zur Abbildung der direkten Kosten im Energievertrieb.
  • Du konzipierst und implementierst robuste ETL/ELT-Pipelines mittels dbt und Airflow, um Daten aus regulatorischen Quellen, Marktdaten und internen Systemen effizient zu verarbeiten.
  • Du stellst die Datenqualität und -konsistenz sicher, die als direkte Entscheidungsgrundlage für unser Pricing dient.

    • Fachliche Konzeption & Monitoring

  • Regulatorisches Monitoring & Implementierung: Du behältst die regulatorischen Entwicklungen im Energiemarkt (wie Änderungen bei Netzentgelten, Steuern und Umlagen) aktiv im Blick und übersetzt diese eigenständig in die notwendigen Anpassungen unserer Datenmodelle und Pipelines.
  • Du entwickelst und pflegst Forecast-Modelle für unsere Kostenkomponenten und stellst sicher, dass sich regulatorische Änderungen zeitnah und präzise in den Prognosen widerspiegeln.
  • Du übersetzt komplexe energiewirtschaftliche Rahmenbedingungen in performante, logische Datenstrukturen.

    • Strategische Zusammenarbeit

  • Du agierst als zentraler Ansprechpartner für unsere Schnittstellen Pricing, Energy Markets (Einkauf/Forecasting) und Gross Margin Controlling.
  • Du berätst die Stakeholder bei der methodischen Weiterentwicklung der Kostenberechnung und stellst sicher, dass die analytischen Outputs direkt in die Business-Strategie einfließen.
  • Du treibst die technische Weiterentwicklung des Teams voran, indem du Best Practices in der Datenmodellierung etablierst.

    • Dein Background:
  • Du hast ein Studium in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Mathematik, Statistik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einem ähnlichen quantitativen Fach erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
  • Du bringst fundierte Berufserfahrung (Mid-Level bis Senior) als Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren datengetriebenen Rolle mit.
  • Du bist ein Profi im Umgang mit SQL und Python. Idealerweise hast du bereits Erfahrung mit dbt und Apache Airflow in produktiven Umgebungen gesammelt.
  • Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Datenarchitekturen und die Fähigkeit, dynamische fachliche/regulatorische Anforderungen in sauberen, wartbaren Code zu übersetzen.
  • Du arbeitest analytisch, konzeptionell und findest pragmatische Lösungen für technische Herausforderungen.
  • Du kommunizierst klar – auf Deutsch und Englisch – und kannst fachliche Komplexität für Stakeholder verständlich aufbereiten.
  • Du hast eine ausgeprägte Ownership-Mentalität: Du baust Systeme nicht nur, du verantwortest ihren Betrieb und ihre kontinuierliche Anpassung an den Markt.
    • Deine Benefits bei uns: ✅ Vergünstigungen & Vorsorge: - Aktienoptionen der Octopus Energy Group Ltd. - Vergünstigte Konditionen für unsere Strom- und Gastarife - Monatlicher Zuschuss zum Nahverkehrsticket - Monatlicher Zuschuss zum Mittagessen - Vergünstigtes Fahrradleasing - Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
    - Nachhaltig unterwegs mit unserem E-Auto-Leasing ✅ Familie - Beratungsangebote und Unterstützung bei Kinderbetreuung über HeyNanny - Monatlicher Zuschuss zur Kinderbetreuung - Elterngeld-Bonus: Wir stocken dein Elterngeld für 3 Monate auf, damit du deine Elternzeit entspannter genießen kannst ✅ Sport & Gesundheit - Zuzahlungen zu Fitness- Angeboten über Wellpass - Förderung deines mentalen Wohlbefindens mit unserem Partner Open Up ✅ Lernen & Weiterbildung - Attraktive Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten - Kostenlose Sprachkurse über Busuu ✅ Extra Goodies - Gutschein zu deinem Geburtstag _________________ Bereit, den Energiemarkt mit uns zu revolutionieren? Erzähle uns, warum genau du uns dabei unterstützen solltest. Schicke uns deinen CV und alles, was wir wissen sollten, über unser Online-Formular. Wir freuen uns auf dich! Du findest die Stelle super spannend, bist dir aber unsicher, ob du alle geforderten Skills zu 100% erfüllst? Bitte zögere nicht, dich trotzdem zu bewerben! title: Analytics Manager
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

835 - Manager, Client Analytics - DTA

About WPP Media 

WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com. 

WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com 

At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values: 

  • Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity. 
  • Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust. 
  • Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise. 

About Choreograph: A Leading WPP Media Brand 

Choreograph is WPP’s global data products and technology company. We’re on a mission to transform marketing by building the fastest, most connected data platform that bridges marketing strategy to scaled activation. 

We work with agencies and clients to transform the value of data by bringing together technology, data and analytics capabilities. We deliver this through the Open Media Studio, an AI-enabled media and data platform for the next era of advertising. 

We’re endlessly curious. Our team of thinkers, builders, creators and problem solvers are over 1,000 strong, across 20 markets around the world. 

Role Summary and Impact   

The Manager, Client Analytics reports to the Director of Analytics, working to design, customize and maintain platforms for business analytics and measurement. You would have excellent oral and written communication skills, be client obsessed, self-motivated and able to operate both as a team and independently with limited guidance and direction

The Manager, Client Analytics is following the direction of Director of Analytics and is responsible for data manipulation and visualization, performing quantitative data analysis, problem solving, statistical modeling, and developing/analysing business cases.

WHAT YOU WILL DO   

  • Apply deep knowledge of basic statistics (significance testing, correlation analysis, confidence intervals, descriptive statistics) to support analytical solutions.
  • Use statistical modeling techniques (regression, classification) to extract business value from campaign data.
  • Utilize programming languages (Python, R, SQL), statistical packages (SciPy), and Google tools (BigQuery, Tensorflow, Datalab) to prototype and deliver data-driven solutions.
  • Recommend and develop technical solutions with guidance from senior leadership.
  • Define project scope, setup, and effort estimation in collaboration with the account Analytics lead.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with Analytics leads and gain a deep understanding of client challenges.
  • Work closely with key stakeholders to assess project needs and ensure delivery of best-in-class analytics work.
  • Collaborate with regional leadership on process development, improvement, and compliance.
  • Support campaign measurement, determine incremental lift from marketing activities, and manage reporting and data needs (ingestion, cleaning, delivery).
  • Code in SQL and Python to create reports and build dashboards; automate recurring workloads to improve efficiency.
  • Generate meaningful insights using advanced analytics/statistical techniques; create dashboards and presentations for wider teams.
  • Ensure continuous collaboration and progression across bands, disciplines, and offices.

Skills and Experience  

  • Relevant industry experience in analytics-focused roles.
  • Degree in an applied quantitative field (data science, mathematics, statistics, engineering, economics, business management, computer science, or related).
  • Understanding of marketing campaigns, objectives, and measurement techniques; prior experience in digital agency or consulting preferred.
  • Proficient coding skills in statistical software (R, Python, SciPy), programming languages (SQL, Python), and MS Office tools (especially advanced Excel/Google Sheets).
  • Experience in owning and delivering analytics projects, including correlation, regression, significance testing, A/B tests, and supervised machine learning.
  • Practical understanding of data science techniques, statistical analysis, and modeling.
  • Passion for data analysis, troubleshooting data anomalies, integrating data from multiple sources to create repositories for data science models.
  • Ability to transform raw data into actionable business insights for decision-making and strategic planning.
  • Strong logical thinking, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Adherence to quality standards and ability to plan and prioritize work.
  • Experience using or building reports with business intelligence tools is a plus.
  • Experience in applying big data, statistics, and analytical techniques to solve client problems is preferred.
  • Business acumen to provide actionable strategic recommendations is preferred

Life at WPP Media & Benefits 

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.   

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. 
 
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. 

Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location

title: Android Developer - AI Finance Agent
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for Android software engineers to build the native Android experience for Doit's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

 

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship Android features using Kotlin.

  • Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.

  • Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable.

  • Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.

  • Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product.

  • Build AI-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey.

 

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

  • Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps.

  • Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.

  • Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.

  • Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

 

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin

  • Jetpack Compose

  • Android SDK

  • Coroutines & Flow

  • SQL / NoSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.

  • Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.

  • Moves fast without creating messy code.

  • Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.

  • Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round


For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Android-Entwickler als Scrum Master (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Entwickle Android-Software, die Menschen in Bewegung bringt

Du möchtest Android-Apps entwickeln und sehen, wie dein Code in einem echten Produkt zum Einsatz kommt? Bei AUGLETICS entwickelst du Software für smarte Rudergeräte und unsere App. Du kannst neue Funktionen direkt ausprobieren und gemeinsam mit dem Team verbessern – vom ersten Prototyp bis zur zuverlässigen Anwendung.

Wir entwickeln und produzieren in Königs Wusterhausen bei Berlin. Unser Unternehmen hat rund 25 Mitarbeitende; im Softwareteam arbeitest du mit vier bis fünf Personen und direkt mit unserem CTO Christopher Klabunde. Wir haben viele Ideen und suchen jemanden, der mitdenkt, gerne programmiert und Wert auf gute Ergebnisse legt.

Das entwickelst du bei uns

  • Android-Funktionen für Gerät und App: Du entwickelst neue Features, verbesserst bestehende Abläufe und arbeitest an einer verständlichen, zuverlässigen Bedienung.

  • Das Zusammenspiel im Blick: Du arbeitest an Schnittstellen zwischen App, Gerätesoftware und Backend und hilfst, Datenflüsse und Fehlerfälle sauber zu lösen.

  • Ideen praktisch erproben: Du setzt Prototypen um, probierst sie am Rudergerät aus und entwickelst gute Ansätze mit dem Team weiter.

  • Qualität von Anfang an: Du schreibst nachvollziehbaren Code, beteiligst dich an Reviews und Tests und behebst Fehler nachhaltig.

  • KI sinnvoll einsetzen: Du nutzt KI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge für Ideen, Code, Tests und Fehleranalyse. Du verstehst und prüfst die Ergebnisse, bevor sie ins Produkt gelangen.

Deine Rolle als Scrum Master

Du verbindest deine technische Arbeit mit der Verantwortung dafür, dass unsere Projekte gemeinsam vorankommen. Als Scrum Master koordinierst du die Zusammenarbeit im Softwareteam und mit externen Entwicklungsagenturen. Du arbeitest eng mit CTO Christopher Klabunde zusammen; disziplinarische Personalführung gehört nicht zur Rolle.

  • Du bringst interne Entwicklung und externe Partner in eine gemeinsame Planung und sorgst für klare Zuständigkeiten, nächste Schritte und nachvollziehbare Abnahmekriterien.

  • Du bereitest agile Abstimmungen vor und moderierst sie, zum Beispiel Sprint Planning, kurze tägliche Abstimmungen, Reviews und Retrospektiven – passend zu unseren Projekten.

  • Du behältst Abhängigkeiten, Termine und offene Entscheidungen im Blick, sprichst Hindernisse früh an und hilfst dem Team, sie zu lösen.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Ergebnisse zusammengeführt, gemeinsam getestet und für einen verlässlichen Release vorbereitet werden.

Wenn du bereits Scrum-Master- oder Projektkoordinationserfahrung hast, kannst du sie direkt einbringen. Wenn du neu in der Rolle bist, wachsen wir mit dir hinein: Chris und das Team unterstützen dich dabei. Eine Scrum-Master-Zertifizierung ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Das bringst du mit

  • Programmiergrundlagen und Lust auf native Android-Entwicklung mit Kotlin oder Java. Praktische Android-Erfahrung ist willkommen; wenn du dich neu in Android einarbeitest, interessieren uns dein bisheriger Lernweg und deine Motivation.

  • Du kannst erklären, wie du technische Aufgaben angehst. Eigene Apps, Lernprojekte, Hochschulprojekte, Praktika und Werkstudententätigkeiten zählen genauso wie berufliche Erfahrung.

  • Ein gutes Verständnis von Programmiergrundlagen und Interesse daran, verständliche, wartbare und getestete Software zu entwickeln.

  • Offenheit für KI-unterstützte App-Entwicklung. Wenn du solche Werkzeuge bereits ausprobiert hast, interessiert uns, was gut funktioniert hat und wie du die Ergebnisse geprüft hast.

  • Eigeninitiative, Freude an Zusammenarbeit und Lust, dich in ein bestehendes Produkt einzuarbeiten und schrittweise Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

  • Gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift ist für den technischen Austausch im Team erforderlich. Deutschkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

  • Bereitschaft, regelmäßig in Königs Wusterhausen vor Ort zu arbeiten, um Funktionen am Gerät zu entwickeln und mit dem Team abzustimmen.

Ein Studium der Informatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung, eine passende Ausbildung oder vergleichbare Kenntnisse sind eine gute Grundlage.

Mit Erfahrung oder am Anfang: Wir wollen dich kennenlernen

Du hast schon mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in diesem Bereich? Super – bring deine Ideen und deinen Blick von außen ein. Du stehst noch am Anfang oder hast bisher keine Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich? Auch das ist in Ordnung. Wenn du für unser Produkt brennst, technische Grundlagen mitbringst und dich schnell in neue Themen einarbeitest, möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

In beiden Fällen ist es unsere Aufgabe, dich gut ins Team zu integrieren und dir Wissen, Werkzeuge und Unterstützung für einen erfolgreichen Start bereitzustellen. Gemeinsam mit Chris und dem Team lernst du unser Produkt und unsere Abläufe kennen. Aufgaben und Verantwortung stimmen wir auf deinen Erfahrungsstand ab und entwickeln sie mit dir weiter.

Zusätzliche Pluspunkte

  • Erfahrung in der iOS-Entwicklung, idealerweise mit Swift oder SwiftUI.

title: Applied AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
TLDR: We’re looking for top 1%, high agency, AI-forward engineers to be part of our early team at Resonance. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital, to deploy AI into the economy and rebuild businesses for the AI era. You’ll work at the frontier and solve real problems in an environment that champions ownership, autonomy and innovation at pace.

Who we are

Resonance is an applied AI company. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital. Our mission is to close the AI diffusion gap and rebuild businesses for the AI era. We're looking to hire Europe’s elite AI talent.

Why now

We believe the economic diffusion of AI is the major challenge of the next decade. Foundation models are advancing far faster than organisations can absorb them; the bottleneck is embedding AI deeply into the core processes of a company to drive an inflection in pace and create organisational advantage. Europe is falling behind on AI, and we exist to help its businesses build real, defensible advantage from it rather than simply adopting it.

The role

As an Applied AI Engineer, you’ll build the production AI systems behind Resonance’s client engagements, driving a dramatic acceleration in productivity or a step change in growth for our key clients. You will work at the AI frontier alongside Senior AI Engineers, owning features, integrations and evals end to end. You’ll build and ship agentic systems, from agents and MCP servers into client systems to retrieval and the product around them, working across the stack from data pipelines and the AI layer to the client’s core systems and the interfaces people use. You’ll build evals and observability from day one, take features from first prototype to production, and deploy and extend what we build inside client environments, shipping at pace with the latest AI coding tools. You’ll grow with the firm by contributing to Resonance’s own AI products and shared platform, turning what you learn on each build into reusable components, and taking on more ownership as you grow.

What we’re looking for: You have extreme agency and a bias for action, thrive on ambiguity, and are AI-obsessed, getting hands-on with new models and tools the day they hit the market. You typically have up to four years building software at a startup, a scale-up, a fast-moving product team or your own company. You write production Python or TypeScript, have shipped software with an LLM at its core, at work or on your own projects, and have iterated on prompts, agent loops and evals. You’re at home with messy real-world data, APIs and SQL, you ship fast without cutting corners, and you enjoy solving problems with technical and non-technical people. You have consistently been among the top performers in high-performing environments, at university or at work. Forward deployed experience, AI side projects or a company you founded are a plus.

What we offer: Competitive total compensation plus equity. Most engineers get one shot at a startup. Here you build many products, not one: our own AI products and platform, and several production AI systems a year across industries. You’ll learn fast alongside people who have embedded AI into 50+ businesses, with scope that grows as fast as your impact. Europe is falling behind on AI, and every build moves another European business to the right side of the productivity chasm. As one of our early joiners, you’ll shape how we build, operate and grow.

Logistics: London, 3+ days a week in the office or at client sites, mostly in the UK and Europe. English is our working language. We can sponsor visas for eligible candidates, and start dates are flexible.

Apply

Send your CV, your GitHub profile and a short note on the AI system you're proudest of shipping and the impact it delivered.

We hire people from every background and judge them on what they've built. If you don't tick every box, apply anyway.

Resonance is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. If you need adjustments at any stage, tell us and we'll make them.

About The Job

Mistral AI is seeking Applied Scientists and Research Engineers focused on time series. You will design, train, and deploy state-of-the-art time-series foundation models, and apply them to the most demanding forecasting problems in industry, from power grids and plants to trading desks.

Timestral, our family of time-series foundation models, ranked first on amongst all benchmarks at release (tech report). The role has two sides: building the next generations of Timestral with our Science team, and taking them into production with our industrial and financial clients, adapted to their data. Working cross-functionally with both external and internal science, engineering, and product teams you will deliver high-impact AI solutions.   • Fine-tune and adapt Timestral on client data, in the cloud or on-premise, and benchmark it against the client's existing models.

  • Develop the necessary tools and frameworks to facilitate data generation, model training, evaluation and deployment.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to tackle complex use cases, including agents that combine Timestral with Mistral LLMs.

  • Manage research projects and communications with client research teams.

About you

  • Expert with PyTorch or JAX.

  • Solid knowledge of modern deep learning and large language models: architectures, pre-training, post-training and evaluation.

  • Experience pre-training or fine-tuning time-series foundation models or large transformer models at scale.

title: Assistant·e Chef de Projet Marketing - alternance
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Pourquoi Deliveroo ?

Lorsque l'on vous dit Deliveroo, vous imaginez sans doute d'abord les bons petits plats livrés chez vous en moins d'une demi-heure. Plutôt sympa non ? Mais c'est en coulisses que l'histoire est la plus intéressante. Nous opérons désormais à travers le monde et travaillons avec plus de 176 000 restaurants partenaires et commerces en tous genres en France. Nous collaborons avec des milliers de livreurs et de livreuses partenaires pour le plus grand bonheur de nos millions de personnes clientes.

Nous recherchons un·e Assistant·e Chef de Projet Marketing Merchant en alternance pour rejoindre notre équipe Marketing à Paris, pour une durée de 12 mois. Aux côtés de l'équipe Merchant, vous contribuerez au développement de la croissance de nos partenaires, au déploiement de nos campagnes nationales 360° et en accompagnerez des projets à fort impact sur l'acquisition, la rétention et la fidélisation de nos restaurants partenaires.

Descriptif du poste :

En tant qu'Apprenti(e) dans l'équipe Marketing Merchant Restaurant, vous travaillerez au quotidien avec l'équipe marketing chargée de mettre en avant toute la sélection de restaurants et de partenaires de Deliveroo. Vous serez également amené(e) à interagir régulièrement avec les autres départements marketing tels que l'équipe média, l'équipe créative, le CRM ainsi qu'avec l'équipe commerciale.

Vos missions consisteront à:

  • Mettre en avant sur l'application les restaurants et partenaires disponibles sur l'app.
  • Soutenir l'équipe commerciale dans la création et l'exécution de plans marketing destinés à mettre en avant les partenaires présents sur Deliveroo.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe commerciale et les équipes marketing transversales (marque, réseaux sociaux, CRM et influenceurs) pour développer et exécuter des plans partenaires basés sur les priorités commerciales (par exemple, objectifs régionaux, accords d'exclusivité, renégociations).
  • Préparer des présentations et des supports pour appuyer les discussions de l'équipe commerciale avec les partenaires, en veillant à l'alignement et à la clarté.
  • Contribuer à l'exécution des points forts des partenaires en collaboration avec le CRM et le Commercial (communications mensuelles d'exclusivité / bannières dédiées sur l'application / notifications push...).
  • Gérer le budget alloué pour le plan de chaque partenaire, en optimisant les ressources locales pour obtenir un impact maximal.
  • Analyser l'impact de nos campagnes pour en tirer des recommandations pour les équipes commerciales

Cette alternance vous permettra d'appréhender de nombreux sujets marketing (création de campagne, analyse, sensibilité client) et vous permettra d'acquérir une bonne connaissance des enjeux marketing et de la gestion de projets complexes grâce à la collaboration transverse que vous aurez avec les autres pôles.

Ce qui vous permettra de réussir

Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau Bac+4 ou Bac+5 en école de commerce, université ou équivalent, avec une spécialisation en marketing, communication ou digital et recherchez une alternance d'une durée d'un an à partir de Décembre 2026 / Janvier 2027.

Vous Vous Reconnaissez Dans Les Points Suivants

  • Vous êtes organisé·e, rigoureux·se et savez gérer plusieurs projets en parallèle en respectant les délais
  • Vous avez une excellente communication écrite et orale en français ainsi qu'un bon niveau d'anglais.
  • Vous êtes à l'aise avec les chiffres et aimez analyser les performances pour en tirer des recommandations.
  • Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et la coordination de nombreux interlocuteurs.
  • Vous êtes curieux·se, proactif·ve et souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et en forte croissance.

Voici un lien avec de la documentation pour vous préparer aux entretiens.

Nous offrons un environnement de travail dynamique et stimulant, où vous aurez l'opportunité de développer vos compétences et de contribuer activement à notre mission. Rejoignez notre équipe exceptionnelle dès maintenant et faites partie de cette aventure passionnante !

La vie chez Deliveroo :

Notre équipe est en forte croissance, notre impact très important, et nous cherchons à répondre aux questions les plus stimulantes du moment. Nous progressons rapidement, nous explorons toujours de nouvelles idées et nous sommes très transparents quant aux décisions que nous prenons et à ce qui motive nos choix.

Il y a tellement de questions que nous souhaitons résoudre, et encore plus que nous n'avons pas encore rencontrées. Comment les données et la technologie peuvent-elles aider les restaurants à développer leur activité à mesure que les habitudes des consommateurs évoluent ? Comment pouvons-nous prédire ce qu'une personne souhaitera pour dîner avant même que l'idée ne lui vienne à l'esprit ? Chez Deliveroo, ces questions ne sont que quelques-uns des défis ambitieux auxquels nous nous efforçons de répondre – et il n'y a aucun projet qui ne peut pas devenir le vôtre. Aucune solution n'appartient à une équipe en particulier, ce qui vous ouvre d'extraordinaires possibilités en termes de développement et d'impact personnel.

À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux travailleurs et travailleuses en situation de handicap ou assimilés au sens de l'article L5212-13 du Code du travail. Deliveroo s'engage en faveur de la diversité, l'égalité professionnelle, l'emploi des personnes en situation de handicap.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

descriptionHtml:
Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement

Location: Remote — this is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners. Some travel is required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and industry events.

The Role

The Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement is responsible for defining and leading Acceleration Partners' data, analytics and measurement capability. This role sits at the intersection of client strategy, data science, measurement, AI-enabled insights and commercial growth. The Director will work directly with enterprise clients to understand their marketing and business data ecosystem, develop measurement strategies, and help clients make better decisions through data. Internally, the role will partner with Client Services, Strategy, Sales and AI Automation teams to build AP's data capability, improve decision-making, develop new services and products, and raise data literacy across the organization. As a senior leader, the Director will also develop AP's market position as a leading authority on affiliate, influencer and partnership measurement.

Top Responsibilities:

Client Measurement & Data Strategy

• Serve as AP's senior advisor on measurement, analytics and reporting.

• Understand client data ecosystems including affiliate networks, influencer platforms, Google Analytics, CRM systems, customer databases, MMM outputs and business intelligence tools.

• Design measurement frameworks that connect partnership marketing activity to broader business outcomes, spanning attribution, incrementality, customer acquisition and lifetime value.

• Advise clients on how affiliate and influencer activity should be measured alongside paid media, brand marketing and broader customer acquisition strategies.

• Own AP's point of view on measurement, partnering with MMM providers, analytics platforms and measurement vendors to keep AP at the forefront of measurement innovation.

Strategic Consulting & Problem Solving

• Lead analytical workstreams for enterprise clients, including programme audits and strategic reviews.

• Support growth strategies, forecasting, partner valuation models and opportunity assessments.

• Translate complex datasets into actionable commercial recommendations.

• Partner with senior client stakeholders across Marketing, Analytics, Finance and Data Science teams.

Data Products & Capability Development • Define and own AP's data and analytics roadmap.

• Partner with Strategy and AI teams to identify opportunities for automation and AI-enabled insights.

• Lead development of scalable reporting frameworks, dashboards, benchmarking products and measurement tools. • Drive innovation across APVision and future analytical capabilities.

Data Enablement & Industry Thought Leadership

• Increase data literacy across Account Management, Strategy and Sales teams through training programmes, workshops and playbooks.

• Coach teams to ask better questions, interpret data effectively and communicate insights to clients.

• Represent AP externally as a thought leader on measurement and analytics, speaking at conferences, webinars and client forums.

• Produce thought leadership on attribution, incrementality, MMM, AI and partnership measurement, and build relationships with key industry vendors and platforms.

What Success Looks Like:

By 6 Months

The Director has built strong relationships with key enterprise client stakeholders and is actively advising on measurement strategy and programme audits. They have an established working relationship with their Data Strategist and a clear view of AP's data and analytics roadmap. Early training and enablement sessions have begun to raise data literacy across Account Management and Strategy teams.

By 1 Year

The Director is recognized internally and externally as AP's leading voice on measurement and analytics. Clients are adopting AP's measurement recommendations, and client satisfaction and retention have improved. The Director has contributed to new business wins, launched at least one new analytical product or framework, and represented AP at industry events. Data literacy and standardized analytical frameworks are visible across the organization, and the Data Strategist is developing well under their mentorship.

Qualities of the Ideal Candidate:

• Strategic thinker, comfortable operating with ambiguity

• Strong communicator and storyteller, able to simplify complex concepts for non-technical audiences

• Commercially minded

• Collaborative and influential across teams and seniority levels

• Naturally curious and innovative

• Confident representing AP as an external thought leader

Minimum Qualifications & Skills:

• 8–12+ years of experience in analytics, measurement, marketing science, consulting or data strategy

• Experience working with enterprise clients and advising senior stakeholders and executive teams

• Strong understanding of affiliate, influencer, digital marketing or performance marketing

• Experience leading teams and developing talent

• Strong understanding of Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM), attribution methodologies and incrementality testing

• Proficiency with Google Analytics, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and Business Intelligence/dashboarding tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker or similar)

• Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and AI-enabled analytics

• SQL and data querying experience preferred

WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS?

Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content, and B2B partnership marketing.

AP PERKS & BENEFITS – WHAT WE OFFER

  • 100% remote work for everyone 
  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage insurance (with opt-out benefits) 
  • 401K with matching 
  • Open Paid Time Off 
  • Summer & Holiday Wellness Breaks in July and December 
  • Volunteer and Birthday Time Off 
  • Focus Fridays 
  • Paid Parental Leave Benefits 
  • Wellness, Technology & Education Allowances 
  • Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more!! 
  • Target base salary is £65K - £85K depending on location and experience.

Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location.

title: Automation & Industrialization Director
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

Harmattan AI is moving from rapid product development and early serial production into high-volume industrial scale-up. Products, production volumes and manufacturing sites are evolving simultaneously.

The next phase requires a Senior Automation & Industrialisation Director who can translate engineering designs and volume requirements into robust, scalable and where justified increasingly automated production systems, while providing strong technical leadership to a diversely skilled team.

The objective is to strengthen both Harmattan AI's industrialisation capability and the technical maturity of the team, enabling the organisation to scale from today's manual and semi-automated processes toward significantly higher volumes and international manufacturing.

 

Responsibilities

The role will own the Automation & Industrialisation roadmap, including:

  • Industrialisation of new products from prototype through stable serial production.

  • DFM/DFA and Design for Automation with Engineering.

  • Production process and line architecture.

  • Workstations, tooling, fixtures, test equipment and semi-automated production systems.

  • Automation concepts, specifications, supplier selection, commissioning and ramp-up.

  • PFMEA, process validation and production-readiness activities.

  • Cycle-time, capacity, line balancing, yield and labour-content optimisation.

  • Identification of the correct automation level based on volume, maturity, quality, flexibility and ROI.

  • Standardisation and replication of production systems across Harmattan AI manufacturing sites.

  • Development of the manufacturing technology roadmap toward significantly higher production volumes.

 

Candidate Requirements

  • 15-20+ years of relevant industrial experience (ideally in aerospace, defence, advanced electronics, or mechatronics) and has personally taken complex electromechanical products from prototype into high-volume or rapidly scaling serial production

  • Ideally, combined experience from a highly developed industrial organisation with experience in a startup/scale-up, defence-tech, UAV, robotics or similarly fast-moving hardware environment.

  • Hands-on experience with semi-automated and automated assembly systems, PLC-controlled equipment (Siemens preferred), and industrial tooling.

  • Solid understanding of DFM/DFA, PFMEA, and lean manufacturing principles.

  • Adaptability & Mobility: Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced, dynamic environment; embraces a “no-task-is-too-small” mentality. Willingness to travel and work flexible schedules (evenings/weekends as needed).

  • Communication & Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication, capable of leading diverse principals – from junior members to senior executives.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Backbone Fibre Connectivity Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

The role

As Backbone Fibre Connectivity Lead, you will lead delivery of the long-haul fibre that links Volta's AI factories and network locations. You will manage backbone route delivery across the portfolio, making sure capacity is in place, physically diverse and accepted before sites need it.

This is an expert-level individual contributor role, reporting to the Senior Director, Global Network Connectivity Delivery. You will drive alignment and set the delivery strategy for backbone delivery across network, procurement and site teams. Your view on route risk and diversity will directly steer commercial and network decisions.

What you will do

Backbone delivery

  • Own delivery of long-haul and inter-site backbone routes across Europe and North America to meet Volta’s requirements.

  • Manage carriers through complex processes including wayleaves, civils, PoP access and interconnection.

  • Escalate and recover routes that threaten facility turn-up, proactively leading recovery plans or identifying alternative routing options.

  • Lead network feasibility studies and outcomes for site due diligence.

Standards and commercial input

  • Set Volta's standards for backbone delivery and acceptance, including diversity evidence and optical test requirements.

  • Assess carrier proposals and route options, and advise Procurement and Legal on leased fibre, IRU and transport deals.

Handover

  • Ensure operational readiness, making sure restoration paths, support protocols, and records are fully prepared for Network Operations.

What we are looking for

  • Expert-level experience delivering long-haul fibre, backbone or carrier infrastructure, typically 9 to 12 years.

  • A proven track record of owning end-to-end backbone delivery across multiple complex routes or geographic regions.

  • Strong knowledge of dark fibre, managed transport, optical infrastructure and route diversity.

  • Commercial strength with carriers and IRU or leased fibre agreements.

  • Ability to influence network architecture, procurement and leadership decisions.

Nice to have

  • Experience in Hyperscale or data centre connectivity portfolios.

  • Optical transport systems and interconnection ecosystems.

  • Experience in International fibre procurement.

What We Offer

At Volta, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted and able to grow. We're building a company where you can make an impact, keep a healthy balance between work and life, and build a career you're proud of.
As a global team, we do our best to provide great benefits wherever you're based. While some benefits vary by country due to local regulations, we believe looking after our people is simply the right thing to do.

  • Competitive salary based on the work you do here, not your previous salary

  • Equity in Volta, giving you the opportunity to share in the company's long-term success

  • Retirement/pension contributions

  • Comprehensive health, wellbeing and insurance benefits

  • Generous number of vacation days each year

Additional Information

Background Checks

All offers of employment at Volta are conditional on the satisfactory completion of pre-employment screening, which includes confirmation of your right to work, verification of your employment history and a criminal record check, where this is permitted by local law. title: Backend Developer (Python, Java)
descriptionHtml:
Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we've been building that knowledge for over 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we're also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax advisors don't just get an answer, but an answer they're willing to attach their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it daily, generating over 100 million euros in ARR across Europe. We're looking for a Medior Backend Developer to help build that.

HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD

Lawyers and tax advisors ask a question in GenIA-L and get a reliable answer. That answer is what they see. What you build is everything needed to make it happen: the backend. These are the systems and connections that keep our AI product fast, secure and reliable. You join the AI team and work with our AI engineers every day. They make the product smart; you make sure that intelligence actually reaches the user. After six months, you know the code well and have shipped several new features. After that, you choose the direction you want to grow in: more towards AI, for example by improving the quality of our AI answers, or more towards DevOps, for example by improving how we automatically test and release software.

  • You build and maintain the backend of our main AI product, together with our AI engineers.

  • You build APIs and services: the connections that let the different parts of the platform talk to each other.

  • You keep an eye on code quality and make sure we follow good practices and standards.

  • You monitor and maintain our live applications and fix problems when something goes wrong.

  • You bring your own ideas on how to improve the product and the way we work.

  • You are proactive, enthusiastic, and take initiative.

  • You communicate clearly and confidently, conveying information in a concise and engaging manner.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • You pick up your work independently. You don’t need much guidance, but you know when to involve a colleague.

  • You have opinions and you are not afraid to share them.

  • And you enjoy working with AI specialists on a product that is still very much in development.

  • At least 3 years of experience building Python applications that run in production and are actually used by customers.

  • Experience with FastAPI and Pydantic. Experience with LangChain or LangGraph is a plus.

  • You have built production-grade APIs that work reliably for real users.

  • You work independently within a team and don’t need hand-holding.

  • Knowledge of Postgres, GraphQL or MongoDB is a plus.

  • Some DevOps knowledge is nice to have, for example working with GitHub Actions and Helm.

WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR

You join the AI team with one other backend engineer, three AI engineers and a Product Owner. You also work closely with the search team, the frontend team and our backend and AI leads. You report to our Lead Backend Engineer. You get a lot of freedom and room for your own opinions and ideas, in a fun team with a good work-life balance. And you can grow into a Senior or Lead Backend Engineer role.

  • A monthly base salary up to €5500 and a standard 36-hour working week.

  • An end-of-year bonus of 4% of your gross annual salary and a variable profit share of up to 6% of your gross annual salary.

  • 23 holidays and a 12% personal benefits budget, of which 8% is holiday allowance and 4% you can spend freely, for example on extra days off.

  • A good pension plan through PGB, including additional partner insurance.

  • A travel allowance of €0.25 per kilometre or a public transport allowance, plus an attractive bike scheme. For employees who travel less than 10 km or more than 60 km, we have an adjusted arrangement.

  • Hybrid working: two days a week at our office in The Hague, on Tuesday and Thursday.

  • Room to grow. In your field, in your role, in the organisation.

WANT TO KNOW MORE?

We'd love to tell you all about the team and the role. Send us your CV and you'll hear from us within a few business days. Have a few questions first? Message or call Nadine at 0628556265.

A reference check and a VOG (certificate of good behaviour) are part of the selection process.
