title: Clinical Recruiter at AIOS- Remote, $100-200k inc equity
descriptionHtml:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving 200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Clinical Recruiter at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team.

As Clinical Recruiter at AIOS, your fundamental role is to make sure every pharmacy we run in Europe is staffed with great clinicians before we need them.

You’ll own clinical hiring across Bolt Pharmacy in the UK and our new pharmacy in the Netherlands. That means our UK Superintendent Pharmacist, 2 clinical team leads, at least 11 UK clinical hires, and the full Netherlands clinical team in Q1.

You don’t wait for seats to open. You build pipelines of pharmacists, technicians and clinical leaders ahead of demand, so new sites launch on time and backfills come from people you already know.

You run every search end to end: sourcing, screening, registration checks, and closing. You also run our clinical recruiting agencies and hold them to our bar. Sloppy screening puts patients and our pharmacies at risk, so your standards are relentless.

Great performance in this role means our pharmacies scale across Europe without staffing ever being the bottleneck.

This is a full-time, fully remote role based in the UK or EU, and you’ll work mostly async — as long as you’re available during UK/EU working hours for candidate and site calls, with some overlap into US Central mornings as needed. You’ll have flex in your calendar for kids if you have them — many of our team have kids so we’re kid-friendly.

This is an individual contributor role. You’ll report directly to our People Lead, Europe (Zoe Wheeler). We’re intense, so you’ll also be intense.

You’ll also work closely with our Head of People (Cierra Olson), our UK Clinical Ops Lead ([Name TBD]), and our Netherlands site leaders ([Name TBD]).

Key responsibilities

  • Clinical pipelines: You build standing pipelines of pharmacists, technicians and clinical leaders for the UK and the Netherlands, so we hire ahead of need, not after a seat is empty.

  • UK pharmacy leadership: You hire our UK Superintendent Pharmacist and 2 clinical team leads.

  • UK clinical staffing: You fill at least 11 UK clinical roles and keep backfills moving.

  • Netherlands launch: You stand up the Netherlands clinical team in Q1.

  • Registration checks: You verify GPhC (UK) and BIG register (NL) status, right to work, and background checks on every hire.

  • Agency management: You run our two European clinical agencies, screen what they send, and hold them to our bar.

  • Hiring manager partnership: You build scorecards and interview loops with site and clinical leaders, and keep feedback fast.

  • Ashby: You run every clinical search in Ashby with clean stages and data we can trust.

KPIs

  • Time to fill: days from role open to accepted offer. Target:

  • Pipeline coverage: qualified, registration-checked candidates ready for each open or upcoming clinical role. Target:

  • Quality of hire: clinical hires still in seat and performing at 90 days. Target:

Need to have

  • Clinical recruiting: You’ve recruited pharmacists, pharmacy technicians or other registered clinicians, and can show the hires you closed.

  • UK pharmacy knowledge: You understand GPhC registration and roles like superintendent and responsible pharmacist.

  • European reach: You’ve hired in the Netherlands or can credibly source there, and you understand the BIG register.

  • Senior and volume: You can run senior clinical leadership searches and volume clinical hiring at the same time.

  • Full-cycle ownership: You source, screen, offer and close yourself.

  • Pipeline builder: You build relationships with candidates before roles open.

  • Agency management: You know how to brief, calibrate and hold agencies accountable.

  • Integrity: You never cut corners on checks. A missed registration issue is not a small mistake.

This is a bad fit for you if you’ve only recruited for corporate or tech roles, or you’d rather manage agencies than source and close candidates yourself.

Nice to have

  • Dutch: You speak Dutch.

  • New sites: You’ve staffed a new pharmacy or clinical site from zero.

  • Digital health: You’ve hired for an online pharmacy, telehealth or digital health company.

  • Locum networks: You have relationships with UK locum pharmacists and agencies.

  • Agentic: You see what needs doing and do it, without waiting to be asked.

  • AI-native: You use AI tools to source, screen and write faster than most recruiters can.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2030 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.


🎯

"You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: $100k–$200k/yr inc equity

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

title: Cloud Engineer  - CDI Paris - Theodo Cloud
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Theodo Cloud est la practice DevSecOps de Theodo, spécialisée dans la construction d’infrastructures et la cybersécurité cloud. Notre mission : aider les scale-ups et grands comptes à résoudre leurs problématiques business grâce à la tech. Nos équipes construisent des infrastructures scalables, résilientes et sécurisées pour les développeurs et les utilisateurs finaux. L’objectif : faire de l’infrastructure un levier de croissance plutôt qu’un frein. Pionniers de la conteneurisation, nous plaçons aujourd'hui l'innovation au cœur de notre approche Cloud. Nous concevons des offres qui adressent les enjeux les plus actuels du secteur :
  • Accélérer les migrations et modernisations Cloud grâce à l'IA pour créer de la valeur au plus vite.
  • Construire et infogérer des environnements d'industries régulées (ex : HDS pour la santé, SecNumCloud) sans sacrifier le time to market.
  • ⁠Exploiter tout le potentiel des LLMs tout en optimisant la performance cloud, les coûts et la sûreté industrielle.

Ton équipe : L’équipe technique de Theodo Cloud est constituée de deux pôles : - le pôle Build, dédié à nos projets de création, migration et optimisation d’infrastructures - le pôle Run, dédié à l’infogérance des infrastructures de nos clients Au build, tu travailles main dans la main avec un ou une Lead DevOps et un ou une Agile Project Manager pour garantir l’impact de tes actions chez nos clients. Au run, tu rejoins une équipe d’une quinzaine de personnes avec laquelle tu gères un portefeuille de clients. L’équipe run dispose également d’un volet build, dédié à l’amélioration continue des plateformes de nos clients. Nous déterminerons ensemble à l’issue de l’entretien RH le pôle sur lequel nous pouvons te positionner. Tes futures missions : En tant que Cloud Engineer, tu travailles sur des infrastructures cloud en suivant les bonnes pratiques techniques et les standards définis par l’équipe. Au run les missions consistent à : - Réagir aux incidents en production et mener des investigations techniques approfondies - Réaliser les post-mortem et assurer une communication claire et structurée avec les clients - Répondre aux interrogations des clients et formuler des recommandations actionnables pour améliorer la qualité, la fiabilité, la sécurité et la performance de leur infrastructure - Concevoir et découper techniquement des fonctionnalités adaptées aux contraintes projet (qualité, coût, délais) Au build tu apprendras à comprendre et répondre aux besoins d’un client sur sa stratégie d’infrastructure : - montage d’infrastructure from scratch - migrations Cloud et Kubernetes - mise en place de pipelines de CI/CD - mise en place d’outils de monitoring et d’alerting - apport des bonnes pratiques DevOps chez nos clients - participation active aux rituels agiles (Scrum) de l’équipe projet La réalisation d’astreintes est également possible, elle se fait sur la base du volontariat. Ce poste de Cloud Engineer est fait pour les personnes curieuses qui veulent monter en compétences rapidement, au contact d’un large panel d’infrastructures et d’outils (AWS, GCP, Azure, Scaleway, Outscale, OVH, …) et de bugs complexes en production. Theodo Cloud est encore une jeune entreprise où il y a de la place pour construire des choses. En parallèle de ton projet, tu auras du temps dédié pour t’investir sur des sujets qui te tiennent à cœur : la formation des équipes business, la diversité, ou le recrutement technique… Tes perspectives d’évolution : La première étape d’évolution chez Theodo Cloud est de devenir Lead, et de devenir ainsi garant de la stratégie technique et de la montée en compétences de ton équipe. Nous proposons ensuite deux tracks d’évolution possibles : - une track Management, qui t’emmènera vers un rôle d’Engineering Manager - une track Expertise, qui te permettra d’accéder à un rôle de Staff Engineer Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu : Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits. Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. Profil recherché : - Tu disposes d’une solide formation en école d’ingénieur, avec une première expérience en infrastructures Cloud (Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, AWS, GCP...) - Tu fais preuve de rigueur, d’une bonne gestion du stress, et sais intervenir efficacement sur des environnements de production - Tu as l’envie de progresser rapidement et de travailler en équipe Tu ne coches pas 100% des critères mais tu penses tout de même correspondre à notre recherche ? Ne t’auto-censure pas et envoie-nous ta candidature, on se fera un plaisir de l’étudier ! Pour information : - Le poste est proposé en CDI, basé depuis nos locaux à Paris. - Le salaire proposé dépend du niveau d’expérience de chacun : nous en parlons toujours dès le premier appel téléphonique. Déroulement des entretiens : Nous répondons à toutes les candidatures dans un délai de 2 jours. Si ton parcours retient notre attention, voici le process qu’on te propose : - un appel téléphonique de 30 minutes avec un membre de l’équipe recrutement, pour comprendre tes critères de recherche - un entretien d’une heure avec le recruteur ou la recruteuse avec qui tu as échangé à la première étape, pour parler plus en détail de la culture Theodo - un entretien de technique théorique de 45 minutes - un entretien technique de debug de 45 minutes - un échange de 30 minutes avec un membre de l’équipe dirigeante Notre process dure 1 semaine en moyenne. Tu seras accompagné(e) par un membre de l’équipe recrutement, qui sera là pour te coacher tout au long du process.Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo Cloud ? L'environnement : 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 Prime d’intéressement indexée sur la croissance de Theodo 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile Prêt à nous rejoindre ?

title: CMM-Programmierer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Isembard

Isembard baut ein Netzwerk hochleistungsfähiger Fabriken für kritische Industrien auf. Wir verbinden moderne Werkzeugmaschinen, Robotik und unsere eigene Software MasonOS, um Präzisionsteile für Unternehmen aus Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung, Energie und Zukunftstechnologien zu fertigen, mit Fabriken in Großbritannien, den USA, Deutschland und Frankreich. Unsere Mission: industrielle Beschleunigung schmieden.

Die Rolle

Du verantwortest die Messtechnik in unserer Hamburger Fabrik, von der CMM-Programmierung über die Erstmusterprüfung bis zur Ursachenanalyse bei Abweichungen und der Audit-Vorbereitung.

Du baust die Qualitätssicherung auf, statt eine bestehende zu übernehmen: Prüfprogramme, Tast- und Bezugsstrategien, Messmittelüberwachung und wie Qualitätsdaten zurück in die Zerspanung und in MasonOS fließen. Du programmierst es, du misst es, du gibst es frei.

Deine Aufgaben

  • CMM-Prüfprogramme in PC-DMIS, Zeiss Calypso oder vergleichbar für komplexe Teile mit engen Toleranzen entwickeln und optimieren.

  • Erstmusterprüfungen (EN 9102), fertigungsbegleitende Prüfungen und Endfreigaben für Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung und Energie durchführen.

  • Taststrategie, Spannkonzept und Bezugssysteme festlegen und Prüfvorrichtungen bei Bedarf selbst auslegen.

  • Ursachen von Abweichungen finden und die Korrekturmaßnahme mit Zerspanern und CAM-Programmierern zurück an die Maschine bringen.

  • Kalibrierung aller Messmittel verantworten und die Dokumentation nach EN 9100 audit-fest führen.

Was du mitbringst

  • Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der CMM-Programmierung in der Präzisionsfertigung, Luft- und Raumfahrt oder einem Zerspanungsbetrieb.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit PC-DMIS und/oder Zeiss Calypso.

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in GD&T und ISO GPS, sicher mit 3D-CAD-Modellen der Kunden.

  • Prüfdokumentation aus der Luft- und Raumfahrt: FAI, AS9102 oder EN 9102.

  • Du prüfst und sicherst Toleranzen von ±0,01 mm und enger ab.

Schön wäre

  • Aufbau einer Qualitätssicherung von Grund auf oder eine begleitete EN 9100- oder AS9100-Zertifizierung.

  • GD&T-Zertifizierung oder eine Qualifikation in Qualitätssicherung.

  • Werkzeugmaschinenintegriertes Messen auf 5-Achs-Maschinen mit Regelkreis-Korrektur.

  • SPC und Prozessfähigkeitsanalyse.

  • Etwas Englisch, für die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Teams in Großbritannien und den USA.

Warum Isembard

  • Die Qualitätssicherung einer neuen Fabrik ab Tag eins verantworten.

  • Sicherheitskritische Bauteile für Luft- und Raumfahrt und Verteidigung.

  • Prüfstandards setzen, die unser Netzwerk übernimmt.

  • Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und Equity.

Standort: Vor Ort in unserer Fabrik in Hamburg.

Isembard steht für Chancengleichheit. Bewerbungen auf Deutsch oder Englisch sind willkommen.

title: CNC Turner / Tourneur CNC
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


[Version française plus bas]


You will be responsible for setting up, programming, and operating CNC lathes to manufacture critical aerospace components, including valve parts, pump components, and shafts.

Working from engineering drawings and manufacturing instructions, you will create and adjust programs directly at the machine, select tooling, prepare setups, and perform turning operations. You will machine materials such as stainless steel, aluminium, titanium, and Inconel, ensuring that parts meet dimensional and surface finish requirements.

The role focuses on hands-on machining and programming at the CNC control. English communication skills are expected for everyday exchanges with our international teams.

Your Responsibilities

  • Create, modify, and optimise CNC turning programs directly at the machine.

  • Set up CNC lathes, including workholding, cutting tools, and tool offsets.

  • Perform turning operations independently, from initial setup through to finished parts.

  • Select suitable cutting tools and machining parameters for each material and operation.

  • Manufacture precision components to drawing specifications, including tight tolerances and surface finish requirements.

  • Perform first-piece and in-process inspections using appropriate measuring equipment.

  • Adjust programs, offsets, and cutting parameters to maintain quality throughout production.

  • Use the band saw to prepare raw material when required.

  • Follow manufacturing instructions and record inspection results to maintain traceability.

  • Carry out first-level maintenance and keep machines and workstations clean and organised.

  • Report machining issues and provide practical feedback to the workshop lead and engineering teams.


Your Profile

  • Vocational or technical qualification in machining, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Proven experience as a CNC turner, with the ability to set up machines and program directly at the CNC control.

  • Proficiency in ISO/G-code and/or conversational programming.

  • Ability to read engineering drawings and interpret dimensional tolerances, geometric tolerances, and surface finish requirements.

  • Experience machining stainless steel, aluminium, titanium, or nickel-based alloys.

  • Confidence using precision measuring instruments and checking your own work.

  • Experience with driven tooling and Y-axis operations and mill turn would be an advantage.

  • Autonomous, practical, and quality-focused, with careful attention to detail.

  • Ability to communicate in English with colleagues from other teams.


Why You’ll Love Working With Us?

  • A hands-on role with responsibility for your parts, from setup and programming through to final inspection.

  • Direct involvement in manufacturing components for next-generation space vehicles and propulsion systems.

  • A modern workshop producing varied and technically challenging parts.

  • Opportunities to develop your machining skills within a growing manufacturing team.

  • A multicultural, international team passionate about space exploration.


////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

Vos missions

Vous serez chargé(e) de régler, programmer et conduire des tours à commande numérique pour fabriquer des composants aérospatiaux critiques, notamment des pièces de vannes, des composants de pompes et des arbres.


À partir de plans d’ingénierie et d’instructions de fabrication, vous créerez et ajusterez les programmes directement sur la machine, sélectionnerez l’outillage, préparerez les montages et réaliserez les opérations de tournage. Vous usinerez des matériaux tels que l’acier inoxydable, l’aluminium, le titane et l’Inconel, en veillant à ce que les pièces respectent les exigences dimensionnelles et d’état de surface.


Le poste est centré sur l’usinage et la programmation directement sur la commande numérique. Une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais est attendue pour les échanges quotidiens avec nos équipes internationales.


Vos responsabilités

  • Créer, modifier et optimiser les programmes de tournage CN directement sur la machine.

  • Régler les tours CN, y compris le montage de la pièce, les outils de coupe et les correcteurs d’outils.

  • Réaliser les opérations de tournage de manière autonome, du réglage initial jusqu’à la pièce finie.

  • Choisir les outils de coupe et les paramètres d’usinage adaptés à chaque matériau et à chaque opération.

  • Fabriquer des pièces de précision conformément aux spécifications des plans, y compris des tolérances serrées et des exigences d’état de surface.

  • Effectuer les contrôles de première pièce et en cours de production à l’aide des moyens de mesure appropriés.

  • Ajuster les programmes, les correcteurs et les paramètres de coupe pour maintenir la qualité tout au long de la production.

  • Utiliser la scie à ruban pour préparer la matière brute lorsque nécessaire.

  • Suivre les instructions de fabrication et consigner les résultats de contrôle afin d’assurer la traçabilité.

  • Réaliser la maintenance de premier niveau et maintenir les machines et les postes de travail propres et bien rangés.

  • Signaler les problèmes d’usinage et partager des retours pratiques avec le responsable d’atelier et les équipes d’ingénierie.


Votre profil

  • Formation professionnelle ou technique en usinage, ou expérience pratique équivalente.

  • Expérience avérée en tant que tourneur CN, avec la capacité de régler les machines et de programmer directement sur la commande numérique.

  • Maîtrise de la programmation ISO/code G et/ou de la programmation conversationnelle.

  • Capacité à lire des plans d’ingénierie et à interpréter les tolérances dimensionnelles, les tolérances géométriques et les exigences d’état de surface.

  • Expérience de l’usinage de l’acier inoxydable, de l’aluminium, du titane ou des alliages à base de nickel.

  • Aisance dans l’utilisation d’instruments de mesure de précision et dans le contrôle de son propre travail.

  • Une expérience des outils tournants, des opérations sur axe Y et du tournage-fraisage (mill-turn) serait un atout.

  • Autonome, pragmatique et orienté(e) qualité, avec un grand sens du détail.

  • Capacité à communiquer en anglais avec des collègues d’autres équipes.


Pourquoi vous allez adorer travailler avec nous ?

  • Un poste très opérationnel, avec la responsabilité de vos pièces, du réglage et de la programmation jusqu’au contrôle final.

  • Une implication directe dans la fabrication de composants pour les véhicules spatiaux et les systèmes de propulsion de nouvelle génération.

  • Un atelier moderne produisant des pièces variées et techniquement exigeantes.

  • Des opportunités de développer vos compétences en usinage au sein d’une équipe de fabrication en pleine croissance.

  • Une équipe multiculturelle et internationale, passionnée par l’exploration spatiale.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. title: Commercial Counsel
descriptionHtml:
This role can be office-based in Freiburg, Germany or remote-first, with a requirement to be in the office one full week per month.

About Black Forest Labs

We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world.

Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use.

Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next.

Why This Role

We are looking for a sharp, motivated, commercially minded Commercial Counsel to join BFL’s legal team. You will support a broad range of commercial transactions across our EU and US go-to-market deals. This is a high-ownership role in which you will draft, review, and negotiate agreements, and help structure and maintain operations across the legal and go-to-market teams.

This is an exciting opportunity for a lawyer who wants to work at the cutting edge of AI: advising on novel agreement structures for foundational generative AI models, negotiating complex licensing and API deals, and helping build the legal and commercial infrastructure of a high-growth company.

What You’ll Work On

  • Partner closely with the GTM, Marketing, FDE, Infrastructure, and Finance teams to negotiate contracts and provide practical, deal-enabling legal advice

  • Support EU (and, as needed, US and UK) commercial transactions, focusing primarily on EU-centric deals across a variety of industry verticals, and advise on German corporate law

  • Contribute to company-wide compliance and legal operations initiatives as the legal team scales

  • Help develop and maintain scalable legal frameworks, contract templates, playbooks, and approval workflows

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of legal experience, including commercial transactions in the technology sector, ideally spanning both in-house roles and private practice. Start-up or high-growth company experience would be an advantage.

  • Demonstrated experience negotiating and closing complex technology agreements, including software licensing, API and platform deals, data and content agreements, and partnership contracts.

  • Prior experience supporting EU commercial deals, with comfort navigating cross-border transactions and a strong awareness of key jurisdictional differences.

  • Excellent drafting and negotiation skills, with the ability to identify material issues quickly and communicate them clearly to non-lawyers.

  • Low ego and high accountability: as comfortable rolling up your sleeves on routine agreements as you are handling high-stakes or novel deal structures.

While not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience negotiating robotics, technical manufacturing, and hardware contracts

  • Experience with products subject to export regulation in the EU

  • Experience with AI/ML, developer platforms, or foundational model licensing

  • Exposure to generative AI in prior roles; familiarity with how AI products are built, licensed, and deployed will meaningfully accelerate your effectiveness in this role

  • A JD from an accredited law school and qualification in Germany or the UK

  • Familiarity with German corporate law, the EU AI Act, GDPR, or other international regulatory frameworks relevant to AI and data

  • A background advising on IP, copyright, or data licensing matters in the context of AI training or model development

How We Work Together

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. You’ll be based in Europe and work from your home location, with one week each month spent with us in Freiburg to stay connected with the team.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

  • Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.

Compensation

EU: €150,000 - €200,000 + equity

Note: We may use AI-assisted tools to help organize applications. All hiring decisions are always made by our team.

title: Commercial Executive
descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.


Role Description

Our new product is a business loan for established UK SMEs, with fixed monthly repayments over 3 to 6 years. Most of the businesses we will be speaking to already know us, so the job is to reach the right people, understand what they need and take good applications from first conversation through to a funded loan.

You will be the person who owns that journey day to day: calling and emailing existing customers, running outreach campaigns, collecting the information we need to underwrite, and keeping the pipeline accurate so the team can see what is working. You will work closely with Risk, Legal and Data, and report progress to senior leadership each week.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Make outbound calls to existing and previous customers, hold clear discovery conversations about what they need the funding for, and record every outcome in HubSpot

  • Maintain a consistent follow up routine

  • Collect bank statements or Open Banking connections and any other documents needed, and pass complete applications to Underwriting with the context they need

  • Explain loan terms, pricing, arrangement fees and personal guarantees clearly and accurately, and know when to hand a question to Risk or Compliance rather than answer it yourself

  • Support customers through offer, KYC refresh, legal documents and direct debit set up until the loan is funded

  • Treat declines and customers who are not interested with care, and refer customers elsewhere only with their consent

  • Run outreach campaigns across email, statement emails, SMS, Whatsapp and LinkedIn, working with the Data team on audiences and reviewing the results

  • Keep the CRM up to date, tidy and consistent, including the reason for every rejection or decision not to proceed

  • Provide weekly reports on calls made, conversations held, applications, offers and funded loans, and flag what is and isn't working

  • Work closely with Risk, Legal and Data to keep applications moving and customers well served

  • Comply with all mandatory policies and adhere to operational procedures to maintain internal controls

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • 1-3 years of experience in a commercial business development or relationship role, ideally in lending, finance or fintech

  • Confident and credible on the phone with small business owners and directors, and comfortable making a high volume of calls

  • Clear, accurate written communication, and the discipline to follow up and keep records up to date

  • Strong numerical ability, with the confidence to work with loan amounts, interest rates, terms, repayments and fees

  • Organised, self-directed and able to manage a busy pipeline of customers at different stages

  • Honest and careful about what can and cannot be promised to a customer, in a regulated environment

  • Knowledge of SME lending, including unsecured loans, personal guarantees or government-backed schemes

  • Experience with a CRM such as HubSpot, and with email or SMS campaign tools

  • Familiarity with Open Banking, KYC and credit underwriting processes

  • Experience of working with brokers or introducers

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

title: Commercial Partnerships & Events Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Adclear

At Adclear, we're building the trust layer for how the world's most regulated companies bring products to market. Every bank, lender and investment platform runs into the same invisible pain: compliance review that slows down every campaign, every launch, every idea. We're turning the function that has always said 'no' into infrastructure that says 'yes, and here's how'.

Founded in 2024, we already work with leading innovators and established enterprises including Monzo, Lloyds, PensionBee, Kraken and Coinbase. We've raised 2.6m and we're scaling fast. Now we need someone to take our name into the rooms where our buyers are, and turn those rooms into pipeline.

The role

Field marketing and partnerships are two of the biggest levers in how Adclear goes to market. Our breakfasts, dinners and panels are where compliance and marketing leaders from banks, lenders and fintechs meet us, meet each other, and see what modern compliance looks like. Our partnerships with compliance bodies, industry voices and marketing institutions carry our name into conversations we're not yet part of.

This role owns both, and is measured on what they produce commercially: the right people in the room, warm conversations handed to sales, and opportunities in the pipeline. Running a great event matters, but it's the starting point, not the job.

We run around three events a quarter. You'll decide who we need to reach, build the event or partnership that gets us in front of them, fill it, work the room, and make sure the conversations turn into meetings.

This is an early-stage seat. You'll be a team of one on this, working directly with the founders and commercial team, and you'll pick up whatever it takes to make go-to-market work, even when it isn't strictly on the brief. Have a look at our LinkedIn and socials to see what we already do, then imagine what you'd do with it.

What you'll do

Field marketing

  • Own the field marketing calendar: around three events a quarter across breakfasts, dinners and panels, plus third-party events and conferences where our buyers already gather.

  • Start from the pipeline, not the venue: agree with the founders and sales which accounts and personas each event is for, and design the theme and format to land with them.

  • Fill the room with the right people. Build target lists with sales, invite personally, chase RSVPs and find another way in when the first one doesn't work.

  • Work the room on the day: make introductions, spot buying signals and connect guests with the right person at Adclear.

  • Turn conversations into meetings: run follow-up with sales, so every event produces booked calls and new opportunities.

  • Get the event done well: venue, speakers, run of show, suppliers and budget, without letting logistics become the job.

  • Create the assets yourself where it's quicker: invites, event graphics and social posts.

Partnerships

  • Own relationships with compliance bodies, industry influencers and marketing institutions, from first outreach to co-hosted events, joint content and referrals.

  • Prioritise partners by commercial value: who gives us access to the buyers and accounts we want.

  • Spot and pitch new partnership opportunities, and negotiate what each side gets out of it.

Commercial impact

  • Track what each event and partnership produces: who came, meetings booked, pipeline created, deals influenced.

  • Report back to the founders and use the numbers to decide what we do more of, change, or stop.

  • Pitch in across go-to-market wherever you can add value, from campaigns to content to sales support.

What we're looking for

  • Startup or scale-up experience. You've worked in a small, fast-moving team where you wore several hats and got things done without a big budget or a support team behind you.

  • Commercial instinct. You think in terms of accounts, pipeline and outcomes. You know the difference between a full room and a room full of buyers, and you care about the second.

  • Hustle. You don't wait for RSVPs to arrive. You chase, follow up, and find another way in.

  • Confident with senior people. You're comfortable walking up to a Head of Compliance at a bank, starting a real conversation, and making the right introduction.

  • You can plan an event, write the invite, design the graphic, negotiate with a partner and update the CRM, sometimes all in the same day.

  • Organised under pressure. There's always one event being planned, one being filled and one being followed up. You keep them all moving.

  • Ownership. You treat every event and partnership as yours, including the results.

How we work

  • London, 4 days a week in our Farringdon office.

  • Founders are closely involved day to day, and you'll work directly with them and the commercial team.

  • You own your events and partnerships from day one, including the results.

  • This isn't the right role if you want a fixed lane or a strict 40-hour week. Events mean the occasional early breakfast and late dinner.

Compensation

title: Community Manager

You make sure fellows are well, feel part of a community, and get help quickly when something goes wrong.

Why work at Pivotal

Pivotal finds people who can work on the biggest risks from advanced AI and gets them working on them. Since 2024, 135 fellows have taken part in our fellowships, and alumni now work at METR, Apollo Research, UK AISI and GovAI. We have grown from 2 staff in 2024 to 10 today, and we plan to reach at least 16 in 2027. Read more about us at pivotal-research.org, and about what it is like to work here.

What you will own

You’ll own the health of our community. You support fellows in doing better physically, mentally and socially. By the end of 2027, we may have more than 70 fellows on site at once.

Most of your work is going to be preventive. You find fellows who need support early, support Research Managers to give good day-to-day pastoral care, and make sure each cohort has a good social life. When something serious happens, such as a wellbeing crisis or a conflict, you are the person Research Managers and fellows turn to. That part of the role needs good judgement, discretion and an ability to handle sensitive situations well.

  • Escalation point. Be the person Research Managers and fellows go to for serious wellbeing or conflict issues, as set out in our community health policy.

  • Early support. Run short check-ins or a survey before each cohort starts, to find fellows who need support early.

  • Policies and training. Keep our community health and conduct policies current, and train Research Managers to give day-to-day pastoral support.

  • Community life. Make sure each cohort has a good social life, for example through fellow social leads with a small budget, and work with the Fellowships Generalist on events.

  • Wellbeing across programs. Track wellbeing across cohorts and propose changes to program design.

Who does well in this role

  • Experience in community health, pastoral care, HR or a similar role.

  • Good judgement and discretion with sensitive information.

  • You stay calm in difficult situations, and you keep clear boundaries.

  • You care about reducing catastrophic risks.

We don’t expect anyone to be strong in all of this. If the role excites you, please apply, even if you match only part of what we describe here.

How we hire

We review applications as they come in, so applying early helps. The process has these stages:

  • Work trial and references. Up to three paid days working with us at our office in London. We also speak to two referees, after asking you.

title: Compliance and Quality Coordinator (FTC)
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

The Company

CLARK UK is a high-growth Insurtech company which is part of the pan-European Insurtech group, CLARK. The company aims to improve how protection is handled and has a lively, friendly team that is dedicated to protecting individuals and families. The company culture blends innovation and high performance with a fun work environment.

The Opportunity

To support CLARK UK to satisfy its FCA regulatory requirements. Focussing on quality and efficiency, you will be involved in key areas of the compliance, quality assurance, and customer operations functions.

Focussing on good customer outcomes, you will work with the Head of Compliance & Customer Outcomes and relevant interdepartmental stakeholders to enhance, implement, and maintain these areas. This role is intentionally broad and agile, flexing across Financial Promotions, Quality Assurance (QA), and Customer Complaints / Resolutions based on immediate operational volume and business need.

Please note that this is a temporary role, offered on a fixed-term contract to cover a period of maternity leave. The expected duration and end date of the contract will be confirmed in your contract of employment.

Your tasks

1. Financial Promotions

  • Conduct compliance reviews and approvals of marketing campaigns, customer communications, web pages, and app screens in line with FCA rules, Consumer Duty, and internal SLA timelines.
  • Liaise with marketing and commercial teams to coordinate the re-approval of expiring promotions and maintain the centralised review tracker.
  • Perform periodic and annual compliance reviews across digital channels and public-facing content.

2. Quality Assurance (QA)

  • Perform regular QA call and interaction monitoring (including Demodesk sessions) to evaluate regulatory compliance, process adherence, and customer outcomes.
  • Identify training needs, operational weaknesses, and knowledge gaps through data analysis and calibration sessions.
  • Provide clear, constructive feedback and contribute to monthly QA insight packs for operational managers.
  • Support targeted quality review campaigns and internal audits focused on specific customer risks.

3. Customer Complaints & Resolutions

  • Investigate and resolve day-to-day and escalated customer complaints in accordance with FCA DISP rules and internal timescales.
  • Deliver fair, empathetic customer resolutions, collaborating across Operations, Underwriting, and Legal to gather evidence.
  • Monitor and respond to customer feedback on public review platforms (e.g. Trustpilot), identifying root causes and non-disclosures to prevent recurring issues.

4. Governance & Operational Support

  • Assist with compliance policy updates, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and centralised CPD/training record keeping.
  • Escalate emerging risks, conduct concerns, or regulatory breaches promptly to the Head of Compliance.
  • Provide flexible ad hoc operational and administrative support across Customer Operations as volume dictates.

What you bring

  • Industry Background: Experience in UK regulated financial services (insurance or consumer credit preferred).
  • Multi-Skilled Exposure: Practical familiarity with financial promotions reviews, QA monitoring, and/or complaint handling.
  • Regulatory Understanding: Working knowledge of FCA rules, including the Conduct Rules, Consumer Duty, and DISP.
  • Analytical & Detail-Oriented: Strong eye for detail with the ability to identify patterns, evaluate risk, and extract root-cause insights.
  • Communication: Clear, professional verbal and written communication skills with experience delivering constructive feedback and balanced customer letters.
  • Agility & Proactivity: High flexibility to pivot between compliance, quality, and operational tasks as business needs shift.

Regulatory Compliance and Conduct Expectations

Accountability for maintaining a compliant culture is shared across all levels of the organisation. Your role contributes directly to ensuring that we operate within the regulatory framework set out by the FCA and all employees are expected to understand and adhere to the company’s regulated responsibilities.

This includes:

  • Acting with honesty, integrity, with due skill and diligence, in accordance with the FCA’s Conduct Rules.
  • Carrying out your role in a manner that supports the company’s compliance with all applicable regulations and internal policies.
  • Escalating any concerns or potential breaches of regulatory requirements to the appropriate line manager or compliance team without delay. (efficiency)
  • Completing mandatory compliance training, including maintaining a CPD record and remaining up to date with any changes in regulatory requirements relevant to your role. (growth)

Your Benefits - Why CLARK

  • 24 Days of Annual Leave
  • 1 Wellbeing Day
  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Death in Service
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Perkbox

and more!

Why CLARK? Because YOU matter here
What makes us special: at CLARK, you can simply be yourself. Our dress code? Come as you are! Because diversity and equal opportunity are more than just words to us – they shape our daily work.
In other words: no matter where you come from or how you tick, as a CLARKee, you’ll experience an open work environment where you can realize your potential, share your ideas, and truly make an impact.
Sounds like your kind of place? Then we’re looking forward to meeting you!

title: Compliance Manager - Credit
descriptionHtml:
Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.

About the role

Pillar Labs Ltd is LemFi's regulated credit entity, and this is its core compliance hire. You'll sit inside a small, growing second-line function, reporting directly to the Compliance Lead and MLRO (SMF16/SMF17). The role spans the full width of a consumer credit business: day-to-day conduct oversight, financial crime, Consumer Duty, financial promotions, FCA returns and deputy MLRO cover. It's broad by design, because the function is lean and the business is building.


This is a hands-on role with real visibility. You'll give practical regulatory advice to Customer Support, Collections and Complaints, review and approve customer-facing content before it goes live, carry out first review of financial crime escalations and internal SARs, and prepare the MI that lands in front of the Board and ExCo. You'll also work directly with the SMF16/17 on new product launches, regulatory change and FCA engagement. If you want to own a wide brief in a business you can actually see growing, this is it.

What you'll build and own

  • Deliver day-to-day second-line oversight across complaints handling (DISP), collections and arrears (CONC 7) and customer support, reporting findings and themes to the SMF16/17

  • Review and approve all customer-facing content before it goes live: marketing, app journeys, servicing emails, arrears communications and partner promotions, assessed against the financial promotions rules, Consumer Duty and the CAP Code

  • Act as deputy MLRO: carry out first review of financial crime alerts, escalations and internal SARs, prepare them for MLRO decision, and cover MLRO duties when needed

  • Run Consumer Duty outcomes monitoring and testing, including vulnerable customer identification and support, and prepare the Board and ExCo MI pack

  • Prepare scheduled FCA returns and ad hoc data requests ready for sign-off, and maintain the compliance breach log, issues log and actions tracker

  • Carry out day-to-day oversight of third parties, including vendor due diligence and ongoing monitoring (IARs)

  • Support the SMF16/17 on new product and product change reviews, regulatory change projects and the firm's financial crime framework, using AI tooling to move faster on drafting, analysis and QA

Your experience

  • 3 or more years in a compliance role at an FCA-regulated firm, with direct exposure to consumer credit products

  • Hands-on financial crime experience: reviewing alerts and escalations, drafting or reviewing internal SARs, and solid working knowledge of POCA and the Money Laundering Regulations

  • Practical experience reviewing and approving financial promotions and customer-facing communications against the FCA rules

  • Working knowledge of Consumer Duty and DISP complaints handling, with experience running second-line oversight or QA of complaints, collections or customer support

  • Comfortable preparing written reports and MI for senior stakeholders, and giving clear, practical regulatory advice to first-line teams under time pressure

  • At ease working in a lean team where you pick up the brief early, work through ambiguity and get things done without a large support structure around you

Nice to have

  • Experience acting as deputy MLRO or nominated officer cover, and familiarity with vulnerable customer frameworks and Consumer Duty outcomes testing

  • Experience of FCA regulatory returns, outsourcing oversight (IARs) and CONC in a fintech or fast-growing credit business

  • A relevant qualification such as the ICA Certificate or Diploma in Compliance or Anti Money Laundering


Why join LemFi?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.

Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours.

Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play.


Don't feel that you're right for this role, but want to submit your interest in working for LemFi? You can join our talent community to stay in touch for future opportunities.

Recruitment agencies notice

LemFi does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee.

AI in hiring at LemFi

We use AI to cut admin, like notetakers that let interviewers focus on the conversation instead of typing. AI never makes hiring decisions. That responsibility always sits with our hiring teams. Read our AI use policy to see how we use AI and how we expect you to use it too.

L’agence regroupe 300 experts, dont 150 en France, présents dans 7 pays à travers 9 bureaux internationaux (Paris, Marseille, Bruxelles, Milan, Genève, Zurich, Prague, Dubaï et Sao Paulo). Pour en savoir plus : www.biggie.co

🗒️ Missions

1. Stratégie SEO

  • Réaliser des audits SEO complets : technique, sémantique, contenu, popularité, UX et performance

  • Définir une stratégie SEO alignée avec les objectifs business, marketing et acquisition

2. Optimisation technique

  • Analyser la structure du site, l’indexation, le crawl, le maillage interne et les performances techniques

    • architecture de l’information

    • balisage HTML

    • données structurées

    • Core Web Vitals

    • gestion des redirections

    • canonicals

    • pagination

  • Collaborer avec les équipes techniques pour la bonne implémentation des recommandations

3. Stratégie de contenu et sémantique

  • Réaliser des études de mots-clés et cartographies d’intention

4. GEO / Visibilité dans les moteurs génératifs

    • clarté et structuration de l’information

    • signaux de confiance

    • entités et cohérence sémantique

    • FAQ, formats conversationnels et contenus orientés réponses

  • Assurer une veille active sur les évolutions des moteurs génératifs, LLM et nouveaux usages de recherche

5. Analyse de performance et reporting

  • Définir les KPI de suivi SEO / GEO

  • Mettre en place des tableaux de bord de performance

  • Suivre l’évolution de la visibilité, du trafic organique, des positions, des conversions et des signaux de notoriété

  • Produire des reportings clairs, actionnables et orientés résultats

  • Présenter les analyses et recommandations aux interlocuteurs métiers et décisionnaires

6. Accompagnement transverse

  • Conseiller les équipes marketing, contenu, produit et technique

  • Sensibiliser les parties prenantes aux bonnes pratiques SEO / GEO

  • Participer aux arbitrages stratégiques

  • Former ponctuellement les équipes internes si nécessaire

title: Consultant SEO & GEO confirmé
descriptionHtml:
Asight accompagne des marques e-commerce (DNVB mode & beauté), des acteurs SaaS B2B, de la lead gen, du média et du retail sur leur visibilité dans les moteurs de recherche et dans les moteurs génératifs (SEO + GEO). L’agence intervient aussi sur l’acquisition payante (Meta Ads, Google Ads) et la création publicitaire, pour une approche complète de l’acquisition.

Nous ouvrons le premier poste de l’équipe SEO. Tu intègres l’équipe du Head of SEO, à qui tu es directement rattaché·e. Concrètement, tu prends en main un portefeuille clients, tu montes en puissance sur nos méthodes et tu contribues à structurer l’activité. À mesure que l’équipe grandira, le poste pourra s’orienter vers un rôle de Team Leader SEO. C’est un rôle à fort impact, avec une vraie latitude et une exposition directe à la direction de l’agence.

Vos missions

Un consultant solide sur toute la chaîne

On cherche un consultant à l’aise sur l’ensemble du spectre SEO, capable de mener la plupart des sujets de bout en bout, avec l’appui du Head of SEO et du senior sur les dossiers les plus complexes. Concrètement, tu maîtrises déjà ou tu montes vite en compétence sur :

  • SEO technique : audits (crawl, indexation, structure, CWV), identification des correctifs et suivi de leur mise en œuvre côté client.
  • SEO éditorial & sémantique : recherche de mots-clés, cartographie d’intentions, cocons / maillage interne, briefs de contenu, suivi de la production.
  • Netlinking & autorité : compréhension des stratégies de liens, analyse de profil de backlinks, suivi de l’autorité.
  • GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) : comprendre et travailler la visibilité dans les réponses IA (ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews…).
  • Analytics & reporting : GSC, GA4, Data Studio, lecture de la performance et traduction en actions concrètes, avec le réflexe de relier le SEO au business (ventes, acquisition).

Tes missions

  • Gérer tes propres dossiers clients : audits, roadmap et suivi de performance, avec l’appui de l’équipe sur les sujets les plus pointus.
  • Mener des recherches de mots-clés : cadrage, traduction du vocabulaire client en vocabulaire SEO, analyse concurrentielle, exploitation d’Ahrefs.
  • Produire les livrables clients (audits, recommandations, reportings) au standard de qualité de l’agence.
  • Appliquer les standards de qualité de l’agence : rigueur des chiffres, cohérence des recommandations et soin de la forme avant envoi.
  • Participer à l’amélioration continue de nos méthodes et de nos process.

Automatisation & outils custom

Chez Asight, on ne subit pas les tâches répétitives : on les automatise. On attend de ce poste qu’il fasse de l’IA un levier concret au quotidien, pas un sujet de veille théorique. Concrètement :

  • Automatiser les workflows SEO : recherche de mots-clés, extraction et croisement de données, reportings, contrôles qualité, pour industrialiser ce qui peut l’être et dégager du temps sur la vraie valeur ajoutée de l’équipe : l’expertise, l’analyse et la reco.
  • Participer à la construction des outils sur mesure : participer au développement de scripts, de mini-outils internes et de chaînes d’automatisation adaptés à nos besoins (par exemple avec Claude Code et n8n) avec l’aide du Head of SEO et du consultant senior.
  • Exploiter les données : connecter nos sources (Ahrefs, GSC, Shopify, etc.) et faire parler la donnée sans process manuel lourd.
  • Partager : faire profiter l’équipe des outils et méthodes que tu développes.

Aucune expertise de développeur n’est exigée : ce qu’on cherche, c’est la curiosité, la débrouillardise et l’envie de construire avec les outils IA d’aujourd’hui.

Stack & outils

Ahrefs, Seobserver, Screaming Frog, Monitorank, Google Search Console, GA4, Supermetrics ainsi que notre environnement de gestion de projet (Notion & Slack), et nos outils d’automatisation et d’IA (Claude Code, n8n, etc.).

Vos compétences

  • 2 à 4 ans d’expérience en SEO, idéalement avec un passage en agence et sur des problématiques e-commerce et/ou lead gen.
  • Autonomie sur la majorité des sujets, avec l’envie de progresser sur les dossiers plus complexes.
  • Aisance relationnelle : tu sais expliquer et défendre une reco face à un client.
  • Rigueur : la qualité de sortie compte autant que le fond (chiffres justes, argumentaire solide, forme soignée).
  • Curiosité sur le GEO et l’évolution du search à l’ère de l’IA, ou l’envie d’y aller.
  • Curieux·se de l’IA : l’envie d’expérimenter, d’automatiser et de construire avec des outils comme Claude Code, n8n et l’écosystème IA pour gagner en efficacité.
  • Envie de s’investir dans la durée et de monter en séniorité : le poste pourra évoluer vers un rôle de Consultant SEO Senior.

Avantages

Conditions du poste

  • Contrat : CDI, statut cadre au forfait jours.
  • Localisation : bureaux quartier Saint-Seurin / Croix Blanche.
  • Télétravail : 2 jours par semaine.
  • Rémunération : selon profil et expérience.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Un poste formateur au sein d’une équipe SEO en construction, avec un vrai accompagnement.
  • Des sujets à la pointe (GEO, IA générative) sur des marques ambitieuses.
  • Une trajectoire claire : le poste pourra évoluer vers un rôle de Consultant SEO Senior à mesure que tu montes en compétence.

title: Consumer PR - Business Director
descriptionHtml:
About Ogilvy  

Ogilvy has been creating impact for brands through iconic, culture-changing, value-driving ideas since the company was founded by David Ogilvy more than 75 years ago. It builds on that rich legacy through Borderless Creativity—innovating at the intersection of intelligence, imagination and influence, with experts across advertising, sports & entertainment, PR & social, consulting, and health collaborating seamlessly across more than 120 offices spanning 90 countries. Ogilvy was named Network of the Year at the 2026 Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity and ranks as the #1 global agency network for creative excellence and effectiveness by WARC for the fourth consecutive year, signifying its ability to deliver creative solutions that drive unreasonable impact for clients and communities. Ogilvy is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. For more information, visit Ogilvy.com, and follow us on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and Facebook.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

Consumer PR - Business Director

Department: Consumer PR & Influence
Location: London
Contract Type: Fixed-Term 12-Months
Full Time/Part time: Full Time
Reporting into: Managing Partner 

The Role: 

As Business Director you will lead client partnership, strategic counsel and integrated delivery across the portfolio, designed to provide the client with fully focused, senior leadership on some of the world’s most iconic FMCG brands. 

The role sits at the intersection of earned-first thinking, culture-led marketing, and integrated agency delivery, ensuring that PR, social, influence and advertising work together to create impact at scale across diverse markets. 
 
This pivotal role places you at the heart of our operations for large FMCG portfolio, one of the world's most iconic and dynamic brands.  

Your remit will span from the initial spark of ideation – identifying trends and innovative opportunities that drive cultural relevance – through the meticulous development of cutting-edge strategies tailored to diverse market nuances and brand objectives. You will lead the charge on defining compelling creative narratives and content frameworks, ensuring brand consistency and breakthrough engagement. Subsequently, you will oversee flawless execution, transforming strategy into impactful activations across various platforms and geographies.  

This role demands a holistic leader capable of driving innovation, navigating complex client relationships, and delivering measurable results within a dynamic, multi-market agency environment. 
 

Key Responsibilities: 

Client leadership & stakeholder management 

  • Act as the senior day-to-day client lead for European and Global teams, building trusted, long-term partnerships
  • Provide strategic counsel across brand, reputation, partnerships and cultural activation
  • Lead complex, multi-market stakeholder management across global, regional and local teams
  • Ensure the FMCG Brand has consistent, senior-level leadership fully embedded in the brand business 

Global & European strategy development 

  • Lead the creation of global and European communications toolkits, frameworks and playbooks that balance global brand consistency with local market nuance
  • Embed earned-first thinking into all toolkits
  • Partner closely with creative and strategy leads to shape culturally relevant, insight-led ideas 

Market management & intelligence 

  • Oversee market engagement across Europe and priority global territories, acting as a central connector between the brands global teams and local markets
  • Ensure clients are consistently informed on market trends, cultural shifts, competitor activity and emerging opportunities
  • Champion local market insight, ensuring work is adaptable, relevant and executable across diverse regions 

Global events & partnerships 

  • Lead the communications strategy and delivery for global brand moments and events, ensuring alignment across markets
  • Play a central role in developing and activating brand partnerships, embedding them seamlessly into toolkits and campaign narratives
  • Work with market and agency leads to bring partnerships to life in locally relevant, culturally resonant ways 

Team leadership & integration 

  • Directly manage a London-based team, working alongside creative and strategy leadership
  • Foster a collaborative, high-performance team culture grounded in integration and shared ownership 

What makes this role different: 

  • 100% dedicated to the FMCG portfolio, allowing for deep brand immersion and long-term strategic thinking
  • Operates at true global scale, balancing global brand stewardship with local market realities
  • Deeply partnership-led, with collaborations embedded into brand strategy
  • Strong emphasis on earned-first, culture-first marketing, influencing how integrated campaigns are built from the ground up
  • Sits within a fully integrated agency model, requiring constant collaboration across discipline 

Key Leadership Competencies: 

  • Proven experience in global and/or European leadership roles, ideally within FMCG or large-scale consumer brands 
  • Exceptional stakeholder management skills — this role is heavily relationship-driven and requires confidence navigating complexity 
  • Strong understanding of how global brands operate across markets, with sensitivity to cultural and market nuance 
  • Demonstrated experience working in integrated agency environments across PR, advertising, social and influence 
  • A passion for culture-led, earned-first marketing and its role in driving brand relevance and business impact 
  • Commercially astute, strategically minded and comfortable operating at senior client level 
  • A genuine interest in — and affinity for — the drinks brands and the wider FMCG landscape 
  • Communication & Collaboration: Defines and communicates the overarching vision for the Influence practice. Develops communication strategies that align the department with agency leadership and fosters a culture of open dialogue and mentorship for senior leaders. 
  • Organisation & Resource Management: Architects the department's operational structure to support profitability and growth. Oversees P&L, leads resource forecasting, and ensures the practice is structured to handle complex, large-scale business needs. 
  • Responsibility & Accountability: Holds ultimate accountability for the entire department's commercial and creative performance. Empowers directors to lead their teams while maintaining transparent, high-level communication with executive leadership on business progress and challenges. 
  • Problem Solving & Decision Making: Acts as the final point of authority on the most critical business issues. Makes high-stakes decisions that protect the agency's commercial interests and mentors directors in strategic problem-solving. 
  • Growth & Development: Champions and funds a departmental learning culture. Defines the long-term talent strategy, creates career pathways for all levels, and builds a best-in-class team through senior hiring and mentorship. 
  • Ogilvy Values & Behaviours: Acts as the ultimate custodian of the agency's values within the department. Embeds these values into the practice's core processes, from recruitment and client management to performance recognition. 
      

Skills for Your Growth to Client Partner: 
To support your progression, you will be expected to develop capabilities in the following areas: 

  • C-Suite Partnership & Business Acumen: Transition from a practice leader to a C-suite strategic advisor. Develop a deep, holistic understanding of the client's entire business model, competitive landscape, and financial drivers to become an indispensable partner to their most senior leaders. 
  • Integrated Solution Leadership: Evolve from leading a single capability to orchestrating the agency's full suite of services. Master the art of integrating diverse crafts—from brand advertising and PR to consulting and data—to solve the client's most complex business problems. 
  • Enterprise Commercial Strategy: Shift focus from departmental P&L management to owning the entire client commercial relationship. Drive enterprise-level growth by identifying strategic opportunities across the client's organization and negotiating large-scale, multi-year partnerships. 
  • Relationship as the Core Product: Move from a role where the craft is the primary product to one where the strategic client relationship itself is the core deliverable. Your success will be measured by your ability to build unwavering trust and long-term loyalty at the highest levels. 
     

Personal Qualities: 

  • Extensive and proven experience in a senior leadership role (e.g., Senior Account Director or Business Director) within a top-tier agency.
  • Strategic yet pragmatic
  • Culturally curious and globally minded
  • Confident, collaborative and calm under pressure
  • Energised by complexity, scale and partnership-driven work
  • Demonstrated track record of P&L ownership and delivering significant, year-on-year business growth.
  • Proven success in leading and winning multi-million-pound new business pitches.
  • Exceptional leadership skills with experience in shaping departmental culture and developing senior talent.
  • Strategic visionary with the ability to anticipate market trends and define a clear, forward-looking path for the business.
  • Outstanding commercial acumen and sophisticated negotiation skills. 

How we help you Thrive: 

  • 25 days annual leave + 1 Volunteer Day 
  • Bupa Healthcare 
  • Enhanced Maternity, Adoption and Shared Parental Leave 
  • Flexible Working Model with core working hours: 10am – 4pm 
  • A 1.5:1 Matching Pension Structure 
  • Wellbeing and Health: Up to £25.00 per month towards physical or online exercise class membership, Unmind membership, LifeWorks tool and annual eye tests. 
  • Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work Scheme 
  • Life Assurance

At Ogilvy, our people are at the heart of what we do: a creative agency that sparks game-changing ideas across culture and business through collaboration, integrity, and a celebration of self-expression. 

We believe in building powerful teams with purpose - and we relentlessly curate transformative initiatives that make our commitment to fairness, and equity a reality. 

Our ultimate mission is to leave a positive impact on the world, creating a better future for all, while supporting and uplifting the global communities we serve.  This is central to our mantra of Borderless Creativity.

title: Credit Strategy Analyst
descriptionHtml:
We’re on a mission to back the UK’s small businesses like no one else 🚀

Small businesses are the backbone of the economy, and we’re here to help them win. We’ve built a platform that uses clever data to get them the funding they need in minutes, not weeks.

At Funding Circle, we have the restless energy of a fintech start-up with the stability of a public company. It’s a unique mix that gives Circlers the autonomy to take ownership and the scale to make an impact that truly counts.

We’re a high-performing team that chooses to lift each other up. We challenge, we champion, and we have each other’s backs - because we know that when we stand together, we move faster and build better.

The impact is real: Last year alone, the businesses on our platform generated £7.2bn for the UK economy 📈 Come and join a mission that matters!

[Read our Impact Report] | [See our Trustpilot]

The role ⚡

📍 London (Hybrid) | 🤝 3 days in the office | 💰 Competitive Salary + Benefits

This role sits in the Credit Risk team who are hugely influential to our overall lending process. They look at measuring our risk, optimising our credit risk funnel and forecasting the performance of our loan portfolios. To do this, they work with the credit risk modelling, engineering, data management, capital markets and business operations teams to truly understand our objectives and shape analytical solutions.

Focusing on our Credit Risk lending capabilities, you’ll be given the opportunity to think outside the box and come up with a wide range of suggestions and ideas to optimise our ability to lend to small businesses, while also delivering strong returns for our investors.

  • Primarily responsible for monitoring our Credit Strategy to identify useful trends and opportunities to optimise our lending strategy

  • Involved with all aspects of credit strategy analytics, from loss rate forecasting to segmentation analysis

  • Guiding business decisions by carrying out ad hoc analysis, providing credit risk insights and recommendations for optimising credit risk strategies and business processes

  • Collaborate with experts from different functions, particularly Engineering and Operations, to ensure daily running of our lending business and to implement any Credit Strategy changes

What we’re looking for 🌱

  • A degree in a highly numerical discipline (e.g., Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, or Physical Sciences)

  • Open to entry-level candidates and recent graduates. Prior internship or work experience in credit risk, portfolio analytics, or banking is a strong plus, but not required.

  • Ability to guide decisions through data—from defining the underlying business question to analyzing datasets and communicating actionable recommendations.

  • Excellent communication skills, particularly with regards to translating data analyses and numbers into actionable insights tailored to the audience

  • Intermediate-to-advanced Excel skills.

  • Practical coding proficiency in at least one analytical language (SQL, Python, or R). Candidates with SAS experience or demonstrated aptitude to learn new languages quickly are also considered.

  • Curious and eager to learn, and comfortable working independently on solving open-ended problems.

  • Able to take ownership of redesigning departmental workflows, using AI to automate complex tasks and drive operational efficiency

  • Competently able to Identify high-impact AI use cases and implement advanced prompting techniques to solve multi-layered business challenges

  • Prior exposure to credit risk analytics or banking (retail, corporate, or investment) is advantageous but not required.

We’re building a place where everyone truly feels they belong. Even if your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement, we'd still love to hear from you.

Why join us? 💜

We back you to build an incredible career and by joining us, you'll be part of one of The Sunday Times Best Companies to Work For 2026! As a flexible-first employer, we use a "best of both" approach. We’ll see you in our London office to collaborate – with barista coffee and subsidised Just Eat lunches on us!

Our Circler Proposition focuses on five areas:

  • Flexibility: We provide a benefit allowance you can tailor to your own life and family.

  • Health: This includes private medical and dental, health assessments, and access to a digital GP.

  • Wealth: We offer life assurance, share schemes, and financial coaching.

  • Development: You get a dedicated annual learning allowance to help you level up.

  • Lifestyle: We have electric car and cycle-to-work schemes, plus season ticket loans.

We also have award-winning parental leave policies. We're here to support you through the big life moments, from fertility treatments to new additions to the family.

Ready to join a mission that matters? We’d love to chat!
