title: CRO Manager
descriptionHtml:
Why This Role Exists

At Pennylane, our website plays a pivotal role in acquiring and converting customers, transforming traffic from paid acquisition, SEO, partnerships, and other channels into sign-ups, demo bookings, and product adoption.

 

As we accelerate our Financial Services offering, including pro account, and the monetization of our existing customer base, we are seeking a CRO Manager to own conversion across these strategic areas.

 

You will lead the production and optimization of website pages and paid landing pages, from identifying friction to measuring business impact.

 

You will join the Website team within Growth and collaborate closely with Growth Engineers and Data in a multidisciplinary squad.

 

🌍 About Pennylane

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

 

Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising their clients.

 

Key Figures and Ambition

  • 💻 Over 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane

  • 🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Over 1,100 Pennylaners from more than 25 nationalities

  • 💰 More than €400 million raised since launch

  • 🌍 Remote-friendly, international culture expanding across Europe

 

What You’ll Do

You will own conversion across the Financial Services and Monetization scope, working across website pages, paid landing pages, product journeys, experimentation, and measurement.

 

Own CRO and Experimentation

  • Define and execute the conversion strategy for key journeys, including pro account landing pages, pricing and product pages, demo-booking journeys, self-sign-up, and upsell flows

  • Build and run a continuous A/B testing program, from ideation and scoping to sizing, analysis, and ship-or-kill decisions

  • Identify conversion friction and opportunities through analytics and behavioral insights

  • Develop clear hypotheses based on user behavior, business priorities, and funnel performance

  • Ensure experiments are measured against meaningful business outcomes

 

Manage the Website Conversion Roadmap

  • Own and prioritize the conversion roadmap for your scope based on expected impact and feasibility

  • Turn opportunities into actionable briefs, specifications, and delivery plans

  • Work closely with Growth Engineers, Data, Design, and other stakeholders to ship improvements

  • Coordinate QA, launch, and post-launch analysis

  • Own key Financial Services journeys, including pro account activation and the accountant portal

  • Contribute to monetization journeys such as upsell and self-sign-up

 

Build and Optimize Paid Landing Pages

  • Produce and optimize landing pages for Financial Services and Monetization campaigns

  • Help increase the speed and volume of landing-page delivery, removing the current bottleneck

  • Partner with Demand Generation and Paid/SEA teams to translate campaign objectives into high-performing pages

  • Develop a strong understanding of target audiences, market context, and local messaging

  • Use these insights to improve both paid landing pages and the wider website experience

 

Own Measurement and Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Define instrumentation and tracking plans with Data

  • Build and maintain dashboards to monitor conversion performance

  • Report on results, learnings, and next steps to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Work closely with Demand Gen, Product, Sales and Customer Success Operations, Brand, Design, and Engineering

  • Create alignment across teams and move projects forward without relying on formal authority

 

What You Bring

  • 3–5 years of experience in CRO, Conversion, Website Product Management, Growth, or a related field

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, digital products, or another data-driven environment

  • A track record of shipping initiatives end-to-end and demonstrating their impact on business metrics

  • Strong hands-on experience with analytics and CRO tools, such as Amplitude and Contentsquare

  • Ability to independently analyse data, identify patterns, and formulate relevant hypotheses

  • Solid understanding of A/B testing methodology, including experiment sizing, success metrics, statistical pitfalls, and decision-making

  • Experience managing a roadmap and prioritizing initiatives based on impact and feasibility

  • Strong project management skills, from writing a clear brief to coordinating delivery and measuring results

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to:

    • Write clear briefs for designers and engineers

    • Explain prioritization decisions to stakeholders

    • Present results and recommendations to non-technical audiences

  • Ability to build relationships and secure alignment across multiple teams

  • Fluent French and professional English

 

🛠️ Tools and Environment

You will work with tools and processes dedicated to experimentation, analytics, behavioral analysis, tracking, and landing-page production.

 

Some our Tools Include

  • Amplitude

  • AB Tasty

  • Analytics and reporting dashboards

  • Website content and landing-page production tools

 

You will collaborate closely with Growth Engineers, Data, Demand Generation, Product, Sales and Customer Success Operations, Brand, and Design.

 

What You Can Expect

  • Ownership of conversion across two strategic areas for Pennylane: Financial Services and Monetization

  • Direct and measurable impact on sign-ups, demo bookings, product activation, and upsell performance

  • The opportunity to shape the conversion roadmap across website and paid landing pages

  • A central role in structuring and scaling our experimentation program

  • Close collaboration with Growth Engineering, Data, Product, Demand Gen, Sales, Customer Success Operations, Brand, and Design

  • High level of autonomy and visibility across the organization

  • Challenging and supportive environment focused on ownership, execution, learning, and measurable impact

 

Success in This Role

Your success will be measured by:

 

  • The frequency and quality of experiments launched

  • The speed and volume of website and landing-page delivery

  • Conversion-rate improvement across the Financial Services and Monetization funnels

  • Growth in relevant outcomes, including sign-ups and demo bookings

  • Ability to absorb inbound landing-page demand without creating a delivery bottleneck

  • Quality of tracking, reporting, and learnings shared with stakeholders

 

📍 Location & Working Model

Permanent position based in Paris on a hybrid basis or fully remote anywhere in France.

 

🌈 Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

Pennylane is dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace, providing equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of background, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic.

 

If you’re excited about this role and think you could make an impact, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t meet every requirement.

Chez Green-Got, nous sommes curieux, exigeants, collectifs, et nous allons vite.

  • Sens du service : tu sais que derrière chaque ticket, il y a une personne. Tu ne fermes pas un ticket, tu résous un problème.

Le service client de demain ne se construit uniquement avec des scripts et des macros. Il se construit avec des personnes qui comprennent le produit, les membres, et l'enjeu de chaque interaction.

descriptionHtml:

The role is 37.5 hours a week, reports to the Customer Service Manager, and is hybrid between home and our office.

What you’ll be doing:

title: Customer Success Account Manager, Mid-Market
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

You help customers adopt the platform, realise measurable value, and renew and expand with confidence. You pick up where Implementation leaves off, learn each customer's fleet and challenges, and advise on tailoring Samsara to them. You manage 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to extend your reach and focus your time where it counts. Your understanding of the value customers get earns you the right to lead the ROI conversation, negotiate terms and close renewals that work for both sides, minimising financial attrition. You work with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform's capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types, from field services and utilities to long-haul transportation and school buses.
  • Manage a portfolio of 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to accelerate your engagement, prioritize proactively, and drive efficiency and outcomes across your book of business.
  • Lead the ROI and value conversation into the renewal, negotiate favorable terms, and close renewals that are a win for both the customer and Samsara while minimizing financial attrition.
  • Demonstrate a willingness to understand and explain technical issues to a non-technical audience and to engage the right cross-functional partners to drive resolution.
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to maximize the value of their Samsara products.
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product to strategically solve problems and optimize customer experience and business outcomes.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Business fluency in French (spoken and written).
  • 2+ years in a customer-facing, quota-carrying role (renewals, customer success, account management or sales), ideally in SaaS, technology or logistics.
  • A record of consistent quota over-achievement.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication and presentation skills, and the ability to build trust with executives, users and internal teams.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, Gong or similar GTM tools.
  • Comfort in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.
  • A bachelor's degree from a 4-year institution, or equivalent practical experience.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • A strong bias towards action, big-picture thinking and high standards.
  • An AI-first approach: you use AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes.
  • Technical depth across a suite of products, with a bonus for hardware-software integration.
  • Industry Knowledge: Experience with routing, navigation, commercial trucking fleets, and logistics.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

title: Customer Success Associate
descriptionHtml:
About Aphex

We're the construction coordination platform that's replacing outdated spreadsheets with multiplayer tools that delivery teams love. Major contractors like BAM, Balfour Beatty, SKANSKA, Kier, MACE, and Murphy use Aphex to deliver their projects ranging from £50 million to multi-billion pound mega projects.

Since launching in 2019, we've grown to become the market-leading solution in the UK and Australia, with aspirations to be where every major project in the world is planned and delivered.

We're tackling an industry that drives 10% of global GDP yet has seen productivity decline for 20 years. It's time for change.

 

The Role

As a Customer Success Associate at Aphex, you'll learn our Land & Expand Engine inside one of the highest-paced teams at the company: the UK Customer Success Hub.

Your job is to help major contractors get genuine value out of Aphex on their live projects. You'll be in the room and on site with planners, engineers, construction managers, and project directors, helping them embed weekly planning routines, daily coordination, and the reporting that makes their projects run better.

This is a fast progression role. You'll start in apprentice mode alongside the UK CS team, learning the playbook by doing it. Within 6 to 9 months, most CSAs are running their own portfolio of projects as full Customer Success Managers. We hire people who are hungry for that progression and ready to earn it from day one, not waiting until month nine.

The team you're joining is in the middle of a step change: scaling the UK book and expanding into new geographical markets. The CSAs we hire now are part of how the UK CS function holds together and grows through that period.

AI is part of how the team works at Aphex. We expect everyone to use it to think, write, plan, and analyse better. Genuine curiosity about how AI can multiply your output is part of the job.

At Aphex we challenge the status quo as a default. As you grow in this role, you'll be expected to propose better ways of working and make them real, not wait for someone to ask.

 

What you'll learn and do

  • Run project deployments. Shadow experienced CSMs through kickoffs, setups, and training, then take the lead on your own.

  • Embed planning routines. Help major contractor teams establish the weekly planning cycle that becomes their project's operating rhythm.

  • Drive daily coordination. Move teams from weekly planning into the daily routines that make site coordination genuinely better.

  • Build trusted relationships across the project. Engineers, supervisors, planners, project managers, construction managers. Hold real credibility at every level.

  • Monitor project health and act on it. Track signals, spot risks early, run plays to fix issues before they escalate.

 

The team you'll join

You'll be part of the UK Customer Success Hub, working directly alongside four Customer Success Managers who collectively support projects worth billions in construction value across the UK's largest contractors. You'll learn by working live deployments with them, not from a training course.

You'll also work closely with our UK sales team to understand how project success translates into account growth, and collaborate with our APAC hub on shared accounts, knowledge sharing, and the global playbook we run across regions.

 

Why this matters

Every project you help succeed means a real project gets delivered better. Less waste, less delay, less rework, less pressure on the people doing the work. You're not just supporting software adoption, you're helping the UK's biggest contractors deliver the infrastructure and buildings the country actually needs.

 

About You

At Aphex, we believe our team should reflect the variety of perspectives in the world we build for. We've noticed that qualified candidates from underrepresented groups sometimes hesitate to apply unless they meet 100% of the listed requirements, while others might apply when meeting just 60%. If you're excited about Aphex and believe you have the core skills to succeed in this role, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't check every box. Your unique perspective might be exactly what we need.

 

What we're looking for:

  • You build trust quickly with people across all kinds of roles and seniority. You've held real relationships beyond the transaction. People you've worked with before still take your call.

  • You've been thrown in over your head and figured it out. At least one specific story (probably more) of taking on something you weren't qualified for and getting up to speed fast.

  • You don't wait to be asked. When you spot something that isn't working (a broken process, a missing resource, an awkward workflow), you take it on yourself to fix it.

 

Nice to have:

  • A second European language relevant to our growth into new markets

  • Previous experience in customer success, SaaS, or a fast-moving B2B environment

  • Some construction or infrastructure background or curiosity (deep industry knowledge isn't required; curiosity for the work matters)

  • Evidence of using AI tools to improve how you work, with a clear view of where AI helps and where it doesn't

Benefits

What we offer:

  • 25 days holiday plus UK bank holidays

  • Bupa Health & Dental Care

  • Pension contribution

  • Parental leave

  • Remote-first working with access to a WeWork office for in-person collaboration

  • The right tools. MacBook Pro setup, modern tech stack, and AI tooling across the team

  • Genuine development. Personal training allowance plus ongoing coaching and learning support

  • A team that takes the work seriously. Collaborative, ambitious people who care about doing the work well

 

Interview & Application Process

Our interview process is typically 2-3 rounds, focused on mutual fit and long-term alignment. As a remote-first business with teams across the UK, Europe, and APAC, parts of the process may run asynchronously.

Du bekommst kein „Startpaket" aus kalten Leads, sondern ein starkes Bestandsportfolio mit starken Marken, das nur darauf wartet, ausgebaut zu werden.

Aufgaben

  • Ownership deines Portfolios: Du verantwortest ein eigenes Book of Business aus namhaften Enterprise-Kunden, treibst es proaktiv statt auf Anfragen oder schlechte Health-Scores zu warten, und entwickelst es strategisch weiter.

Qualifikation

  • Du verstehst technische Konzepte und kannst sie verständlich erklären.

Benefits

  • Ein eigenes Bestandsportfolio aus etablierten Kunden, das du eigenverantwortlich weiterentwickelst, mit klarem Weg zu größeren und strategischeren Accounts.

  • Neben deinem Fixgehalt eine variable Komponente mit Umsatzbeteiligung, wenn du dein Portfolio in neue Buying Center hinein ausbaust (horizontale Expansion).

title: Data Center Architect
descriptionHtml:
Role Profile

Job Title: Data Centre Architect

Reports to: Head of Data Centre Development

Location: UK hybrid

Company Overview:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we’re building this organisation from the ground up. We’re looking for people who’d rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of team you’ve previously managed.

This is a senior individual contributor role with authority to sign off technical schedules, working with cluster and network architects, NVIDIA and other OEM engineers, colocation provider engineering and sales teams, and the internal Procurement, Legal, Finance and Site Operations teams.

What You’ll Do

You will be the single technical authority between our GPU-as-a-service business and the colocation providers that host our NVIDIA clusters. You turn cluster architecture and OEM requirements into a precise, contractable statement of work (SOW) for the data centre white space, then hold the provider to it through design, installation and acceptance.

We are growing from tens of megawatts to hundreds, on rack-scale liquid-cooled platforms at 130 kW per rack and rising to 200 kW and beyond. Mistakes in power, cooling or fibre specification show up as stranded capacity, delayed cluster delivery and disputes, so the role carries real commercial weight.

Key Responsibilities

Technical negotiation with colocation providers

  • Lead technical due diligence on candidate sites: power availability and energisation dates, redundancy topology, liquid-cooling capability, floor loading, rack logistics, fibre and meet-me access.

  • Negotiate the technical schedules of the colocation agreement with commercial and legal: capacity and density commitments, power and cooling SLAs, temperature and flow envelopes, metering, expansion rights, change control and remedies.

  • Challenge provider claims with evidence: single-line diagrams, P&IDs, load-bank and commissioning records, reference customers.

Specification & SOW

  • Work with cluster architects and OEMs (NVIDIA first) to capture rack, power, cooling, network and layout requirements, and keep them current across product generations.

  • Write and own the technical SOW for white-space fitout: containment and cooling interfaces, power distribution to rack, structured cabling and pathways, rack and POD layout, security zoning, labelling and records.

  • Define clear scope boundaries and responsibilities between us, the colocation provider, OEMs and installation contractors, with no gaps and no overlaps.

  • Maintain a requirements baseline with traceability from OEM document, to SOW clause, to acceptance test.

Design, installation & acceptance

  • Review provider and contractor designs, shop drawings and method statements against the SOW; run design reviews and close findings.

  • Define acceptance: factory and site tests, liquid flush and cleanliness, power quality, thermal performance at full load, fibre loss, burn-in, and the evidence pack needed for each gate.

  • Attend key witness tests and sign off, or reject, completion of each phase before hardware is energised.

  • Manage technical change requests and variations, and advise on cost and schedule impact.

Knowledge & standards

  • Build reusable reference designs, SOW templates and a site-scoring framework so each new deployment starts from a proven baseline.

  • Track the roadmap: higher rack densities, 800 VDC distribution, new cooling classes and optics, and tell the business early what it means for sites already contracted.

Deliverables You Own:

  • Site technical assessment: Scored, evidence-based report per candidate site, comparable across providers, with risks and mitigations.

  • Technical schedules to the colocation agreement: Measurable commitments, tested in acceptance, with remedies agreed by legal.

  • Cluster white-space SOW: Complete enough that a contractor can price and build without asking us questions; traceable to OEM requirements.

  • Reference designs and layouts: Rack, row and POD layouts, power and cooling single-line and P&ID level interfaces, fibre pathways and densities.

  • Acceptance test plan and evidence pack: Pass and fail criteria set before work starts; signed results per gate.

  • Requirements baseline and change log: One current version of the truth, with every variation recorded and costed.

  • Risk and issues register: Technical risks to schedule and capacity, with owners and dates.

Working Relationships:

  • Cluster and network architects: You translate their cluster design into facility requirements, and they rely on you to say what a site can and cannot carry.

  • OEMs, mainly NVIDIA: You are the facility-side counterpart; you obtain, interpret and challenge site-requirement documents.

  • Colocation providers: Day-to-day technical counterpart through negotiation, build and acceptance.

  • Procurement, legal and finance: You provide the technical substance of commercial terms and the impact of variations.

  • Site operations and deployment teams: You hand over a clean specification and acceptance evidence, and take back lessons learned.

What You Bring:

  • 8 or more years in data centre design, delivery or technical consulting, including at least 3 years on high-density (50 kW per rack or more) or liquid-cooled deployments.

  • Direct experience writing or reviewing technical specifications and SOWs for white-space fitout, and managing contractors against them to acceptance.

  • Strong working knowledge of data centre power: MV and LV distribution, UPS and generator topologies, redundancy models (N+1, 2N, distributed), busway and rack power, metering and power quality.

  • Strong working knowledge of cooling: direct-to-chip liquid cooling, CDUs, facility and technology loops, warm-water and dry-cooler designs, fluid quality and flushing, leak detection and containment.

  • Working knowledge of structured cabling and pathways for large GPU fabrics (single-mode optics, high fibre counts, InfiniBand and Ethernet physical layers), and of rack and POD layouts.

  • Familiarity with NVIDIA rack-scale platforms (GB200 or GB300 class, or later) and their facility requirements, and the ability to read OEM site-requirement documents critically.

  • Proven ability to run technical negotiations with colocation or construction counterparties, and to explain trade-offs to commercial, legal and executive audiences.

  • Command of standards such as EN 50600 and the Uptime Tier framework, ASHRAE TC 9.9 liquid-cooling guidance, and commissioning practice (levels 1 to 5).

  • Excellent written communication: you produce clear, unambiguous contract-grade documents.

Preferred Skills (Nice to Have):

  • Experience at a hyperscaler, neocloud or colocation provider on the operator or customer side.

  • Experience with 800 VDC or other DC distribution, large battery storage, or power smoothing for AI load swings.

  • Chartered engineer status or equivalent; recognised data centre credentials (for example CDCP, CDFOM, Uptime ATD or AOS).

  • Familiarity with BIM, digital-twin tools and requirements-management tools.

  • Willingness to travel up to 30% to sites in the UK, Europe and the US.

Success Measures:

  • First 90 days: Audit current colocation contracts and SOWs and list technical gaps; publish a requirements baseline for the current NVIDIA platform; take over technical lead on one live negotiation; agree the site-scoring framework with the cluster architects.

  • 6 months: One complete SOW issued and priced with no material scope disputes; acceptance plan agreed with the provider before build starts; reusable SOW template adopted by the team.

  • 12 months: Every new site contracted on the template with traceable requirements; clusters accepted on schedule with no facility-caused performance issues; fewer late variations and a measurable cut in time from site shortlist to signed technical schedule.

Qualities we look for:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up.

  • Inspire the change: There’s no blueprint for the future. You’ll embrace challenges and change.

  • You’re real and you’re true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you’ll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you’re talking to, you treat everyone the same.

  • Get stuck in: You’d rather be building than overseeing. Our strategy will keep evolving, and so will you — attitude and adaptability matter more to us than a fixed playbook or a big team behind you.

Package & Process:

  • Employment type: Full-time, permanent.

  • Travel: Up to 30%.

  • Interview process:

    Talent Screening >Hiring Manager Screen > Technical Interview > Final with the Head of Data Centre Development.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all backgrounds.

As Data Protection & Quality Management Officer at Orcrist Technologies, you own our data protection framework and build and operate our ISO 9001 quality management system. You act as our appointed Data Protection Officer under GDPR and lead the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of our QMS.

Both are independent staff functions reporting directly to the C-Level Management. You advise, monitor, audit, and document; the business remains responsible for operational decisions and implementation.

We build AI platforms for customers in the defence and government sector. Data protection and quality management are essential to our business and customer trust. As the company grows, you will build these structures hands-on, working closely with engineering, product, people, IT, and our Information Security Officer.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain our data protection management system, including policies, processes, and documentation.
  • Act as our appointed DPO under Art. 37–39 GDPR and § 38 BDSG, advising management and teams on GDPR, BDSG, and TDDDG requirements.
  • Monitor compliance, including records of processing activities, processor agreements, TOMs, data protection impact assessments, and data subject requests.
  • Advise on privacy by design, international data transfers, retention, and personal data breaches.
  • Build and maintain our ISO 9001 QMS, including process documentation, quality objectives, risk-based thinking, and continual improvement.
  • Own the internal audit programme, track nonconformities and corrective actions, and coordinate certification and surveillance audits.
  • Prepare the annual management review and report on data protection risks, audit findings, and improvement priorities.

About you

  • Familiarity with AQAP-Standards.

  • Experience leading a first ISO 9001 certification.

title: Data Scientist - Measurement, Experimentation & Causal Inference
descriptionHtml:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Role Overview:

As a Data Scientist, you will help measure the impact of PlayStation's products, features and commercial initiatives through experimentation, causal inference and applied data science.

Working at the intersection of data science, machine learning, product and commercial strategy, you will apply robust analytical techniques to solve complex business problems, generate actionable insights and support evidence-based decision-making across PlayStation.

This role goes beyond traditional A/B testing. You will apply modern causal inference, statistical modelling and machine learning techniques to evaluate initiatives where controlled experiments are difficult or impossible, collaborating closely with product, engineering, analytics and business teams to deliver high-quality measurement and insights.

This is an opportunity to work on high-impact initiatives affecting millions of PlayStation players while developing your expertise in experimentation, causal inference and applied data science.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Apply measurement methodologies across experimentation, causal inference and advanced analytics to evaluate product and commercial initiatives.
  • Design and execute robust measurement approaches across randomised experiments, quasi-experimental methods and observational causal inference where controlled experimentation is impractical.
  • Apply statistical, machine learning and AI techniques to solve complex measurement challenges and generate actionable business insights.
  • Apply advanced data science and machine learning techniques where appropriate to complement experimentation and support complex business decisions.
  • Contribute to the development and adoption of best practices for experiment design, statistical analysis and causal measurement.
  • Partner closely with product managers, engineers, analysts and business stakeholders to identify high-impact measurement opportunities and ensure product and commercial decisions are supported by rigorous evidence.

title: Deine Ausbildung: Fachinformatiker (m/w/d) für Systemintegration
descriptionHtml:
Dein Einstieg in die IT: Technik verstehen, Lösungen finden, Zukunft gestalten.

Du interessierst dich für Computer und Technik und möchtest verstehen, wie eigentlich alles zusammen funktioniert? Vielleicht bist du auch die Person, die zu Hause zuerst gefragt wird, wenn das WLAN nicht funktioniert oder der Computer plötzlich Probleme macht?

Dann könnte die Ausbildung zum Fachinformatiker (m/w/d) für Systemintegration genau das Richtige für dich sein.

Bei der Deutschen Extrakt Kaffee GmbH (DEK) dreht sich vieles um Kaffee. Damit unsere Kolleginnen und Kollegen jeden Tag ihre Arbeit machen können, braucht es im Hintergrund aber auch eine zuverlässige IT. Und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Während deiner Ausbildung lernst du, wie Computer, Netzwerke und IT-Systeme miteinander verbunden sind, wie man technische Probleme löst und dafür sorgt, dass im Unternehmen alles möglichst reibungslos funktioniert.

Dabei musst du noch nicht alles können. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du neugierig bist, gerne dazulernst und Lust hast, gemeinsam mit uns in die IT-Welt einzutauchen.

Das erwartet dich in deiner Ausbildung

Als Fachinformatiker (m/w/d) für Systemintegration sorgst du dafür, dass unsere IT-Systeme funktionieren und unsere Mitarbeitenden zuverlässig damit arbeiten können.

In deiner dreijährigen Ausbildung lernst du Schritt für Schritt die verschiedenen Aufgaben unserer IT kennen. Dabei schaust du nicht nur zu, sondern kannst dein Wissen auch praktisch anwenden.

Das bedeutet für dich:

  • Du lernst unsere IT-Welt kennen: Von Computern und Laptops über Server bis hin zu Netzwerken erfährst du, wie unsere technische Infrastruktur aufgebaut ist und zusammenarbeitet.

  • Du bringst Technik zum Laufen: Du unterstützt dabei, neue Geräte einzurichten, Software zu installieren und Arbeitsplätze technisch auszustatten.

  • Du gehst Problemen auf den Grund: Wenn etwas nicht funktioniert, hilfst du bei der Fehlersuche und lernst, wie sich technische Störungen systematisch beheben lassen.

  • Du unterstützt unsere Kolleginnen und Kollegen: Du beantwortest IT-Fragen und hilfst dabei, technische Herausforderungen im Arbeitsalltag zu lösen.

  • Du beschäftigst dich mit IT-Sicherheit: Du erfährst, wie wir unsere Systeme und Daten schützen und warum das für unser Unternehmen so wichtig ist.

  • Du entwickelst dich weiter: Mit zunehmender Erfahrung übernimmst du eigene Aufgaben und kannst dich in spannende IT-Themen und Projekte einbringen.

Das bringst du mit

Du hast Interesse an Technik, möchtest verstehen, wie IT-Systeme funktionieren, und probierst gerne Neues aus? Dann bringst du schon eine wichtige Voraussetzung für deine Ausbildung bei uns mit.

Was uns außerdem wichtig ist:

  • Du hast einen guten Schulabschluss oder stehst kurz davor, deinen Abschluss zu machen.

  • Computer, Netzwerke und digitale Technologien interessieren dich. Vielleicht hast du dich auch privat schon mit dem einen oder anderen IT-Thema beschäftigt.

  • Du gehst Dingen gerne auf den Grund und gibst nicht gleich auf, wenn etwas nicht auf Anhieb funktioniert.

  • Du arbeitest sorgfältig, denkst gerne mit und hast Spaß daran, Lösungen zu finden.

  • Du bist offen, hilfsbereit und arbeitest gerne mit anderen Menschen zusammen.

  • Du hast Lust, Neues zu lernen, Fragen zu stellen und dich während deiner Ausbildung weiterzuentwickeln.

Und keine Sorge: Du musst weder programmieren können noch ein IT-Profi sein. Alles, was du für deinen Beruf brauchst, lernst du bei uns und in der Berufsschule.

Unser Angebot

  • Bei uns kannst du Ausbildung und Privatleben super verbinden! Dank unserer Gleitzeitregelung hast du die Möglichkeit, deinen Arbeitstag flexibel zu gestalten – so lassen sich Familie, Freizeit und Beruf optimal miteinander vereinbaren.

  • Bei uns startest du im ersten Lehrjahr mit 1.065€ brutto. Dies erhöht sich im zweiten Lehrjahr auf 1.166€ brutto und im dritten Lehrjahr auf 1.319€ brutto. Zusätzlich bieten wir Dir Urlaubsgeld, Weihnachtsgeld und jährliche Gehaltsanpassungen.

  • Unsere Idee ist, dass du nach der Ausbildung bei uns bleibst: Du erhältst eine strukturierte Einarbeitung und eine praxisnahe Ausbildung. So hast du die besten Chancen, nach deiner Ausbildung übernommen zu werden und langfristig mit uns gemeinsam zu wachsen.

  • Karriere mit Geschmack: Du erhältst monatliche Freikontingente, damit Du auch nach der Arbeit erstklassigen Kaffee oder Kakao genießen kannst.

  • Unsere Mitarbeitenden liegen uns am Herzen, u.a. mit Geburtstags- und Weihnachtsgeschenken machen wir Dir regelmäßig eine Freude.

  • Wir bieten Dir weitere Benefits wie unsere betriebseigene Kantine, in der täglich frisch gekocht wird, eine Übernahme des Deutschlandtickets, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, vergünstigte Sport- und Gesundheitsangebote über machtfit und ein professionelles Mental Health Angebot durch das Fürstenberg Institut. 

Dürfen wir uns kurz vorstellen?

Familiär. International. Langfristig.

Besondere Qualität entsteht, wenn Tradition und Moderne miteinander harmonieren. 

Wir gehen respektvoll, offen und hilfsbereit miteinander um und geben jeden Tag unser Bestes, um erstklassige Kaffee-Spezialitäten zu produzieren.

Bei der DEK arbeiten Sie in einem internationalen Umfeld und spüren zugleich die Vorteile eines inhabergeführten Familienunternehmens.

title: Delivery Solutions Architect
descriptionHtml:
CSQ427R257

At Databricks, we are on a mission to empower our customers to solve the world's toughest data problems by utilizing the the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. As a Delivery Solutions Architect (DSA), you will play an important role during this journey. You will collaborate with our sales and field engineering teams to accelerate the adoption and growth of the Databricks platform in your customers. You will also help ensure customer success by increasing focus and technical accountability to our most complex customers who need guidance to accelerate usage on Databricks workloads that they have already selected, helping them maximise the value they get of our platform and the return on investment.

This is a hybrid technical and commercial role. It is commercial in the sense that you will drive growth in your assigned customers and use cases through leading your customers' stakeholders, building executive relationships, orchestration of other focused/specialized teams within Databricks, and creating and driving plans and strategies for Databricks colleagues to build upon. This is in parallel to being technical, with expectations being that you become the post-sale technical lead across all Databricks products. This requires you to use your skills and technical credibility to engage and communicate at all levels with an organisation. You will report directly to a DSA Manager within the Field Engineering organization. 

The impact you will have:

  • Engage with Solutions Architects to understand the full use case demand plan for prioritised customers
  • Lead the post-technical win technical account strategy and execution plan for the majority of Databricks use cases within our most strategic accounts
  • Be the accountable technical leader assigned to specific use cases and customer(s) across multiple selling teams and internal stakeholders, creating certainty from uncertainty and driving onboarding, enablement, success, go-live and healthy consumption of the workloads where the customer has made the decision to consume Databricks
  • Be the first contact for any technical issues or questions related to production/go live status of agreed upon use cases within an account, oftentimes services multiple use cases within the largest and most complex organizations
  • Leverage both Shared Services, User Education, Onboarding/Technical Services and Support resources, along with escalating to expert level technical experts to build the right tasks that are beyond your scope of activities or expertise
  • Create, own and execute a point-of-view as to how key use cases can be accelerated into production, coordinating with Professional Services (PS) resources on the delivery of PS Engagement proposals
  • Navigate Databricks Product and Engineering teams for new product Innovations, private previews and upgrade needs
  • Develop an execution plan that covers all activities of all customer-facing technical roles and teams to cover the below work streams:
    • Main use cases moving from ‘win’ to production
    • Enablement / user growth plan
    • Product adoption (strategy and activities to increase adoption of Databricks’ Lakehouse vision)
    • Organic needs for current investment (e.g. cloud cost control, tuning & optimization)
    • Executive and operational governance
  • Provide internal and external updates - KPI reporting on the status of usage and customer health, covering investment status, important risks, product adoption and use case progression - to your Technical GM

What we look for:

  • 5+ years of experience where you have been accountable for technical project / program delivery within the domain of Data and AI and where you can contribute to technical debate and design choices with customers
  • Programming experience in Python, SQL or Scala 
  • Experience in a customer-facing pre-sales, technical architecture, customer success, or consulting role
  • Understanding of solution architecture related distributed data systems
  • Understanding of how to attribute business value and outcomes to specific project deliverables
  • Technical program, or project management including account, stakeholder and resource management accountability
  • Experience resolving complex and important escalation with senior customer executives
  • Experience conducting open-ended discovery workshops,  creating strategic roadmaps, conducting business analysis and managing delivery of complex programmes/projects
  • Track record of overachievement against quota, Goals or similar objective targets
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience through work experience

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. title: Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Since early 2024, we've gone from 0 to over 900 customers, succeeding where many have tried and failed before. We have a big mission: to make it wildly easier and more profitable to run and grow a renewables installation business, and through that to make a real dent in the world's carbon emissions and a far better experience for homeowners.

We're now looking for a Design Engineer who wants to design & ship exceptional outcomes for users. Most of our product is a front end over hard physics (heat-loss calculations, hydronic design, LiDAR floor plans, compliance that has to be right), used by installers on a phone, with no signal, in a hurry. Making that feel simple is a design problem and an engineering problem at the same time, and this role sits right on that seam.

 

🌲 About Spruce

  • Almost 20% of the UK's carbon emissions comes from heating homes – there's simply no way to reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (🤯). But the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can't currently offer a heat pump when someone's boiler breaks and they urgently need heating.

  • We're fixing this. We've built a platform for heat pump installers to manage the whole installation journey from initial enquiry through to final compliance paperwork, freeing up their time to focus on what really matters: doing high-quality installations, providing great customer service, and scaling their business. Despite only getting started at the beginning of 2024, we're having a massive impact on installation businesses, suppliers, and manufacturers across the UK: halving the time they spend on each job and doubling their sales conversion rates.

  • We raised a chunky Seed round last year from top-tier investors and this year have grown the team 3x and revenue 4x. We've expanded into Ireland, are launching an end-to-end solar and battery product in November, and are increasingly becoming the operating system for the whole home renewables supply chain. If you can picture a combination of ServiceTitan, Procore, and AutoCAD, you might get a sense of where we're headed…

 

🥖 The role

You'll own how the product looks, feels and behaves wherever installers use it, from the first sketch to the shipped feature. Installers only adopt Spruce if it's easy to use on a real job, and adoption is what drives our growth. That puts your work at the centre of the business. Day-to-day you'll be:

  • Designing and shipping – You'll take a flow from rough idea all the way to production, prototyping in whatever gets you to an answer fastest (often code, sometimes Figma or a sketch), and testing with installers as you go. The gap between "we should fix this" and "it's fixed" is often a day.

  • Owning the interaction layer – You'll build and look after the component library and the patterns underneath it: motion, loading and empty states, touch targets that still work with gloves on. The small things that make a complex tool feel simple.

  • Building the parts that are hard to get right – The canvas-based floor plan and system design tools, the offline survey app (incl. LiDAR), the proposals homeowners see. These are the parts where the UI is the product, and where we've got the most still to build.

  • Raising the bar on everything we ship – You'll work closely with our product designers and developers, pairing on their work and reviewing it, so the quality of what you build rubs off on the rest of the product.

  • Spending time with installers – You'll go out on site, watch how the product actually gets used, then come back and change it.

You'll report to Steph, our co-founder and CPO (she’s pretty awesome) and you’ll work alongside Dan & Arron who’ve cooked up some incredible work in their time so far.

 

🫵 About you

We look for the same five things in everyone at Spruce: curiosity; intense drive, ambition and work ethic; a high degree of personal agency and ownership; deep humility and a growth mindset; and excellent craft. You might currently call yourself a designer who ships, a front-end engineer with strong design instincts, or already a design engineer. We're looking for 3+ years of experience (and potentially a lot more) designing and building product UI, ideally in a startup or a fast-paced, impact-focussed team. We'd love to speak with you if you have:

  • Real taste, and shipped work to prove it – You can show us production UI you designed and built, and talk about why the details are the way they are. Work you'd happily put next to the best-crafted B2B products out there.

  • Strong design craft, and a real appetite for code – You're a strong designer first. You don't need to be a front-end engineer, and you might well ship with Cursor or Claude Code, but you want to understand the code you're shipping. Bonus for React and TypeScript depth, canvas/WebGL, animation, or complex state on mobile.

  • A prototyping instinct – You'd rather build a rough version and test it than argue about it in a doc. You're comfortable with things being imperfect in front of users.

  • Systems thinking – You enjoy the structure of a good component library and understand that consistency is what lets a small team ship fast. You also know when to slow down first: you value time spent on lo-fi wireframes and on understanding the data model before anything gets polished.

  • Curiosity about the domain – You want to understand how heating systems, solar and battery actually work, and you pick up technical detail fast. By the end of week two you'll be arguing about the best way to show a homeowner their solar self-consumption.

 

🌟 Our offer

  • 💰 £60-110k salary, depending on experience and location

  • 🍰 Meaningful slice of equity (options) in the company

  • 🏖️ 33 days holiday (25 plus bank holidays) and opportunity to work from abroad for another 30 days each year

  • 🏡 Hybrid working: 2–3 days in-person a week (London or Bristol), with full-team meetups every fortnight

  • 🏥 Private Medical Cover (Vitality)

  • 👧 Workplace Nursery Benefit scheme (YellowNest)

  • 🧑‍🍼 Enhanced Parental Leave

  • 🚲 Cycle to Work scheme

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Brilliant team to learn from and massive opportunity to grow

 

🧑‍💻 Working at Spruce

  • We're currently a close-knit team of 34, split between London and Bristol. We spend 2-3 days each week working together in-person in both locations, and get everyone together every fortnight.

  • You'll have genuine influence from day one. The best idea wins regardless of seniority. We expect you to challenge everything, ask "why?" multiple levels deep, and push back when something doesn't make sense.

  • We want everyone to spend time with installers on-site, feel their pain points, then be able to rapidly suggest and implement solutions based on real feedback rather than assumptions. This is clearly particularly important for this role but you'll be surrounded by a whole team who are also close to our customers.

  • We move fast and ship imperfect things, learning from users rather than trying to perfect in isolation. When things break, we focus on how we fix it, what we can learn, and never blame. You'll own your outcomes whilst knowing the team has your back.

  • Feedback is constant, direct, and kind. We'll tell you when something isn't working and expect the same honesty (and empathy) back.

Compensation: £60K – £110K • Offers Equity

En tant que Développeur Nouveaux Projets, vous serez en première ligne pour identifier et sécuriser de nouveaux sites solaires et/ou de stockage en régions AURA et Bourgogne, tout en construisant des relations solides avec les acteurs locaux (collectivités, propriétaires fonciers, entreprises, partenaires). Grâce à votre sens du terrain et votre capacité à fédérer, vous participerez activement au développement de projets qui font sens pour le territoire et ses habitants.


Vos missions

· Assurer une veille active des opportunités de marché (appels à projets, appels d’offres) sur votre territoire.

Votre profil

· Formation Bac+5 : école de commerce, master en aménagement du territoire, urbanisme ou droit rural.

· Excellentes capacités relationnelles et de négociation.

· Goût prononcé pour le terrain et le contact direct avec les acteurs locaux.

· Esprit d’analyse, rigueur et autonomie dans la gestion de projets.

· Motivation à évoluer dans un secteur porteur et en pleine transformation.

Ce que NOVAR vous offre

Chez Novar, nous ne vous proposons pas seulement un emploi – nous vous invitons à rejoindre une véritable aventure. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement entrepreneurial et innovant, où l’énergie est au cœur de tout – au sens propre comme au sens figuré. Aux côtés de professionnels passionnés, vous contribuerez concrètement à la mise en œuvre de systèmes énergétiques durables. Et qu’est-ce que cela vous apporte ?

💰 Un salaire attractif, compris entre 48 060 € et 62 383 €, en fonction de votre expérience et de votre parcours.
🎁 Un système de primes basé sur la performance.
🌴 Une prime vacances.

🏠 Un mode de travail flexible et hybride – dans nos bureaux modernes ou confortablement depuis chez vous.

À propos de Novar – Nous façonnons l’avenir énergétique de l’Europe

Chez Novar, nous croyons que l’avenir de l’énergie est vert – et nous le concrétisons. Depuis notre création en 2014 aux Pays-Bas, nous sommes devenus un acteur majeur du développement et de l’exploitation de grandes installations d’énergies renouvelables. Avec plus de 150 collaborateurs engagés et 800 MWc de capacité installée, nous faisons avancer la transition énergétique à pleine vitesse.

Ce qui a commencé par des centrales solaires au sol est devenu une entreprise énergétique complète. Aujourd’hui, nous développons et fournissons de l’énergie solaire, du stockage par batteries, du solaire thermique, de l’hydrogène, des réseaux intelligents et bien plus encore. Nous couvrons toute la chaîne de valeur – du développement et de la construction à la gestion de l’énergie et à l’innovation.

Depuis 2024 nous étendons nos activités au-delà de notre marché d’origine, avec une présence en Suède, en Allemagne et en France. Notre objectif est ambitieux : développer 4 gigawatts de systèmes énergétiques verts d’ici 2030. Chez Novar, vous rejoindrez une équipe internationale en pleine croissance, animée par la volonté de faire la différence. Nous ne construisons pas seulement des projets énergétiques – nous façonnons les systèmes énergétiques de demain.

title: DevOps Engineer - Developer Experience (Lisbon or Berlin based)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider helping enterprises and consumer brands deliver seamless connectivity worldwide. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform, proprietary eSIM technology, and its own mobile core network across 15 countries, 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider in 43 countries.


Founded in 2022, 1GLOBAL has rapidly become one of Europe's fastest-growing telecom technology companies, connecting more than 80 million people and devices globally. Our customers include leading banks, multinational enterprises, global retailers, travel companies, payment service providers, and digital-first businesses.


Headquartered in the Netherlands, with R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 550 professionals across 16 countries. With annual revenues exceeding US$200 million and a strong track record of profitability, we continue to invest in innovation, infrastructure, and international expansion as we redefine the future of global mobile connectivity.

About the DevOps department

Our DevOps department has three teams. Each owns one layer of the platform:

  • Foundations (ROOT): machines, operating systems, virtualisation, VPNs and databases.
  • Cloud-Native Infra (CLOUD): cloud accounts, Kubernetes clusters, networking, identity and shared platform services.
  • Developer Experience (DEVX): pipelines, GitOps, internal tooling, observability and APIs used by engineering teams every day.

    About the Team

DEVX builds the tools and workflows our engineering teams use to ship software. That covers pipelines, GitOps, internal CLIs, observability and API management. Our tooling is written in Go.

We own: GitLab CI pipelines, Stack CLIs and internal tooling, Argo CD, Crossplane Compositions, metrics, logs, tracing, profiling, alerts and dashboards, API management, OAuth2 clients and the Governance API, our internal developer platform

We don't own: cloud accounts, clusters, networking, the service mesh, Crossplane providers and XRDs (CLOUD), GitLab instance upgrades and VMs.

Your first 6 months

  • Improve observability across the platform: alert quality, performance and data-transfer optimisation.
  • Take ownership of our Internal tools and the shared pipeline templates our developers use.
  • Help migrating the remaining deployments to GitOps with Argo CD.

About the role

  • Develop Internal tools in Go.
  • Own metrics, logs, alerts and dashboards, and help teams decide what to measure.
  • Build and maintain GitLab CI pipelines and shared templates.
  • Run Argo CD and GitOps workflows across environments.
  • Write Crossplane Compositions on top of XRDs.
  • Manage APIs, OAuth2 clients and the Governance API.
  • Help shape our internal developer platform.

Requirements

Requirements

About You

Must Have

  • 5+ years in DevOps, infrastructure or platform engineering, including ownership of production systems and on-call.
  • You write design docs, reason about trade-offs, and mentor other engineers.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken. Please send your CV in English.
  • Solid fundamentals in compute, networking and storage, and you're at home on Linux.
  • Go as your main language: production code with tests and releases, and CLIs or services you maintain.
  • Observability: Grafana, Prometheus, Thanos, Loki, Tempo, Pyroscope and alerts that people actually trust.
  • GitLab CI at scale: shared templates, includes, runners, pipeline security.
  • Helm and Kustomize.
  • Kubernetes from the workload side: CRDs and debugging deployments.
  • You treat developers as customers, with clear docs, feedback loops and attention to adoption.


Nice to Have

  • OpenTelemetry or distributed tracing (Tempo, Jaeger).
  • Argo CD/GitOps: ApplicationSets, sync strategies, promotion between environments.
  • OAuth2/OIDC, JWTs, API management.
  • Python as a second language.
  • Crossplane Compositions
  • Multi-stage Docker builds and image hygiene.
  • Writing Operators (kubebuilder/controller-runtime)
  • REST API design

Benefits

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 50% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

title: Director, Financial Services - Health Insurance & Insurance Technology Transformation
descriptionHtml:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Insurance practice is looking for an experienced Director or Senior Manager to help deliver and grow our Health Insurance and Insurance Technology Transformation capability.

Baringa helps insurers define their strategy, deliver complex change and modernise their platforms, data and operating models. We are growing our presence with leading UK health insurers and developing a cross-Baringa Health Insurance proposition. At the same time, we are building our Insurance Technology Transformation capability to support Global P&C carriers and clients across the wider Insurance sector.

As a Director or Senior Manager, you will combine Health Insurance expertise with strong technology transformation experience, client leadership, programme delivery and business development. You will lead complex workstreams and engagements, build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, support the development of client opportunities and help grow our people, propositions and market profile. Your primary focus will be our Health Insurance agenda, but your skills will transfer to our Global P&C and wider Insurance technology transformation work.

What you will be doing

  • Leading Health Insurance and Insurance technology transformation engagements and complex workstreams from initial assessment and design through to implementation
  • Building trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, including CEOs, CIOs, COOs, business leaders and operational and technology teams
  • Assessing operating models, technology estates and change portfolios, and translating findings into prioritised roadmaps, business cases and practical improvements
  • Advising clients on market trends, emerging technology and AI, leading practice and the design of target operating models
  • Shaping and delivering technology-enabled transformation, including platform modernisation, core system migration, data re-engineering and re-architecting insurers' operating and technology models
  • Managing multidisciplinary teams, engagement plans, risks, budgets and delivery quality to achieve strong client outcomes
  • Supporting the origination, shaping and conversion of Health Insurance and wider Insurance opportunities and contributing to proposals and account development
  • Developing market-relevant propositions, credentials, thought leadership and go-to-market activity, including Baringa's cross-firm Health Insurance proposition
  • Raising the visibility of Baringa's Health Insurance and Insurance Technology Transformation capability through client conversations, industry engagement and internal collaboration
  • Coaching and developing consultants and managers, providing clear direction, constructive feedback and inclusive leadership
  • Working collaboratively across Baringa's sectors and capabilities to bring the best of the firm to clients and identify broader opportunities
  • Applying your transformation skills flexibly to support Global P&C and other Insurance sub-sector opportunities as client demand requires

Your skills and experience

Essential

  • Strong consulting experience within a recognised consultancy, specialist advisory firm or major insurer, with a focus on Health Insurance
  • Deep knowledge of the Health Insurance market, including private medical insurance (PMI), and of the insurance value chain across product, pricing, underwriting, claims and customer servicing
  • Strong understanding of the Health Insurance landscape, and the strategic, commercial and technology drivers of change
  • A track record of managing complex technology transformation, platform modernisation, data or operating model change engagements within insurance or financial services
  • Credibility with senior client stakeholders and the ability to translate complex issues into clear decisions and practical outcomes
  • Experience managing engagement delivery, including scope, plans, risks, quality, budgets and team performance
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and coaching consultants, senior consultants and managers

Desirable

  • Experience in Global P&C or the wider Insurance market, with the ability to support our Global P&C and other Insurance sub-sector transformation work
  • An understanding of insurance technology platforms, data and vendor solutions, with transferable skills to support Global P&C and wider Insurance transformation
  • In-depth knowledge of the UK Health Insurance market and its key participants
  • Experience in specific Health Insurance areas, such as claims, provider and network management or digital customer journeys
  • Experience contributing to business development, proposals, proposition development and the growth of client accounts
  • Strong commercial judgement and an understanding of how to balance client outcomes, delivery quality and engagement economics
  • An existing network of Health Insurance client relationships

What a career at Baringa will give you 


Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. 
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. 
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice. 
  • Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success. 

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people.

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this. 

Using business as a force for good. 

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve. 

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.
