title: Information Security Engineer - Infrastructure Security
descriptionHtml:
A World-Changing Company Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role

We're looking for an Information Security Engineer who can think broadly about how infrastructure is built, attacked, defended, and improved. You may have deep experience in one area—such as endpoint security, Active Directory, Data Loss Prevention, cloud security, identity, or detection and response—but you’re motivated by solving security problems across the environment.

As an Information Security Engineer focused on infrastructure security, you'll help protect Palantir's global endpoints, servers, identity systems, applications, networks, and data flows. You'll work across teams to reduce attack surface, improve defensive controls, investigate security events, and turn security findings into durable architectural and operational improvements.

This is not just a corporate security role; the adversaries we face are sophisticated. We need someone who understands both the details and the broader system: how a weakness in one part of the environment can create risk somewhere else, how controls interact, and how to build security improvements that hold up in practice.
Core Responsibilities
  • Design, implement, and improve security controls across endpoints, servers, identity systems, cloud services, SaaS applications, networks, and data flows.
  • Drive security posture improvements through hardening standards, configuration management, vulnerability remediation, access controls, monitoring, and ongoing validation.
  • Assess security risks in new platforms, products, architectures, vendors, and services, and turn findings into practical recommendations and engineering work.
  • Build and maintain automation for security operations, including configuration validation, drift monitoring, patching, access reviews, policy enforcement, alert triage, and security hygiene.
  • Partner with Identity, Infrastructure, Engineering, Legal, and other Information Security teams to strengthen security architecture and address recurring risks.
  • Turn insights from assessments, red team exercises, incident investigations, and operational reviews into durable fixes, such as configuration changes, architectural improvements, policy updates, and automation.
  • Build expertise in one or more security domains while contributing across the broader infrastructure security lifecycle.

    • What We're Looking For
  • Experience securing one or more major infrastructure domains, such as Windows, macOS, Linux, Active Directory, cloud platforms, SaaS applications, networking, identity systems, or enterprise endpoints.
  • A broad infrastructure security mindset and curiosity about systems beyond your primary area of expertise.
  • Familiarity with common infrastructure attack paths, adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures, and the controls used to prevent, detect, and contain them.
  • The ability to assess complex environments and recognize how weaknesses across identity, endpoints, applications, networks, cloud services, or data flows can combine to create risk.
  • Experience evaluating security tools and validating that controls are deployed effectively and continue to work as intended.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, CI/CD, or other approaches to making security controls repeatable and scalable.

    • What We Value
  • The ability to own projects, make progress through ambiguity, and balance competing priorities while working well with colleagues.
  • Experience in complex, high-assurance, regulated, or rapidly changing environments.
  • Comfort moving between strategic problem-solving and hands-on technical work.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and work with partner teams to drive remediation.
  • Contributions to security programs, tooling, automation, incident investigations, or technical research—whether public or internal.

    • What We Require
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in information security, infrastructure security, security engineering, security operations, or a closely related field.
  • Demonstrated experience securing at least one major infrastructure or security domain, with the ability and interest to work across multiple domains.
  • Active TS/SCI security clearance, or eligibility and willingness to obtain one.
  • A strong sense of ownership, sound judgment, and integrity.
    • Life at Palantir We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region. In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office. If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please and let us know how we can help. Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

title: Ingénieur de Recherche
descriptionHtml:
Ingénieur de Recherche à l’Unité d’Economie Appliquée de l’ENSTA (F/H) :

Contexte :

ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, recherche et innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé.

L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission :

  • la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé,

  • la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR).

Début 2026, l’Unité d’Economie Appliquée de l’ENSTA (UEA, i3-CRG, CNRS) s’engage dans un projet de quatre ans financé par l’Agence Innovation Défense (AID). Ce projet s’appelle RésiCheVal (Résilience des chaînes de valeur). L’UEA s’intéresse à développer les outils permettant d’évaluer la capacité des filières associées à l’industrie de défense à résister dans un environnement géopolitique incertain où l’innovation technologique permanente est souvent une condition essentielle de la supériorité des forces armées.

Activités principales

L’ingénieur de recherche sera rattaché(e) à l’Unité d’Economie Appliquée (UEA). Il est attendu des candidat(e)s d’être en mesure :

  • De contribuer à la production d’états de l’art sur les formalismes de théorie des graphes en matière d’étude des chaînes de valeur dans le domaine des biens d’armement.

  • D’accompagner la production d’outils d’aide à la décision fondés sur ces formalismes.

Avantages :

  • Transports (participation forfaitaire de l’employeur à hauteur de 75 %)

  • Forfait mobilité durable (jusqu’à 300€/an)

  • Possibilité de télétravail (après accord du manager et dépôt d’une demande)

  • Subvention employeur au restaurant administratif et/ou à la cafétéria de l’établissement

  • Comité d’action sociale, avec notamment des événements et animations proposés au personnel, salle de sport sur adhésion,

  • Mutuelle (participation à hauteur de 50% de l’établissement)

Aménagement du poste de travail et recrutement inclusif :

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux candidats en situation de handicap.

ENSTA s’engage à un recrutement favorisant l’égalité, la diversité et l’inclusion. Toutes les candidatures sans aucune distinction (âge, handicap, sexe, nationalité, religion, orientation sexuelle…) ont leur place dans notre processus de recrutement.

ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID)). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans, inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment.

ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne. Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027.

Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle.

title: Innovative Planning Manager (Data Centres/Buildings/High-tech/Infrastructure) - UK (Hybrid)
descriptionHtml:
Are you a seasoned construction planner that is a bit tired of the standard old-fashioned wayof doing things in the construction industry?
Do you get deep satisfaction from making things run more effi ciently using a good dose ofcommon sense and maybe a bit of technology?
Have you always cared about the importance of proper planning and the connection betweenthe schedule and the real day-to-day delivery of the job?
Have you ever wanted to work a bit more fl exibly but still be hands-on in construction andimproving the industry?
Sounds like a dream. Well, it isn’t, it is actually quite real!
Read on! ____________________________________________________________ We are Laminar Projects! If you’ve already heard about us, you’re probably reading this because you’re tired of the typical, chaotic ways of doing things in construction. But in case you haven’t, we’re a high-end project management consultancy and tech developer with a focus on upgrading the way construction projects are delivered. Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Check out our short film about it.) We bring transparency and control to projects through a pragmatic mix of the latest tech, our own processes, and a big dose of common sense. We then take our deep understanding of these projects and we invest heavily into developing the digital solutions that anyone can use to deliver their projects better. (Check out Shape, our construction management tech, to see what we’re doing.) The core of all this is our true secret sauce: our people. We only recruit the very best, both in capability and personality. We’re deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that’s optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People who join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined. (Read more about our vision and missions.) This approach has allowed us to grow from just two people in 2017 to over 220 today. We have a stable, repeat client base across infrastructure and complex building projects in the UK and internationally, and we’re still growing fast. Joining us isn’t just some “job”. It’s a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life. There are many diverse and interesting challenges available. It’s up to you to guide yourself into whichever areas you’re most interested – we’ll enable it. (Get to know us better by watching a few more of our videos.) Core values for a good life A life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships and challenging yourself to create a positive impact, so our values reflect the four levels of relationships that each of us has: - Grow yourself – your relationship with yourself - Care about people – your relationship with others around you - Execute to greatness – your relationship with your team - Build civilisation – your relationship with humanity and the world We enshrined our values in our vision: We exist so that everyone in our team can flourish in a high-impact community that: - Connects us with meaningful relationships - Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans - Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures By first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world. And enable the achievement of our vision through our two missions: - To fully digitalise the construction of human civilisation - To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society ____________________________________________________________ The Role Purpose of the role You will be enhancing the delivery of the most complex and interesting projects in the world through the power of project planning. You will be a senior leader in our team pushing the discipline to new heights not only within Laminar but within the industry in general. Your Team This role is part of our Project Management Consultancy which focuses on:
- Understanding what the real problems of projects are
- Implementing the best solutions to those problems
- Developing scalable best practices, tools and technology
More specifically you will be part of our Project Planning Discipline Team who are industry leaders in the planning of complex construction projects. Your initial leader will be one of our planning discipline directors. Your top 3 objectives
1. To make construction projects deliver to near perfection
2. To create scalable and repeatable solutions to common problems
3. To develop yourself and everyone around you
Your top 5 responsibilities
1. Own the plan: Own the project plan for one or more projects and ensure that the project isworking to it eff ectively. Ensure delays are mitigated and managed commercially.
2. Own the outcome: You may not be the project manager ultimately responsible for the resultsbut you are sure as heck responsible for putting in your best eff ort to ensure the project’sunderstanding and focus on the plan no matter how stubborn they are!
3. Report and inform: Provide simple actionable reports to stakeholders at all levels that helpthem deliver their part of the project more effi ciently and eff ectively.
4. Make scalable solutions: Develop scalable and repeatable best practices and tools incollaboration with the team so that long-term impact is achieved.
5. Develop everyone: Maximise the development of your team personally and professionallyand educate our clients to improve as well. Must-Have (The fundamentals)
- Mastery: Solid construction project planning capability in all aspects that take into accountstrategic objectives and the broad context you are operating in
- Communication: The charisma, infl uence and presence to get construction people to do newthings and take the best approach
- Leadership: A proven leader/coach/developer of teams
- Impact: A track record of implementing scalable and repeatable solutions in projects that hada signifi cant positive impact Laminar isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true:
- You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge
- You like to be the smartest person in the room
- You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback
- You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team ____________________________________________________________ Frequently Asked Questions What kinds of projects would I be working on? It’s common for people to be exposed to several projects in their first year with us. You’ll work on some of the most complex and interesting environments in the world. We’ve delivered over 100 data centres internationally, many of them fast-tracked and multi-package. Our teams have supported flagship infrastructure programmes like HS2 through integrated planning and digital delivery, contributed to over $30bn in power generation and transmission projects, and played a key role in the development of high-containment labs and R&D campuses for some of the world’s most advanced industrial and life sciences clients. You might find yourself working in sectors such as data centres, infrastructure (including defense, rail, and highways), high tech (such as advanced manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, and semiconductors), or complex building projects. These aren’t hands-off assignments. They’re dynamic, hands-on environments designed for people who want to be challenged. We bring back the lessons from every project to help our team grow and deliver the highest levels of value. (Check out our case stories.) Who are our clients? Major owners/operators and main contractors with project values between £1m and £1bn+ globally. Where would I be working? One week you might be working from home. The next, you might travel to the site to meet the construction teams and help organise them. Maybe you’ll pop into our London office for a workshop or a beer. Maybe you’ll fly out to exotic (and sometimes not!) locations in Europe or the Middle East to visit clients. It really depends on what you want to get involved in and what fits with your life. How does what I do connect with the long-term impact on the construction industry? You’re tasked with understanding and solving common problems. We don’t want to reinvent the wheel every time, so you’ll be responsible for documenting new solutions and evolving ones we’ve developed. This goes into our knowledge repository, which we’re going to open source to the industry. The knowledge you capture will be used by us to build new products. You’ll constantly test those products in the field, so we can rapidly iterate and improve them for anyone in the industry to use. ____________________________________________________________ Benefits The standard stuff: - Health Insurance Scheme. Comprehensive private health coverage - for you and your family. Because your well-being is our priority - Pension Scheme. A competitive plan to help you plan for the long term - plus salary sacrifice options available to maximise your savings - Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future - with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance - Professional body membership. One fee covered per year - so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft - Cycle to Work Scheme. A tax-efficient way to get wheels - and do your bit for the environment The life-changing stuff: - In-house coaching. Regular 1:1 coaching sessions, fully confidential, to help you navigate challenges, build self-awareness, and grow intentionally - professionally and as a human being - Equity upside. As we grow, you grow. Our generous equity scheme is especially powerful for those who stay with us on our journey. You help us build the future - and own a piece of it - Flexible working. Work where it makes sense - most of our team works from home, visiting sites or clients regularly. We care about outcomes, not clock-ins - Relentless development. Our goal is for every year here to be worth five years of development anywhere else. You’ll get a coach, a mentor, honest feedback, and a culture that challenges you to keep levelling up ____________________________________________________________ Important! Applying properly We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining: - Why you want to join us - What you’ll bring to the team We aren't a giant, faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team, so your letter will be read carefully. After that, we’ll reach out to you to schedule a casual conversation to help you get to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself. A couple of technical and personal assessments follow to understand your capability based on our own development matrix. This is to ensure that when you join, you’re starting at the right level of responsibility.

Au quotidien, des milliers d'entreprises s'appuient sur nos solutions pour accélérer leur business.

Dans le cadre de notre stratégie produit, nous recherchons un Product Owner Senior pour la verticale Service Tertiaire & B2B. Cette verticale est stratégique : elle sert de socle commun à toutes les offres du Groupe.

Elle doit devenir l'un des moteurs des innovations qui vont changer la façon dont les entreprises détectent, qualifient et développent leurs opportunités commerciales. Elle alimente aussi les autres verticales d'Intescia (Construction, Immobilier, Manufacture et Services au Territoire) avec des capacités communes : connaissance des entreprises, détection d'opportunités, enrichissement de données et intelligence artificielle.

Votre mission :

En binôme avec le Product Manager de la verticale, vous transformez la vision et la roadmap en produits livrés, utilisés et créateurs de valeur.

Vous êtes le garant du backlog et le référent produit au quotidien des équipes de développement. Vous faites le lien entre les besoins des utilisateurs, les enjeux business et les contraintes techniques, data et IA. Votre objectif : livrer de façon régulière des fonctionnalités de qualité, qui ont un vrai impact.

Les fonctionnalités que vous livrerez sur cette verticale seront réutilisées dans l'ensemble des offres d'Intescia. La qualité de conception, la modularité et la cohérence de l'expérience sont donc au cœur de votre rôle.

Vos activités :

Piloter le backlog produit

  • Traduire la vision et la roadmap en epics, user stories et critères d'acceptation clairs, testables et orientés valeur.

  • Prioriser le backlog en continu selon la valeur client, l'impact business, la faisabilité technique et la dette.

Animer la delivery

  • Recetter les fonctionnalités et valider leur conformité avant mise en production.

  • Suivre les indicateurs de delivery (vélocité, délais de livraison, qualité) et contribuer à leur amélioration.

Livrer les fonctionnalités IA de nouvelle génération

Spécifier et livrer des fonctionnalités qui s'appuient sur les dernières avancées de l'intelligence artificielle :

  • Agents IA

  • Recherche conversationnelle

  • Qualification automatique des prospects

  • Recommandations intelligentes

  • Automatisation des tâches commerciales

  • Copilotes de prospection

  • Sales Engagement augmenté

  • Vous travaillez étroitement avec les équipes Data et IA pour cadrer les cas d'usage, définir les critères de qualité des modèles (pertinence, précision, explicabilité) et organiser l'expérimentation : prototypes, tests utilisateurs, déploiements progressifs.

Exploiter la richesse de la donnée Intescia

Concevoir des fonctionnalités qui valorisent concrètement les actifs data du Groupe :

  • marchés publics

  • projets privés

  • données entreprises

  • presse économique et spécialisée

  • données essentielles

  • données financières

  • signaux d'affaires

  • données ouvertes

  • enrichissements issus de l'IA

Vous veillez à la qualité, à la fraîcheur et à la bonne exposition de ces données dans les parcours utilisateurs.

Construire des briques transverses réutilisables

Vous travaillez avec les Product Owners et Product Managers des verticales Construction, Immobilier, Manufacture et Services au Territoire. Ensemble, vous spécifiez des composants, des API et des services communes autour de la recherche, du scoring, de la recommandation, des signaux d'affaires et de l'automatisation.

Vous gérez les dépendances entre équipes, assurez une documentation fonctionnelle de qualité et facilitez l'adoption de ces briques par les autres verticales.

Rester au plus près des utilisateurs

  • Participer aux entretiens utilisateurs, aux ateliers et aux tests d'usage avec les équipes Design et Customer Success.

  • Analyser les retours clients, les données d'usage et les indicateurs d'adoption pour améliorer le produit en continu.

  • Accompagner les lancements avec les équipes Sales, Marketing et Customer Success : supports, démos, notes de version.

    La rémunération sur ce poste est de 55K€ annuelle + variable.

    Le profil que nous recherchons :

Vous êtes un Product Owner expérimenté, reconnu pour la rigueur de votre delivery et pour votre capacité à transformer des besoins complexes en fonctionnalités simples et utiles.

Vous avez idéalement au moins 5 ans d'expérience en tant que Product Owner dans un environnement B2B SaaS, Data ou IA.

Vous maîtrisez :

  • les méthodes agiles (Scrum, Kanban) et les outils associés (Jira, Confluence ou équivalents)

  • la rédaction de spécifications fonctionnelles et de user stories

  • les échanges avec des équipes techniques, data et IA (API, modèles de données, notions de machine learning et de LLM)

  • l'analyse de données d'usage pour guider vos priorités

Vous avez un réel intérêt pour :

· l'intelligence artificielle

· les plateformes de données

  • les produits B2B

  • les outils de prospection

  • les CRM

  • les technologies d'automatisation

Vous êtes à l'aise pour arbitrer, vous communiquez avec clarté et vous aimez les environnements en forte évolution, où l'innovation est au cœur de la stratégie.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Vous livrerez concrètement la prochaine génération de solutions d'intelligence commerciale.

  • Vous serez au cœur de la stratégie IA du Groupe et mettrez en production des fonctionnalités qui changeront durablement les usages de milliers d'entreprises.

  • Votre travail ira au-delà de votre verticale : les briques que vous livrerez enrichiront les offres Construction, Immobilier, Manufacture et Services au Territoire.

  • Vous rejoindrez une équipe produit ambitieuse, avec beaucoup d'autonomie, un impact direct sur le produit et la possibilité de contribuer à une plateforme qui servira tous les métiers d'Intescia.

title: Investment Analyst (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über die Rolle

Eine gute Kaufentscheidung beginnt damit, dass jemand genau hinsieht. Bei Buena bist du das: Du verstehst das Unternehmen, hinterfragst Annahmen, erkennst Risiken und begründest, welchen Preis wir zahlen sollten.

Du verantwortest die Due Diligence für Hausverwaltungen, die wir übernehmen möchten: von der ersten Sichtung des Datenraums über die Bewertung und die Präsentation im Investment Committee bis zu den finanziellen und operativen Anlagen für den Kaufvertrag. Wenn das Committee ins Detail geht, kennst du das Unternehmen und kannst deine Empfehlung fundiert begründen.

Unser Prozess steht. Jetzt suchen wir jemanden, der die Verantwortung für die Qualität der Analysen übernimmt, die Due Diligence eigenständig steuert und unseren Prozess mit dem Wachstum weiterentwickelt.

Über Buena

Buena übernimmt Hausverwaltungen und digitalisiert sie mit selbst entwickelter Software. Wir verbinden Akquisitionen, operative Erfahrung und Technologie, um Immobilieneigentum und Verwaltung einfacher zu machen.

M&A ist ein zentraler Teil dieser Strategie. Die Unternehmen, die wir kaufen, werden Teil von Buena. Deshalb zählt unser Verständnis ihrer Zahlen, Verträge, Teams und Abläufe weit über den Abschluss einer Transaktion hinaus.

Deine Verantwortung

  • Das Unternehmen hinter dem Datenraum verstehen. Du führst Finanzdaten, Verträge, Objektlisten und Mitarbeiterinformationen zusammen. Du erkennst Lücken, gehst Widersprüchen nach und klärst offene Fragen mit den Verkäufern, bis ein belastbares Gesamtbild entsteht.

  • Die Bewertung fundiert herleiten. Du analysierst die wirtschaftliche Entwicklung, arbeitest mit unseren Kaufpreismodellen und prüfst die zugrunde liegenden Annahmen. Du zeigst, was deine Erkenntnisse für den Kaufpreis und die Investitionsentscheidung bedeuten.

  • Deine Ergebnisse im Investment Committee vertreten. Du verdichtest die Due Diligence zu einer klaren Einschätzung von Chancen, Risiken und offenen Fragen und präsentierst sie direkt vor den Entscheidungsträgern.

  • Die Details bis zum Closing begleiten. Gemeinsam mit unserem M&A-Anwalt bereitest du die finanziellen und operativen Anlagen zum Kaufvertrag vor und stellst sicher, dass die Angaben stimmen.

  • Für die Qualität einstehen. Du prüfst die Beiträge unserer Praktikant, erkennst Fehler frühzeitig und übernimmst Verantwortung für die fertige Analyse.

  • Den Prozess weiterentwickeln. Du lernst unsere Playbooks kennen, setzt sie sorgfältig um und bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie wir Datenräume, Analysen und Entscheidungen besser organisieren können.

Du passt gut zu uns wenn

  • Du bereits an Transaktionen gearbeitet hast. Idealerweise bringst du ein bis zwei Jahre Erfahrung als Analyst im Transaktionsumfeld, bei Private Equity oder Venture Capital mit. Auch fundierte Praktikumserfahrung kann relevant sein. Entscheidend ist, wie tief du in die Arbeit eingestiegen bist und welche Verantwortung du dir jetzt zutraust.

  • Deine analytischen Grundlagen sitzen. Du bist sicher in Excel, kannst Finanzdaten interpretieren und verstehst Bewertungskonzepte wie Equity Bridge und Discounted-Cashflow-Analyse.

  • Du den entscheidenden Details nachgehst. Eine Zahl, die sich nicht nachvollziehen lässt, oder eine Vertragsklausel mit unerwarteten Folgen ist für dich ein Grund, genauer hinzusehen.

  • Du dein Urteil erklären kannst. Du gehst souverän mit Rückfragen um, unterscheidest belastbare Erkenntnisse von Annahmen und änderst deine Einschätzung, wenn neue Informationen es erfordern.

  • Du Verantwortung übernimmst. Du hältst den Prozess in Bewegung, verfolgst offene Punkte konsequent und holst dir Unterstützung, wenn sie gebraucht wird.

  • Du dich in einem direkten, informellen Umfeld wohlfühlst. Du bringst sorgfältiges Arbeiten aus dem Transaktionsumfeld in ein Startup ein und gestaltest mit, wie wir arbeiten.

Die Besonderheiten von Hausverwaltungen und unsere internen Abläufe kannst du bei uns lernen. Startup-Erfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung.

Warum Buena

Früh eigene Verantwortung übernehmen. Du begleitest deine Targets durch die Due Diligence und stehst für die Ergebnisse ein. Deine Analysen fließen direkt in konkrete Kaufentscheidungen ein.

Direkt mit den Entscheidungsträgern arbeiten. Du präsentierst im Investment Committee und arbeitest eng mit Kolleg aus M&A, Legal und Operations zusammen.

Mit jeder Transaktion dazulernen. Unsere volle Pipeline bietet dir immer wieder die Gelegenheit, Unternehmen zu verstehen, Risiken zu bewerten und zu sehen, wie deine Erkenntnisse einen Deal beeinflussen.

Mitgestalten wie wir Unternehmen kaufen. Unser Prozess ist strukturiert und lässt sich weiter verbessern. Sobald du ihn kennst, hast du den Freiraum, einzelne Schritte zu hinterfragen und bessere Lösungen vorzuschlagen.

So lernen wir uns kennen

Wir sprechen über deine Transaktionserfahrung, deine Herangehensweise an Due Diligence und die Verantwortung, die du als Nächstes übernehmen möchtest. Anschließend bearbeitest du einen praxisnahen Case und lernst das Team kennen, auch bei einem gemeinsamen Mittag- oder Abendessen. Referenzgespräche sind Teil der abschließenden Phase.

Du möchtest die Due Diligence hinter Buenas nächsten Akquisitionen verantworten? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

title: IT Support Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Clay

AI is unleashing the biggest wave of company creation in history. Clay's mission is to be the engine those companies use to grow to their full potential.

Clay predicts the next best action for your business and then helps you take it. We started by aggregating the best data for B2B companies. Then, we built the infrastructure to run any personalized campaign on top of it, including emails, ads, landing pages, and workflows that make reps more productive. Now, we're building agents that can help grow your company for you. We're already helping thousands of customers — including Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and Visa — go to market with unique data, signals, and AI research.

In 2026, we raised a $115M Series D at $7.1B Valuation led by Wellington — and are on track to cross $200M in revenue this quarter. We also launched a $1M Scholarship fund for GTME Education.

Some things to know about us:

  • Our community includes 17,000+ customers, 200+ integration partners, 125+ agencies, 50+ Clay clubs, and 30k members on Slack.

  • Our cultureis unique inside and outside of work. Our team members are also DJs, activists, writers, clowns, marathoners, skydivers, psychedelic therapists, social workers, and more.

  • All employees can work with world-class coaches who specialize in creativity, management, and more.

  • Our operating principles — including negative maintenance and non-attached action — guide our work. Read more about them here.

  • Read about us in the NYT, Forbes, First Round Review, and more.

Hear from our employees directly on our Glassdoor page!

 

About the Role

Clay is scaling fast and the IT function is new. The IT Support Team will be the first point of contact for requests, the team that keeps the queue moving, and a key partner to the Head of IT in building out how the helpdesk operates.

The core of the support engineer role is service delivery: triaging incoming requests, resolving issues quickly, and making sure employees get reliable, responsive support. Alongside that, you'll work closely with the Head of IT to configure workflows and build process in our AI-powered ITSM platform, so the function gets more efficient as Clay grows.

This is a good fit if you take pride in running a clean queue, communicate clearly with employees, and are genuinely interested in building better process, not just executing it.

What You’ll Do (Job Responsibilities)

  • Be the face of IT at Clay. Triage and resolve incoming requests across access, software provisioning, onboarding and offboarding, hardware support, and general helpdesk needs. Employees should feel like IT is fast, reliable, and easy to work with.

  • Own onboarding and offboarding execution. Provision and deprovision accounts, coordinate hardware, and make sure new hires are set up from day one and departing employees are fully off-boarded without gaps.

  • Help build the helpdesk function. Partner with the Head of IT to configure and improve our ITSM platform — define request categories, build intake workflows, and manage queues as the function takes shape and scales.

  • Keep the office running. Support conference room AV, networking equipment, peripherals, and general office tech so employees can do their best work without technology getting in the way.

  • Administer the SaaS stack. Manage day-to-day administration across Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Notion, and other core tools — provisioning users, managing settings, and keeping things clean.

  • Handle hardware logistics. Coordinate device provisioning, shipping, receiving, and basic asset tracking so employees have what they need when they need it.

  • Build process, not just runbooks. Document what you own, identify patterns in incoming requests, and flag opportunities to improve or automate recurring work. The goal is a helpdesk that gets smarter over time.

What You’ll Bring

  • 3 to 5 years in IT support, helpdesk, or a closely related role

  • Strong service delivery instincts; you prioritize well, keep queues clean, and close requests with clear communication

  • Hands-on experience with ITSM platforms; you understand how to configure and manage one, not just work inside it

  • Broad SaaS admin experience: Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Notion, and similar platforms; you've provisioned users, managed settings, and handled admin tasks across a modern SaaS stack

  • Familiarity with office technology: conference room AV setup and troubleshooting, Meraki or similar networking equipment, common peripherals

  • Experience supporting onboarding and offboarding workflows end to end

  • Technical fluency: comfortable in SaaS platforms, macOS, and basic identity and access management tasks (provisioning, deprovisioning, group management)

  • AI-forward mindset: you use AI tools to work faster, handle volume more intelligently, and improve the support experience

  • Process-oriented: you notice what's inefficient and want to fix it

  • Clear communicator: employees trust you and know their issues are being handled

Bonus Points If You

  • Experience with Serval ITSM, either launching it or working within it day to day

  • Experience at a fast-scaling startup where IT processes were being built out

  • Familiarity with Okta or similar identity platforms at a user/admin level

  • Experience building workflows or automations in an ITSM or similar platform

  • Exposure to broader automation tooling

Why This Role

You'll handle the most visible function in IT and have a real hand in shaping how it works. Clay is an AI-forward company and this role reflects that — we're building a helpdesk that runs well and gets smarter over time. If you want to do solid IT support work at a fast-moving company and help build the process that makes it scale, this is a good fit.

title: Junior Compute Architect
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

About the Hardware organisation at Fractile
Processor Architecture sits within Fractile’s hardware organisation, which owns everything from compute engine definition and ISA design through memory hierarchies, on-chip interconnects, and the path from early architectural exploration through to tapeout and post-silicon validation. Architecture at Fractile isn’t a paper exercise — it’s built in constant collaboration with logical design, physical design, and verification teams, so that every architectural decision is grounded in what will actually perform in working silicon.

About the team and role
As an Early Career Processor Architect, you’ll join our architecture team to learn how to define the compute engines, ISA definitions and programming models that sit at the heart of our silicon. Working closely with senior architects and our logical design, physical design, and verification teams, you’ll get real exposure to performance modelling, specification writing, bottleneck analysis, and pre- and post-silicon validation — with experienced architects mentoring you as you build toward owning more of this yourself.

About you
We’re looking for someone with a strong foundational understanding of computer or processor architecture — built through coursework, personal projects, internships, placements, or research — who’s genuinely curious about performance and power trade-offs and eager to learn how to navigate them. You don’t need prior industry experience as a Processor Architect; what matters is real hands-on exposure to processor or accelerator design, through a final-year project, FPGA build, RISC-V implementation, internship, or research, plus a comfort working across disciplines and a track record of thriving in ambiguity and fast iteration.

Key Requirements

  • A degree (BEng, MEng, MSc or equivalent) in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.

  • A solid foundational understanding of computer/processor architecture, including matrix- and vector-centric floating-point arithmetic and memory hierarchies, gained through study, projects, internships, or research.

  • Some exposure to RTL design concepts and how physical design constraints feed back into architectural choices — academic or internship-level experience is fine.

  • Any hands-on exposure to architectural performance modelling tools (gem5, SystemC, or custom cycle-accurate simulators), compiler/toolchain interactions, or AI acceleration/vector-matrix compute, through study or projects, is highly valued.

  • A clear communicator, comfortable working across architecture, modelling, implementation, verification, and software teams, who thrives in ambiguity and fast iteration.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

 

Export controls

Our work involves technologies subject to UK, US and other international export control regulations. Certain roles may require additional eligibility checks to ensure compliance with applicable law. We'll be transparent about this throughout the hiring process.

title: Junior Procurement Trader
descriptionHtml:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

What You Will Do

  • Make deals: negotiate prices, contracts and work closely with our Sales team to identify and seize market opportunities.

  • Establish and maintain international supplier relationships as part of our strategic procurement, purchasing a seven-figure trading volume per month.

  • Find new partners internationally, for example via trade shows or cold calls, and build these up into long-lasting relationships.

  • Resolve issues with internal and external stakeholders that block revenue.

  • Follow spot market trades, price dynamics and trends, and act on them at high speed.

  • Work with advanced AI tools that keep you a step ahead of the market.

Who You Are

  • You think like a trader. You like buying and selling and ideally have made money before, for example through trading, your own business, a side hustle or a sales role.

  • You want to win. You chase deals and results without waiting to be pushed.

  • You act fast. You decide and follow up.

  • You have a natural curiosity. You always ask how and why, and you learn fast from every conversation.

  • You are comfortable interacting with internal stakeholders and external parties in real-life meetings or (video) calls.

Background

  • You are fresh out of university, or you have a couple of years of work experience in a commercial role, for example sales or trading. Any industry works.

  • Self-employment, your own business or a side hustle is very welcome. We look for people who drive commercial value, understand trade and know how to create revenue.

Required Qualifications

  • You have a university degree.

  • You have strong analytical and negotiation skills, and can clearly articulate complex subjects with confidence and precision.

  • You bring a hands-on mentality: you take ownership, solve problems independently, and thrive in dynamic settings.

  • You are curious about AI and how it changes the way we trade.

  • German post: You speak German at C2 level (mandatory) and English fluently.

  • English post: you speak English fluently. Italian is a plus, and so is any other European business-fluent language.

What’s In It for You

  • Real ownership from day one - shape operational processes in a fast-scaling, AI-first company.

  • Learn from the best - work directly with senior operators, interact with skilled industry leaders and CEOs on a daily basis

  • Competitive compensation - attractive base salary and performance-based bonus program.

  • Personal growth & visibility - rapid learning opportunities, cross-functional exposure, and early leadership potential in a growing global team.

  • Vibrant company culture – modern Berlin office, monthly All-Hands, team events, and regular offsites.

Why Join

You’ll be joining a company that’s not only transforming a global industry but doing so with the speed, precision, and intelligence of AI.
Here, you won’t just manage supply chains - you’ll help redefine how global commerce operates.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

Compensation: €70K – €90K

title: Key Account Manager 🇫🇷
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Our Account Management team’s purpose is to make our key accounts stay and grow with Alan. We created the team in 2020 and we are now 30+.
We are looking for amazing people to help us take care of our growing pipe, especially with our medium-touch segment and large accounts.
Being a Key Account Manager at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate experts, with different backgrounds.
We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

  • Participate in the evolution of our products and services, acting as the voice of our customers when discussing with Product teams

You would be a great fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you:

  • You have at least 6 years of experience in a customer-facing role including frequent interactions with C-Levels

  • You are analytical and love to solve problems in order to delight our members

  • You have great active listening skills ans are a master in the art of crafting the right follow-up message

  • You have a growth mindset: you are able to adapt to new trends and to develop an in-depth understanding of the health insurance market

  • You are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon or Annecy.


It is nice to have a previous experience in Insurance or any industry linked to benefits (but definitely not a must-have !)

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.Learn more about our coaching culture.

title: Kfz-Prüfingenieur mit Betrauung (m/w/d) – mit Perspektive zum Abteilungsleiter
descriptionHtml:
Beschreibung

Sie sind betrauter Kfz-Prüfingenieur und möchten nicht nur prüfen, sondern mittelfristig Verantwortung übernehmen? Dann bieten wir Ihnen einen Weg, auf dem Sie in Ruhe in eine Führungsrolle hineinwachsen.

Wir sind die von Hebel Fahrzeugtechnik GmbH. Wir betreiben eigene GTÜ-Prüfstellen in Lüneburg, Lauenburg/Elbe und Hamburg und führen als Partner der GTÜ Gesellschaft für Technische Überwachung mbH amtliche Fahrzeuguntersuchungen durch.

Gut zu wissen: Wir arbeiten eng mit dem von Hebel Ingenieurbüro zusammen – einem etablierten Kfz-Sachverständigenbüro, das professionelle Unfall- und Haftpflichtgutachten für Privat- und Geschäftskunden erstellt. Für Sie bedeutet das: ein breites fachliches Umfeld über die Prüftätigkeit hinaus.

Warum wir jetzt suchen: Wir planen langfristig. Die Leitung unserer Prüfstellen und des ca. zehnköpfigen Teams soll in einigen Jahren in neue Hände übergehen – und wir möchten die Person dafür frühzeitig an Bord holen. Sie steigen zunächst als Prüfingenieur ein, lernen unser Team, unsere Standorte und Abläufe kennen und übernehmen dann Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung. Für die Einarbeitung nehmen wir uns bewusst Zeit.

Ihr Einsatzgebiet: Unsere Standorte Lüneburg, Lauenburg/Elbe und Hamburg.

Ihr Weg in die Führungsposition

Kein Sprung ins kalte Wasser, sondern ein geplanter Übergang in Ihrem Tempo:

  • Ankommen: Prüftätigkeit an unseren Standorten, Kennenlernen von Team, Kunden, Abläufen und der Zusammenarbeit mit der GTÜ
  • Verantwortung übernehmen: erste Aufgaben der fachlichen und organisatorischen Leitung, z. B. Qualitätssicherung, Einarbeitung neuer Kolleginnen und Kollegen, fachliche Ansprechperson im Team
  • Übergabe: Stellvertretung der jetzigen Führungskraft und anschließend vollständige Übernahme der Position

Zuständigkeiten / Hauptaufgaben

Von Beginn an:

  • Durchführung von Untersuchungen der periodischen Fahrzeugüberwachung (HU/SP)
  • Abgasuntersuchungen (AU)
  • Änderungsabnahmen nach §19(3) StVZO
  • Wenn bereits Qualifizierung vorliegt: Begutachtungen im Rahmen des Technischen Dienstes, z. B. für Sondereintragungen, Umbauten und Importfahrzeuge
  • Tätigkeit im Außen- und Innendienst

Schrittweise hinzukommen:

  • fachliche Qualitätssicherung und Einhaltung der amtlichen Vorgaben an allen Standorten
  • fachliche Anleitung, Einarbeitung und Schulung des Teams
  • Ansprechperson für die GTÜ, z. B. bei Audits und fachlichen Rückfragen
  • Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden: Großkunden, Fuhrparks, Werkstätten, Autohäuser oder Einzelkunden
  • Mitwirkung an Dienstplanung, Prüfausstattung und der Weiterentwicklung unserer Abläufe

Qualifikationen / Anforderungen

  • Betrauung zum Kfz-Prüfingenieur – gern auch von einer anderen Überwachungsorganisation, den Wechsel zur GTÜ begleiten wir
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung
  • Interesse daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und ein Team fachlich zu führen
  • Sorgfalt, Zuverlässigkeit und ein hoher Qualitätsanspruch
  • Freude am Umgang mit Kunden und Kollegen
  • Bereitschaft zum Einsatz an unseren Standorten

Was noch fehlt, bauen wir gemeinsam auf

Sie haben noch keine Führungserfahrung oder sehen bei sich selbst noch Entwicklungsbedarf? Kein Problem – genau dafür planen wir die lange Einarbeitung ein. Wir schauen gemeinsam, where Sie stehen, und entwickeln Sie gezielt weiter:

  • Weiterbildungen zu Führungs-, Kommunikations- und Konfliktmanagement
  • fachliche Weiterbildungen, z. B. zum Unterschriftsberechtigten des Technischen Dienstes oder zum Kfz-Sachverständigen (inkl. IfS-Zertifizierung)

Leistungen der Anstellung

title: KYC/KYB Analyst
descriptionHtml:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot,based on 60,000 reviews. Our cultureputs customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here).

 

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 byAlexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

 

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, and 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

 

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

Join us as a KYC/KYB Analyst to protect Qonto's regulated growth while keeping onboarding fast and fair for our clients. You'll review enhanced due diligence and KYBC cases, decide who can safely open or keep a Qonto account, and flag financial-crime risks the moment you spot them, working closely with our Lead EDD. 

➡️ What you'll do

  • Decide on high-risk files: Review EDD cases for onboarding and lifecycle reviews, then approve, reject, or send them back to L1 for missing or invalid documents.

  • Handle KYBC edge cases fast: Assess alternative documents and gray-activity requests, closing decisions within a 48-hour SLA when clients are blocked.

  • Focus where it matters: Automation handles the routine files, so you'll concentrate your judgment on the riskiest ones during your weekly control checks.

  • Cross-check the numbers: Compare declared turnover and financial documentation against real account activity to spot inconsistencies.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • Fluent in French and English, including legal reading: You read bylaws, RCS extracts, and legal documentation as comfortably as any other business document, in French, and work just as easily in English.

  • Risk judgment under ambiguity: You reason through gray-area cases instead of defaulting to blanket rejection or blanket approval.

  • AFC/KYC/KYB fundamentals: You're curious about AFC/KYC/KYB topics and ready to learn on the job.

  • Attention to detail: You catch missing documents, invalid evidence, and inconsistencies that others might miss.

  • AI-native mindset: You're comfortable letting AI handle routine cases so you can focus on the ones that need real judgment.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • Real autonomy, fast: Reach independent decision-making on routine files within a few months, with complex cases escalated together.

  • A growing scope: As Qonto's credit products expand, you'll take on larger companies and more complex corporate structures over time.

  • Structured onboarding: Shadow the team, get weekly 1:1s, and have every early decision reviewed before you go fully autonomous.

  • A seat at the intersection of compliance and fraud: Your work directly feeds AFCU's transaction-monitoring investigations, broadening your view beyond onboarding. 


[DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.

title: Laser Architect (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Focused Energy is a fusion energy startup with the goal of generating unlimited clean energy to responsibly meet future global demand. With the use and commercialization of laser-induced inertial fusion, a clean and highly efficient power generation technology is coming within reach, suitable to ensure a secure and scalable future energy supply.

We are seeking a Laser Architect to join our dynamic laser development team. The Laser Architect is the system‑level technical lead responsible for the conceptual design, modeling, and experimental validation of laser driver architectures for inertial fusion energy (IFE) at the research and pre‑pilot stage.

This role focuses on defining and evolving credible laser driver concepts that can ultimately support fusion energy production, while operating primarily at the R&D and demonstrator level, where performance exploration, risk reduction, and physics‑driven trade studies dominate over industrial optimization.

The Laser Architect ensures coherence between laser physics, system architecture, and fusion requirements, guiding the transition from laboratory concepts toward scalable driver solutions. They enable the transition of inertial fusion energy from proof‑of‑principle laser experiments toward credible, scalable driver concepts, shaping the technical foundations on which future pilot plants and commercial systems will be built.

What you'll do:

  • Define and refine laser driver concepts suitable for IFE.

  • Explore alternative architectures and assess their feasibility through modeling and experiments.

  • Maintain ownership of the global architectural vision, even as individual subsystems evolve in parallel.

  • Define the laser R&D roadmap, including critical component development/evaluation, integrated beamline demonstrators, and intermediate testbeds

  • Work closely with experimental teams to ensure results feed back into architectural decisions

  • Support design of diagnostics and test protocols aligned with future scaling needs.

Who you are:

  • PhD or equivalent experience in laser physics, optical engineering, or related fields

  • Deep expertise in high‑energy and/or high‑average‑power laser systems

  • Strong background in laser system modeling and scaling analysis

  • Demonstrated experience in conceptual design and experimental validation of complex laser systems

  • Ability to operate across physics, optics, and systems‑level reasoning

  • Ability to bridge theoretical modeling and experimental reality

  • Operates as a system thinker with strong physics intuition

  • Comfortable exploring multiple architectural paths in parallel

  • Values quantitative modeling, experimental feedback, and iterative refinement

  • Communicates technical trade‑offs clearly to scientists, engineers, and leadership

What we offer:

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a subsidized canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 15% on top of your monthly contributions.

  • Equipment: Choose between a state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptop. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs—whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job

Lead the design, development, and adoption of AI systems within a strategic business domain.

You will combine deep AI engineering expertise with product and business understanding to identify high-impact opportunities, define roadmaps, and deliver measurable outcomes.

As the AI technical lead for your domain, you will drive architecture decisions, engineering excellence, and AI adoption across teams and stakeholders. Examples of domains include: Sales, GTM and Marketing or Finance & Legal

This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week.

Annual gross salary range (package): €90,000 – €100,000

 This range is provided for transparency purposes and reflects our internal compensation grid for this role level. The final offer will be determined based on your experience, skills, and the scope of responsibilities involved.

Why Now, Why Mirakl

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Lead AI Engineer to transform cutting-edge AI technologies into reliable, scalable, and measurable products used by leading enterprises worldwide.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.


What You’ll Do

1. Own Tech Strategy for Your Domain

  • Identify high-value opportunities with Business leaders
  • Define the Tech vision and own the agent product roadmap for your domain

2. Lead AI System Development

  • Design and build production-grade AI systems
  • Drive architecture decisions
  • Ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability

3. Drive Adoption & Business Impact

  • Work closely with end users
  • Measure adoption and outcomes

title: Senior Business Development Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über unseren Kunden

Wahrscheinlich hast du heute schon ein Produkt unseres Kunden benutzt, ohne es zu merken. Das Unternehmen ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter intelligenter Zugangslösungen: Tor- und Türautomation, die Gebäude, Grundstücke und Garagen sicher und smart macht. Mehrere tausend Mitarbeitende arbeiten weltweit für den Konzern, hinter dem ein renommierter internationaler Investor steht. Zum Portfolio gehören starke Marken für den professionellen B2B-Markt und den DIY-Bereich sowie ein App-basiertes Smart-Access-Ökosystem, das Zugangsprodukte vernetzt.

Das Europa-Geschäft mit Zentrale in Deutschland wächst und verändert sich gerade. Ziel ist es, Marktanteile zu gewinnen und den Vertrieb noch professioneller aufzustellen. Dafür sucht das Unternehmen eine Person, die nicht nur selbst Neukunden gewinnt, sondern das BDM-Team mitzieht.

Deine Mission

In den nächsten 12 bis 24 Monaten gewinnst du messbar mehr Neukunden, vor allem große OEMs. In deinem Kerngebiet Nordeuropa (Skandinavien und Benelux) baust du eine starke Pipeline auf. In Deutschland (DACH) holst du wichtige Zielkunden an Bord. Gleichzeitig setzt du für das BDM-Team den Standard im Neugeschäft.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Neukunden gewinnen: Du verantwortest dein eigenes Kerngebiet Nordeuropa (Skandinavien und Benelux) und konzentrierst dich auf große OEMs. Außerdem bist du dafür verantwortlich, wichtige Zielkunden in Deutschland (DACH) zu gewinnen. Dabei hilft dir idealerweise dein eigenes Netzwerk.

  • Abschlüsse in ganz Europa unterstützen: Mit den BDMs in Benelux und Nordeuropa besuchst du Kunden gemeinsam und hilfst, neue Accounts zu gewinnen.

  • Vorbild und Coach sein: Du prägst mit, wie das Team (ca. 5 BDMs) Neukunden anspricht, Kundentermine gestaltet, das CRM nutzt und die Pipeline steuert. Wenn du schon erste Führungserfahrung hast, ist das ein Plus.

  • Vertrieb steuern und Forecasts verantworten: Du berichtest KPIs in HubSpot, verantwortest deine Forecast-Zahlen und legst Maßnahmen fest, wenn erwartete Aufträge ausbleiben.

  • Den Markt entwickeln: Du beobachtest Markt und Wettbewerb und bringst Ideen ein, wie das Unternehmen Kunden vom Wettbewerb gewinnt.

Du berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung Europa.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im operativen B2B-Vertrieb oder Business Development und kannst nachweisen, dass du Neukunden gewinnst.

  • Du hast große Accounts, idealerweise OEMs, in mehreren europäischen Märkten gewonnen und weiterentwickelt.

  • Du arbeitest diszipliniert: Ein CRM (z. B. HubSpot), sauberes Pipeline-Tracking, KPI-Reporting und verlässliche Forecasts gehören für dich zum Alltag.

  • Du lieferst Ergebnisse, statt nur darüber zu reden. Du gehst proaktiv auf Kunden zu, setzt dich durch, denkst in Zahlen und hältst ein, was du zusagst.

  • Du betreust gern eigene Kunden und unterstützt dabei deine Kolleg:innen. Profitabilität behältst du im Blick, neue Ideen bringst du aktiv ein.

  • Du wohnst in Deutschland und bist bereit, etwa 60-70 % zu reisen (v. a. Skandinavien, Benelux, DACH und weitere Länder in Europa)

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.

Ein Plus ist, wenn du:

  • Erfahrung mit Tür-, Tor-, Zutritts- oder Sicherheitslösungen mitbringst oder aus einer verwandten Branche kommst, etwa Bau, Gebäudetechnik oder Elektro. Das ist keine Pflicht, solange du dich schnell ins Geschäft einarbeitest.

  • schon Vertriebskolleg:innen gecoacht oder ein Vertriebsteam fachlich geführt hast

  • ein Netzwerk zu OEMs und Großkunden in Nordeuropa, Benelux und DACH hast.

  • weitere Sprachen sprichst, vor allem Französisch, Niederländisch oder eine skandinavische Sprache.

Deine Benefits

  • Home-based arbeiten: Du musst nicht regelmäßig in der Europazentrale sein

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit bei einem globalen Marktführer

  • Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Das Europa-Geschäft wächst, und du hast direkten Einfluss darauf, wie der Vertrieb sich entwickelt

  • Internationales Arbeitsumfeld mit Kund:innen und Kolleg:innen in ganz Europa

  • Kurze Wege zur Geschäftsführung Europa und schnelle Entscheidungen

  • Attraktives Gehaltspaket + Car Allowance
