title: Modelling Resident
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Most AI is frozen in place - it doesn’t adapt to the world. We think that’s backwards. Our mandate is to build efficient intelligence that evolves in real-time. We bring together exceptional people with the drive and creativity to push the boundaries of continual adaptation. We’re looking for builders and creative thinkers ready to shape the next era of intelligence.

Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in accountability, initiative and shared success. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. We operate with low egos, high velocity, and extreme ownership to build technology that expands access and benefits the many, not the few.

How We Work

  • Impact over activity: We are building a generational company. We value people who execute on ideas rather than comment from the sidelines. We believe our competitive edge lies in caring about excellence across the entire lifecycle - from research to product. No task is beneath anyone: no one is too senior to test the build, clean the data, or unblock a teammate.

  • Vulnerable, low-ego collaboration: We believe exceptional work comes from people who challenge, support and push one another to think bigger. Rapid iteration requires stepping into discomfort. We encourage bold, half-baked, and unorthodox ideas. When we disagree, we share feedback directly, never through side channels.

  • Celebrate decisively: Extraordinary effort should be deeply memorable. We celebrate milestones generously and publicly - via spot bonuses, team dinners, spontaneous gifts, and company-wide recognition - to fuel each other for the next sprint.

The Role

Our vision is AI systems that are flexible, adaptable, and accessible to everyone. We believe efficiency is what makes this possible. It’s how we expand access and ensure innovation benefits the many, not the few.

A modelling residency puts you in the center of a frontier lab. You'll be embedded in real work: placed on key production and research projects and mentored directly by our modelling team. We're building our frontier innovation around efficiency, gradient-free exploration, real-time learning, and interface design. By the end of this 8-month residency, our hope is that you leave with a track record you're proud to put on your resume and experiences that meaningfully upskill you.

What You'll Do

  • Innovation: Build the future of adaptive algorithms that continuously learn. Co-design algorithms that react in real-time to product signal and feedback, and explore new ways of capturing feedback that make those algorithms better

  • Cross-stack optimization: Collaborate across software, hardware, and algorithmic domains to drive system-wide efficiency gains

  • Measure what matters: We believe the ultimate signal of value is real-world impact. The smartest algorithm is one capable of interacting with the world — that's why product signal matters so much to how we work.

 

Skills You'll Bring

We look beyond traditional markers of experience. What matters most to us is what you’ve built and the impact you’ve had. We value demonstrable output, curiosity and alignment with our core values:

  • A degree or equivalent research/engineering experience in a computer science field.

  • Genuine interest in, and at least one project touching: model efficiency, synthetic data, interfaces, real-time alignment, or algorithmic optimization

  • Systems thinking — the ability to understand and optimize across the full ML stack

  • Strong Python skills and experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow)

  • Familiarity with model optimization techniques such as RLHF and fine-tuning

  • Strong communication and self-awareness — you know how to collaborate in a remote environment and you're open to feedback

  • You care about technical excellence and last mile impact. We value impact more than effort, and about owning outcomes end to end.

We value impact over credentials. Above all, we're looking for great teammates who make work feel lighter and aren't afraid to go out on a limb with bold ideas. You don't need to check every box - but you do need to be adaptable.


What We Offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: A dynamic environment with opportunities to take on new challenges, expand your responsibilities, and make an impact beyond your immediate role.

  • Adaption Passport: An annual travel allowance to explore somewhere new, experience different cultures and keep expanding your horizons. It can be used to travel to any country you haven’t previously been to.

  • Lunch on us: A weekly allowance for takeout or grocery delivery, wherever you are in the world. Whether it's stocking your fridge or having dinner delivered, it’s one less thing to think about.

  • Comprehensive benefits: High-quality medical coverage and benefits designed to support your health and well-being.

  • Team offsites and visits to SF HQ: We're a global team, but believe there's real value in spending time together in person. We regularly bring teammates together at our SF HQ and for team offsites in locations around the world, including London, Mexico City, and New York.

MSF International

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 26 sections, 28 associations and 16 branch offices together. Registered in Switzerland, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF Movement, as well as implements international projects and initiatives as requested.

I. CONTEXT

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent medical humanitarian organisation providing emergency assistance to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters, based solely on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation.

MSF International is the legal entity whose membership is composed of all MSF associations. It hosts the International Secretariat, supports the International Board, facilitates coordination across the MSF movement, and provides shared services and initiatives as mandated by the movement.

Within MSF International, the International Office acts as the Secretariat of the International Board (IB) and operates under the direct management of the International Secretary General (ISG). MSF International also provides administrative and operational support to movement-wide initiatives and services, including MSF Access.

II. PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The MSF International Managing Director is a senior executive role responsible for institutional leadership, stewardship of resources, and organizational performance of MSF International as a legal entity serving the MSF movement.

The role ensures that MSF International:

  • Effectively implements -within the scope of MSF International - the MSF International Multiyear Plan and SPARC (MSF-wide Strategic Planning, Accountability and Resource Cycle) and supports the International Board and the International Secretary General in their governance roles and responsibilities.

  • Provides high quality, well governed services to the MSF movement, as mandated by the Full ExCom (executive committee);

  • Operates with strong systems of governance, accountability, risk management and duty of care;

  • Has robust, transparent and efficient governance, financial, human, and knowledge systems;

  • Operates as a coherent, inclusive, and accountable internationally distributed organization;

  • Models MSF values in leadership, equity, duty of care, and ethical management;

  • Ensures that the decisions taken by the Board of Directors of MSF International and its implementation is compliant with the Articles of Association, the internal regulations, as well as Swiss standards and Swiss laws, for as long as the registered office is in Geneva, Switzerland.

The MSF Management Director acts as a strategic partner to the International Secretary General, providing leadership on transversal and institutional topics with regards to the management of MSF International.

III. ACCOUNTABILITIES

1. Strategic Leadership and Implementation of MSF International (Multi‑year Plan & SPARC): Lead the translation of MSF International and movement strategic priorities into clear objectives, organisational plans, policies and resourcing within MSF International; support cross‑functional initiatives required by international platforms as needed to deliver the Multi‑Year Strategic Plan and SPARC commitments.

Expected result: MSF International delivers on agreed strategic priorities and SPARC commitments through coherent plans, measurable milestones and coordinated delivery across functions and movement partners.

a. Contribute to the development of MSF International Multi‑year Strategic Plan and SPARC within MSF International’s mandate and scope and translate strategic priorities into concrete organisational objectives, policies, systems and resource allocations, ensuring coherence across functions and services.

b. Supports cross‑functional and transversal initiatives required to deliver common strategic priorities and SPARC‑related commitments.

c. Contribute to movement-wide discussions on harmonization, efficiency and shared services.

d. Sets up and tracks implementation plans, including key milestones, indicators, and risks. Support the ISG in reporting to the International Board and relevant Standing Committees, and contribute to SPARC’s Monitoring & Evaluation Framework and Expense Steering Process for functions and services managed within MSF International’s scope.

e. Deputize for the ISG as required, within agreed scope and representation mandates.

f. Represent MSF International to key stakeholders, partners and external audiences as required, and build relationships that protect and advance MSF's institutional interests.

2. Governance, legal compliance, accountability and risk management for MSF-International: Ensure robust governance implementation, statutory compliance and effective risk management systems for MSF International as a Swiss legal entity and for services delivered on behalf of the movement; prepare governance-level advice and support Board decision-making.

Expected result: International Board and executive decisions are supported by timely, compliant and risk‑informed advice; MSF International statutory obligations and legal requirements are met and organisational risks are identified and mitigated.

a. Act as senior management liaison to the ISG, the International Board and Standing Committees on matters related to MSF International organisational governance, resources, risk, compliance and organisational performance.

b. Ensure robust systems of internal control, risk management and accountability, are in place and functioning for MSF International, in line with legal, fiduciary and associative obligations, including preparedness for critical incidents directly affecting MSF International.

c. Lead or support organizational responses to critical incidents directly affecting MSF International, including HR, legal, reputational, safeguarding or security‑related situations.

d. Ensure that MSF International fulfils its statutory responsibilities as a Swiss legal entity and that appropriate legal, administrative and governance support is obtained for decisions of the IB in light of the International Statutes, the Internal Regulations, and Swiss standards and law. Ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations regarding daily management of MSF International.

e. Oversee compliance with GDPR and Swiss data protection law, promoting a culture of privacy and responsible data use.

f. Ensure appropriate legal review of all contracts and agreements directly involving MSF International and including those through which it delivers services to the movement, in accordance with MSF’s rules and policies, as well as Swiss law.

g. Design, implement and monitor the effectiveness of internal control systems and procedures; ensure that MSF International risks are identified and registered and ensure that mitigation measures are discussed and incorporated in the respective departments annual plans.

3. Services to MSF: Provide executive stewardship of movement-wide services mandated to MSF International, ensuring clear service governance, defined accountabilities and cost‑effective delivery.

Expected result: Movement services operate to agreed service charters and KPIs, with transparent costs and reliable delivery that meet sections' needs and contractual obligations.

a. Provide executive leadership and stewardship over services mandated to MSF International in support of the MSF movement, ensuring they are clearly governed, fit for purpose, cost‑effective and appropriately funded.

b. Ensure that roles, responsibilities, decision‑making authority and service boundaries between MSF International and MSF sections are clearly defined and communicated, balancing interoperability and mutualization objectives with the sections and ODs autonomy.

c. Establish and monitor service governance and performance frameworks, including service charters, KPIs, cost‑sharing arrangements and escalation mechanisms where relevant, and ensure transparency.

d. Facilitate structured dialogue with MSF sections to identify service needs, manage expectations and address risks or performance issues.

4. Financial stewardship and institutional integrity: Oversee budgeting, financial planning, statutory accounts, audits and financial controls; ensure alignment of resources with strategic priorities and manage institutional financial and insurance arrangements.

Expected result: MSF International maintains sound financial health, regulatory compliance and transparent resource allocation that supports strategic objectives.

a. Provide executive oversight of budgeting, forecasting and financial reporting for MSF International.

b. Ensure alignment between strategic priorities (including SPARC) and resource allocation.

c. Oversee statutory accounts, audits, financial policies and compliance with Swiss GAAP, tax and VAT requirements.

d. Oversee relationships with external auditors, financial advisors and legal counsel.

e. Oversee institutional insurance coverage and financial risk mitigation. Manage the full suite of institutional and corporate insurance coverage for MSF International.

f. Oversee legacies and donations earmarked for MSF International

5. People, culture and organisational development: Oversee people strategy, workforce planning, performance management, leadership development and organisational design to foster an inclusive, safe and high‑performing culture across a distributed workforce.

Expected result: A diverse, supported and capable organisation with clear succession pathways, strong performance management and a positive organisational culture.

a. Provide strategic leadership over human resources management, organizational design and workforce planning.

b. Ensure a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct.

c. Oversee performance management, leadership development and succession planning.

d. Ensure a lively MSF International culture despite the geographical spread, including through adequate internal communication.

e. Lead organisational development, when necessary, to ensure the organisational structure remains fit for purpose and appropriate for a well-functioning office.

f. Manage institutional relationships with MSF sections hosting MSF International staff and ensure coherent frameworks for hosting, contracting, payroll and staff integration.

g. Ensure appropriate information governance and that knowledge management systems support collaboration, institutional memory and organizational learning, including learning from strategy and SPARC implementation.

h. Liaise regularly with the Staff Committee of MSF International.

IV. AUTONOMY, COMPLEXITY

The MSF International Managing Director operates with a high degree of autonomy to think, interpret and act within the strategic direction set by the International Secretary General, the International Board and the governance framework of MSF International.

The role is required to make independent judgements on organisational priorities, resource allocation, risk mitigation, service performance, people matters and operational responses, often in situations where issues are sensitive, cross-functional and without straightforward precedent.

The complexity of the environment is significant: the postholder works across a federated MSF movement with multiple stakeholders, distributed teams, hosted staff arrangements and diverse section interests, while also ensuring compliance with Swiss legal and regulatory requirements, internal governance rules, financial and HR procedures, safeguarding standards and data protection obligations. Success therefore depends on balancing institutional coherence, legal and procedural rigour, and service effectiveness with diplomacy, sound judgement and the ability to operate in ambiguity.

V. SAFEGUARDING REQUIREMENTS FOR THE ROLE

The incumbent commits to contribute to a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct. They will not engage in any form of abuse including those detailed in MSF Typologies of Abuse and when an employee suspects or observes abuse, they will report it (without investigating it) to protect others.

  • Ensure respectful management and communication at all levels.

  • Ensure that staff and consultants under their supervision understand their responsibilities with respect to required behaviour and report abuse while working for MSF by reinforcing and regularly discussing expected standards of behaviour.

  • Welcome complainants, understand how to guide colleagues to appropriate channels, promote and create an environment that does not tolerate abuse or inappropriate behaviour. Guide colleagues to the correct process without investigating.

  • Ensure that staff know how to complain and keep staff updated on reporting mechanisms.


Education

Experience

  • Extensive senior leadership experience (General/Executive Director, Deputy Director or Director of a major organizational function) in a complex and large international and decentralised organisations

  • MSF experience is a major asset

  • Proven ability to operate at Board and executive level

  • Strong people leadership, including conflict management and change leadership

  • Solid expertise in financial oversight, governance and organisational systems

  • Experience with equity, diversity and inclusion strategies

Knowledge

  • Strong commitment to MSF’s humanitarian principles and associative values.

  • High level of integrity and ability to handle confidential and sensitive matters.

  • Knowledge of Swiss legal, institutional, employment, financial and data protection frameworks is an asset.

  • Familiarity with governance of associations and federated movements is an asset.

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional and institutional change.

  • Comfortable leading teams across different locations and liaising with stakeholders at all levels.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, able to communicate complex or sensitive matters clearly, concisely, and professionally.

  • High level of discretion, judgement, and emotional intelligence, and the ability to build a strong network across an organisation.

  • Confident decision‑making and the ability to act autonomously as appropriate.

  • Flexible team player, willing to adapt to changes, and confident tackling unfamiliar challenges across multiple domains of knowledge/experience.

Languages

title: Navigation Engineer (Precise Navigation)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a Navigation Engineer within our Precise Navigation team, you will design and develop high-precision navigation and positioning solutions based on tightly-coupled IMU/GNSS filtering, improving localisation accuracy, integrity, and robustness to jamming and spoofing for our autonomous systems – from concept to field deployment. You will work hand-in-hand with the Navigation and Radar teams, as well as software and Electronic Warfare (EW) teams, to deliver robust, resilient Position, Navigation and Timing (PNT) and ensure overall performance, robustness and reliability.

Responsibilities

  • Navigation Architecture: Drive the architecture and implementation of navigation / PNT solutions for autonomous platforms.

  • Resilient PNT: Develop navigation resilient to GNSS degradation, jamming and spoofing (anti-jam / anti-spoof).

  • Sensor Fusion: Design multi-sensor fusion (GNSS, INS/IMU, RF, vision) and the associated estimation and filtering algorithms.

  • Testing & Validation: Design test plans (e.g. GNSS receiver testing in jamming environments), run simulations and replays, and report on findings and performance against targets.

  • Technical Coordination: Collaborate across HW, software, EW and ML teams on technical interfaces and system-level trade-offs.

  • System Reviews & Documentation: Contribute to design and architecture reviews and maintain requirements traceability and documentation.

Candidate Requirements

  • MSc in Engineering (aerospace, robotics, EE or related); PhD is a plus.

  • Strong mathematical background combined with good physical intuition.

  • Experience with GNSS, INS/IMU and navigation/estimation filters (e.g. Kalman filtering), particularly in tightly-coupled architectures.

  • Experience with navigation in GNSS-denied / contested environments.

  • Familiarity with RF and EW constraints (GNSS jamming / spoofing) is a plus.

  • Solid software / algorithm skills; combined algo + software profile rather than a pure coder.

  • Broad engineering culture with understanding of electrical, embedded and mechanical systems.

  • Rigorous, structured and mission-driven mindset with strong analytical skills.

  • Excellent communication and documentation abilities.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Offre de stage :  Imprimer l'énergie de demain : développement de générateurs thermoélectriques innovants
department: Matériaux à haute performance et éco-matériaux
descriptionHtml:
Unité : CERI MP

Responsables : Dr. CHARLON Sébastien, Pr. SAMUEL Cédric, Dr. Amulya RAJ

Nature de l’emploi : Stage de master 2 ou équivalent d’une durée de 6 mois

Lieu de travail : Douai (59)

Description de l’IMT Nord Europe :

École sous tutelle du ministère de l’économie, des finances et de la souveraineté industrielle et numérique, IMT Nord Europe est née en 2017 de la fusion de Télécom Lille et de l’École des Mines de Douai. Elle compte aujourd’hui parmi les plus Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs au Nord de Paris avec plus 2200 élèves, dont un quart d’apprentis, plus de 600 diplômés par an et un réseau de 15 000 diplômés. Elle fait partie de l’Institut Mines Télécom, premier groupe public de Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France, et est partenaire de l’université de Lille.

IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l’innovation et les créations d’entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l’Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1H30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l’ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l’ingénieur et les technologies du digital.

Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d’enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s’appuie sur plus de 20 000 m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d’excellence dans les trois domaines « Systèmes Numériques », « Energie Environnement » et « Matériaux et Procédés ».

Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’École : www.imt-nord-europe.fr

Contexte scientifique et missions :

Le développement de capteurs autonomes en énergie pour l'Internet des objets (IoT) représente un défi scientifique et technologique majeur. Dans ce contexte, les technologies de récupération d'énergie constituent des solutions prometteuses pour convertir différentes sources d'énergie présentes dans notre environnement (mécanique, thermique, solaire, électromagnétique, etc.) en énergie électrique.

Le projet européen THERMOHARV, réunissant l'Université de Mons, l'Université de Lille, le C2DE et l’IMT Nord Europe, ambitionne de développer une nouvelle génération de microgénérateurs thermoélectriques organiques (OTEG), flexibles et performants, capables de convertir directement la chaleur fatale en énergie électrique. Ces dispositifs pourraient notamment contribuer à l'alimentation de capteurs autonomes dans les bâtiments, les centres de données ou les environnements industriels.

Dans ce cadre, le Centre d'Enseignement, de Recherche et d'Innovation Matériaux & Procédés (CERI MP) d'IMT Nord Europe développe des encres fonctionnelles à base de nanotubes de carbone, présentant des propriétés thermoélectriques. Ces encres sont déposées sur des substrats polymères flexibles grâce à un procédé innovant de fabrication additive par écriture directe (Direct Ink Writing, DIW).

L'enjeu scientifique consiste à maîtriser les interactions entre la formulation des encres, leur imprimabilité et les performances thermoélectriques des dispositifs obtenus afin de concevoir des générateurs optimisés.

Dans ce contexte, les missions scientifiques et technologiques confiées à la personne recrutée seront les suivantes :

  1. Formulation des encres : développer et optimiser des encres thermoélectriques à base de nanotubes de carbone, notamment en étudiant l'influence des conditions de dispersion sur leurs propriétés.

  2. Caractérisation physicochimique : étudier les relations entre la formulation, l'état de dispersion des nanotubes de carbone et les propriétés rhéologiques des encres.

  3. Optimisation du procédé d'impression : identifier les paramètres d'écriture directe permettant d'obtenir des dépôts homogènes, reproductibles et présentant une géométrie maîtrisée.

  4. Conception et optimisation des dispositifs : modéliser l'influence de la géométrie des générateurs sur leurs performances thermoélectriques.

  5. Fabrication et caractérisation d'un prototype fonctionnel : concevoir, fabriquer et évaluer les performances d'un prototype de générateur thermoélectrique flexible.

Ce stage permettra ainsi de participer à l'ensemble de la chaîne de développement d'un dispositif fonctionnel, de la formulation des matériaux jusqu'à la validation expérimentale d'un prototype, au sein d'un environnement de recherche collaboratif.


Profil de la personne recrutée :

La personne recrutée devra être étudiante en Master 2, en dernière année d’école d’ingénieurs ou suivre une formation équivalente dans le domaine de la science et du génie des matériaux, de la physicochimie ou du génie des procédés.

Des connaissances en formulation et dispersion d’encres, notamment par ultrasons, en fabrication additive (impression 3D, écriture directe) ainsi qu’en caractérisation des matériaux (rhéologie, goniométrie, profilométrie) seront particulièrement appréciées. Une expérience ou des connaissances dans le domaine de la thermoélectricité constitueront un atout supplémentaire.

Au-delà des compétences techniques, la personne recrutée devra faire preuve de rigueur scientifique, d’autonomie, de curiosité et d’un intérêt marqué pour la recherche expérimentale. De bonnes capacités d’analyse, de synthèse et de communication scientifique, tant à l’écrit qu’à l’oral, sont également attendues.

Conditions :

Le poste est à pourvoir à compter du 01/02/2027 pour une durée de 6 mois

Renseignements et modalités de dépôt de candidature :

  • Pour tout renseignement sur le poste, merci de vous adresser à

Dr. CHARLON Sébastien, Pour tout renseignement administratif, merci de vous adresser à la Direction des Ressources Humaines :

Date limite de candidature : 31/12/2026

title: Ontwikkelaar vastgoed
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij bouwen aan de vastgoedopgave én aan een nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie? Als ervaren ontwikkelaar bij Dura Vermeer Bouw & Vastgoed werk je aan grootschalige vastgoedprojecten in Midden-Nederland. Je stapt in na acquisitie en bent verantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling richting verkoop en realisatie. In een ondernemende omgeving krijg je alle ruimte om mee te bouwen aan het team, je expertise in te zetten in de samenwerking met adviseurs én door te groeien naar een rol met meer inhoudelijke en coachende verantwoordelijkheid.

Dit wordt jouw baan

Ondernemend, ervaren en klaar om impact te maken? Dan voel jij je thuis binnen deze nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie van Dura Vermeer. Als senior Projectontwikkelaar werk je aan omvangrijke vastgoedprojecten en help je niet alleen projecten verder te brengen, maar ook het team en de organisatie. Je begrijpt hoe ontwikkeling en bouw elkaar versterken, neemt eigenaarschap en krijgt de ruimte om mee te denken, mee te bouwen en mee te groeien. Je bent betrokken vanaf de fase na acquisitie / tendergunning en schakelt intensief met de het ontwikkelteam om projecten succesvol verder te brengen.

Wat ga je doen
De focus ligt op het moment waarop een tender is gewonnen of een acquisitie is verworven en projecten daadwerkelijk ontwikkeld gaan worden. Je werkt aan (middel)grote vastgoedontwikkelingen en ben je de verbindende factor tussen ontwikkeling en bouw. Dat maakt deze rol ideaal voor een ervaren ontwikkelaar die energie krijgt van het uitwerken van projecten, ondernemerschap toont en wil meegroeien met een ambitieuze organisatie.

· Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling van woningbouwprojecten vanaf tendergunning/acquisitie, naar omgevingsvergunning tot aan de start van de verkoop;

· Je bewaakt de businesscase en stuurt op waardecreatie gedurende het gehele ontwikkelproces;

· Je vertaalt ambities en plannen naar concrete ontwikkelbeslissingen die bijdragen aan een succesvolle uitvoering;

· Je stuurt het ontwikkelproces aan op het gebied van kwaliteit, planning, financiën en risico's;

· Je verbindt de belangen van gemeenten, adviseurs, beleggers, corporaties, bouwteams en andere stakeholders;

· Je werkt intensief samen met collega's van Bouw om projecten optimaal uitvoerbaar en haalbaar te maken;

· Je werkt nauw samen met makelaars, verkoopmanagers en notarissen om projecten succesvol in verkoop te brengen;

· Je voert regie op vergunningstrajecten, overeenkomsten en besluitvorming;

· Je draagt actief bij aan de verdere opbouw en professionalisering van de ontwikkelorganisatie.

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis.

Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent iconisch én dichtbij en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.


Hier zit je op jouw plek

Bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Utrecht staan we aan het begin van een nieuw hoofdstuk. Waar we jarenlang bekend stonden als een sterke renovatie/transformatiespecialist, zijn we sinds begin dit jaar uitgegroeid tot een volwaardige Bouw en Vastgoed organisatie. Naast renovatie en transformatie realiseren we nu ook nieuwbouwprojecten in de woning- en utiliteitsbouw én zetten we de volgende stap naar eigen gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling.

Dat betekent dat je terechtkomt in een organisatie die volop in beweging is. Met ruim 100 collega's binnen onze werkmaatschappij bouwen we niet alleen aan duurzame woningen, utiliteitsprojecten en leefomgevingen, maar ook aan de toekomst van onze eigen organisatie. De lijnen zijn kort, de ambities groot en de kansen om mee te bouwen aan nieuwe werkwijzen, teams en projecten liggen voor het oprapen.

Hier krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken. Niet vanaf de zijlijn, maar midden in een frisse organisatie die zich verder ontwikkelt en waarin ondernemerschap, samenwerking en eigenaarschap centraal staan. Samen bouwen we aan projecten waar we trots op zijn én aan een organisatie die klaar is voor de toekomst.


Dit breng jij mee

· Minimaal 5 tot 10 jaar ervaring als projectontwikkelaar;

· Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding;

· Ervaring met woningbouwontwikkelingen;

· Aantoonbare ervaring met complexe projecten;

· Ruime ervaring met ontwikkeltrajecten in de SO-, VO- en DO-fases, het verkrijgen van omgevingsvergunningen en verkooptrajecten;

· Ervaring binnen een ontwikkelaar, ontwikkelende bouwer of vastgoedorganisatie.

Je bent een ontwikkelaar die vooral energie krijgt om projecten na tendergunning/acquisitie verder te brengen richting realisatie. Je komt het beste tot je recht wanneer met alle betrokken partijen, de complexe projecten succesvol weet te ontwikkelen én realiseren.

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Het salaris voor deze functie ligt bij senior profiel tussen € 6.512,- en € 9.512,- (op basis van 40 uur), exclusief 8% vakantiegeld. Het exacte salaris is afhankelijk van jouw kennis, niveau en werkervaring;

  • Voor deze functie geldt een individuele bonusregeling, waarbij de hoogte van de bonus afhankelijk is van de behaalde resultaten;

  • Bovenop salaris komt een vast bedrag Budget Duurzame Inzetbaarheid voor zaken die eraan bijdragen gezond en gemotiveerd te blijven (2,3% volgens cao Bouw & Infra);

  • 43 verlofdagen volgens de cao Bouw & Infra. Van deze dagen worden er 13 uitbetaald in je individuele budget, je kunt ervoor kiezen om deze dagen terug te kopen;

  • Een laptop en een smartphone;

  • Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een standaardverzekering van alle werknemersrisico's, pensioenregelingen, een extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en een bijdrage voor het vakbondslidmaatschap;

  • Je hebt de keuze tussen een elektrische leaseauto, een mobiliteitsbudget of NS Business Card;

  • Bij een contract voor onbepaalde tijd kun je een gloednieuwe (elektrische) fiets uitzoeken dankzij onze samenwerking met lease-a-bike;

  • Veel aandacht voor jouw groei dankzij onze eigen Dura Vermeer Academie met volop opleiding- en trainingsmogelijkheden binnen je vakgebied, maar ook op het gebied van vitaliteit;

  • Bedrijfsfitnessregeling met keuze uit een sportaanbod van ruim 3.500 sportlocaties door heel Nederland;

  • Een goede werk-privébalans dankzij een flexibel werken beleid en soepele regelingen voor arbeidsduur, werktijden, calamiteiten, mantelzorg of sabbatical;

  • Voor verse vaders en partners: 100% doorbetaling van je salaris tijdens de 5 weken van het aanvullend geboorteverlof, in plaats van de standaard 70%.

Wil jij ook meer uit je werk halen?

Dan zijn wij nieuwsgierig naar jou! Solliciteren kan direct via onze website middels de solliciteerbutton onder de vacature.

title: Operational Service Intelligence Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Radiant

Radiant is building AI native cloud infrastructure for the most demanding compute workloads.

Our platform combines high density GPU compute, high performance networking, storage, data centre operations and cloud software. We design and operate infrastructure for customers who require predictable performance, strong security, operational resilience and clear service accountability.

As Radiant scales across multiple sites, regions and infrastructure environments, we are building the operational intelligence layer that connects technical performance with customer outcomes, commercial commitments and investment decisions.

About the role

The Operational Service Intelligence Manager will create the reporting, KPI and capacity-planning framework used across Radiant’s Service Management, Infrastructure Operations and Data Centre Operations teams.

You will turn operational data into clear insight for leadership, Finance, Customer Success, Product and Engineering. You will help the business understand service performance, customer impact, capacity constraints, infrastructure cost and opportunities for improvement.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can define the right metrics, build practical reporting and use data to improve how teams operate.

What you’ll do

  • Define and maintain KPIs for:

    • Incident, Change, Problem and Request Management

    • Infrastructure Operations and SRE

    • Data Centre Operations

    • Security-related operational activity

  • Establish customer-facing service reporting, including:

    • Availability and uptime

    • SLA performance

    • SLA credits and penalties

    • Incident and service trends

  • Build dashboards and reporting for operational performance, capacity and risk.

  • Own reporting standards, definitions and data quality across operational teams.

  • Analyse:

    • Compute, network and storage utilisation

    • Available and constrained capacity

    • Power usage and infrastructure efficiency

    • Failure rates and recurring incidents

    • Spare inventory and component usage

    • Vendor performance and RMA trends

  • Support capacity planning for GPU clusters, networks, storage and data centre infrastructure.

  • Develop SLA simulations and planning models, including hot and cold spare requirements.

  • Work with Finance on infrastructure reporting and FinOps, including:

    • Cost per MW

    • Cost per GPU hour

    • Asset inventory

    • Committed and available capacity

  • Partner with Customer Success to create consistent service reporting for customers.

  • Own the strategy for service intelligence and KPI tooling.

  • Identify operational bottlenecks and use data to recommend improvements.

  • Work with Product and Engineering to turn recurring service issues into product improvements.

  • Help define telemetry and observability requirements for new products and releases.

  • Measure how product changes affect operational KPIs and customer experience.

  • Lead quarterly service reviews with Product and Engineering leaders.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience in service intelligence, operational analytics, service management, infrastructure operations or a related field.

  • Strong experience defining KPIs, SLAs and operational reporting.

  • Experience working with ITSM, infrastructure, data centre or cloud operations teams.

  • Strong analytical and data visualisation skills.

  • Ability to work with operational data from multiple systems and identify meaningful trends.

  • Understanding of capacity planning, infrastructure utilisation and service performance.

  • Experience presenting concise, decision-ready reporting to senior stakeholders.

  • Commercial awareness and experience working with Finance or FinOps teams.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work across technical and non-technical teams.

  • Comfortable building structure and reporting standards in a growing organisation.

Nice to have

  • Experience in AI infrastructure, HPC, cloud, hyperscale or data centre environments.

  • Experience with ITIL, service management or operational excellence frameworks.

  • Familiarity with GPU, network, storage and power-related infrastructure metrics.

  • Experience working with observability, telemetry or data platform teams.

  • Experience turning operational data into customer-facing product features.

Success in the role

  • Radiant has a consistent and trusted set of operational KPIs.

  • Leadership can quickly understand service health, capacity and risk.

  • Customer reporting is accurate, consistent and delivered on time.

  • Finance has reliable infrastructure cost and utilisation data.

  • Capacity constraints and vendor issues are identified early.

  • Operational trends consistently inform product and process improvements.

title: Operations Manager, Offer Operations
descriptionHtml:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

🦾 Our Offer Operations team

Joko helps millions of users earn cashback automatically, whether they shop online through affiliate links, activate coupons, or pay in-store with their linked bank card. Behind each of these experiences, there's an operational engine that needs to work flawlessly: transactions must be tracked, cashback must be caught, offers must be reliable, and merchants must perform as expected. When this engine breaks, users don't get paid — and trust erodes fast.

Offer Operations owns that engine. The team's mission is to guarantee the reliability and continuous improvement of Joko's core monetization mechanics — across affiliate tracking, coupons, card-linked bank integrations, gift cards, and merchant performance. It's a technical, data-heavy, high-stakes scope that sits right at the heart of what makes Joko's product work.

🎯 What you will do

As an Operations Manager, your main mission is to own one of the processes that decides whether millions of Joko users actually get the cashback they're owed. You'll report to David Le Pahun, our Offer Operations Lead. The role blends four things: analysing data, designing how the process should work, solving problems with AI, technologies or in the last resort outsourcing, and managing projects.

  • Analyse data. You'll build the dashboards that tell you — and everyone else — whether your part of the system is healthy: how many transactions are being correctly tracked and rewarded, what's silently breaking down, whether user experience is suffering.

  • Design the process. You decide how merchants get set up on our platform: their cashback rate, which purchases qualify, how we connect to their systems. A lot of this doesn't have a playbook yet — you'll be writing a good chunk of it as you go.

  • Solve problems with technology. A merchant might be showing users a coupon that doesn't actually pay out. A batch of card purchases might not match cleanly to any merchant we track. You'll dig into why, then fix it choosing the right solution for it: automating it with AI, improving one of our internal tools (built on Retool) and if a human is required, you'll build the right playbook to outsource it.

title: Package Reliability Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

The Role

We are seeking a Package Reliability Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will own the reliability of our packaged products, from defining mission profiles and reliability targets to identifying package-level failure mechanisms, developing qualification strategies, and making evidence-based release recommendations.

Reporting to the Quality & Reliability Program Lead, you will work closely with the Package Architecture, Device Reliability, Product Engineering, and OSAT/laboratory partners to translate product use cases into mission profiles and FIT/MTBF targets. You will assess reliability risks, define and execute package-level reliability test plans, lead failure analysis activities, and ensure findings are driven to resolution.

Your core focus will be to transform product requirements into robust reliability strategies, validate package concepts through targeted stress testing, and provide data-driven recommendations that enable confident product release.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Own mission profiles and reliability targets by defining product operating conditions (temperature, voltage, humidity, thermal cycling, and lifetime requirements) and allocating FIT, MTBF, and lifetime targets across package, interconnect, and device-level contributors.

  • Assess package reliability risks by evaluating failure mechanisms across substrates, die attach, interconnects, solder joints, board attach, and optical/fiber interfaces, including delamination, warpage, fatigue, electromigration, and optical or electrical drift.

  • Define and execute package reliability qualification plans covering thermal, mechanical, environmental, and board-level stress testing in accordance with JEDEC, AEC-Q100/Q006, IPC, IEC, and customer-specific requirements.

  • Lead the technical interface with OSATs, substrate suppliers, and labs, defining reliability requirements, reviewing data, and challenging results when the supporting evidence is insufficient or unrepresentative.

  • Drive root-cause investigations and failure analysis, leveraging techniques such as X-ray, C-SAM, cross-sectioning, SEM/EDX, and related methods, and translate findings into CAPA/8D actions, design improvements, and requalification decisions.

  • Develop risk-based qualification strategies for novel packaging technologies, such as UBC and optical interconnects, where industry standards are incomplete or do not yet exist.

  • Provide data-driven release recommendations by assessing whether products are ready for customer sampling, qualification milestones, or production release, while clearly communicating any remaining reliability risks.

Your Qualifications

  • Educational background with a Master's degree (or equivalent experience) in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Materials Science, Reliability Engineering, or a related field.

  • Package reliability expertise with 3–5+ years of experience evaluating semiconductor package construction (substrates, die attach, interconnects, and solder joints) and understanding the failure mechanisms associated with these technologies.

  • Understanding of high-speed I/O and RF reliability, including how reliability degradation impacts high-speed serial, RF, and optical interfaces (e.g., signal integrity, insertion loss, jitter, and eye closure over product lifetime). This expertise goes beyond conventional digital logic reliability and is a core requirement for this role. Experience with photonics reliability is highly desirable.

  • Solid foundation in reliability engineering, including FIT and MTBF calculations, mission profile development, acceleration models, and translating product use cases into measurable reliability requirements and targets.

  • Experience with industry qualification standards, including JEDEC, AEC-Q100/Q006, IPC, and IEC, as well as the judgment to apply knowledge-based qualification approaches when existing standards are not sufficient.

  • Failure analysis expertise, with the ability to interpret results from techniques such as X-ray, C-SAM, cross-sectioning, and SEM/EDX, and translate findings into risk-based recommendations.

  • Experience collaborating with OSATs, substrate suppliers, and external laboratories, including defining technical reliability requirements, reviewing qualification data, and driving technical discussions to ensure robust evidence for product qualification.

  • Excellent cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate reliability risks, trade-offs, and evidence gaps to architects, engineers, suppliers, and leadership.

  • Thrives in a startup environment, demonstrating initiative, ownership, adaptability, and the ability to make progress in a fast-paced, resource-conscious setting.

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

Can you picture yourself in this Role and our Company? Let’s connect!

title: Partner Account Manager, Cabinet Intégrateurs (en télétravail depuis Lille) (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 350 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 000,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !



Pourquoi ce rôle est-il important chez nous ?

Les intégrateurs historiques disposent souvent d’une expertise métier reconnue, d’équipes commerciales et de conseil, ainsi que d’un parc de clients à accompagner. Ils peuvent contribuer fortement à la croissance de Pennylane, à la fois par la vente de nouvelles solutions et par le développement de leur parc existant.

Pour transformer ce potentiel en résultats, il faut installer une dynamique commerciale durable : aligner les dirigeants et les équipes terrain, faire émerger des opportunités, améliorer la maîtrise du produit et faciliter la collaboration avec les équipes Pennylane. Tu aideras les partenaires à passer d’une relation de distribution ou de prescription à une collaboration active, structurée et créatrice de valeur.

 

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

Tu piloteras le développement d’un portefeuille de partenaires intégrateurs, de la stratégie de compte jusqu’à l’exécution des plans d’action :

  1. Développer les comptes partenaires, en alignant les dirigeants, responsables commerciaux et équipes opérationnelles autour d’objectifs communs.

  2. Accélérer le business Resell et Cosell, en animant les opportunités, en améliorant leur qualité et en aidant les partenaires à faire progresser leurs cycles de vente.

  3. Faire monter les équipes partenaires en compétence, grâce à des démonstrations, des formations et un accompagnement commercial concret.

  4. Créer une dynamique de croissance sur le parc existant, en identifiant les opportunités de déploiement, de migration et d’équipement des clients des intégrateurs.

  5. Faire rayonner les apprentissages du terrain, en partageant les résultats, les besoins partenaires et les leviers qui fonctionnent avec l’équipe Partnerships et les autres équipes internes.

 

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

1. Construire et déployer les plans de croissance des partenaires

  • Comprendre le modèle économique, l’organisation, les priorités et le potentiel de chaque intégrateur.

  • Construire avec les dirigeants et responsables commerciaux des plans de compte ambitieux, assortis d’objectifs et d’étapes concrètes.

  • Identifier les leviers de croissance adaptés à chaque partenaire : développement du parc, nouveaux projets, campagnes ciblées, événements ou actions conjointes.

  • Mobiliser les sponsors et les équipes terrain pour ancrer le partenariat dans les pratiques commerciales et opérationnelles.

  • Prioriser ton temps et les ressources internes en fonction du potentiel et de l’impact attendu.

2. Animer le business Resell et Cosell

  • Créer et entretenir une relation de confiance avec les décideurs, les équipes commerciales et les consultants du partenaire.

  • Suivre le pipeline Resell et Cosell, assurer la qualité des opportunités et rendre le forecast fiable.

  • Aider le partenaire à qualifier les besoins, structurer les opportunités et mobiliser les bons interlocuteurs Pennylane.

  • Coordonner les actions avec les Account Executives et clarifier les rôles sur les cycles de vente partagés.

  • Détecter les risques, débloquer les situations et accélérer les opportunités pertinentes jusqu’à leur conclusion.

3. Développer le parc et les opportunités chez les clients des intégrateurs

  • Identifier avec le partenaire les segments de clients et les cas d’usage prioritaires.

  • Construire des plans d’action pour équiper ou faire migrer les clients du parc lorsqu’une opportunité pertinente existe.

  • Aider le partenaire à organiser la prospection, la qualification et le suivi des projets issus de son réseau.

  • Participer à des rendez-vous clients, démonstrations ou événements lorsque cela peut accélérer le business ou renforcer la relation.

  • Suivre l’impact des actions engagées et capitaliser sur les approches qui produisent des résultats.

4. Former et rendre les équipes partenaires plus autonomes

  • Maîtriser la proposition de valeur et les principaux cas d’usage de Pennylane afin de réaliser des démonstrations convaincantes.

  • Former les équipes commerciales du partenaire à présenter la valeur de la solution, au-delà des seules fonctionnalités.

  • Aider les consultants et équipes opérationnelles à comprendre les conditions d’un déploiement réussi et à orienter les clients vers les bons interlocuteurs.

  • Préparer les partenaires à leurs rendez-vous, événements clients et temps forts commerciaux.

  • Adapter ton accompagnement aux profils et au niveau de maturité des équipes du partenaire.

5. Être présent sur le terrain et faire vivre la relation

  • Assurer une présence physique régulière auprès des partenaires prioritaires, notamment lors de revues d’activité, de rendez-vous dirigeants et d’actions commerciales.

  • Préparer et animer des revues de partenariat qui débouchent sur des décisions, des responsables et des prochaines étapes claires.

  • Entretenir un réseau de contacts au-delà de l’interlocuteur principal afin de sécuriser la continuité du partenariat.

  • Identifier tôt les signaux de risque, les irritants et les sujets nécessitant un arbitrage.

  • Représenter Pennylane auprès des partenaires avec exigence, réactivité et transparence.

title: Payments Optimization Consultant
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

You'll identify high-impact opportunities to improve payment performance by analysing merchant data, transaction trends, and industry benchmarks.

  • Identify opportunities to improve payment performance through merchant data, transaction trends, and industry benchmarks.

  • Build and refine payment optimisation methodologies and playbooks that help Airwallex stay ahead of industry developments.

  • Lead deep-dive conversations with enterprise merchants about payment performance, acting as a trusted strategic advisor to improve transaction outcomes.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to develop optimisation levers, including AI- and machine-learning-powered approaches to smart routing, cost reduction, and payment success.

  • Translate merchant feedback and frontline insights into product roadmap recommendations.

  • Enable Sales and Account Management teams with practical payment optimisation knowledge, tools, and training.

  • Build relationships with external stakeholders, including card issuers and payment networks, to improve the end-to-end payment experience.

You'll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 5+ years of experience in payments, with strong knowledge of e-commerce, card-based processing, and payment optimisation.

  • Strong understanding of card network rules, local payment methods, and regulatory requirements such as PSD2 and PSD3.

  • Strong analytical skills and experience using data and business intelligence tools to identify opportunities and explain performance trends.

  • Experience turning complex analysis into clear recommendations for both technical and commercial audiences.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging enterprise clients and senior stakeholders.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, and Account Management teams.

  • A self-directed approach and the ability to make progress in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

  • Intellectual curiosity and a practical approach to solving complex customer and payment problems.

Preferred

  • Experience with BI and data platforms such as Looker, Power BI, Tableau, or Databricks.

  • Experience working with payment optimisation, smart routing, fraud mitigation, or transaction success-rate improvement.

  • Experience engaging directly with card issuers, payment networks, or other global payments stakeholders.

  • Experience creating standardised methodologies, playbooks, or enablement programmes for commercial teams.

You'll thrive here if

  • You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

  • You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

Learn more about your team

Merchant Services at Airwallex is made up of two teams: Solutions Engineering and Technical Support, working together to turn customer-facing technical work into product progress. Across both teams, we help businesses design, integrate, launch, optimize, and scale on Airwallex's global financial infrastructure, covering solution architecture, delivery, technical account management, optimisation, and support.

The mandate is simple: solve for the customer in front of us, and build for the customers we haven't met yet. Sitting close to Product, Engineering, and Design means the patterns you see in real customer integrations can become better APIs, documentation, tooling, onboarding paths, and product capabilities. The hard part is doing both at once: shipping for today's customer without losing the signal that improves the product for the next.

This is a team for people who can earn trust with builders, reason through complex systems, communicate clearly, and stay grounded in commercial outcomes. If you want to work at the intersection of agentic finance, customer impact, and product development, this is where your work compounds.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.

title: Photonics Packaging & Cryogenic Integration R&D Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry.
Its offerings include a very energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers.
Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components.
Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.
Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Description of the Team/Project

We are looking for a Photonics Packaging & Cryogenic Integration Engineer to contribute to the development and industrialization of our photonic quantum systems.

You will work on the integration of single-photon sources, photonic integrated circuits and optical/electromechanical assemblies, with a strong focus on miniaturization, automation and operation under cryogenic conditions.

This is a highly hands-on role at the intersection of photonics, electronics, mechanics, automation and experimental physics.

You will contribute across the full development cycle: design, prototyping, assembly, testing, optimization and transfer toward industrial-scale production.

Your Key Responsibilities:

    • Design and develop packaging and integration solutions for photonic and quantum devices.
    • Integrate single-photon sources, photonic integrated circuits and optical components into complete systems.
    • Develop and optimize optical coupling strategies, including fiber coupling and direct chip-to-chip integration.
    • Design, build and assemble precision positioning and alignment systems, including nano-positioning stages and multi-axis platforms.
    • Develop experimental setups operating under cryogenic conditions, typically in the 2–4 K range.
    • Design mechanical parts and assemblies using CAD tools.
    • Contribute to electronics development, including PCB design, instrumentation and control systems.
    • Automate alignment, test and characterization processes using Python, C++, Rust or similar programming languages.
    • Work with microcontrollers, FPGA-based systems or other hardware-control architectures when relevant.
    • Build, test and iterate rapidly on prototypes, including using 3D printing and other rapid prototyping techniques.
    • Perform test and measurement activities to characterize system performance and identify failure modes.
    • Contribute feedback to the design of photonic chips and single-photon sources based on integration and testing results.
    • Support the transition from laboratory prototypes to repeatable and scalable manufacturing processes.
    • Document designs, experiments, procedures and lessons learned, and actively share knowledge within the team.

Requirements

What we're looking for:

You should ideally bring:

  • A PhD in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, applied physics, condensed matter physics, solid-state physics, optics, photonics or a related field.
  • Strong hands-on experience building and testing scientific or high-precision equipment.
  • Experience with photonics, optomechanics, semiconductor devices, cryogenics or precision engineering.
  • Familiarity with optical alignment, fiber coupling and/or photonic packaging.
  • Experience with mechanical design and CAD tools.
  • Good understanding of electronics, instrumentation and test equipment.
  • Programming skills in Python, C++, Rust or similar languages for automation and hardware control.
  • Experience working with multidisciplinary systems combining optics, mechanics, electronics and software.
  • Strong experimental problem-solving skills and the ability to iterate quickly from concept to prototype.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to produce clear technical documentation and collaborate in an international environment.

Nice to Have

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be particularly valuable:

  • Cryogenic systems and experiments at very low temperatures.
  • Photonic or optoelectronic packaging.
  • Chip bonding, indium bump bonding or related micro-assembly techniques.
  • Pick-and-place systems or automated precision assembly.
  • Nano-positioning and multi-axis motion control systems.
  • Robotics or computer vision.
  • FPGA or microcontroller development.
  • PCB design using KiCad or similar tools.
  • Finite-element simulation using tools such as ANSYS or COMSOL.
  • Semiconductor or quantum photonics environments.

More than a specific academic background, we are looking for someone who enjoys building complex scientific systems and solving problems directly at the hardware level.

Benefits

  • Company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • A hybrid work model (3-4 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris or 1 to 2 days remotely)
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

title: Post-doctorant(e) en IA agentique correcte par construction (SoS)  - CDD de 12 mois
descriptionHtml:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons notre futur(e) post-doctorant(e) en IA agentique correcte par construction (SoS) pour rejoindre le département INFRES de Télécom Paris.

Contexte scientifique :

les cadres de vérification existants supposent généralement des modèles finis et précisément définis, dont les actions et les relations de transition sont connues. Ces hypothèses sont difficiles à maintenir dans les systèmes modernes d’IA agentique, où les actions peuvent être générées dynamiquement, les environnements peuvent évoluer et les informations sur le système peuvent être incomplètes.

Le projet Sound or Silent (SoS) vise à combler cette lacune en étudiant une nouvelle approche d’IA agentique correcte par construction. L’idée centrale consiste à intégrer le raisonnement stratégique et la vérification formelle directement au processus décisionnel des agents autonomes. Au lieu de vérifier un agent uniquement après son développement ou de surveiller son comportement après l’exécution, SoS étudie la possibilité de produire des actions formellement certifiées conformes à une spécification donnée. Selon cette approche, une action candidate n’est exécutée que s’il est établi qu’elle appartient à une stratégie garantissant les propriétés requises. Si une telle garantie ne peut être établie, l’agent s’abstient d’agir.

Atteindre cet objectif exige d’étendre les techniques de vérification stratégique à des environnements ouverts, évolutifs et partiellement spécifiés, et d’étudier des notions de correction adaptées à une information incomplète. Le projet explorera également une architecture associant un composant génératif non fiable, chargé de proposer des actions ou des stratégies candidates, à un noyau de vérification formelle de confiance, chargé d’en contrôler la correction. Une attention particulière sera portée à l’expressivité des modèles formels sous-jacents, au coût de calcul de la certification et au compromis entre garanties formelles et capacité des agents à accomplir des tâches utiles.

Les travaux associeront des développements théoriques à la réalisation et à l’évaluation expérimentale de prototypes, dans des scénarios de planification autonome, d’agents d’IA utilisant des outils et de coordination multi-agents. L’objectif général est de poser les fondements de systèmes d’IA agentique dont l’autonomie est encadrée par des garanties stratégiques formellement vérifiables.

Vos missions principales seront de :

  • Mener des travaux de recherche sur l’IA agentique correcte par construction

  • Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat

  • Contribuer au rayonnement scientifique de Télécom Paris


Vous devrez être titulaire d’un doctorat ou d’un diplôme équivalent et disposer de solides connaissances en méthodes formelles, logique et vérification de modèles. Une expérience dans les systèmes multi-agents, les logiques stratégiques, la vérification à l’exécution ainsi que dans le développement d’agents fondés sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM) sera également attendue.

Vous devrez maîtriser le développement logiciel et l’implémentation d’algorithmes, ainsi que la démarche de recherche scientifique, notamment la formulation de problématiques, la conception d’expériences et l’analyse de leurs résultats. Une excellente maîtrise de l’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, sera indispensable.

Enfin, vous devrez faire preuve d’un bon esprit d’équipe, de qualités relationnelles et pédagogiques, de bonnes capacités rédactionnelles ainsi que d’un esprit de synthèse.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers).
