title: Product Manager - Products & Pricing
descriptionHtml:
Product Manager - Products and Pricing

Location: London, UK (hybrid, three days a week in the office)
Salary: £50,000 – £60,000
Team: Energy Commerce
Contract: Permanent 

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you’ll do

  • Lead the localisation efforts for our products and pricing capabilities, ensuring they meet the specific commercial, regulatory, market, and cultural requirements of retailers in Europe.  This will include European localisations such as indexation and unbundled energy products as well as broader market promotions and discounts.

  • Deep dive into European energy market structures and regulations for designated countries, translating complex needs into detailed product specifications.  Understand the broader context of piercing and selling products in Europe and the required tooling, workflows and models to accelerate our retailers

  • Collaborate intensely with clients and in-country experts to understand their unique needs and requirements. You will be the first point of contact with the client for all domain specific needs.

  • Coordinate cross domain discovery and delivery for features that support key journeys, aligning requirements where needed (eg. billing, quoting and energy insights).

  • Define and manage detailed product requirements for features related to country-specific needs to support energy products and pricing.

  • Contribute to the Global Energy Commerce roadmap, when new acceleration opportunities are identified.

  • Work closely with engineering, UX, and QA teams to ensure the successful implementation and testing of localised billing functionalities.

  • Act as the go-to expert for global teams on specific European market nuances related to energy products and pricing and related customer journeys.

    (Note: Travel to client sites e.g., Brussels, is expected at roughly 1–3 trips a month initially, tapering to 1–2 times a quarter.)

What you’ll bring

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager with a strong track record of successfully localising complex software products for international markets.

  • Able to establish and maintain great relationships with B2B clients, throughout the entire product lifecycle.

  • Solid understanding of the end-to-end energy lifecycle within a European context, with a particular focus on retailer commercial operations.

  • Direct experience with specific European energy markets, understanding their unique regulatory frameworks and requirements

  • Exceptional ability to translate abstract regulatory text or client requirements into clear, actionable requirements for development teams.

  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams (engineering, legal, operations, client success) to deliver localised solutions.

  • Experience working alongside multiple services/domains to deliver complex journeys.

  • Excellent communication skills, able to articulate technical and market complexities to various stakeholders, including clients.

What will set you apart 

  • Deep, hands-on experience with the French or Belgian energy retail markets, particularly concerning their energy products and pricing specificities.

  • Proficiency in a second European language relevant to key target markets (e.g., French).

  • Experience with large-scale data migration and integration projects involving legacy billing systems.

  • A background in energy commercial operations or regulatory affairs within a European energy retailer.

Where you'll work
We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.
    Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

We want the best people
We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Product Manager Soft Fabrics

Wil jij bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van hoogwaardige stoffen die hun weg vinden naar klanten door heel Europa? Krijg je energie van de combinatie van productontwikkeling, commercie en projectmanagement? Dan is dit een mooie kans om als Product Manager Soft Fabrics onderdeel te worden van ons Product Team.

Jouw rol

Als Product Manager Soft Fabrics ben je verantwoordelijk voor het product en het commerciële succes van onze collecties voor gordijn- en meubelstoffen. Design is verantwoordelijk voor de creatieve ontwikkeling van de stoffen. Vanuit Product Management vertegenwoordig jij de markt-, klant- en businessbehoefte. Je brengt markt- en klantinzichten in en vertaalt deze naar duidelijke productbriefings en commerciële uitgangspunten. Vervolgens bewaak je samen met Design het ontwikkelproces en stuur je op een succesvolle productintroductie en optimale productlevenscyclus. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's van Sales, Marketing, Procurement, Supply Chain en het Design Team.

Je combineert projectmanagement met commercieel inzicht, data-analyse en een passie voor textiel. Een veelzijdige rol waarin je veel verschillende mensen en disciplines bij elkaar brengt.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je beheert het fabrics-portfolio gedurende de volledige productlevenscyclus, van concept tot uitfasering.
  • Samen met Design vertaal je marktinzichten naar productbriefings en commerciële uitgangspunten voor nieuwe stoffen en collecties.
  • Je coördineert productontwikkelingsprojecten van conceptfase tot marktintroductie, waarbij je samenwerkt met Design voor de ontwikkeling van nieuwe stoffen en collecties.
  • Je bewaakt planning, voortgang, risico's, budget en afstemming tussen de verschillende betrokken teams.
  • Je bent gedurende het ontwikkelproces een commerciële en strategische sparringpartner voor Design.
  • Je analyseert markt-, klant- en verkoopdata en vertaalt inzichten naar kansen voor het portfolio.
  • Je ondersteunt bij prijsstelling, productpositionering en businesscases.
  • Je werkt samen met Sales en Marketing aan productintroducties, trainingen en commerciële tools.
  • Je zorgt voor goede productinformatie en bent een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor interne en externe stakeholders.

Dit breng jij mee

Je bent een junior/medior professional die graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt en energie krijgt van het verbinden van mensen, ideeën en projecten. Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar relevante ervaring in bijvoorbeeld productmanagement, projectmanagement, category management of een vergelijkbare functie.

Daarnaast heb je:

  • Een hbo diploma in bijvoorbeeld Bedrijfskunde, Marketing, Textieltechnologie of een vergelijkbare richting.
  • Sterke projectmanagement- en stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden.
  • Commercieel inzicht en een klantgerichte instelling.
  • Een analytische, data-gedreven manier van werken.
  • Ervaring met het managen van meerdere projecten en stakeholders tegelijk.
  • Goede beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels.
  • Interesse in AI en de mogelijkheden om hiermee productiviteit, inzichten en bedrijfsprocessen te verbeteren.
  • Ervaring binnen een productieomgeving, textiel, interieurproducten of een industriële omgeving is een pré.

Je bent georganiseerd, proactief en hands-on. Je houdt gemakkelijk overzicht, ook wanneer er verschillende belangen en deadlines spelen. Tegelijkertijd werk je graag samen en weet je anderen mee te krijgen in jouw aanpak.

Waarom deze rol?

Je komt terecht bij Artex in Aarle-Rixtel, maar bent deel van het Product Team van Hunter Douglas met hoofdkantoor in Rotterdam. Hunter Douglas is een wereldwijd toonaangevende speler in raamdecoratie en architecturale producten, met meer dan 100 jaar ervaring in innovatie.

Als Product Manager Soft Fabrics krijg je de ruimte om eigenaarschap te nemen, ideeën in te brengen en zichtbaar bij te dragen aan de toekomst van ons stoffenportfolio. Je werkt samen met collega's uit verschillende disciplines en landen en hebt een belangrijke rol in het verbinden van design, commercie en productontwikkeling.

Wil jij jouw ervaring inzetten in een rol waarin product, commercie en design samenkomen? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Je kunt de sms-service op elk moment annuleren. Stuur gewoon “STOP” als antwoord op een van onze sms-berichten om je af te melden. Er kunnen kosten voor berichten en data van toepassing zijn. title: Product Manager – Traffic (Flow, Jams, Speed Profiles & Moderation)
descriptionHtml:
Introduction
Real-time traffic is at the heart of TomTom's mission to engineer the smartest, most useful map on the planet. Our live and historical traffic products — flow, jams, and speed profiles — power navigation, ADAS, and mobility decisions for the world's leading automotive OEMs, enterprises, and ride-hailing companies. As these customers move faster and expect richer, more accurate content, the way we generate, moderate, and deliver traffic data becomes a decisive competitive advantage.
As Product Manager for Traffic Flow, Jams, and Speed Profiles, you will own a core part of TomTom's real-time traffic portfolio and set its multi-year roadmap, grounded in a deep understanding of traffic processing technology and customer needs. You will also own TomTom's traffic moderation tool — enabling the world's leading ride-hailing companies to submit event reports, such as closures — running its user operations and prioritizing its feature roadmap.
What you'll do
  • Own and deliver against Traffic Flow, Traffic Jams, and Speed Profiles — setting the roadmap, OKRs, and quality bar, and taking a leading role in product quality.
  • Own and operate TomTom's traffic moderation tool, enabling the world's leading ride-hailing companies to submit event reports such as closures; run user operations and prioritize the tool's feature backlog.
  • Bring a deep understanding of real-time traffic processing and jam detection, and use it to manage tradeoffs effectively.
  • Focus on outcomes over outputs, tracking metrics such as ETT accuracy, jam detection quality, traffic coverage, and speed profile coverage.
  • Lead brainstorms and drive product exploration through prototypes and wireframes.
  • Gather deep customer insights from automotive OEMs, government agencies, and enterprise clients, separating high-value initiatives from nice-to-haves.
  • Data acumen — able to analyze data from multiple sources, such as GPS traces, probes, STOs, camera observations, and traffic authorities, to drive decisions and assess tradeoffs.
  • Build strong cross-functional relationships and steer the product team by removing blockers and escalating appropriately.
  • Communicate effectively to internal teams (automotive, navigation, delivery) and external stakeholders using customer problem statements and business logic; deliver concise presentations and lead meetings from standups to stakeholder reviews.
  • Maintain product strategy and vision, and contribute to broader Traffic discussions; formulate compelling value propositions tied to articulated problems and product metrics.
  • Establish yourself as the subject-matter expert and go-to person for live and historical traffic data products, maintaining trust across product and business teams with visible, citable personal impact.

    • What you'll need
  • A minimum of 5 years' experience as a Product Manager, preferably in traffic, geospatial, mobility, or automotive domains.
  • A bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, or a related field.
  • Familiarity with real-time data processing, GPS/probe data, or traffic and mobility analytics (preferred).
  • Experience or technical training in data science, analytics, or related disciplines.
  • Strong ability to understand, articulate, and represent customer needs and requirements.
  • Proven ability to coordinate people and technical resources across multiple teams.
  • Effective time management and strong interpersonal communication skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including with senior technical and executive audiences.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and creative, structured thinking.
    • What we offer
    A competitive compensation package, of course.
    Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning.
    Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities.
    Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. It’s all about getting the best out of both worlds – we ask TomTom’ers to come to the office two days a week, and the remaining three are free to be worked in either location.
    Improve your home office with a setup budget and get extra support with a monthly allowance.
    Enjoy options to work from your home country and abroad for a set number of days each year, to visit family and friends, or to simply explore the world we’re mapping.
    Take the holidays you want with a competitive holiday plan, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday.
    Join annual events like our Hackathon and DevDays to bring your ideas to life with talented teammates from around the world.
    Become a part of our inclusive global culture and have the chance to collaborate with a diverse community – we have over 80 nationalities at TomTom!
    Find out more about our global benefits and enjoy additional local benefits tailored to your location.
    Meet your team
    We’re the User Experience Design team. Fueled by user insights and data analytics, our mission is to create powerful, easy-to-use products that delight our customers, from millions of drivers to automotive customers who embed our technologies in their vehicles. We deliver the design specifications for all TomTom’s products. Joining us, you'll be part of a team that brings together design disciplines from user research to interaction, concept and visual design. Together, we'll continue to develop a map that people trust all around the world.

    At TomTom...
    You’ll help people find their way in the world. In 2004, TomTom revolutionized how the world moves with the introduction of the first portable navigation device. Now, we intend to do it again by engineering the first-ever real-time map, the smartest and most useful map on the planet.
    Work with a team of 3,600+ unique, curious and passionate problem-solvers. Together, we’ll open up a world of possibilities for car manufacturers, enterprises and developers to help people understand and get closer to the world around them.

    After you apply
    Our recruitment team will work hard to give you a meaningful experience throughout your journey with us, no matter the outcome. Your application will be screened closely and you can rest assured that all follow-up actions will be thorough, from assessments and interviews all the way through onboarding. To find out more about our application process, check out our hiring FAQs.

    TomTom is an equal opportunity employer
    TomTom is where you can find your place in the world. Every day we welcome, nurture and celebrate differences. Why? Because your uniqueness is what makes you, you. No matter your culture or background, you’ll find your impact at TomTom. Research also shows that sometimes women and underrepresented communities can be hesitant to apply for positions unless they believe they meet 100% of the criteria. If you can relate to this, please know that we’d love to hear from you.

title: Product Marketer
descriptionHtml:
We’re looking for a Product Marketer to join the Contentoo team and turn everything we build into one clear story that Sales can confidently take to market.

This is a hands-on role for an experienced product marketer who is genuinely interested in AI and what it’s doing to marketing and content operations. You’ll own the product story across our platform, AI capabilities, human experts, and managed support, and make sure the way we explain it holds up in a real sales conversation.

You’ll report to our Content Lead and work closely with our VP GTM, Product, Sales, and Customer Success. You’ll sit in on product, pricing, roadmap, and release conversations, join customer calls, and brief our specialists across copy, design, and SEO when enablement needs to be made.

About Contentoo

Contentoo helps global marketing teams scale content without turning their marketers into project managers.

We combine AI agents, human expertise, and managed content operations to take more of the production and coordination burden off marketing teams, so they can spend more time on the work that actually needs their judgment.

What you’ll be doing

A big part of your role is giving Sales a sharp, defensible story built on what customers actually experience.

Positioning & Messaging

  • Own the development of our core product narrative and website messaging, defining clear propositions, use cases, and proof points.

  • Show how our software, AI tools, and managed services work together as a cohesive solution rather than disconnected features.

  • Ensure messaging across our website, pitch decks, and demos aligns without contradictions.

GTM Launches & Sales Enablement

  • Package new and existing capabilities around defined ICPs, customer problems, and commercial value.

  • Plan and coordinate launches across Product, Sales, Marketing, and CS—from readiness and evidence to external comms.

  • Build field-tested enablement materials (one-pagers, pitch decks, demo narratives, battle cards, and objection-handling guides) based on real sales conversations, not theory.

Customer & Market Intelligence

  • Join sales calls, discovery sessions, and CS check-ins to spot recurring objections, use cases, and buying triggers.

  • Gather competitive intelligence and market trends to inform product, pricing, and messaging decisions.

  • Push back constructively when internal assumptions don't match market reality.

Release Governance

  • Establish a lightweight release process that separates early experiments from market-ready features and approved external claims.

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for someone who talks about what they shipped, not what they planned. Someone structured, with good judgement and the confidence to tell us when something isn’t ready to sell.

  • You have 4–5 years of marketing experience, with at least 2–3 years directly in product marketing.

  • You have a proven track record of creating or repositioning propositions, launches, and sales enablement materials that teams can execute without a walkthrough—and the outcomes to show for it.

  • You take strong project ownership, synthesizing fragmented input and aligning Product, Sales, and Customer Success without formal authority or becoming a bottleneck.

  • You’re genuinely interested in AI and content operations, able to speak plainly about what it does well, its limits, and where humans still matter, without hype or excessive technical jargon.

  • You’re curious about customers and grounded, comfortable joining live sales calls to understand objections, and ready to push back constructively when claims lack evidence.

  • You have native or bilingual-level English, live in or near Amsterdam, and can work from our Houthavens office 3 days a week.

  • You also get bonus points for experience in B2B SaaS (especially hybrid platform/service models), AI-enabled tools, localisation, or agency workflows, or fluency in Dutch, German, French, or a Nordic language (nice to have, not essential).

Why you’ll like it here

  • You’ll shape how the market understands a hybrid AI agent and human expert proposition, not polish someone else’s collateral

  • You’ll have a seat in product, pricing, roadmap and release conversations, and bring the customer view into the decision

  • Your work gets tested in live deals every week

  • It’s highly visible: Sales, Customer Success, Marketing and leadership will use what you build

  • You’ll own the product story and website messaging, with specialists to help you execute

What you’ll get

  • A competitive salary based on experience

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • Pension contribution

  • Laptop of choice (Mac or HP)

  • A monthly Alleo budget

  • A learning budget

  • Lunch at the office

  • Hybrid work environment (great office at the Houthavens, 3 days in office, 2 days home, plus remote flexibility)

  • A bar in the office. Who doesn’t want a bar in their office?!

title: Product Owner Hardware (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
What We're Building Towards

At Omegga, we're on a mission to reinvent how AI and spectroscopy can drive positive change for animals, people and the planet. We started with a clear objective: eliminate chick culling on a global scale through early, non-invasive detection. This outdated practice still impacts billions of lives, and we're here to change that. We're not building for the niche, we're building for the global standard.

Today, our systems are already in use, and the focus is on scaling performance, robustness, and deployment across an international customer base. For us, scaling means more than growth. It means changing an industry for the better.

We are looking for people who take ownership, think in systems, and want to help turn a working product into the industry benchmark. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a Technical Project Manager who runs our hardware development projects end to end and holds the thread between our engineers, our external partners, and our leadership. Our system combines optics, mechanics, electronics, and embedded control with machine learning on top. Most of what you manage is hardware, but every hardware decision touches software and data science, and you make sure those pieces move together.

Development happens in-house, but parts of it are outsourced to production partners and component suppliers. You keep those external work packages aligned with our internal timelines, specifications, and quality standards. Our Sales Engineering team owns the customer relationship; you make sure their requirements turn into delivered systems.

You take ownership end to end, hold yourself to a high standard, and focus on outcomes that matter for the customer. You communicate openly, give honest feedback, and build trust through your actions.

What You'll Build

  • Own the plan for our hardware development projects, from concept and prototypes to release for series production

  • Keep hardware, software, and data science development in sync: interfaces, test campaigns, integration milestones, and releases

  • Prioritize the integration backlog together with our tech leads and align it with customer commitments

  • Manage the outsourced parts of our development with production partners and component suppliers: scope, specifications, timelines, and quality

  • Integrate partner timelines into the overall project plan and resolve conflicts before they become blockers

  • Plan and coordinate system deployments together with Sales Engineering: installation scheduling, spare parts, and incident handling

  • Plan and monitor project budgets, track risks, and initiate corrective measures early

  • Deliver clear, regular reporting on milestones, trial outcomes, and project status to leadership

What You Bring

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in technical project management in a hardware development environment: machinery, medtech, robotics, optics, or comparable

  • Solid understanding of hardware development, from prototyping to release for small series production

  • Experience coordinating outsourced development work with manufacturers or key suppliers

  • Enough understanding of software and data science to spot dependencies to the hardware and plan integration realistically

  • Experience with project budgets and risk tracking

  • Strong communication skills: you naturally become the connective tissue between engineers, partners, and leadership

  • A structured, hands-on working style and an affinity for using AI tools in your daily workflow

  • Fluent English. Fluent German is a strong plus for working with our partners and suppliers

  • Willingness to travel occasionally to our partners

title: Product Owner, Technical - AI Finance
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product owners to own product areas within Doit's AI Finance.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Product Owner Werkplek & Support (Detachering / ZZP)
descriptionHtml:
Hoe zorg je ervoor dat ruim 3.300 collega’s iedere dag goed hun werk kunnen doen? Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support geef je richting aan onze werkplekdienstverlening: van Microsoft 365 en randapparatuur tot support en servicedesk. Je bepaalt de roadmap, brengt focus aan en zorgt samen met het team en onze leveranciers dat we sneller, voorspelbaarder en met een betere gebruikerservaring leveren.

Wie ben jij

Je bent iemand die verder kijkt dan de eerstvolgende sprint. Je kunt zelfstandig een visie en roadmap ontwikkelen, brengt focus aan en durft keuzes te maken wanneer belangen uiteenlopen.


Daarbij hoef je niet jarenlang de formele titel Product Owner te hebben gehad. We vinden het belangrijker dat je aantoonbaar eigenaarschap hebt genomen over een IT-product of -dienst en gewend bent om daarin richting en prioriteiten te bepalen. Je krijgt in deze rol veel ruimte. Je stelt zelf de roadmap op, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en stuurt op verbeteringen binnen Werkplek & Support. Die autonomie betekent niet dat je alles alleen doet. Je stemt keuzes af het team, Servicemanager en teammanager zodat je elkaar kunt challengen op de juiste prioriteiten.


Het team bestaat uit collega's die al langere tijd bij Univé werken én collega's die relatief nieuw zijn. Het team heeft behoefte aan iemand die vanuit de Product Owner-rol richting en focus kan geven, zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn.


Onze werkplek is sterk gebaseerd op Microsoft 365, maar omvat meer dan alleen de digitale werkplek. Denk ook aan randapparatuur, lokale ondersteuning en supportdienstverlening. Je hoeft niet zelf de technisch specialist te zijn. Wel begrijp je moderne werkplekdienstverlening voldoende om een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn voor engineers, architecten, securityspecialisten en leveranciers.


Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is de operationele samenwerking met onze externe servicedesk en andere leveranciers. Samen met het team geef je richting aan prioriteiten en verbeteringen en zorg je dat ontwikkelingen binnen Werkplek & Support goed aansluiten op de ondersteuning van onze medewerkers.


Je voelt je daarnaast thuis in een omgeving die verandert. Je durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen, kunt omgaan met weerstand en neemt stakeholders mee wanneer nog niet alles vaststaat.

Wat ga je doen

Wat breng je mee?
Voor ons is niet je exacte functietitel of het aantal jaren ervaring doorslaggevend. We willen vooral zien dat je dit soort verantwoordelijkheid eerder succesvol hebt gedragen.

• Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het bepalen van visie, roadmap en prioriteiten voor een IT-product of IT- dienst;

Je kunt verschillende belangen afwegen en duidelijke besluiten nemen en onderbouwen;
• Je kunt vanuit een Product Owner-rol richting en focus geven aan een team zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn;
• Je bent sterk in stakeholder- en relatiemanagement en krijgt engineers, gebruikers, management en leveranciers mee;
• Je hebt ervaring met externe IT-dienstverleners en weet in operationele samenwerking, samen met het team, verbeteringen te realiseren;
• Je begrijpt werkplekdienstverlening en IT om inhoudelijk een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn;
• Je hebt ervaring met het verbeteren van dienstverlening en kunt sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid en klantbeleving;
• Je kunt omgaan met weerstand, bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie stellen en koers houden wanneer nog niet alles duidelijk is;
• Je beschikt over hbo/wo-werk- en denkniveau.
Ervaring met Microsoft 365 is welkom, maar diepgaande technische expertise is niet noodzakelijk. Ervaring met grotere transities of het insourcen van IT-dienstverlening is een pré.

Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support ben je verantwoordelijk voor de visie, roadmap en prioritering van onze werkplek- en supportdienstverlening.

Daarbij staat één vraag centraal: hoe zorgen we dat onze collega's prettig, veilig en efficiënt kunnen werken én snel en goed geholpen worden wanneer ondersteuning nodig is?

We willen vooral sneller en voorspelbaarder worden in wat we leveren en tegelijkertijd de gebruikerstevredenheid verder verhogen. Jij vertaalt die ambitie naar concrete keuzes en verbeteringen.


• ontwikkelen en onderhouden van de visie, roadmap en backlog voor Werkplek & Support;
• prioriteren van ontwikkelingen, incidenten en structurele verbeteringen;
• vertalen van IT-doelstellingen en behoeften van medewerkers naar concrete prioriteiten;
• richting geven aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Microsoft 365-gerichte werkplek, randapparatuur en ondersteunende dienstverlening;
• sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid, kwaliteit en gebruikerstevredenheid;
• onderhouden van nauw contact met stakeholders, waaronder Regionale Univé's en decentrale beheerders, en hen meenemen in keuzes en veranderingen;
• afstemmen met engineers, architecten, security, servicemanagement, leveranciers en andere IT-teams;
• samen met het team operationeel aansturen van de externe servicedesk en andere relevante leveranciers en verbeteringen realiseren;
• signalen en terugkerende vragen vanuit Support gebruiken om de werkplek structureel te verbeteren;
• richting geven aan lifecyclemanagement, upgrades, migraties en vernieuwingen van de werkplek en randapparatuur;
• kansen rond onder andere automatisering, selfservice en AI vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen;
• organiseren en voorbereiden van Scrum-activiteiten binnen het team, waaronder sprintplanning, reviews en retrospectives.

Je krijgt daarbij ruimte om zelfstandig richting te geven. Dat betekent ook dat we verwachten dat je bestaande keuzes kritisch bevraagt en de teammanager durft te challengen wanneer jij denkt dat het beter kan.

Wat bieden wij

Je krijgt een functie binnen IT Kern Services voor 36–40 uur per week met veel ruimte om zelf richting te geven. Werkplek & Support wordt dagelijks door duizenden collega's gebruikt. De keuzes die jij maakt zijn dus direct merkbaar in de organisatie.

Ontwikkeling vinden we bij Univé belangrijk. Dat geldt voor de dienstverlening waarvoor je verantwoordelijk bent, maar ook voor jezelf.

Het team werkt hybride vanuit Zwolle en Assen. Er is één vaste teamdag per week, afwisselend in Zwolle en Assen. De overige dagen werk je veelal vanuit je standplaats of thuis.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dichtbij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie.

Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé.


IT Kern levert het IT-fundament waarmee Univé haar doelen kan realiseren. Binnen IT Kern richt Services zich onder andere op werkplekdiensten, eerstelijns gebruikersondersteuning, proces- en servicemanagement en consultancy.
Binnen Werkplek & Support werk je samen met functioneel beheerders, IT-specialisten en een Business Informatie Analist. De servicedesk en het lokale beheer in Zwolle en Assen worden momenteel geleverd door een externe partner.
Je komt terecht in een team met verschillende achtergronden en ervaringsniveaus, binnen een organisatie met veel verschillende belangen en afhankelijkheden. Dat maakt de omgeving soms complex, maar geeft je als Product Owner ook veel ruimte om verbinding te leggen en zichtbaar verschil te maken.

title: Product Qualification Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

The Role

We are seeking a Product Qualification Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will execute product qualification activities, turning qualification plans into robust test setups, reliable bench data, and clear, traceable evidence that supports product release.

Reporting to the Quality & Reliability Program Lead, you will work closely with the Package Reliability Engineer, Product Engineering team, and external laboratories and OSAT partners to plan and execute qualification testing. You will develop test hardware in collaboration with external partners, coordinate the design of test PCBs and fixtures, select and configure test equipment, and ensure every qualification campaign produces accurate, well-documented, and reproducible results.

Your core focus will be to transform qualification requirements into practical test solutions, execute high-quality validation campaigns, and deliver the reliable data needed to make confident product qualification and release decisions.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Run product qualification testing by performing bench and laboratory qualification tests (thermal, electrical, mechanical, and environmental stress tests) in accordance with qualification plans and test matrix, while accurately tracking samples, test conditions, and results.

  • Develop test PCBs and fixtures with external partners, work ontest boards, adapters, and fixtures, from requirements through review and bring-up.

  • Set up and maintain qualification test equipment, including thermal chambers, power supplies, data acquisition systems (DAQ), probe stations, and other laboratory instrumentation, ensuring the lab is always ready to support qualification activities.

  • Coordinate qualification campaigns with OSATs and external laboratories by managing schedules, sample logistics, and test execution, while providing on-site or remote test supervision where needed

  • Collect, analyze, and document qualification results, producing clear pass/fail assessments, comprehensive test reports, and fully traceable records that contribute to the overall product qualification evidence package.

  • Identify and communicate risks early, proactively escalating test failures, equipment limitations, data anomalies, or schedule risks to the Package Reliability Engineer and Quality & Reliability Program Lead to keep qualification activities on track.

Your Qualifications

  • Educational background with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related discipline.

  • Hands-on product qualification experience with 2–4+ years of experience in hardware bring-up, bench testing, or product qualification test campaigns.

  • Experience testing RF and high-speed I/O, including high-speed serial, RF, or optical links using equipment such as vector network analyzers (VNAs), high-bandwidth oscilloscopes, BERTs, and other signal integrity measurement tools. This is a core requirement for the role, as experience limited to low-speed digital or logic circuit testing is not sufficient. Experience with photonics testing is a strong advantage.

  • Proficiency with laboratory test equipment, including oscilloscopes, power supplies, thermal chambers, data acquisition (DAQ) systems, and, ideally, RF and high-speed characterization equipment such as VNAs, BERT, and high-bandwidth scopes.

  • Experience developing test hardware, working closely with PCB design and fabrication partners to define specs, review designs, and support the bring-up of test boards or fixtures.

  • Strong test execution and documentation skills, running test campaigns methodically and writing clean, traceable results.

  • Excellent collaboration and coordination skills, with experience working across reliability engineering, product engineering, external laboratories, and OSAT partners to successfully execute qualification activities.

  • Thrives in a startup environment, demonstrating initiative, adaptability, and the ability to take ownership in a fast-paced, resource-conscious setting.

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

title: Product & Regulatory Counsel
descriptionHtml:
Tired of meeting the product at the terms and conditions stage?

Most product lawyers see the flow once it's built and the launch date is set. Here, you're on the whiteboard at ideation, so compliant by design is the plan, not the clean-up.

And the stakes are real. Taptap Send moves billions of dollars every month across 100 countries, and is now building wallets, cards and broader financial products for diaspora communities.

The job

You'll advise on new licensing and products from first idea to go-live, and own regulator engagement across our markets.

  • Shape products before they're built: review designs, UX, flows and terms against regulatory and customer-outcome rules, Consumer Duty included, while change is still cheap.

  • Turn regulation into decisions: what's mandatory, what's prudent, and the alternative route that still gets it launched.

  • Own the regulator relationship: across our markets, including new ones, and flag what regulatory change means for the roadmap early.

title: Product Support Engineer - EMEA
descriptionHtml:
Hello!

I’m Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. I’m excited to share that we’re hiring a Product Support Engineer in EMEA 🎉

We’re expanding our global Support team to provide 24/7 coverage across time zones. You’ll join a global team while establishing the technical Support Engineering presence in EMEA, with the ownership and visibility that come from being one of the first Support Engineers across European time zones. We staff across regions rather than relying on on-call rotations; we’ll discuss the specific schedule for this opening during the process.

Not sure which Support role is right for you?

We’re hiring for both Product Support Specialist and Product Support Engineer roles.

  • Support Specialist owns cases and customer communication end-to-end. Troubleshoots complex issues by navigating internal tooling — audit logs, user experience testing, and API testing — to help customers reach successful outcomes.

  • Support Engineering serves as the escalation point between Support Specialists and Product Engineering. Owns integrations, supports data mapping and data migrations for customers, and resolves escalated tickets that don't require product code changes.

Please choose the role that best reflects your experience and interests rather than applying to both. If another Support role seems like a closer match, we’ll consider that in our review.

About the role

Support Engineering is the technical layer between frontline Support and Engineering. You’ll take on complex issues involving integrations, APIs, permissions, data, reporting, migrations, and workflows—using application behavior, logs, databases, and customer context to determine whether an issue can be resolved through Support or represents a product defect.

You’ll investigate issues end to end using tools such as Plain, GitHub, Datadog, databases, and the codebase. You won’t write the fix; you’ll give Engineering a well-validated escalation with reproduction steps, relevant evidence, customer impact, and a root-cause hypothesis when possible. You’ll also identify recurring issues, improve documentation and enablement, and partner with Product and Engineering on improvements. As an early Support Engineer in EMEA, you’ll establish regional operating practices and handoff norms across European time zones while bringing EMEA customer patterns to a global team.

What you’ll own

  • Own complex technical issues from intake through resolution or escalation—investigating APIs, integrations, logs, data, configuration, and workflows to determine whether Support can resolve them or Engineering should be involved.

  • Set a high bar for complex technical investigations and ensure Engineering receives clear, actionable, well-validated product issues.

  • Build trusted working relationships with frontline Support, Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and customers.

  • Identify recurring problems and turn them into documentation, enablement, tooling, process improvements, or product feedback.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering on recurring product improvements by synthesizing customer patterns, validating defects, and sharing the technical context needed to choose between a product change, documentation, tooling, or process improvement.

  • Establish EMEA coverage, handoff, and operating practices across European time zones while bringing regional customer patterns to the global Support Engineering team.

  • Track and improve the outcomes that matter: resolution speed, escalation quality, fewer avoidable Engineering escalations, frontline self-sufficiency, reduced customer effort, and customer confidence.

You should apply if:

  • You’ve worked in a hands-on, customer-centric technical role where you independently investigate ambiguous issues involving APIs, integrations, logs, data, and application behavior.

  • You’re comfortable moving between customer conversations, APIs, logs, databases, product behavior, and code-level context to find root causes.

  • You can distinguish a configuration, data, documentation, or enablement issue from a true product defect—and explain your reasoning clearly.

  • You write precise investigations that others can quickly understand and act on, and communicate thoughtfully with technical and non-technical audiences across time zones.

  • You naturally look beyond the immediate ticket and improve the systems around it through documentation, enablement, tooling, or process design.

  • You want to be an early technical owner for EMEA and are energized by building regional structure within a global team.

You should not apply if:

  • You’re looking primarily for a high-volume support role centered on predefined troubleshooting steps, rather than open-ended technical investigation and ownership.

  • Most of your experience is in internal IT, help desk, endpoint, hardware, network, infrastructure, cloud operations, systems administration, infrastructure maintenance, or service deployment—and you haven’t worked extensively with customer-centric SaaS applications, APIs, logs, or data-backed troubleshooting.

  • You prefer to pass difficult issues to another team rather than reproduce, investigate, and explain them yourself.

  • You’re looking for a role focused mainly on writing production code; this role diagnoses and escalates bugs but does not own code changes.

  • You prefer clear-cut problems and predefined answers over working through ambiguity with careful documentation, focused questions, and evidence-based decisions.

  • You want a narrowly defined role without regional operating ownership or projects that improve how the broader Support team works.

About Ashby

Ashby builds a suite of products that helps talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run their hiring process significantly better. We raised a $50M Series D in July 2025 and support nearly 5,000 customers, including Shopify, Snowflake, OpenAI, Deliveroo, and Confluent. We’re growing much faster than 100% year over year, with a team of roughly 300 people across 22+ countries. Learn more at ashbyhq.com.

About Go To Market

We view our Support team as an extension of the product itself, one that ensures an optimal customer experience for customers ranging across all market segments. Here are a few points that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us:

  • We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is easier to sell.

  • We also spend a lot of time building a best-in-class customer experience. We aim to offer deep expertise whenever we interact with prospects and customers.

  • We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people and the right work environment deliver much better performance than teams with large headcount.

We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication (we put a lot of effort into using the right communication channels) - we’ll get into these and other values during the hiring process. You can take a look at our Leadership Principles to get a sense of what we value in People Leaders at Ashby.

Interview process

Our interview process is thorough and designed to give you enough information to assess whether Ashby is the right fit for you, while helping us evaluate technical reasoning, communication precision, and ownership.

  • Intro call with Recruiting — 30 min

  • Take-home assessment — 5 days to complete

  • Hiring Manager interview — 45–60 min

  • Virtual onsite — 120 min

    • Meet the team — 30 min

    • Technical & integration skills — 45 min

    • CS and Support leadership — 30 min

    • Closing questions — 15 min

Onboarding

Your onboarding will combine Ashby-wide product and company training with a Support Engineering-specific ramp plan. You’ll learn the product and support workflow, get familiar with the tools and systems used for technical investigations, and build relationships across Support, Product, and Engineering. With support from your manager and onboarding buddy, you’ll take on increasingly complex investigations as you build context, with regular check-ins throughout your first 90 days.

Benefits

Benefits vary by country and are shared in more detail during the process. International employees receive statutory benefits and, where available, employer-paid supplemental health coverage.

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅

  • A $1,200 annual learning and professional-development budget.

  • A one-time $2,000 home-office setup budget for furniture, monitors, peripherals, and ergonomic equipment, plus a company-provided laptop.

  • Opportunities to spend time with teammates through an annual company offsite, team offsites, local meetups, and virtual events.

  • Extended health benefits for you and your dependents (subject to availability with our Employer of Record)

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

title: Program Director
descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the job

Anduril Australia delivers advanced maritime capability to the Royal Australian Navy and our allied partners. Our maritime programs are among the most significant and closely watched capability efforts in Australian Defence, and they are moving into operational service at a pace the sector has not seen before.

As Director, Program Management, you will lead a critical program for Anduril Australia and our Maritime division through disciplined execution, introduction into service and continuous capability development. You will own cost, schedule, risk and performance outcomes, and you will be the senior relationship lead for Navy, Defence and Government stakeholders. Working hand-in-hand with the Chief Engineer and with the engineering, operations and support teams, you will make sure capability reaches the fleet, is supported in service and keeps improving. This is an execution-focused leadership role, and stakeholder confidence matters as much as the schedule. You will both lead and execute.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and execute a large, complex, high-profile maritime program, owning delivery against contracted cost, schedule, scope and performance commitments.
  • Own the program’s baselines, Integrated Master Schedule and resource plan (headcount, budget and facilities). Forecast accurately, identify variances early and drive recovery.
  • Lead introduction into service. Plan and coordinate delivery, acceptance, operational test and evaluation, and transition to the operating and support organisations, working with Navy to reach initial and full operational capability milestones.
  • Work with the engineering, logistics and support teams to ensure the Fundamental Inputs to Capability are in place for service entry, including training, maintenance and support, supply, facilities and documentation.
  • Drive continuous capability development. Manage a regular cadence of hardware and software capability increments, balance new capability against operational availability, and keep configuration management and assurance in step.
  • Capture operator and customer feedback and, with product and engineering leads, turn it into a prioritised capability roadmap that the customer understands and supports.
  • Build and manage relationships across a complex stakeholder landscape, including Navy capability and fleet stakeholders, Defence acquisition and sustainment organisations, Government, industry partners and suppliers. Act as their trusted senior point of contact for the program.
  • Develop and maintain stakeholder engagement and communication plans. Lead program governance forums, steering committees and executive briefings, and manage expectations proactively, particularly when the news is difficult.
  • Manage delivery against Commonwealth contracts (including ASDEFCON-based contracts), covering milestones, contract deliverables, payments, contract change proposals, acceptance and reporting obligations.
  • Ensure crisp communication and reporting at all levels: to Anduril Australia and Maritime senior leadership, to Defence customers, to your program teams and to functional teams across Anduril globally.
  • Lead, mentor and grow a team of Program and Technical Program Managers. Set clear expectations and instil a high-ownership, delivery-focused culture.
  • Partner with the Chief Engineer and engineering leaders to drive execution and team velocity. Understand the technical implementation well enough to make informed trade-offs and to propose alternatives when necessary.
  • Identify, resolve and escalate key cross-team dependencies, including those spanning Anduril’s Australian and US teams, industry partners and suppliers.
  • Ensure the program meets its Defence security (DISP), export control (Australian and ITAR/EAR) and Australian Industry Capability obligations.
  • Identify and resolve systemic execution issues. Establish lean, effective governance, processes and tools suited to a fast-moving environment, and exercise meticulous, swift follow-through on all asks and deliverables.

Core Requirements

  • Minimum of 10+ years’ experience in program and project management, including at least 5 years in senior roles such as Program Director, Senior Program Manager or Project Director leading complex defence programs through execution and into service.
  • Background in Navy or military programs (as serving or former ADF personnel, within Defence, or in defence industry), with experience across maritime platforms, systems or capability.
  • Significant experience delivering complex programs with the Australian Government, including strong working knowledge of the Defence capability life cycle, introduction into service and sustainment processes, and Commonwealth contracting (ASDEFCON).
  • Demonstrated experience introducing capability into service, including acceptance, operational test and evaluation, the Fundamental Inputs to Capability and transition to sustainment.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management, with a proven ability to build trust with and influence senior Navy, Defence and Government stakeholders, balance competing interests and keep their confidence through challenging program phases.
  • Proven track record of managing cost, schedule and risk on large, technically complex programs, including resource management and integrated schedule planning.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and developing teams of program and project managers, and leading cross-functional teams through influence.
  • Solid technical aptitude and an understanding of systems engineering, hardware and software integration, configuration management, and the associated challenges and risks.
  • Practical familiarity with both Agile and Waterfall (phase-gated) methodologies, including managing incremental capability updates within a contracted environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong interpersonal skills and executive presence. Able to brief senior Defence and company leadership with confidence.
  • An aptitude and appetite to thrive in an organisation with nascent structure, a high-ownership culture and a “whatever it takes” environment. High ownership, low ego.
  • Based in Sydney and willing to travel domestically and internationally (including to the US), approximately 25% of the time.
  • Australian citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain an NV1 security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Current NV2 security clearance.
  • Experience with autonomous systems, robotics or other advanced and emerging maritime capability.
  • Experience with in-service support and sustainment, including integrated logistics support; reliability, availability and maintainability; and performance-based support arrangements.
  • Experience running programs with continuous or spiral capability development, including software release management under Defence seaworthiness or technical regulatory frameworks.
  • Experience with Defence gate reviews, independent assurance reviews and capability acceptance processes.
  • Experience on international or collaborative programs, including US–Australia collaboration, AUKUS-related activity and export controls (ITAR/EAR).
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to use data and metrics to back up assumptions and recommendations and to drive decisions.
  • Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, MS Project or Primavera P6.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science or a related discipline. Postgraduate qualifications in project management or business, or a professional certification (e.g. AIPM, PMP, PRINCE2, MSP), are desirable.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an ----- address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to

    • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is ----- before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

    • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/. 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

title: Project Manager, Merchandising
descriptionHtml:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

We're looking for a driven, analytical, outcome-focused Project Manager to join our Merchandising team. You'll take open-ended quality challenges on our supplier and traveler-facing data, think activity attributes, categories, and location data, and turn them into scoped, measurable projects, using AI to scale your work across our inventory. This is a data and process role: you'll be working with structured content and quality metrics, not copywriting or editorial content.

Your mission

  • Own outcome-driven projects end-to-end: set the scope, timeline, and success metric upfront, then run execution independently (i.e., freelancer content batches, supplier data fixes, or full quality evaluation cycles)

title: Projektentwickler (m/w/d) Energiecontracting
descriptionHtml:

aktiv die Zukunft der Energieversorgung – mit einer klaren Vision: Als

entscheidenden Beitrag zur Energiewende in Deutschland.

nachhaltiger Versorgungskonzepte und arbeitest dabei eng mit internen

title: Projektingenieur Entwicklung (m/w/x) – Teilprojektleitung Prototypen und Prüftechnik
descriptionHtml:
Die Alveon MedTech GmbH ist ein innovatives Medizintechnik-Startup mit Sitz in Ostfildern bei Stuttgart. Unser Fokus liegt auf der Entwicklung medizinischer Inhalationssysteme. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2020 haben wir erfolgreich eine patentgeschützte Basistechnologie entwickelt. Aktuell arbeiten wir – im Rahmen einer strategischen Partnerschaft mit einem der größten deutschen Unternehmen im Medizinalcannabis-Markt – an der Entwicklung und Zulassung des ersten dosierfähigen Cannabis-Inhalators für den europäischen Markt.

Jetzt steht die entscheidende Phase an: Prototypen, Versuche, Verifikation und Zulassung. Dafür erweitern wir unsere Prüfkapazitäten in Ostfildern und bei externen Partnern und suchen jemanden, der diesen Bereich verantwortet.

Als Projektingenieur Entwicklung und Prüftechnik übernimmst du abgegrenzte Entwicklungsbereiche mit voller Ergebnisverantwortung — von der Konzeption über Versuch und Prototyp bis zum belastbaren Nachweis. Du bekommst Ziele, keine Arbeitsanweisungen.

Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem CTO und Projektleiter zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass zum jeweiligen Meilenstein die richtigen Prototypen bereitstehen — und koordinierst dafür Kolleginnen, Kollegen und externe Partner.

Aufgaben

Eigenverantwortliche Arbeitspakete:

  • Konzeption und Umsetzung abgegrenzter Entwicklungsthemen

  • Festlegung von Vorgehen, Umfang und Abbruchkriterien

  • Abstimmung mit QM/Regulatory und externen Partnern

  • Terminverantwortung für die Bereitstellung von Versuchsaufbauten, Prototypen und Mustern

Schwerpunkt: Versuch, Prüfaufbau und Labor

  • Aufbau, Inbetriebnahme und Weiterentwicklung von Prüfvorrichtungen, Messplätzen und Versuchsständen

  • Planung, Durchführung und Auswertung von Entwicklungs- und Verifikationsversuchen, unter anderem zu Verdampfungsleistung, Dosiergenauigkeit, Temperaturverhalten, Dichtheit und Lebensdauer

  • Aufbau und Betreuung der Messtechnik inklusive Kalibrierung und Prüfmittelverwaltung

  • Vorbereitung, Begleitung und Auswertung von Prüfkampagnen bei externen Laboren und Hochschulen

  • Erstellung von Versuchsplänen, Versuchsprotokollen, Prüf- und Entwicklungsberichten

Ergänzend: Konstruktion und Prototyping

  • Konstruktion von Vorrichtungen, Adaptern und Bauteilen im CAD

  • Prototyping mittels 3D-Druck sowie Aufbau, Kennzeichnung und Rückverfolgbarkeit von Mustern

  • Technische Bewertung von Bauteilen und Werkstoffen aus Keramik, Spritzguss und Silikon

  • Zuarbeit zur technischen Dokumentation gemäß MDR und ISO 13485

Qualifikation

Damit du in dieser Position erfolgreich bist, solltest du Folgendes mitbringen:

  • Abgeschlossenes technisches Studium (z. B. Maschinenbau, Medizintechnik, Verfahrenstechnik, Physik) oder Technikerabschluss mit einschlägiger Erfahrung

  • Mind. 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im technischen Entwicklungsumfeld, davon mehrere Jahre in eigenverantwortlicher Rolle

  • Die Fähigkeit, pragmatisch zu entscheiden, wie weit eine Lösung gehen muss — und das zu begründen

  • Sicheres, repräsentatives Auftreten gegenüber Lieferanten, Prüflaboren und Hochschulen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Messtechnik sowie mit der Auswertung und Darstellung von Versuchsdaten

  • Sorgfältige, nachvollziehbare Dokumentation deiner Arbeit

  • Hohe Eigenmotivation, Selbststrukturierung und Verantwortungsbewusstsein

  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe, analytisches Denken und die Bereitschaft, dich tief in technische und regulatorische Themen einzuarbeiten

  • Bereitschaft zur Arbeit vor Ort in Ostfildern sowie zu gelegentlichen Einsätzen bei Partnern und Prüflaboren

  • Ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität: du baust auf, misst und packst selbst an

  • Praktische Erfahrung im CAD, etwa mit SolidWorks, Creo oder Fusion 360

  • Deutsch verhandlungssicher, Englisch sicher in Wort und Schrift

Besonders von Vorteil sind:

  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung medizinischer Geräte unter EU-MDR

  • Kenntnisse der Qualitätsnormen ISO 9001 und ISO 13485

  • Erfahrung mit Aerosolen, Inhalation, Thermodynamik oder Strömungstechnik

  • Kenntnisse in statistischer Versuchsplanung und Auswertung, etwa Python, Minitab oder R

Benefits

Was wir bieten:

  • Ein Produkt, das in den nächsten Jahren durch die Zulassung geht — deine Versuchsergebnisse entscheiden mit darüber, ob es funktioniert

  • Eigene Verantwortungsbereiche mit Entscheidungsspielraum — und die Perspektive, daraus Teilprojektleitung zu machen

  • Arbeiten auf Augenhöhe in einem kleinen, vielseitigen Engineeringteam

  • Schnelle Übernahme von Verantwortung, hoher Gestaltungsspielraum und direkter Einfluss auf den Produkterfolg

  • Kurze Wege: Entwicklung, Labor und Prototypenbau an einem Standort statt verteilter Abstimmungsschleifen

  • Ein Team, das KI-Werkzeuge nicht diskutiert, sondern baut

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, 30 Tage Urlaub, unbefristete Vollzeitanstellung

  • Mobiles Arbeiten für Auswerte- und Dokumentationstage nach Absprache

Gestalte mit Alveon MedTech die Zukunft der Medizintechnik im Bereich der Inhalation. Wenn du Lust hast, ein Gerät nicht nur zu rechnen, sondern es zu bauen, zu messen und zum Funktionieren zu bringen, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung — gerne formlos mit Lebenslauf und einem kurzen Wort dazu, warum diese Rolle zu dir passt. Zeugnisse brauchen wir erst später.
