title: Senior Forward Deployed Platform Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.

Our AI portfolio spans model development through to production inference at scale, in a highly regulated healthcare context. This role exists to make sure that infrastructure runs reliably, scales predictably, and gets AI engineers' work safely into production.

What to expect

This is what you can expect from us as a Senior Forward Deployed Platform Engineer:

  • Purposeful work – your work keeps our AI portfolio reliable and performant for hospitals and aftercare providers who depend on it daily.

  • Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

  • Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.

  • Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.

This is how you will make an impact as a Senior Forward Deployed Platform Engineer:

  • Our AI portfolio needs to run reliably and perform well. Thus it has to be properly monitored.

  • Capacity needs planning, support scaling initiatives, and ensure our systems remain stable as the company grows.

  • SageMaker models need to be continuously delivered, following AWS' best practices.

  • AI engineers need assistance with productionalizing AI workloads end-to-end, from code to container build, and rollouts using optimal deployment strategies.

How we build

We run a modern cloud-native stack to build, ship, and operate AI workloads reliably in a regulated healthcare environment.

  • Cloud: AWS (The European Sovereign Cloud partition)

  • Runtime: Kubernetes and Postgres

  • Inference: Bedrock, SageMaker, ClearML

  • Observability: Datadog, LangFuse, OTEL

  • CI/CD: GitHub Enterprise Cloud with Actions

  • Plus various auxiliary tools for security, compliance and operations: DockerHub, Google as IdP, SonarCloud, VPNs, QuickSight, CDN, Snowflake, ETLs, etc.


Requirements

Here's how we picture you as our Senior Forward Deployed Platform Engineer:

These are the knowledge and skills you need:

  • Experience with AWS (CloudFormation, IAM, ECR, SageMaker, Bedrock, S3, SQS, DynamoDB, RDS, KMS).

  • Experience with Kubernetes (EKS) in production (kustomize, HPA and KEDA based autoscaling).

  • Experience deploying SageMaker models, setting up custom inference containers (HuggingFace and/or OSS model) and endpoints (provisioning, autoscaling, and blue/green rollouts).

  • Familiarity with observability & LLMOps best practices and solutions (Datadog, Langfuse, LLM/GenAI tracing, OTel, CloudWatch).

  • Proficiency in Python, specifically with FastAPI and async task management.

  • Knowing how to set up ML/LLM GPU inference on EKS (GPU-backed instances, Nvidia driver/plugin).

  • Ability to own technical decisions and collaborate directly with other teams.

  • Troubleshooting, RCA, and resolving problems. When things get stressful, you stay cool headed and work through issues step by step, asking for support from SMEs when needed.

  • Preference for writing over talking, resulting in clear, concise, yet complete documentation and asynchronous communications.

  • This is a cross-functional role bridging the gap between applications and the platform. Ability to both explain complex concepts clearly to non-domain experts, and extract information through well-formed questions during verbal communication, is a must.

Bonus points:

  • Healthcare or regulated-domain experience (e.g. ISO 27001, C5).

  • Self-hosting/home lab.

  • Nvidia Triton/vLLM or similar.

  • MLflow, Kubeflow, ClearML, DVC, Vertex AI.

  • Slack and GitHub automations (bots, workflows, apps, etc.).

This will help you decide if you want to join us – our values are:

  • Strong opinions, weakly held. We adapt, negotiate trade-offs, and reconsider decisions when necessary. We don't stick to one implementation – we re-evaluate and adjust as needed (including throwing away the old one).

  • Pragmatic choice of tools and avoidance of one-size-fits-all thinking.

  • Bringing professionalism and empathy to how you work with others.

  • Strong belief in solid technical fundamentals and preference for understanding and first principles over memorization.

  • Language proficiency (at least English, but the more, the better).

title: SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist

SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist – Technical SEO, Google Ads & Lead Generation | Remote

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies.

You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO).

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Optimization

  • Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.
  • Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.
  • Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance.
  • Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data.
  • Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.
  • Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
  • Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  • Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels.
  • Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals.

Content Marketing & Website Management

  • Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives.
  • Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages.
  • Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms.
  • Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience.

Analytics, Reporting & Optimization

  • Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports.
  • Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns.
  • Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.

Marketing Automation & CRM

  • Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows.
  • Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign.
  • Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs.
  • Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing.
  • Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation.
  • Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools.
  • Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns.
  • Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms.
  • Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels.
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines.
  • Availability during U.S. Business Hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

  • Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses.
  • Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting.
  • Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results.
  • You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together.
  • You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance.
  • You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements.
  • You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends.
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions.

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic.

  • Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions.

title: Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Location: UK. Fully remote, or from our London office next to East Croydon Station

Working pattern: Fully remote working is allowed, and the London office is available to you

Reports to: CTO

About Us

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities.

With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

Role Overview

You will build the products drivers and car park operators use every day: ANPR camera enforcement, pay-by-web, Autopay, permits, a client console and a motorist account app, across about 160 sites, and the new products we build next. We are a small engineering team, and we form teams around the work from the people we have.

We work in Kotlin on the backend (Spring Boot WebFlux, a domain-driven layering of domain, edge services and repository, Postgres, Axon event sourcing and Pub/Sub) and in TypeScript with Next.js and React on the front end, on GCP and Kubernetes. You do not need to know Kotlin to apply. Our engineers work with AI coding agents day to day, and we are looking for people who use them well and check what they produce.

Every engineer here is product-minded. You will talk to the people who use what you build, decide with product people what is worth building, and find out afterwards whether it worked.

You will report to the CTO and work with a team that reviews each other’s work.

The Mid-level

Mid-level Software Engineer. You own features end to end: you shape them with a product person, build them, test them, release them and look after them once they are live. You work inside an existing architecture with senior review. The work is mostly Kotlin backend plus Next.js and React front end.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the delivery of what you are given, from the first ticket to production, with tests, and be the person who fixes it if it breaks.

  • Talk to the people who use what you build, and use what you learn to shape and cut scope.

  • Write acceptance criteria, and check a feature after release to see whether it was used and whether it worked.

  • Work in our existing codebase and its layering, and keep it consistent for the next engineer.

  • Use AI coding agents as part of how you work, and be accountable for everything you ship, however it was written.

  • Take part in the on-call rota and look after what you ship.

  • Review other engineers’ pull requests, and welcome review of your own.

Who we’re looking for

  • You’re product-minded. In the last 12 months you’ve talked to real users or customers, and what you learned changed or cut the scope of what you built. You write acceptance criteria, you check a feature after release, and you can say whether something you shipped got used.

  • You’ve shipped production code end to end in the last 12 months, in any language. You can say what you personally built, and what happened after it went live.

  • You test as you build. You can describe a bug you shipped and the test that would have caught it.

  • You use AI coding agents in real work today, and you can describe how you check what they produce, including a time one was wrong.

  • You’re willing to be on call, and you take ownership of what you ship. You don’t need to have been on call before.

  • You work well in an existing codebase with a layered or domain-driven structure that you did not design, and you read before you write.

  • You’re comfortable across the stack. You’ve changed a React or Next.js front end, or worked properly against an API contract, even if you lean backend.

  • You review others’ pull requests, finding real problems and saying so well, and you change your own design when review shows you a better way.

You do not need a degree, a particular programming language, or Kotlin. Experience of Axon, Temporal, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, parking or payments is welcome, but none of it is required.

This advert is for the Mid-level. If you have more senior experience, see our Senior Software Engineer vacancy here.

What We Offer

  • Real ownership: mid-level engineers own whole features, and senior engineers own a product area.

  • A team that works with AI coding agents every day and measures what they do for us.

  • A strong, high performing culture, with genuine influence over how that culture develops as Hozah grows.

  • Fully remote working in the UK, with access to a fully refurbished, modern office, right next to East Croydon Station (with a fully stocked kitchen, offering free breakfast, lunch and drinks!).

title: Research Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Hudson River Trading (HRT) is a quantitative trading firm at the forefront of technological innovation. We build and deploy cutting-edge systems within one of the world’s most advanced computing environments to power our global trading operations. Our non-siloed, collaborative coding environment empowers talented engineers to make significant contributions and see their impact daily. At HRT, you'll be challenged to solve the most complex problems in trading alongside many of the brightest minds in the field.

We are seeking highly motivated and skilled Research Engineers who will work very closely with our Algo Developer (Quant Research) trading teams. These roles require exceptional programming fundamentals, a strong user focus, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with constantly evolving requirements. Multitasking and context switching are inherent aspects of this role, through which you will gain insight into the ideation and execution of some of the world's most sophisticated trading strategies.  

Research Engineers at HRT work on a wide variety of projects. Examples include:

  • Designing highly customized quantitative systems that enable Algo Developers to easily express and backtest new predictive signals.
  • Building world-class research tooling to speed up Algo Developers’ research iteration.
  • Aiding the development and deployment of very large deep learning models for HRT’s live trading.
  • Improving HRT’s monetization systems which turn our predictions into profitable trades.
  • Evaluating sim vs. live differences to improve the fidelity of our simulations.
  • Building systems to monitor and manage live trading.
  • Specializing in specific time horizons, from high frequency trading to mid-to-low frequency hedge fund-style strategies.
  • Working across a very wide variety of asset classes (from equities to fixed income to options) and regions (from North America to Asia Pacific) – you’ll interact with markets across the world!

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, performant, and scalable software systems.
  • Optimize existing codebases for performance, reliability, and efficiency.
  • Debug complex issues across distributed systems in a time-sensitive environment.
  • Optimize both the mechanics and ergonomics of Algo Developer research workflows; this requires developing a deep intuition for research methodologies.
  • Balance the short term goals of individual trading teams with the longer term goals of HRT’s generalized trading platforms across trading teams. Because we don’t work in a pod environment, REs on different trading teams are expected to share technology and ideas.

Qualifications

  • Completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. If you are currently pursuing your Bachelor's degree, please apply to our Campus/New Grad opportunities.
  • Previous experience at a top-tier finance or technology company with an excellent track record of rapid advancement and superlative reviews.
  • Experience with supporting internal users is preferred; bonus if you have real hands-on experience with quant research and/or ML/Deep Learning platforms.
  • Experience with python numerical, ML and data-oriented libraries is a big plus (e.g. pandas, scikit, pytorch, etc.)
  • Candidates should be prepared for technical interviews in either Python or C++. While there is no hard language requirement for RE roles, proficiency in one of these languages will be assessed during the interview process.
  • Kindness and empathy is a real requirement. No “smart jerks” at HRT. 
  • Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and design principles.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • HRT ships every day. The ability to thoughtfully, methodically, and reliably deploy new software and features is a critical skill. 
  • If you have management experience, that’s always a bonus – but even so, expect to code!

The estimated base salary range for this position is 200,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role will also be eligible for discretionary performance-based bonuses and a competitive benefits package.

For more info about interviewing at HRT, see this blog!

Culture

Hudson River Trading (HRT) brings a scientific approach to trading financial products. We have built one of the world's most sophisticated computing environments for research and development. Our researchers are at the forefront of innovation in the world of algorithmic trading.

At HRT we welcome a variety of expertise: mathematics and computer science, physics and engineering, media and tech. We’re a community of self-starters who are motivated by the excitement of being at the cutting edge of automation in every part of our organization—from trading, to business operations, to recruiting and beyond. We value openness and transparency, and celebrate great ideas from HRT veterans and new hires alike. At HRT we’re friends and colleagues – whether we are sharing a meal, playing the latest board game, or writing elegant code. We embrace a culture of togetherness that extends far beyond the walls of our office.

Feel like you belong at HRT? Our goal is to find the best people and bring them together to do great work in a place where everyone is valued. HRT is proud of our diverse staff; we have offices all over the globe and benefit from our varied and unique perspectives. HRT is an equal opportunity employer; so whoever you are we’d love to get to know you.

Please be advised: Use of AI tools by an applicant during interviews or assessments is strictly prohibited, unless otherwise instructed or agreed upon. We employ various methods to evaluate the authenticity of candidate responses. If we determine that AI assistance was used by an applicant during an interview or an assessment, we reserve the right to immediately end the interview or assessment, disqualify the applicant’s candidacy and/or rescind any job offers extended.

You can review our Global Applicant Privacy Notice, which explains how we process applicant information.

title: Research Engineer / Scientist, Reinforcement Learning
descriptionHtml:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As a Member of Technical Staff, Modeling in Harvey Research, you’ll own how we adapt and improve leading open-weight models for legal work.

We recently post-trained our first model built for legal work, and we’re now building the team to scale up our post-training efforts. You’ll own the post-training recipe across SFT and RL, including reward design and verification for challenging, semi-verifiable legal tasks. You’ll help set the research direction and carry ideas from experiments through training runs to models used by customers. You’ll join a small, high-bar team of hands-on engineers and researchers, where each person owns a large part of the work.

We’re looking for research engineers and scientists who have gotten training runs working at scale, are immersed in RL for language models, and want their work to reach users quickly.

Learn more about our work at harvey.ai/research.

What You'll Do

  • Own and pursue a research agenda to improve model capability on long-horizon legal reasoning and agentic workflows.

  • Design and run post-training experiments across SFT and RL, building on leading open-weight models.

  • Develop reward functions and verifiers for semi-verifiable tasks, including rubrics, learned preference models, and expert preference data, and study where they break.

  • Run and debug training at scale, addressing divergence, reward hacking, and instability.

  • Build and use rigorous evals to track improvements and decide what ships.

  • Design, implement, test, and debug code across our research stack.

What You Have

  • Hands-on experience post-training LLMs with SFT and RL, including preference optimization, and direct ownership of training runs and results.

  • Deep ML fundamentals and experience getting distributed training runs working reliably.

  • Strong engineering skills in Python, with production-quality code and end-to-end system ownership.

  • Research experience in RL for language models or reward modeling, with the ability to move quickly from experiments to shipped improvements. Publications welcome, not required.

descriptionHtml:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath.

Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day.

We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

We're 100 people, profitable, and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

As a Revenue Operations Engineeer you anchor the build end of Revenue Operations - our internal product team whose customers are the GTM functions: Sales, CS, Marketing, and Finance. You build the AI, automation, and data foundations that make these teams faster, smarter, and more scalable, owning the end-to-end delivery of internal tools, integrations, and AI-powered workflows - from problem framing and architecture through launch, adoption, and measurable business impact.

Who We Want

Proven GTM Systems Builder.
You bring 3+ years of hands-on experience in RevOps, GTM Engineering, SalesOps, Business Systems, or a comparable B2B SaaS role, and can show production systems you personally built.

AI-Native Builder.
You've integrated LLMs into real workflows or tools through APIs and understand how to move beyond prompting into reliable, production-ready use cases.

Product-Minded Systems Thinker.
You start with the user and business problem, map the relevant process and data dependencies, and choose the simplest scalable solution rather than defaulting to a particular tool.

Integration & Data Fluent.
You're comfortable working with APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication, data models, and the movement of data between multiple systems.

End-to-End Owner.
You can take a project from discovery and architecture through building, testing, rollout, documentation, monitoring, and ongoing improvement.

Pragmatic Production Engineer.
You ship quickly without treating reliability as optional, including appropriate testing, error handling, security, observability, and documentation.

Business-Impact Oriented.
You connect technical work to measurable outcomes such as pipeline, productivity, data quality, speed, cost, or customer experience.

Clear Cross-Functional Communicator.
You can explain technical decisions simply, manage trade-offs, work through ambiguity, and collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You are fluent in written and spoken English; German is a plus.

Curious & Self-Directed.
You actively experiment with new technologies, learn through building, and share useful findings without chasing novelty for its own sake.

Who We Don’t Want

Uses tools without hands-on depth.
You've used CRM and AI tools but lack hands-on experience building automations, configuring systems, or solving operational problems end-to-end.

Struggles with cross-functional GTM processes.
You find it hard to understand how operational decisions ripple across the wider GTM motion and the business as a whole.

Weak on the technical fundamentals.
You struggle with APIs, JSON, data models, authentication, debugging, or moving data reliably between systems.

Can't connect the build to the business.
You can't explain technical choices clearly, manage trade-offs, influence stakeholders, or connect a build to its wider business impact.

Uses AI without shipping anything real.
You use ChatGPT or Claude but can't point to an LLM-powered workflow, integration, or tool you've personally built and shipped.

Builds without thinking about what comes after.
You've built isolated automations without considering maintainability, documentation, ownership, failure handling, or how the solution fits into the wider architecture.

Your Day To Day

Building: AI, Automation & Systems (~ 65%)

  • You identify and productionize high-leverage AI use cases across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Finance, including LLM integrations, workflow design, evaluation, guardrails, and monitoring
  • You design and build lightweight internal applications and interfaces that remove recurring manual work, improve decision-making, and are simple for teams to adopt
  • You build end-to-end workflows using Make, n8n, and custom logic, including business rules, system handoffs, error handling, alerts, and ongoing monitoring
  • You create clean, maintainable data flows between HubSpot, the data warehouse, billing, support, and other GTM tools using APIs, webhooks, enrichment pipelines, and data activation
  • You work deeply within HubSpot's objects, properties, workflows, and integration layer to support complex use cases without creating fragile or unnecessarily complicated architecture

Discovery & Solution Design (~ 15%)

  • You translate scoped or ambiguous business problems into clear technical solutions, define success metrics, and choose the simplest approach that can deliver meaningful impact

Deployment, Adoption & Documentation (~ 20%)

  • You test, document, deploy, and iterate on solutions with end users so they remain secure, maintainable, reliable, and useful after launch

Stakeholders

RevOps: Your peers and manager to collaborate on projects and daily initiatives
Engineering team: Coordinate with engineers for projects that may require product know how and integration across the engineering tool stack GTM teams as and when required

Why People Choose Us

  • We believe in the power of in-person collaboration: We genuinely love being together in the Berlin office. That's where the best ideas happen, decisions move faster, and we learn from and grow with each other every day. We do offer some flexibility for remote work, but our default and our energy is being in the room together.

title: Revenue Operations Manager  - London
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role:

Perk is going through a period of significant growth, and we're using AI and automation to make our sales teams more productive and to take manual work out of our reps' day-to-day, in our tools and in the CRM. Nowhere is that more visible than in our SDR organisation, where we are rolling out AI-driven outbound prospecting with tools like Clay.

We're hiring a Revenue Operations Manager in Barcelona to support our SDR organisation globally. This is a senior individual contributor role: a strategic business partner to SDR leadership on process, systems, and operating cadences, and the business owner of the SDR tech stack, from Sales Engagement tooling to LinkedIn Sales Navigator and enrichment. You'll own how SDRs prospect, engage, and hand off pipeline, from the data and signals that tell them who to contact, to the sequences and automations that help them do it at scale, to the reporting that shows what is working.

We're looking for a true owner who understands what good looks like, has rolled out AI and automation for outbound at scale elsewhere, and is curious about where AI can take outbound next.

What You'll Do:

Be the strategic partner to SDR leadership

  • Partner with global SDR leaders to define and run the operating model: processes, territories and handoffs, and the weekly, monthly, and quarterly cadences that keep the team on track.

  • Work with Sales Leadership, Marketing, Sales Enablement, and Finance to keep lead management and pipeline definitions aligned end to end.

Own the SDR process

  • Own the end-to-end SDR process, from prospecting and outreach to qualification and handoff to Account Executives, and keep it documented in clear playbooks that are consistent across regions.

  • Own the prospecting process: ICP and account prioritisation, signal-based targeting, and outbound cadences.

  • Own the qualification methodology: lead and opportunity definitions, qualification criteria, stage and disqualification logic, and acceptance standards for handoffs, and evolve them as our go-to-market changes.

  • Own the inbound lead process: capture, routing, speed-to-lead standards, follow-up expectations, ownership rules, and the handoff between Marketing and SDRs.

  • Roll out process changes with SDR leaders and Enablement, and make sure they are adopted and followed.

  • Own the Rules of Engagement for outbound and inbound, including account ownership between regional and global accounts, so SDRs, Account Executives, and Marketing know who works which accounts and leads, and conflicts are resolved quickly and fairly.

Own the SDR tech stack

  • Act as the business owner of every tool our SDR organisation uses in its prospecting efforts globally, including Sales Engagement platforms, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and data enrichment tools, owning the roadmap, configuration, licences and cost, adoption, data quality, and vendor relationships.

  • Make sure the tools, the CRM, and the data around them work as one system, so reps spend their time selling, not updating records.

  • Evaluate, pilot, and roll out new tools and features, with clear business cases and success metrics.

  • Partner closely with the Revenue Systems team, who are the technical owners of these tools and manage configuration, syncs, and integrations, by setting priorities and requirements as the business owner, and with Enablement on training and change management.

Drive AI and automation for outbound and inbound

  • Partner with the GTM Engineering team, who own Clay and the AI automation for SDRs, and act as the business owner of the SDR automation roadmap, defining the use cases and priorities for AI-driven outbound: signal-based targeting, account and contact research, enrichment, personalisation, and sequencing.

  • Reduce manual work for SDRs by automating CRM updates, lead and account research, routing, and follow-up, and measure the time saved and the pipeline impact.

  • Design and refine lead routing, scoring, and inbound handling so the right leads reach the right reps quickly.

  • Test and pilot emerging AI capabilities for SDR and inbound use cases, and scale what works with clear guardrails on data quality, compliance, and brand.

Protect data and quality

  • Set the standards for data hygiene, outreach governance, and deliverability across SDR tools, and make sure they are followed.

  • Build the dashboards and reporting that give SDR leaders and reps a single source of truth on activity, funnel, and outcomes.

  • Document processes and playbooks so they are repeatable across regions.

What We're Looking For:

  • Significant experience (typically 5+ years) in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or SDR/Pipeline Operations in B2B SaaS, with a focus on SDR or outbound productivity.

  • Proven experience supporting the roll out of AI and automation for outbound prospecting from a process point of view

  • Deep hands-on knowledge of Salesforce and of Sales Engagement platforms (such as Outreach, Salesloft, or Gong), including sequencing, enrichment, routing, and scoring.

  • Strong analytical skills: you can find the story in funnel and rep-activity data and turn it into decisions that SDR leaders act on.

  • A true owner: you take responsibility for a tool, a process, or an outcome end to end, and you don't wait to be asked.

  • Credibility as a strategic partner to senior sales leaders, comfortable challenging and influencing across Sales, Marketing, Enablement, Finance, and Systems.

  • Strong project and change management skills, with a track record of driving adoption across global teams.

  • Curiosity about AI and where it can take SDR, outbound, and inbound operations next.

  • Comfortable in a fast-growing, fast-changing environment where processes are still being built.

What we offer:

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

Hiring Process

  • 30 min online call with Talent Acquisition

  • Online 45min call with the hiring manager

  • IRL Assessment with the Hiring manager + another senior person from the Rev Ops team

  • 30 min online panel interview with the SDR Manager

  • 30 min Online Culture interview with SE Manager

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

Why Isembard

title: Sales Development Representative (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

At RobCo, we automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary. To achieve this, we are looking for an ambitious Sales Development Representative (m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as leading provider of automation solutions.

You are part of our revenue team and actively drive the new customer pipeline. You independently build relationships with potential clients, qualify accounts, and turn market potential into concrete sales opportunities. With a data-driven and performance-oriented approach, you directly shape the growth of RobCo in Germany and make a significant contribution to the team’s success.

Your Responsibilities

  • Contact Specialist:
    You initiate first contact with potential customers and identify the right decision-makers.

  • Sales Professional:
    You generate new sales opportunities and work strategically within a dynamic marketing landscape.

  • Relationship Manager:
    You build and maintain relationships in line with RobCo’s Operating Principles and ensure a smooth handover to the Field Sales team.

  • Team Player:
    You collaborate closely with other departments and support our campaigns to optimize the overall sales strategy.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • 1–3 years of relevant professional experience in Sales Development, Business Development, or a comparable performance-driven role. You have experience in direct customer interaction and are motivated to actively contribute to building and growing the revenue team.

  • Results-driven: You have a proven track record of meeting or exceeding prospecting and outreach quotas.

  • Technology enthusiast: You have a strong interest in robotics or the manufacturing industry.

  • Customer-focused: You are a natural networker who builds trusted customer relationships and understands the importance of excellent customer engagement.

  • Strong communicator: You possess excellent communication skills in both German and English.

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Work out across Germany in over 7,200 studios with our subsidized Wellpass membership.

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and—depending on the role—the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events—from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that continuously learns and improves, requiring zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. In October 2026, RobCo reached unicorn status with a valuation exceeding one billion US dollars, with its valuation doubling in less than nine months. With $200M raised from investors including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Lingotto, Kindred, Cherry Ventures, and the European Tech Collective, 225+ people globally, and 3.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our Bay Area Lab in San Francisco.

title: Sales Director
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the role

As a Sales Director at Faculty, you will lead the sale of large-scale strategic AI engagements, building trusted C-suite relationships and establishing Faculty as the essential partner for the world's largest companies pursuing transformative AI initiatives.

You will drive high-impact growth by navigating complex sales cycles, collaborating closely with key strategic partners like Accenture, and shaping bold, differentiated commercial solutions that empower Fortune 500 and FTSE 100 organisations to harness the full power of artificial intelligence.

What you'll be doing

  • Building and managing a qualified pipeline of high-value strategic opportunities directly across target enterprises and joint Accenture partnership channels.

  • Leading end-to-end sales processes from initial executive engagement through to contract signature, orchestrating technical scoping, solution design, commercial negotiations, procurement, and legal reviews.

  • Developing enduring executive relationships with C-suite sponsors at global enterprise accounts, positioning Faculty as their premier partner for transformative AI initiatives.

  • Collaborating with Accenture leadership to identify joint pursuit opportunities, align go-to-market strategies, and coordinate enterprise deal execution.

  • Achieving quarterly and annual revenue targets while maintaining rigorous forecasting discipline and providing leadership with clear visibility into pipeline health.

  • Partnering with cross-functional technical and delivery teams to shape compelling, credible propositions that solve complex organisational challenges.

Who we're looking for

  • You bring a proven track record of enterprise sales leadership, successfully closing complex, multi-quarter strategic engagements with Fortune 500 or FTSE 100 companies.

  • You excel at C-suite engagement, building trusted relationships with senior executives such as CTOs, CSOs, and CISOs who sponsor enterprise-wide AI and safety initiatives.

  • You possess strong technical sales acumen, comfortably translating complex AI concepts into clear business value while engaging fluently with both technical teams and commercial decision-makers.

  • You bring valuable partnership sales experience, adept at collaborating with consulting firms, systems integrators, and hyper-scalers to co-sell and win major accounts.

  • You master deal orchestration and commercial structuring, with expertise in guiding multi-stakeholder work streams and negotiating sophisticated agreements like MSAs and outcome-based pricing models.

  • You demonstrate exceptional executive presence and resilience, presenting confidently to boards and C-suites while maintaining energy and momentum through complex, high-stakes sales cycles.

The Interview Process

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 mins)

  2. Introduction call with the Hiring Manager (30 mins)

  3. On site Panel Interview (60mins)

  4. Final interview with one of our Managing Directors (30mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Sales Engineering Manager Core - Mainland Europe
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking an experienced and results-driven Sales Engineering Manager to focus on our Enterprise Core business in Mainland Europe (DACH & France). You should have experience managing and ideally growing a dispersed sales engineering team in a high-performance environment. Our Sales Engineering team is full of problem solvers and tinkerers who are not afraid to get their hands dirty (literally) and play a critical role in demonstrating and communicating the value of Samsara's platform with our largest customers.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and inspired to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Manage individual and team performance ensuring our partnership with sales, product, support, and customer success teams are productive and efficient
  • Work with Account Executives and Regional Sales Directors on account planning, strategy, and sales call activity
  • Manage escalations (product issues, feature requests, etc.) in a pre-sales environment
  • Participate in customer/prospect calls as a trusted advisor
  • Partner with other Sales Engineering leaders to improve the overall Sales Engineering organization at Samsara

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • B.S. degree in Computer Science or similar
  • 5+ years of sales engineering management experience
  • Experience with Software Product sales: Infrastructure, SaaS
  • Knowledge in one or more of these areas of expertise: IoT, Networking / Security, SaaS, Cloud Technologies, or Physical Security
  • Strong technical and business acumen
  • Excellent communication, customer service, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to partner with a broad coalition of stakeholders, ranging from sales, product, marketing, support, and customer success, and from individual contributors to executive team members across the organization
  • Demonstrated leadership, creativity, and problem-solving abilities
  • Excellent presentation and organizational skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced dynamic environment
  • Ability to travel as needed
  • Location: Remote, Germany or Remote, France
  • Language requirement: Fluent German or Fluent French

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. title: Sales Executive
descriptionHtml:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

We’re looking for a Sales Executive
Our Sales Executives are skilled sales professionals focused on re-engaging and converting business customers. You’ll manage and nurture a high quality sales pipeline, with the opportunity to earn uncapped commission based on revenue generated. Our Sales Executives are focused on businesses who have either applied, or used our products or services in the past, but aren’t currently.

Your mission

  • Build and nurture a pipeline of high quality leads from qualified pools of business customers

  • Employ expert sales skills to understand customer needs and tailor your pitch to iwoca’s market-leading product offering

  • Utilise our market leading tech and systems to effectively manage your own portfolio of leads, following your own contact strategy

  • Go above and beyond to hit your KPIs, maximise commission and exceed growth targets

  • Liaise with different teams within iwoca, such as Account Management, Marketing and Underwriting to achieve the best outcome for your customers

  • Be a team player, helping to improve this exciting part of the business

Requirements

We look for people who are smart, humble, motivated and who are always looking to improve.

Ideally you'll have:

  • Have past experience in sales, ideally within financial services

  • Be comfortable making outbound calls, and have an excellent call manner

  • Be highly motivated, and excited to exceed targets

  • Be able to take on, and provide, quality feedback to power your own growth, as well as that of your teammates

  • Be organised and able to manage a large pipeline of prospects, with deals at various stages of progress

  • Be able to simplify and explain complex products in a way that customers with little experience in commercial financing can easily understand

Desired (but not essential):

  • Understand the challenges facing small businesses

  • A good understanding of different financial products used by small businesses

The salary

The expected OTE for this role ranges from £55,000 - £70,000. We’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

title: Sales Manager (m/w/d) – Stadtwerke & Industrie | Süddeutschland
descriptionHtml:
Dein Job für sauberere Luft. Werde Emission Partner.



Technik aus dem Saterland. Wirkung weit darüber hinaus.

In der Gemeinde Saterland entwickeln und produzieren wir Technologien, die Schadstoffemissionen reduzieren. Unsere Katalysatoren und Systeme kommen dort zum Einsatz, wo Abgase zuverlässig gereinigt und Emissionsgrenzwerte eingehalten werden müssen.

Dabei entwickeln wir uns kontinuierlich weiter und erschließen neue Anwendungsfelder für unsere Technologien. Gerade bei Stadtwerken und Industrieunternehmen entstehen neue Anforderungen und damit neue Möglichkeiten für moderne Lösungen zur Abgasnachbehandlung.

Und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Als Sales Manager für Süddeutschland entwickelst du unser Geschäft mit Stadtwerken und Industriekunden weiter. Du identifizierst Marktpotenziale, gewinnst neue Kunden, entwickelst bestehende Key Accounts und bringst unsere technischen Lösungen mit den Anforderungen unserer Kunden zusammen.

Du möchtest nicht einfach ein bestehendes Vertriebsgebiet verwalten, sondern Marktpotenziale erschließen, Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen und ein Geschäftsfeld aktiv weiterentwickeln? Dann werde Emission Partner.

Was du bei uns bewirkst



Du bringst unsere Technologie dorthin, wo Emissionen entstehen und Lösungen gebraucht werden.

In deiner Region bist du nah an unseren Kunden und am Markt. Du sprichst mit Stadtwerken und Industrieunternehmen über ihre technischen Herausforderungen, erkennst neue Projekte und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Fachbereichen die passende Lösung.

Dabei geht deine Aufgabe über klassischen Produktvertrieb hinaus.

Du analysierst Märkte, identifizierst neue Anwendungsfelder und entscheidende Kunden, baust Netzwerke auf und entwickelst langfristige Geschäftsbeziehungen.

Kurz gesagt: Du verkaufst nicht einfach ein Produkt. Du entwickelst mit uns einen Markt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst unser Geschäft mit Stadtwerken und Industriekunden in Süddeutschland strategisch weiter.
  • Du identifizierst Marktpotenziale, Wachstumsfelder und neue Anwendungsbereiche für unsere Lösungen zur Abgasnachbehandlung.
  • Du identifizierst relevante Zielkunden und sprichst potenzielle Neukunden aktiv an.
  • Du gewinnst neue Kunden und entwickelst aus ersten Kontakten langfristige Geschäftsbeziehungen.
  • Du betreust ausgewählte Kunden als Key Accounts und entwickelst die Zusammenarbeit kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Du analysierst Kundenanforderungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren technischen Fachbereichen passende Lösungen.
  • Du begleitest Projekte vom ersten Kundenkontakt über die technische und kaufmännische Abstimmung bis zum Abschluss.
  • Du beobachtest Markt- und Kundenentwicklungen und bringst die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in unsere Vertriebsstrategie ein.
  • Du baust ein belastbares Netzwerk aus Kunden, Partnern und relevanten Marktteilnehmern auf.
  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Marketing geeignete Maßnahmen zur Marktbearbeitung und Geschäftsfeldentwicklung.
  • Du bringst deine Markterfahrung in unser Vertriebsteam ein und unterstützt den internen Wissenstransfer.

Das bringst du mit



Uns ist wichtiger, dass du Kunden und Märkte entwickeln kannst und unsere Technik verstehen möchtest, als ein vollkommen geradliniger Lebenslauf.

  • Du hast eine kaufmännische oder technische Ausbildung oder ein entsprechendes Studium abgeschlossen.
  • Du bringst idealerweise mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im technischen B2B-Vertrieb oder Vertriebsaußendienst mit.
  • Erfahrungen mit Stadtwerken, Energieversorgern, Industrieunternehmen oder öffentlichen Auftraggebern sind ein Plus.
  • Kenntnisse aus Energietechnik, Anlagenbau, Umwelttechnik, Abgasnachbehandlung oder verwandten technischen Märkten helfen dir beim Einstieg, sind aber kein Muss.
  • Du hast Spaß an Neukundenakquise und Geschäftsentwicklung und wartest nicht darauf, dass Anfragen von allein kommen.
  • Du verstehst technische und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und kannst sie für unterschiedliche Ansprechpartner verständlich übersetzen.
  • Du trittst sicher und verbindlich auf und bringst Verhandlungsgeschick sowie Abschlussstärke mit.
  • Du arbeitest eigenständig und kannst ein größeres Vertriebsgebiet zuverlässig organisieren.
  • Du gehst sicher mit CRM-Systemen und den gängigen Microsoft-Office-Anwendungen um.
  • Du besitzt einen Führerschein der Klasse B und bringst Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Süddeutschlands mit.


Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Bewirb dich trotzdem.

Vielleicht kennst du Stadtwerke und Industrie sehr gut, aber noch nicht die Abgasnachbehandlung. Oder du kommst aus einem technischen Bereich und möchtest den nächsten Schritt in Richtung Vertrieb und Business Development machen.

Wenn du Märkte verstehst, Kunden gewinnen kannst und Lust hast, dich in unsere Technologie einzuarbeiten, sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Dein Vertriebsgebiet



Du verantwortest schwerpunktmäßig die Marktbearbeitung in Süddeutschland.

Dabei bist du regelmäßig bei bestehenden und potenziellen Kunden vor Ort und baust dein Netzwerk in der Region kontinuierlich aus.

Gleichzeitig arbeitest du eng mit unserem Vertrieb, der Entwicklung und unseren technischen Fachbereichen zusammen.

Du erhältst damit Verantwortung für deine Region, ohne beim Kunden auf dich allein gestellt zu sein. Bei anspruchsvollen technischen Fragestellungen kannst du jederzeit auf das Know-how unserer Spezialisten zurückgreifen.

Das bieten wir dir



Natürlich soll nicht nur deine Arbeit zu uns passen, sondern Emission Partner auch zu deinem Leben.

Dienstwagen auch zur privaten Nutzung
Für deine Kundentermine bist du mobil ausgestattet und kannst deinen Firmenwagen auch privat nutzen.

30 Tage Urlaub
Zeit für Erholung, Familie und Freizeit.

Flexible Arbeitszeiten
Gerade im Außendienst zählt für uns eine eigenverantwortliche Organisation deines Arbeitsalltags.

600 € Gesundheitsbudget
Über unsere arbeitgeberfinanzierte betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung.

Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
Mit überdurchschnittlichem Arbeitgeberzuschuss.

E-Bike-Leasing
Für Alltag und Freizeit.

Jährliche Gehaltsanpassung
Mit wachsender Erfahrung und Kompetenz entwickelt sich auch dein Gehalt weiter.

Individuelle Weiterbildung
Wir unterstützen dich bei deiner fachlichen, vertrieblichen und persönlichen Entwicklung.

Markt gestalten statt nur verwalten
Du betreust nicht einfach ein bestehendes Kundenportfolio, sondern kannst Marktsegmente und Kundenbeziehungen aktiv weiterentwickeln.

Technischer Rückhalt
Bei komplexen Kundenprojekten stehen dir unsere Fachbereiche zur Seite. Du musst nicht allein jedes technische Detail beherrschen.

Team & Firmenevents
Auch im Außendienst bist du fester Bestandteil unseres Teams.

Arbeiten mit Sinn
Du bringst Technologien zur Emissionsminderung zu Stadtwerken und Industrieunternehmen, bei denen sie konkret zum Einsatz kommen können.

Klingt nach deinem Job?



Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Kein kompliziertes Anschreiben. Kein Bewerbungsmarathon.

Bewirb dich einfach online und erzähl uns kurz, wer du bist, welche Märkte und Kunden du kennst und was dich am technischen B2B-Vertrieb reizt.

Jetzt bewerben und Emission Partner werden.

Dein Job für sauberere Luft.
