title: Senior Full Stack Engineer | AI & Security
descriptionHtml:
Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Product & Platform) • Paris Office

  • Location: Paris (75002), 2 days remote per week

  • Company: Escape : Leading AI Cybersecurity

  • Compensation: €75–90k base + 0.05% BSPCE depending on seniority and scope

  • Total Engineering Team at Escape: 21 Engineers, 4 Technical Leads, 4 Squads

About Escape

Escape is offensive security for the teams that are 100x outnumbered. We build AI agents that find and exploit vulnerabilities in modern applications, APIs, and microservices: the way a real attacker would, but at the speed of a CI pipeline.

We're a Y Combinator W23 company. We just closed an $18M Series A in March 2026 led by Balderton Capital (with Uncorrelated Ventures, IRIS, and YC following on). Our customers and partners include Zoom, Schibsted, Wiz, Pandadoc, and a growing list of teams who've stopped pretending annual pen tests are enough. We're 40 people split between Paris and NYC, scaling to 80 in the next 12 months.

The product surface is real: ASM, business-logic-aware DAST, and AI Pentesting GA-ing this year. The competitive thesis is that LLMs collapsed the cost of offensive engineering by 1000x, and the companies that ship that capability into production first will own the next decade of the category. We're betting we're those companies.

About the Role

In AI, context is the moat. At Escape, the data model is the context: and a team of three owns it end to end.

Every Escape product (ASM, DAST, AI Pentesting) is built on top of one data model rich enough to represent an entire attack surface and everything our agents learn about it. That model is our moat, and this team owns it. You'll own the schema at the heart of the company and the last mile that delivers our offensive R&D to customers through the GraphQL API and the product UI. If it ships to a customer, it goes through your team.

This is not a CRUD SaaS role in security clothing. It's the highest-leverage seat in product engineering: small team, central surface, and a direct line from your commits to what a CISO sees. "Senior" here means you set technical direction, not just execute it.

What You'll Do

  • Own the data model that is the moat: Design and evolve the schema representing tens of thousands of assets, millions of findings, multi-identity context, and everything our AI accumulates across engagements. This compounds: get it right and the whole platform gets stronger.

  • Turn R&D into Product for customers: Turn the output of our offensive AI research into something teams actually use: through the Svelte frontend, the GraphQL API, integrations, and real-time data refresh. You're the bridge between technology and value.

  • Push PostgreSQL to its edge: Query optimization, index design, pagination, caching, low-latency search over millions of records. The platform is intensely data-driven and the standard playbook runs out fast. This is most of the job.

  • Build AI-native workflows: Guided triage, assisted remediation, signal extraction from noisy scan data. AI is woven through the product, not bolted on: you build the surfaces where it meets the user.

  • Drive architecture: Data modeling, system design, GraphQL schema. You decide how we build, not just what: with a real, un-gimmicky path to Tech Lead.

Our Tech Stack & Focus

Frontend: Svelte + TypeScript, GraphQL client Backend: Node.js, GraphQL (Yoga + Pothos), Prisma, PostgreSQL, Kafka Infra: AWS, GitLab CI, Grafana Adjacent deep tech: Python (AI/ML), Go (network tooling)

Perks & Benefits

  • 💸 Significant equity (Stock Options/BSPCE) – become a core stakeholder in Escape's journey

  • ❤️‍🩹 Top-tier health insurance with Alan

  • 🍕 Meal vouchers with Swile

  • 💪 EGYM Wellpass sport subscription

  • 📚 Continuous learning: budgets for books and online courses

  • 💻 Premium equipment to support your work

  • 🎁 Dedicated time for open-source projects

  • 🌍 Present at top international conferences (RSAC, BlackHat, DEFCON, BSides, APIDays)

About You

  • 5+ years building production web apps, genuinely strong on both frontend and backend

  • Deep TypeScript knowledge: you use the type system to its full potential, you don't just tolerate it

  • Proven experience designing (not just consuming) GraphQL schemas A real passion for product, craft, and design: you care how it feels, not only whether it works

  • Strong ownership: you fix the problem the moment you spot it Excellent communicator: able to explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineering stakeholders

Nice to have:

  • Svelte expertise Security / DevSecOps background Early-stage startup experience

Ready to own the moat of an AI-native security company? Apply now to join Escape and ship offensive security to the teams that need it most.

Horizon Trading Solutions (HTS) is hiring a Senior Group Accountant( F/M) to bring accounting processes in-house, strengthen compliance with international accounting standards and external reporting requirements, and implement new tools (systems of record / automation). This is a hands-on role with scope to shape how accounting works at HTS. You will combine day-to-day accounting ownership with ERP implementation and practical uses of AI. Full professional fluency in English is essential, as you will interact confidently with international stakeholders, global business partners, and external advisors across jurisdictions.

Missions

Accounting Operations

  • Take ownership of the accounting function’s internalization: map all activities currently handled by external accountants and execute a phased handover covering records, opening balances, responsibilities, controls and deadlines.
  • Deliver a significant improvement in the quality, accuracy and consistency of the accounting records, ensuring that transactions are properly supported, classified and reflected in the general ledger.
  • Strengthen monthly, quarterly and annual closing schedules, documented journal entries, analytical reviews and clear explanations of material movements and variances.
  • Establish rigorous balance-sheet reconciliations for all significant accounts, with documented support, timely investigation of discrepancies and disciplined clearance of aged or outstanding items.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the accounts and underlying business flows, enabling reliable financial analysis, early identification of accounting issues and clear communication of financial performance to management.
  • Improve accounting policies, documentation and internal controls in line with applicable accounting standards and external reporting requirements; coordinate statutory accounts, tax filings and audit requests with external advisors while retaining clear internal ownership.

ERP implementation

  • Lead a significant 12-month ERP implementation project that must be delivered from requirements definition through testing, data migration, go-live and stabilization, working closely with internal teams and implementation partners.
  • Define the chart of accounts, analytical dimensions, accounting rules and approval workflows; connect purchasing, billing and banking processes to the ledger.
  • Document workflows, train users and support adoption; prioritise improvements that reduce manual work, strengthen controls and shorten the close.

Artificial Intelligence (AI)

  • Identify, assess and pilot high-value AI applications across accounting, including invoice and document extraction, reconciliation support, anomaly detection, close assistance, cash-flow analysis and first drafts of variance commentary.
  • Build controlled AI workflows using approved tools that protect confidential data; validate outputs against source records and retain clear human accountability for accounting judgments, journal entries, approvals and payments.
  • Define success measures for each use case and turn successful pilots into documented, scalable workflows that colleagues can use consistently.

What you bring

  • A degree in accounting, or an equivalent professional qualification, and at least five years of relevant accounting experience.
  • Hands-on ownership of general ledger accounting and month-end and year-end closes, with strong reconciliation skills and a sound command of international accounting standards and cross-border reporting requirements.

  • Strong Excel skills and confidence working with accounting data. Experience with reporting tools, data integrations or workflow automation is a plus.
  • A structured, detail-oriented approach, with the autonomy to take work through to completion and the ability to prioritise operational deadlines alongside improvement projects.
  • Full professional fluency in English and French, with clear communication and a collaborative mindset: you can explain accounting issues to non-specialists and collaborate effectively with international stakeholders, colleagues, advisors and system partners in France and in our other entities.

Why join us ?

title: Senior High-Voltage Electrical Design Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

As Senior High-Voltage Electrical Design Engineer (all genders) you will lead the electrical design of the battery packs, power distribution units (PDUs), and junction box of the propulsion battery system for VÆRIDION's CS-23 all-electric aircraft. You will own everything electrical on and within these units, from cell interconnections and busbars to protection and safety devices, internal HV and LV wiring, and the HV power and LV communication connector interfaces. Through electrical modelling and analysis, you will close the design before it moves to test and provide the engineering evidence that the propulsion battery system is electrically safe, robust, and certifiable.

Within the Airborne Electronics team, you will collaborate with Electronic Hardware Design and Power Electronics, and work closely with the Electrical Systems Architect and the HV Electrical Systems, Mechanical Design & Integration, Thermal Systems, Cell Technology, Safety, and Certification teams to ensure that the design of each unit is fully aligned with the propulsion battery system and the aircraft electrical system. Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION's mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead the electrical/electrothermal design of HV equipment for an 800 V class propulsion battery system, covering topology, segregation, protection, isolation, precharge, and safe disconnection within each unit.

  • Align the electrical design of each unit with the propulsion battery system and the aircraft electrical system, working closely with the HV Electrical Systems team and the Electrical Systems Architect.

  • Design cell interconnections and busbars as well as develop the cell connection system together with the Mechanical Design & Integration team.

  • Specify and select protection and safety devices, including contactors, fuses, pyrofuses, precharge components, current sensors, manual service disconnects, and the HV interlock loop, working with Airborne Electronics colleagues where solid-state power controllers (SSPCs) are used.

  • Define the HV power and LV communication connector interfaces of each unit together with the HV Electrical Systems team.

  • Lead or support component specification, selection, and supplier engagement depending on the component, together with the responsible teams.

  • Develop or assist with electrical models of the full battery pack to close the design before testing, and support propulsion battery system modeling of performance and failure cases together with the HV Electrical Systems team.

  • Perform electrical/electrothermal analyses, including short-circuit and fault current, protection coordination, insulation coordination, creepage and clearance, partial discharge at altitude, voltage drop, and Joule losses as input to the Thermal Systems team.

  • Own the grounding, bonding, shielding, and EMC design within each unit.

  • Define the physical layout and routing of electrical components together with the Mechanical Design & Integration team.

  • Perform safety analyses such as FMEA for each unit or support the Safety team in system-level safety assessments.

  • Draft test requirements (TRQs) for electrical verification, independently or together with the respective teams as required.

  • Create and maintain schematics, wiring diagrams, requirements, and interface definitions under configuration control, and contribute to design reviews and certification evidence.

 

Your Profile:

  • Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in HV electrical design, preferably in aerospace or automotive battery systems, or other safety-critical industries.

  • Proven experience in the electrical design of HV battery packs, power distribution units, or junction boxes.

  • Strong understanding of HV DC distribution and protection, including contactors, fuses, pyrofuses, precharge circuits, insulation monitoring, HV interlock, and fault coordination.

  • Experience designing busbars and cell interconnections, including current-carrying capacity, thermal derating, and short-circuit withstand.

  • Experience with insulation coordination, creepage and clearance, and partial discharge, ideally for equipment operating at altitude.

  • Proficiency with electrical modeling and analysis tools such as MATLAB/Simulink, Simscape Electrical, PLECS, or equivalent.

  • Proficiency with ECAD tools such as Zuken E3.series, Siemens Capital, EPLAN, SolidWorks Electrical, or equivalent.

  • Experience with grounding, bonding, shielding, and EMC design.

  • Experience writing requirements and test requirements, and correlating analysis results with test data.

  • Experience with safety analyses such as FMEA, FTA, and FHA is desirable.

  • Experience with electronics or PCB design, including flex PCBs, is beneficial.

  • Working proficiency with 3D CAD, such as CATIA, SolidWorks, or Siemens NX, is beneficial.

  • Familiarity with CS-23, DO-160, DO-311A, DO-254, ARP4754A/B, ARP4761/4761A, and IEC 60664-1 is beneficial.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, technical curiosity, and attention to detail.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. German is a plus.

  • Passionate about aviation and the electrification of flight.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

title: Senior Influencer Manager
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

The Airbnb Communications team drives earned visibility and cultural relevance for the brand, delivering campaigns that support direct traffic, brand love and positive conversation. Our influencer function sits at the intersection of culture, content and community — leading social-first campaigns that inspire travel on Airbnb and strengthen its long-term reputation.

The Difference You Will Make

We're looking for a Senior Influencer Manager to lead Airbnb's influencer programme in theUK, localising regional priorities and delivering campaigns that connect the brand to culturally relevant conversations.

The role covers our full influencer remit: earned and organic creator partnerships, and influencer work running through paid media. You'll own campaigns end to end — creator sourcing, briefing, contracting, measurement and reporting — and help position influencers as both a commercial lever and a long-term driver of brand health, while collaborating with agency partners.

Sitting in the UK Communications team, you'll build influencer into campaign narratives from inception, and partner with Brand Marketing and Paid Media so creator content is designed for amplification from the outset, with usage rights, whitelisting and dark posting permissions secured up front.

This is a hands-on role for someone who knows how to turn brand objectives into content that is authentic, thumb-stopping and earns attention rather than interrupting it.

A Typical Day

  • Own and scale Airbnb's influencer programme in the UK against local, regional and global priorities — timelines, creative execution and performance
  • Deliver across earned, organic and paid influencer work, partnering with the regional Influencer Lead and the UK Brand Marketing and Paid Media teams on creator selection, briefing for amplification, permissions and asset delivery
  • Build influencer into the core campaign narrative and press strategy from inception, with the UK Communications team
  • Identify, vet and build relationships with creators across Instagram, TikTok and YouTube — emerging talent through to established partners — with inclusive, culturally relevant casting
  • Write clear, strategic briefs covering objectives, key messages and content guidelines, and lead onboarding and content reviews against brand standards
  • Partner with legal and agency teams on contracts: deliverables, usage rights, paid media, exclusivity and payment
  • Stay plugged into culture, consumer and media trends — particularly Gen Z — bringing forward creator ideas and campaign hooks, and moving fast on reactive opportunities
  • Manage logistics for influencer stays and experiences, including vetting, Host coordination and credit approvals
  • Track performance across commercial and brand health metrics using CreatorIQ,Sprinklr and Airtable, optimising with the agency and reporting to the regional team
  • Align plans with local Marketing, Partnerships, Affiliate and Growth teams and the global influencer team to avoid duplicated effort
  • Lead day-to-day communication and program operations with our respective UK Influencer agency partners 
  • Identify opportunities with key opinion formers — policy, cultural and news influencers, and third-party validators — for reputation campaigns

Your Expertise

  • 8+ years in communications, influencer marketing, talent partnerships or social-first content strategy
  • Deep knowledge of the UK creator landscape and strong instincts on what resonates and why, across a diverse audience
  • A communications mindset: a track record of building creator partnerships into integrated campaigns, connected to the earned, social and reputation storytelling around them
  • End-to-end campaign experience across organic and paid environments — sourcing, briefing for amplification, dark posting, usage rights, contracting and performance analysis
  • Confident negotiating with creators and managing external agencies and stakeholders across legal, marketing and comms
  • Strong writing, particularly briefs and content feedback
  • Familiarity with influencer tools (CreatorIQ, Sprinklr or similar tooling platforms) and reporting that quantifies brand health and sentiment, not just reach and engagement
  • Able to run multiple campaigns and creators at once with high attention to detail
  • Belief in influencer as a driver of long-term brand equity, not just short-term performance

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

United Kingdom Annual Pay Range£72,000—£90,000 GBP

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Senior Integrated Marketing Manager (Global Campaigns)
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it's a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand.

We're looking for a Senior Marketing Manager, Brand Integrated Marketing to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you'll help us take ideas from global strategy through to local activation across markets, delivering integrated campaigns that drive measurable business growth.

You'll be joining the Integrated Marketing team. We own the Deliveroo brand globally and lead our biggest campaign moments. Working in a cross-functional squad alongside strategic teams, functional leads, and local markets, we turn big ideas into high-impact campaigns across our markets.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Global Campaign Ownership: Lead high-profile global marketing programmes and integrated campaigns from global strategy through to local market execution.

  • Framework & Playbook Development: Design, scale, and maintain measurement frameworks, playbooks, and systems that enable global and local teams to execute best-in-class brand campaigns.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with cross-functional squads, strategic teams, functional leads, and local market leads to align campaign strategies with core business goals.

  • Stakeholder Management: Influence senior stakeholders across the global organisation without direct authority, ensuring alignment on messaging, execution, and performance metrics.

  • Strategic Optimisation: Balance tactical execution with a longer-term strategic perspective to solve complex marketing briefs and continuously optimize brand performance.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Integrated Brand Leadership: Proven experience leading end-to-end global integrated marketing campaigns from initial strategy through to local market activation.

  • Framework Development: Strong track record in establishing measurement frameworks, campaign playbooks, and operational systems that scale across multiple regions.

  • Stakeholder Influence: Demonstrated ability to influence and align senior cross-functional stakeholders and matrix teams without direct line management authority.

  • Strategic & Tactical Execution: Proven ability to operate independently on complex or ambiguous briefs, balancing day-to-day execution with longer-term brand strategy.

  • Commercial Acumen: Strong expertise in linking brand initiatives and marketing campaigns directly to measurable business growth and commercial impact.

Nice to Have

  • Experience navigating three-sided marketplace dynamics or fast-paced consumer tech environments.

  • Background working across international or multi-market structures.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

We are building next-generation interceptor drones and are looking for a Senior Jet Engine Design Engineer to lead the development of small-scale jet propulsion systems (12–25 kg thrust class), from concept to flight-ready hardware. descriptionHtml:

Your Mission

As our Senior Product & AI Counsel, you’ll own the legal side of our product and AI proposition, working with us about one day a week on a retainer basis. It’s a new role. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering and leadership to make sure what we build and ship holds up under the EU AI Act, cybersecurity law, digital accessibility rules and GDPR.

Your Job

  • Act as our product counsel: join product syncs, review features before they’re built, and flag legal and compliance questions early.

  • Senior and independent: you make calls and own them, without someone steering you.

Your Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience as product counsel for software, ideally including AI products.

  • Deep working knowledge of the EU AI Act and how it applies to AI propositions in practice.

  • Experience with cybersecurity law (NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act) and digital accessibility rules (European Accessibility Act).

title: Senior Lifecycle Manager
descriptionHtml:

Synthesia is growing fast, and lifecycle is how we turn that growth into lasting customer relationships, guiding every user from first signup to real value. Every month we send 150+ emails to 1+ million contacts, and as we launch new products and enter new markets, that scale and its impact on revenue will keep rising.

You’ll own the product-led growth motion after signup: the journeys that turn new users into activated, paying and expanding customers.   • You’re analytical and curious: You use data to understand performance, challenge assumptions and continuously improve what you build

  • You take ownership: You’re comfortable independently leading initiatives from concept through execution, proactively solving problems and making informed decisions

We’d be particularly excited if

  • 6+ years of experience in lifecycle, CRM or email marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS or product-led companies

Nice to have

Required Qualifications

  • Eight or more years of progressively responsible industrial, government, defence, intelligence, or corporate security experience, including ownership of a UK defence-security programme.

  • Practical experience with FSC or IPSA readiness and assurance, UKSV sponsorship, NSVS administration, SC or DV aftercare, and government inspection activity.

  • Experience establishing or operating secure facilities and controls for classified information, systems, material, visitors, and international engagements.

  • Strong leadership, judgement, discretion, writing, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate requirements into practical processes in a fast-paced technology environment.

  • British nationality, or qualifying dual nationality including British nationality, subject to government restrictions for designated security-controller duties.

  • Current SC or DV clearance, or the ability to obtain and maintain the required level, plus legal authorisation to work in the United Kingdom.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Current SC or DV clearance and prior appointment as a Facility Security Controller or Personnel Security Controller for an FSC- or IPSA-assured supplier.

  • Experience standing up a security programme or secure facility and supporting multinational defence, NATO, allied, or AUKUS-related work.

  • Relevant degree, professional certification, or recognised security-body membership; working knowledge of U.S. industrial security and export-control requirements is advantageous.

title: Senior Medewerker Financiële Administratie
descriptionHtml:
GGZ inGeest zoekt een senior medewerker Financiële Administratie in Amsterdam.

Als senior medewerker Financiële Administratie ben je verantwoordelijk voor een zorgvuldige uitvoering en bewaking van diverse financiële administratieve processen. Je speelt een belangrijke rol in het waarborgen van de juistheid, volledigheid en tijdigheid van de financiële administratie. Naast de uitvoering van de dagelijkse werkzaamheden analyseer je financiële gegevens, onderzoek je afwijkingen en signaleer je mogelijkheden om processen te optimaliseren. Met jouw expertise draag je bij aan een betrouwbare financiële bedrijfsvoering en een adequate ondersteuning van de organisatie.


Waar ga je werken?

  • De afdeling Financiële Administratie bestaat uit 10 enthousiaste medewerkers, inclusief de manager Financiële Administratie, en maakt onderdeel uit van de Directie Financiën.

  • De afdeling is verantwoordelijk voor de controle op en de tijdige, juiste en volledige verwerking van financiële gegevens in het financiële systeem.

  • Vanuit jouw financiële expertise ondersteun je de organisatie bij administratieve en financiële vraagstukken. Hiermee ontlast je behandelaren en andere zorgprofessionals, zodat zij zich kunnen richten op hun primaire werkzaamheden.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering en bewaking van de debiteurenadministratie. Hieronder vallen onder andere het verzorgen van facturatie, het controleren van openstaande posten, het versturen van aanmaningen en het bewaken van de volledigheid van de facturatie.

  • Je controleert financiële gegevens in AFAS en voert, indien nodig, correcties door.

  • Je stelt financiële informatie beschikbaar voor interne rapportages en levert een bijdrage aan periodieke afsluitingen en aansluitingen met het grootboek.

  • Je analyseert de financiële en projectadministratie, signaleert onvolkomenheden en doet voorstellen ter verbetering van de administratieve processen.

  • Je voert de financiële administratie van samenwerkingsprojecten in het kader van het Integraal Zorgakkoord (IZA) en van subsidieprojecten.

  • Je analyseert verschillen tussen administratieve gegevens en gerealiseerde resultaten en draagt zorg voor een adequate opvolging.

  • Je fungeert als inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor financiële vraagstukken met betrekking tot debiteuren, IZA-samenwerkingsprojecten en subsidieprojecten.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in de richting van financiële administratie, Finance & Control of een vergelijkbare studierichting.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met debiteurenadministratie en projectadministratie.

  • Een proactieve instelling en affiniteit met het optimaliseren van financiële administratieve processen.

title: Senior ML Ops Engineer (Experiences)
descriptionHtml:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Tripadvisor Experiences Engineering is the team that builds and supports the world's leading marketplace for travel experiences. We believe that making memories is what travel is all about. And with 400,000+ travel experiences to explore—everything from simple tours to extreme adventures (and everything in between) —making memories that will last a lifetime has never been easier.

Our Internal Systems pillar is at the forefront of transforming how we harness AI, Machine Learning and Data Science to drive innovation and growth. To address the increasing traffic and deliver a cutting-edge platform, the team is in search of a MLOps Engineer to join and support Tripadvisor’s growth.

We are looking for an intermediate level MLOps Engineer to join the team. If you're passionate about creating ML/AI Platforms that empower teams to enhance customer experiences, we’d love to have you on board! 

This is a hybrid role based in London, opened for all the candidates who are already based in London or max 1,5h away. (relaxed hybrid, 2x per month)


What you'll do:

  • Empowering Data Science and ML stakeholders, by providing the tools and support the infrastructure necessary for seamless execution of machine learning and AI processes.
  • Support tech stack evolution by developing across our existing technology stack running in  AWS cloud, leveraging and adopting the latest solutions available in that environment.
  • Build and maintain a robust and scalable infrastructure to support pre-computed, batch and real-time model needs, ensuring smooth deployment and reducing time-to-market of machine learning models.
  • Take responsibility for all aspects of software engineering, from design to implementation, QA, and maintenance.
  • Monitor and support ML pipelines for accuracy, drifts, enhancements, changes, SLA, and billing volumes to ensure all models are processed accurately and when needed.
  • Foster a culture of innovation by generating and promoting new ideas within the MLOps domain.
  • Work with cross-functional stakeholders in defining and documenting requirements for building high-quality and impactful ML/AI products.


What you'll need:

  • 4+ years of MLOps experience, participating in building modern ML infrastructure catering to all stages of a model lifecycle.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS and/or GCP, demonstrating proficiency in leveraging cloud services for scalable and reliable MLOps solutions.
  • Demonstrable experience of IaC (Infrastructure-as-code) tools like Terraform or CloudFormation in a production environment.
  • Previous exposure to additional technologies like Seldon, KServe, RayServe, Kubernetes, MLFlow, Sagemaker, Kubeflow, Anyscale, Valohai, ArgoCD, Docker, Python, Java, Ray, Spark, Pandas, Argo Workflow, Postgres, Snowflake and BigQuery is highly desirable.
  • Good to have: previous knowledge managing complementary DBs like vector and/or graph DBs
  • Good to have: Hands-on experience in model optimization with experience in handling high throughput and low latency applications with an eye on cost.
  • Good to have: Experience with LLMOps leveraging open source models
  • Ability to develop across a diverse technology stack and willingness and ability to take on new technologies.
  • Demonstrated experience participating in cross-functional teams in fast-paced environments.
  • Experience with CI/CD processes and platforms.
  • Ability to effectively operate both independently and as part of a team.
  • Sense of ownership, urgency and pride in your work. Experience being a lead engineer / SME on multiple projects
  • High-quality verbal and written communication skills.

Perks of Working at Viator

  • Competitive compensation packages, including base salary, annual bonus, and equity.
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. We take a remote-friendly approach to collaboration, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like in select locations. 
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.

Our Values

We aspire to lead; We’re relentlessly curious;... want to know more? Read up on our values: 

  • We aspire to lead. Tap into your talent, ambition, and knowledge to bring us – and you – to new heights.
  • We’re relentlessly curious. We push beyond the usual, the known, the “that’s just how it’s done.”
  • We’re better together. We learn from, accept, respect, support, and value one another– and are creating something remarkable in the process.
  • We serve our customers, always. We listen, question, respond, and strive for wow moments. 
  • We strive for better, not perfect. We won’t get it right the first time – or every time. We’ll provide a safe environment in which to make mistakes, iterate, improve, and grow.
  • Our workplace is for everyone, as is our people powered platform. At Tripadvisor, we want you to bring your unique identities, abilities, and experiences, so we can collectively revolutionize travel and together find the good out there.

title: Senior National Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
The Practical Detail
Location: Hybrid | Remote

Why this role matters
In your first year, you will deliver an ambitious growth plan for Flora Food Group's largest customer, Bidfood, driving both sales and margin across the full P&L. This role is critical to strengthening Flora's position in the food service market by embedding a joint business plan that aligns Flora's brand priorities with Bidfood's commercial strategy. You will shape how our brands are listed, promoted, and grow within a key account that influences menus and food trends across the UK. Your work will directly impact the availability and innovation of better food in kitchens nationwide.

What you'll do

  • Own the Bidfood P&L, managing pricing, promotions, trade spend, and trade promotion management accruals to achieve sales and margin growth.
  • Lead the joint business plan and negotiate annual trading terms to ensure Flora's brands are well positioned and invested in.
  • Build and maintain relationships across all levels of Bidfood, from senior buyers to depot and logistics teams, to improve service and unlock commercial opportunities.
  • Deliver new product development and innovation launches on time and at the right price, collaborating closely with culinary and new business teams.
  • Champion the push-pull strategy by engaging Bidfood's end users—contract caterers, pubs, hotels, restaurants and Quick Serve Restaurants (QSR) — to grow brand presence and volume.

Performance
You will own the full P&L for the Bidfood account, driving measurable growth in sales and margin while managing trade spend within budget. Your leadership of the joint business plan will ensure alignment between Flora's brand ambitions and Bidfood's commercial goals. Success will be seen in improved brand listings, timely innovation launches, and strong trading terms that support sustainable growth.

Care
You will report directly to Helen Scott and collaborate with internal teams including new business, culinary, supply chain, and demand planning to ensure seamless service delivery. Externally, you will engage with multiple Bidfood functions such as buying, logistics, marketing, and category teams. Your decisions will balance commercial ambition with operational integrity, supporting a lean team environment during a period of organisational change.

Passion
Bidfood is at the heart of food service trends, where culinary culture is shaped. You will connect Flora's innovation pipeline directly to the chefs and kitchens that bring our products to life. Your role will influence how plant-based, indulgent, and culinary food categories evolve in the out-of-home market. Your curiosity about taste, nutrition, and functionality will drive meaningful innovation and brand growth.

About you
You'll bring solid food service experience, ideally managing Bidfood, Brakes, or Booker accounts, with a deep understanding of this route to market. You are commercially rigorous, confident in owning a P&L, and skilled at negotiating assertively while maintaining productive relationships. You sell on brand value, not price, and thrive in a fast-changing, lean environment. Your resilience and solution-oriented mindset help you navigate complex commercial and cultural challenges. You are genuinely interested in food culture and curious about how consumer behaviour and future food trends shape innovation. You understand that strong brands are built by anticipating what's next in taste, nutrition, and functionality, and by translating insight into meaningful consumer experiences.

Where this could lead to
This role typically leads to broader commercial leadership opportunities within Flora Food Group, including potential European roles as the business integrates into a larger unit. There is also scope to move into retail or new business functions. With success, you may take on direct reports and progress into senior management positions within 2 to 3 years.

What's next
If this opportunity sounds exciting, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply before: 31-Oct-2026

title: Senior National Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide. From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.

 

We’re looking for a Senior National Account Manager to join our UKI team. In this role, you’ll manage the daily relationship with a portfolio of our largest restaurant partners, using data-driven insights to grow their sales and help them achieve operational excellence.

 

Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

 

What You’ll Be Doing

 

You’ll be joining the National Accounts team. Working with partners of this scale means you will often tackle challenges that Deliveroo is facing for the first time, directly shaping the future of how we collaborate with the world's largest food brands.

 

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

 

  • Strategic Relationship Management: Act as the primary consultant for a portfolio of major restaurant partners, managing weekly operational meetings and high-level performance reviews.

  • Data-Driven Insight: Monitor and analyse partner-specific goals, creating compelling narratives from complex data to show partners where and how they can improve.

  • Consultative Growth: Increase revenue and health metrics by advising partners on best practices for selection, pricing, and service levels.

  • Operational Training: Deliver in-person training sessions for key partners covering operational best practices, Deliveroo insights, and on-site troubleshooting.

  • Regional Collaboration: Partner with regional Commercial Managers to identify and prioritise growth opportunities across specific UK zones.

  • Marketing Integration: Work with restaurant marketing counterparts to design and deliver campaigns that create long-term value for both the partner and Deliveroo.

  • Cross-Functional Advocacy: Identify opportunities to deepen relationships by involving and working with Deliveroo’s Marketing, Operations, and Product teams.

 

What You’ll Need to Thrive

 

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

 

  • Partnership Expertise: Proven experience in account management or a strategic partnerships role, ideally within a high-growth technology or marketplace environment.

  • Analytical Rigour: The ability to manage large datasets and translate them into clear, applicable insights that drive business decisions.

  • Communication & Influence: Effective relationship-building skills with the ability to communicate and present confidently to senior stakeholders.

  • Operational Agility: A proactive approach to problem-solving and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced setting.

  • Collaborative Mindset: A team player who can work across functions to deliver complex, multi-layered projects.

     

Why Join Us?

 

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

 

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Senior netwerk infrastructuur engineer
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij, met inzet van moderne technieken, zorg dragen voor het fysieke en virtuele netwerk van het CBS en hiermee de beschikbaarheid en betrouwbaarheid maximaliseren? Heb je daarnaast affiniteit met het automatiseren van beheer en hersteltaken? Dan biedt het CBS jou een unieke kans!

Waar jij het verschil maakt

  • Je levert en ontwikkelt diensten op basis van virtuele netwerktechnieken en beheert en onderhoudt deze;

  • Je zorgt voor de continuïteit van het CBS door het fysieke netwerk te onderhouden, te ontwikkelen en te beheren, zowel in het datacenter als op kantoorlocaties.

  • Je werkt aan de bescherming van onze omgeving middels beheer van firewalls, microsegmentatie, proxy servers en application delivery controllers;

  • Je werkt aan het maximaal automatiseren van beheertaken en het bieden van autonomie aan afnemende teams

  • Je hebt affiniteit met het aanbieden van infrastructuurdiensten als selfservice en door middel van ‘Infrastructure-as-Code’.

Je toekomstige collega's

Je werkt in het Team IaaS van de afdeling Generieke Infrastructuur (IGI). We opereren middels een Agile methodiek, in combinatie met ITIL. Een actieve bijdrage wordt verwacht in het succes van deze werkmethode, dit uit zich oa in het opstellen van kwalitatief goede story’s en Epics, het actueel houden van jouw story’s op het Azure DevOps bord, actieve en constructieve deelname aan events als dag-starts, planning, review en retrospectives.
De totale omvang van de afdeling Generieke Infrastructuur is ongeveer 30 experts die werkzaam zijn in Heerlen en Den Haag. Het IaaS Team bestaat uit ca 15 collega’s die in Heerlen en Den Haag werkzaam zijn. Plezier in het werk vinden we belangrijk en dat is dan ook verankerd in onze kernwaarden.

Dit ben jij

Je bent gericht op het continu verbeteren: je signaleert, adviseert, voert uit, reflecteert en pakt de regie en verantwoordelijkheid, zo zien we je graag.

Daarnaast verwachten wij dat je:

  • Aantoonbare ervaring hebt op het gebied van het beheer van complexe netwerken

  • Informatieveiligheid altijd on top of mind hebt,

  • Ruime ervaring hebt met het automatiseren van infrastructuurdienstverlening.

  • Kennis en ervaring hebt met netwerkvirtualisatie ingezet ten behoeve van selfservice.

  • Bedreven bent met het werken op een iteratieve wijze, waarbij producten worden afgestemd op de klantvraag,

  • Je kunt verplaatsen in gebruikers van onze IT-diensten en vanuit dat perspectief probleemoplossend te werk gaan.

  • Ben je ervaren met Terraform/Ansible en DevOps pipelines om infrastructuurdiensten als code beschikbaar te stellen? Dan maken we graag gebruik van die kennis en ervaring.

Feitelijk goed geregeld

Voor onze arbeidsvoorwaarden volgen wij de CAO Rijk. Dat betekent dat je onder andere kunt rekenen op het volgende:

title: Senior Nuclear Theorist - Few-Body Physics (gn) @ Fusion Energy Venture, Munich
descriptionHtml:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

Snap Fusion develops a fundamentally new approach to controlled fusion energy.

We are a small team of physicists and engineers. The work is early, the questions are real, and the standard is high. Our findings feed into research in fusion energy, scientific discovery, advanced simulation, AI for Physics and quantum technologies.

Some problems are too important not to solve.

Your mission
Lead the nuclear theory behind a new approach to fusion energy.

At Snap Fusion, we are pursuing a bold mission: developing a fundamentally new approach to controlled fusion energy.

Parts of our roadmap rest on questions of low-energy nuclear physics. Some of these have clear answers in the literature; others turn out, on close reading, to be less settled than they first appear. Knowing which is which matters to us, because it shapes what we build and what we test.

We are therefore establishing an in-house nuclear theory effort, and we are looking for a senior few-body theorist to lead it. Your job will be to decide which of our questions current theory can actually answer, to answer those at a standard that would hold up to expert review, and to say plainly where the uncertainties lie.

This is an unusual setting for a theorist, in a good way: the questions are concrete, the team is small, and your conclusions will be acted on.

What you will do

You will work directly with the founders as theory lead. Your responsibilities may include:

• Leading theory projects from problem definition to a clear recommendation

• Judging which questions current nuclear theory can answer, and with what uncertainty

• Carrying out and supervising few-body scattering and reaction calculations

• Setting the benchmarks and cross-checks against which results are accepted

• Working with our computational physics lead on the numerical implementation of the methods you specify

• Reviewing theoretical and experimental claims that bear on our roadmap

• Building collaborations with academic groups, including for independent confirmation of key results

• Helping the rest of the team understand the physics behind your conclusions

Your assessments will directly inform Snap Fusion's technology roadmap.

What we’re looking for

You will probably hold a PhD in theoretical nuclear physics or a closely related field, with research experience beyond it. Ideal candidates will have strong experience in several of the following areas:

Nuclear theory

• Quantum scattering and reaction theory

• Few-body or ab initio methods

• Realistic nuclear interactions

• Resonances, thresholds, and continuum physics

• Low-energy charged-particle reactions

• Fusion cross sections and astrophysical S-factors

Scientific leadership. You should be comfortable:

• Running a research program with milestones and honest go/no-go decisions

• Saying that a question cannot be answered with current theory, when it cannot

• Writing clearly for readers who are not few-body specialists

• Reviewing other people's derivations, and having your own reviewed

Like most few-body theorists, you will have done a good deal of numerical work, and that experience will be valuable here. But this is a physics role first: we have a computational physics lead, and implementation is a collaboration rather than the core of your job.

Industry experience is not required.

Bonus Points

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

• Light-nuclei reaction calculations

• R-matrix or related continuum methods

• Nuclear astrophysics

• Benchmark comparisons between methods or codes

• Close collaboration with experimentalists

• Refereeing and reviewing

• Teaching or mentoring

Who thrives here?

You may be a great fit if:

• You like physics questions with practical consequences

• You would rather establish a modest result firmly than a striking one loosely

• You are comfortable saying “we don't know yet” and explaining why

• You enjoy making difficult material clear to colleagues from other fields

• You want to see your work used

This role suits someone who wants to keep doing serious theory while seeing it put to use.

Why join Snap Fusion?

The questions you settle will feed into research in:

• Fusion energy

• Scientific discovery

• Advanced simulation

• AI for Physics

• Quantum technologies

You will work alongside physicists and engineers on problems where careful theory has direct consequences. The work is early, the questions are real, and the standard is high.

title: Senior Product Analyst, Driver Supply
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Delivery companies have always bought capacity by guesswork. Book too few drivers and parcels wait; book too many and you pay for empty vans. Most carriers accept that waste as the price of being reliable. Relay is building a marketplace where it isn't. You can't schedule drivers. You can only design what's on offer, and measure what happens.

Every part of our network runs on decisions. The next two years are about building the systems that make them well, and proving they do. Engineering and operational research build what you design.

Marketplace Highlights

  • You own decision-making, not the model: you decide what Marketplace changes on booking, matching and shifts, and recommend on pay. Our scientists' models and experiments feed your calls, and the squad lead acts on them.

  • Drivers choose when to work. What makes a shift worth booking early, and how do you prove what works when a clean experiment isn't possible?

  • Every booked shift is paid, used or not, and every unserved route means late parcels. Where should each area sit between the two, and what would let the network get there on its own?

  • Local shops hold our parcels while running their own businesses. Where does the network need more of them, what should a shop be paid, and how would you see a closed shop coming?

  • A whole area, not a slice: no playbook, and the result is on the street the next morning.

  • Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Product Analyst, Driver Supply at Relay, you'll:

  • Decide which Marketplace problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

  • Design how Marketplace decides: which signals count, and what good looks like for booking, matching and pay.

  • Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

  • Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

  • Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

title: Senior Product Designer, Boltz Lab
descriptionHtml:
About Boltz

Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible.

Boltz began as an MIT spin-out. Our founders built Boltz-1 at MIT, and it became the first fully open-source model to match AlphaFold 3's accuracy in predicting the 3D structure of biomolecular complexes.

We focus on two things:

  • Open foundation models. Boltz-1, Boltz-2, and BoltzGen are open models trusted by 100,000+ scientists across biotech and academia, and used in programs at every Top 20 pharma as well as leading agrichemical and industrial research organizations.

  • Boltz Lab. Our commercial platform runs our latest models and design agents as reliable, production-grade tools built around real chemistry and biology workflows. Teams start from a target and a hypothesis, then generate, evaluate, and rank candidate molecules, while we provide the compute, infrastructure, and collaboration layer so their scientists can move faster.

The two feed each other: open-source adoption earns scientific credibility and community insight, and Boltz Lab turns that into real impact on our partners' discovery programs.

You can read more about our mission, research and product vision in our manifesto.

About the role

As Product Designer for Boltz Lab, you will own how scientists experience, trust and use our AI for molecular modeling and drug discovery. Our models are powerful but complex; design is what makes them usable, and trustworthy, for researchers who aren't ML experts.

You will work closely with Product engineering, ML Research and our chemistry and biology experts to turn user needs into clear concepts, interaction patterns and end-to-end workflows.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys technically deep products, cares about craft and usability, and wants to build tools that expand what scientists can do.

What you'll do

  • Own Boltz Lab's design end to end, from discovery and user research through prototyping, visual design and engineering handoff.

  • Define the product's information architecture, interaction model and visual language, and keep them consistent as it grows.

  • Design interfaces for exploring data, configuring models, interpreting results and iterating on experiments.

  • Make ML outputs interpretable and actionable, so users can judge when to trust a result.

  • Run research and usability testing with expert users, and feed what you learn back into the product and roadmap.

About you

Minimum Requirements

  • 6+ year of experience designing complex, data-rich products for technical or expert users.

  • Excellent interaction design, information architecture and visual design, with strong prototyping in modern tools (e.g. Figma).

  • Ability to turn abstract or highly technical concepts into intuitive, well-structured experiences.

  • A track record of owning product design end to end, from discovery to shipped product.

  • Close collaboration with engineers and researchers, and clear communication of design decisions and trade-offs.

Preferred Requirements

  • Basic understanding of biology, chemistry, drug discovery or ML workflows.

  • Experience designing for scientific, research or developer tools, or owning design direction at an early-stage startup.

  • Experience using Boltz models, or usability testing with expert users.

We know great people don't always tick every box. If this role excites you and you meet most of the minimum requirements, we'd like to hear from you.

What we offer

  • Ownership of the design of Boltz Lab, used by leading discovery teams.

  • Work alongside one of the most talent-dense teams in the field.

  • Significant ownership and independence, with responsibility for driving projects from concept to deployment.

  • Highly competitive salary with meaningful equity in a public benefit company.

How we hire

  2. Portfolio presentation

  3. Onsite in London or virtual onsite with the team

  4. Offer + Onboarding

Our commitment

Boltz is committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If you need any adjustments during the hiring process, tell us and we'll make it work.

You combine sharp user insight, craft, and pragmatism to deliver experiences that are elegant, usable, and built to scale.

One week you might be running user interviews to shape a new feature; the next, refining our design system or designing a marketing landing page. You will work closely with CXOs, product owners, engineers and data scientists to co-own the product vision and help them craft the path forward. Within the team, you will drive ambiguity towards real, valuable outcomes through design.

You will own and shape the product direction, challenge weak assumptions and stay close to implementation. You will leverage your collective experience as a design practitioner in this entire journey for driving impact on the client side. You will craft ‘new ways of working‘ from a design perspective with the influx of AI.

We are not looking for someone whose primary focus is making requirements turned into artefacts, make things look polished or pixel-perfect.

The Expectation

You're comfortable across the full design lifecycle, but you're exceptional at the parts that make it land: sharp problem framing, design that ships, and AI-accelerated craft.

Consulting with Delivery in mind: Challenging the ask and ideating intervention that matters, and seeing them through.

  • Turn ambiguous client asks into well-framed problems, prioritised opportunities and practical delivery plans.
  • Challenge assumptions, agreed scope and propose solutions constructively, using evidence and arguments to help clients choose the new scope 
  • Pitch, consult and negotiate design decisions for faster iterations and decisioning. 
  • Stay with the problem, be the custodian for the north-star  throughout delivery.
  • Constantly reframe design decisions as new constraints and evidence emerge.

Design that ships: Owning the work from framed problems to live product.

  • Own design across the lifecycle: discovery, concept, design, build, launch and iteration.

  • Design for production reality: complex workflows, edge cases, data and system constraints.

AI-accelerated craft: Using AI to design better, and designing better AI native products

  • Use AI across research, synthesis, ideation and prototyping to compress design cycles.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with Product Managers and engineers to take designs through to delivery, then learn from real usage and feedback quickly.

  • Explain the why behind every design decision, welcome challenge from anyone, and change your mind when the evidence says so.

  • Design how AI and people work together: what the AI should do, when it hands over to a human, and how users understand, trust and correct it.

  • Bring ideas from other products and industries to Duffel, and share them so the whole team's design thinking improves.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years designing digital products, with a portfolio that shows you've taken a complex product from problem to shipped outcome and can say what changed because of it.

  • Strong craft across interaction, visual and systems design: you ship the states, edge cases and accessibility, not only the happy path.

  • Experience working with several stakeholder groups at once, ideally both business customers and end consumers, and a clear method for turning their conflicting needs into decisions.

  • Experience designing AI, conversational or support products, and an understanding of what makes them hard: uncertainty, failure states, trust and handover to humans.

  • A close working relationship with engineers and PMs, including prototyping in code or with AI tools where it speeds up learning.

  • A collaborative mindset with a strong point of view: you push back with evidence, take feedback well and can articulate the why behind any design.

  • The confidence to hold a quality bar and speak for design across the company. You influence without authority and you're happy to set the example.

What you'll be working on

  • Designing the experience of an AI support agent that answers travellers and hands over to our travel support team when it should.

  • Defining the patterns for AI behaviour: when it acts, asks, escalates or defers, and how users see what it did and why.

  • Building tools for the businesses on Duffel to review, correct and trust what the AI does on their behalf.

  • Helping other teams with their design needs when they ask, and sometimes when they don't yet know they have one.

  • Sharing design progress, rationale and open questions weekly with product, engineering and operations,

Why You’ll Love Working at Duffel

We believe in true ownership. That’s why every permanent employee gets equity in the business.
