title: Senior Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

How we work

We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder, and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work.

We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods, usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart.

We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move.

Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately AI-native role, and one of the areas where we're moving fastest.

A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. You don't need to be full-stack by trade, but you do need to be comfortable working outside your strongest layer.

The Product Engineer role is the same at every level. What scales is the size of the problem you own, how expensive your decisions are to reverse, and how far your judgement travels beyond your pod. At Level 3, that looks like this:

 

What you'll be doing

  • Taking a customer problem from discovery to production inside a pod, getting close to customers yourself, framing the problem, and shipping in small increments guided by real customer signal rather than internal opinion.

  • Directing AI agents to draft implementation, tests, and migrations, then reviewing, integrating, and hardening that work. You'll write intent precisely enough to brief both a teammate and an agent, and own correctness and maintainability regardless of how the first draft was produced.

  • Designing and delivering robust production systems where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency matter, with the tests and observability that make complex behaviour safe to evolve.

  • Working across the codebase wherever the problem leads, including areas your pod doesn't steward, with stewards looped in proportionate to the risk rather than handing work off and waiting.

  • Moving between pods, problems, and streams as priorities change, ramping fast on unfamiliar domains and leaving what you built running well behind you.

  • Taking full accountability for outcomes rather than just your code changes: raising risks early, and deciding rather than escalating.

What you'll need to have done

  • Built and shipped production systems end-to-end, from design through rollout, monitoring, and iteration, in settings where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency mattered.

  • Designed testing and observability that made complex behaviour understandable, debuggable, and safe to evolve.

  • Worked effectively in a polyglot environment, choosing the right tool for the problem and picking up unfamiliar languages, domains, and codebases fast. Strong systems experience, for example in Rust, C/C++, or Python, is valued, and we'll upskill you where there are gaps.

  • Shipped work outside your strongest layer of the stack when the problem needed it, picking up the front end, the data layer, or the infrastructure rather than waiting for someone else to.

  • Used AI tools as a serious part of how you build, with the judgement to direct, review, and stand behind what they produce.

  • Carried product and design judgement into your engineering work, shaping the solution rather than only implementing a spec and making sensible calls under ambiguity.

  • Owned outcomes beyond your immediate task, taking decisions rather than escalating them.

 

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach.

  • You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges.

  • You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

 

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

 

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

 

Interview process

  1. Initial chat with our Talent team

  2. Lead Hirer Interview

  3. Live AI Skills Assessment

  4. Values Interview with the CPTO

  5. Meet the CEO

 

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

 

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

title: Senior Product Engineer (m/w/d) mit Claude Code
descriptionHtml:
Als Product Engineer verantwortest Du bei uns ein Produkt als Ganzes. Du sprichst mit Kunden und Team, findest heraus, welches Problem wirklich gelöst werden muss, und entscheidest, was gebaut wird und was wegfällt. Dann setzt Du es mit Claude um, bringst es live und schaust, ob es im Alltag der Nutzer funktioniert. Was Du dort lernst, wird die nächste Version.

Wer wir sind

Lightweb Media ist eine AI-first Software- und KI-Entwicklungsfirma mit Büros in Dresden und Hamburg. Bei uns läuft die gesamte Firma über Claude: Entwicklung, Betrieb, Projektmanagement und Kommunikation. Dafür haben wir eigene Werkzeuge gebaut: ein Company Brain, in dem unser Wissen und unsere Abläufe liegen, ein eigenes Secret Management und ein eigenes KI-Projektmanagement-Tool. Daneben entwickeln wir eigene Produkte und B2B-Plattformen für Kunden, die im Betrieb laufen müssen.

Das machst Du

  • Du setzt Projekte von der Idee bis zum Deployment um und betreust sie danach weiter: Anforderungen klären, Lösung entwerfen, bauen, ausliefern, beobachten, verbessern.

  • Du orchestrierst Claude und Subagenten über mehrere Repositories parallel, mit Plan, Review-Schritten und Freigaben vor Push und Deploy.

  • Ob etwas funktioniert, prüfst Du an der echten Datenbank und im laufenden Betrieb.

  • Releases bringst Du selbst live, schaust danach auf Health-Checks, Logs und Fehlertracking und behebst, was auffällt.

  • Du verantwortest Infrastruktur und Deployments: Server, Container, CI/CD, Monitoring und Sicherheitsupdates.

  • Am Company Brain baust Du mit: Skills, Hooks, Routinen und die Regeln, nach denen unsere Agenten arbeiten. Was sich wiederholt, machst Du zu einer Routine, die von selbst läuft.

  • Nach jedem Release schreibst Du die Nachricht an Kunden und kommunizierst im Team.

Das erwarten wir außerdem

  • Mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung

  • Mindestens sechs Monate Arbeit mit Claude

  • Erfahrung mit Infrastruktur und Deployments: Linux-Server, Docker, CI/CD und Releases, die Du selbst live gebracht hast

  • Erfahrung mit Agenten-Orchestrierung: mehrere Agenten oder Subagenten parallel steuern, mit Plänen, Prüfschritten und Freigaben

  • Der Abschnitt „At a Glance“ aus Deinem /insights-Bericht

  • Du hast Software gebaut und selbst betrieben und kennst die Probleme, die erst nach dem Livegang auftauchen

  • Backend und Datenbank sind Dein Terrain: Bei langsamen Abfragen misst Du erst und urteilst dann

  • Große Aufträge gibst Du an Agenten ab und sorgst dafür, dass am Ende der ganze Umfang fertig ist

  • Du hast eigene Skills, Hooks oder MCP-Server gebaut

  • Fließendes Deutsch, weil wir mit unseren Kunden und intern Deutsch sprechen

  • Der At-a-Glance-Teil Deines /insights-Berichts aus Claude Code

*Ein Lebenslauf zeigt, was Du gemacht hast. Der Abschnitt „At a Glance“ zeigt, wie Du mit Claude arbeitest: wie Du Aufgaben zuschneidest, was Du abgibst, wo Du nachprüfst und wo es hakt. Ein makelloser Bericht ist nicht das Ziel. Uns interessiert, wie Du mit den Stellen umgehst, an denen es nicht rund läuft.

Das hilft (kein Muss)

  • Eigene Apps oder Produkte, die Du uns zeigen kannst, als Link, Repository oder Demo

  • PHP, TypeScript, Python oder Rust in Live-Systemen

  • PostgreSQL oder MariaDB, GitLab CI, Coolify

  • Ein Blick für Sicherheit und Datenschutz in KI-Workflows

Das bieten wir

  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

  • Hybrid & Gleitzeit, mit Büros in Dresden und Hamburg

  • 30 Urlaubstage

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge

  • Eigener Laptop/ Ausstattung

  • Jede Woche eine kurze Weiterbildung

  • Eine Firma, die komplett mit Claude arbeitet, und eigene Werkzeuge, die Du mitgestaltest

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und dem Entwicklungsteam

title: Senior Product Engineer (Product Manager)
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

We're building a larger, dedicated Platform team at Lendable, increasing our investment in the infrastructure that enables our products and engineering teams to scale.

We're hiring a Technical Product Manager to sit within Engineering and connect platform technology, reliability and commercial value. You'll own what we prioritise and why, giving engineers the business context they need while helping Product and leadership understand the impact and opportunities that Platform enables.

This is a hands-on technical IC role, where you'll stay close to engineering through writing code, reviewing PRs and contributing to architecture discussions.

Working closely with the Platform Engineering Manager and Tech Lead, you'll help shape the Platform roadmap, connect technical investment to measurable business outcomes, and build the foundations that allow Lendable to move faster and scale with confidence.

What you'll be doing

Own platform stability

  • Own platform stability as a primary accountability - SLA/SLO metrics, incident rates, release quality.

  • Hold release gating authority: block features from production that don't meet testing standards or introduce unacceptable regression risk.

  • Enforce CI/CD standards centrally so pods don't fragment into one-off solutions.

  • Track and report stability metrics alongside commercial outcomes - stability is the foundation that makes the rest possible.

Be commercially accountable

  • Own the business case for platform investment and answer "why are we spending six engineers on this for three months?" in terms leadership understands.

  • Track platform impact in business terms: developer velocity, incident cost, time-to-market, reliability, capacity - e.g. "CXO rollout removes a 3-second API fan-out, reducing session abandonment" or "we can now handle 20k simultaneous logins".

  • Input into headcount and investment decisions for the platform team.

Own the platform roadmap

  • Own the platform backlog, prioritised by business value and sequenced to unblock the highest-value product teams first - not driven by technical debt or engineer preference alone.

  • Make trade-offs explicit: "if we do X now, we defer Y by Z weeks - here's what that means for products depending on us".

  • Ensure every initiative has a defined success metric that non-engineers can track.

Be the stakeholder interface

  • Act as the single point of contact for Pod Leads: business requirements coming from pods and engineering/developer requirements flowing to pods; prioritise both in service of platform stability.

  • Make platform work visible to leadership - regular forums with product MDs and PMs to capture upcoming dependencies before they become blockers; represent platform work in leadership reviews; translate technical milestones into business milestones.

  • Drive cross-team collaboration and buy-in with other PMs; engage architecture in technical design.

  • Escalate when product teams make requests that would create unsustainable platform load or technical debt.

Contribute as an engineer

  • Write code, review PR's, and participate in architecture design as a core part of the role - not a side project.

  • Bring a strong technical voice to roadmap decisions without owning final architecture calls (that's Architecture and Tech Leads).

What we're looking for

Essential

  • Deep, hands-on engineering background - this role must be staffed by someone who has shipped production systems, not someone who has only managed backlogs.

  • Strong commercial instinct: can build a business case, speak to P&L impact, and hold a line on ROI.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management across product, engineering, and finance without direct line authority over all of them.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity - platform value is often indirect and long-horizon.

  • Track record of contributing as an IC while operating at a senior, cross-team level.

  • Proactive, low-ego, and clear communicator - able to hold a line with leadership and pod leads alike.

Nice to have

  • Experience in platform, infrastructure, or developer tooling contexts.

  • Familiarity with SLA/SLO frameworks and incident management at scale.

  • Experience enforcing CI/CD standards across multiple teams or pods.

  • Prior work making "invisible" infrastructure legible to non-technical leadership.

Our tech stack

Platform & backend: Kotlin, AWS, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes.

Gateway & clients: Node GraphQL gateway, React Native / TypeScript mobile app, Relay.

Tooling & observability: GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jira, Confluence, Datadog, Sentry, Grafana.

Interview process

  • Quick call with the Talent Team (30 minutes)

  • Hiring manager interview (30 minutes)

  • Technical and Product interview (90 minutes)

  • Culture-add interview (60 minutes)

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
We are the platform turning browsing into shopping. We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands.

We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases.

In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company Flipp, creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia.

Ready to spark your growth with us?

WHO WE LOOK FOR 🦄

Flipp + Shopfully’s Product team focuses on driving adoption and revenue of our products by identifying the biggest market opportunities, building the case for investing in them, and shipping solutions with engineering, all while representing the voice of our merchant customers.

About the role

The Senior Product Manager is a senior, commercially minded product leader who already understands digital advertising. This role requires a strong strategic thinker with good business sense and solid hands-on product skills who leads opportunity identification, builds decision-ready business cases, and works with engineering to ship.

You will work closely with Sales, Engineering, Data, and Marketing teams across markets to align on key business objectives. By combining market insight, customer feedback, and industry trends, you will make sure our products resonate with merchants and drive growth. We’re looking for someone who can ramp up quickly and contribute independently.

WHAT YOU WILL DO 🏄

Market Understanding and Opportunity Identification

  • Work with Product Marketing, Sales Engineering and customer-facing teams to understand customer needs and prioritize the opportunities that matter most.
  • Find the highest-leverage areas to invest in, and weigh customer demand against our resources, capabilities and strategic direction.
  • Turn complex questions into clear priorities. For example: how do we create more value for retail partners as their strategies move toward e-commerce? How do we find and build opportunities at scale as products launch in new markets?

Business Cases and Strategy

  • Build business cases that size opportunities, weigh revenue trade-offs, and structure a clear recommendation so leadership can make a decision.
  • Own your recommendations, and be ready to explain them and adapt them as you learn.
  • Lead the strategy for how our products differentiate from competitors in the market.
  • Partner with Sales and Finance on pricing and monetization so our offering stays cohesive.

Product Discovery and Delivery

  • Lead discovery with merchants, advertisers, and internal teams to define problems worth solving.
  • Prioritise ruthlessly, balancing revenue impact, effort, and strategic fit.
  • Work hands-on with engineering to define requirements and ship, from alpha and testing through broad launch.
  • Partner with Sales and Marketing on launch timing and readiness, and run retrospectives on past launches to improve future ones.

Alignment and Stakeholder Management

  • Generate cross-functional alignment (Engineering, Data, Sales, Marketing, Content) with a shared focus on goals and timing.
  • Work across markets and levels of seniority, including senior leadership, with confidence.
  • Track progress and impact of product initiatives and communicate results clearly.
  • Build relationships with industry analysts, partners, and customers, and represent Flipp + Shopfully at conferences and industry events where relevant.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED🪄

Must-haves

  • Digital advertising foundations: supply vs. demand, how exchanges, SSPs, and DSPs work, programmatic bidding, pricing models (CPM, CPC, CPV), and fill rate and yield. Ideally gained in ad tech, a retail media network, a publisher, or a marketplace.
  • Proven experience building business cases: sizing opportunities, weighing revenue trade-offs, and structuring recommendations for decisions.
  • High autonomy: you figure things out, own the outcome and don’t need close management.
  • Genuine excitement about using AI tools and rethinking how work gets done.
  • Hands-on product skills: discovery, prioritisation, and working with engineering to ship, not only strategy.
  • Stakeholder management, with the confidence to work across markets and levels of seniority.
  • A scrappy, curious and confident approach. You’re hungry to make an impact.

👉 At our company, we value diversity and actively encourage it — we believe a variety of perspectives and backgrounds makes us stronger. We focus on potential rather than on having a “perfect” CV. If this role excites you and you believe you could grow into it — even if you don’t tick every single box in the requirements — we’d love to hear from you!

NICE TO HAVE  🎆

  • Retail, CPG, or retail media background
  • Multi-market experience
  • Can speak Italian or German

LOCATION 🌐 

While we have offices in Milan, Berlin, Barcelona, you can benefit from our flexible hybrid model (full remote available), empowering you to work where you're most effective.

HOURS ⏰
Your manager and several partner teams are in North America, so you’ll need to be flexible about working some later hours, beyond a standard 9-5 CET.

WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SHOPFULLY 🤗

🌎 An opportunity to thrive in a rapidly scaling multinational company

🕶️ A vibrant, informal, and inclusive work environment

🧠 We champion autonomy, flexibility, and a hybrid work model, empowering you to own your work

📚 Access to learning opportunities and regular feedback sessions

🍓 Enjoy our central, modern offices featuring fresh snacks, coffee (including vegan options!), and ergonomic setups

🎉 Engage in meaningful team events: offsites, happy hours, company parties and celebrations that unite us beyond daily tasks

💻We provide all the necessary equipment for you to work effectively and set up your workspace, wherever you are

🧰 Benefit from additional country-specific advantages based on local contracts and practices

WHO WE ARE 💜 

We’re a team of 450 people (and counting!), from 30 different nationalities. We’re on a mission to innovate, and we believe the key to that is seeing the world through a variety of perspectives. That’s why building a more diverse team, as well as bringing in even more talent, is so important for us.

TO FEEL AT HOME 🛋️ IN SHOPFULLY YOU NEED 🎯

  • Progress Over Perfection: We move forward. Always. In a fast-moving world, speed with purpose beats certainty without action. Momentum matters—not for its own sake, but because it drives results.
  • Clarity Through Transparency: We bring each other along. We work in teams, not silos. Transparency gives context, and context enables action. That means we share decisions early, publish work in progress, and document outcomes so others can learn, move faster, and build better.
  • Learn Loudly: We grow by doing and by daring. Big bets unlock big breakthroughs. But real innovation demands risk, and risk always carries the possibility of failure. That’s not a flaw. It’s the price of ambition.
  • Challenge with Empathy: We speak up, even when it’s hard—because candor shows care, and leads to better outcomes. Listening deeply is how we grow. Disagreeing openly is how we build trust.

Always Build Better: We are builders—of products, systems, and ideas. But more than that, we are builders of better. Better has no finish line. It’s a mindset.

The aforementioned entities will act as joint controllers for the limited purpose of intra-group sharing related to the evaluation of candidates’ applications. title: Senior Product Manager, AI Products & Agentic Hospitality (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the role

At Apaleo, we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, and the first AI agent marketplace for hospitality in our Agent Hub, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers.

We're looking for a senior Product Manager to ownin our AI product domain. You'll turn our AI capabilities into coherent, commercially viable products that solve real operational problems for hoteliers. Your goal is to help hotels move towards genuinely autonomous operations, not to ship isolated automations or AI assistants.

This is not a backlog role. You'll take an ambiguous opportunity, find the right customer problems, define the proposition, build it with Engineering, bring it to market and drive adoption. You'll also play a central role in turning our AI capabilities into a meaningful and growing source of revenue.

This is a senior individual contributor role with real autonomy. You won't receive a roadmap and execute it. You'll shape it along our vision, using customer insight, data and sound reasoning. You'll work closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, and in close collaboration with our other value stream teams.

What you'll be up to

  • Productising and commercialising our AI capabilities. Define the proposition, target customers and use cases, and shape packaging and launch with commercial teams.
  • Building the foundations for AI across our ecosystem. Shape how our AI capabilities understand each hotel's context and work reliably with Apaleo and connected systems across operational areas.
  • Productising hospitality knowledge. Turn hospitality expertise and operational processes into scalable product experiences, with appropriate human oversight.
  • Driving autonomy and measurable value. Think in complete outcomes, such as staff hours saved and manual work removed. Show hoteliers tangible ROI.
  • Driving adoption. Run discovery, shape onboarding and usability, measure adoption and improve from real-world feedback.
  • Keeping AI products reliable and viable. Define good agent performance, understand cost and latency, set up evaluation and monitoring with Engineering, and trade off autonomy, reliability, human intervention and cost.
  • Owning strategy, roadmap and delivery in your scope, with clear specs, a definition of done and impact analysis.
  • Working with Engineering on trade-offs, dependencies, quality and our API-first AI-first architecture.
  • Balancing ambition with reality. Weigh the roadmap against operational requests, bugs and technical debt, and say no to good ideas that aren't great ones.
  • Spotting dependencies early with Hotel Operations and other engineering teams, since our AI capabilities build on the core platform.
  • Using AI in your own PM work and championing AI-assisted engineering.

What you'll bring

  • 6+ years as a Product Manager, owning products from discovery through launch and adoption with limited day-to-day direction.
  • Proven zero-to-one experience. You've taken a new B2B product, not a feature, from an ambiguous problem to paying customers, driving discovery, validation, definition, prioritisation and launch.
  • Ownership after launch. You've owned a revenue, adoption or retention number and can tell us what moved and what you killed, pivoted or repriced.
  • Commercial thinking. You've defined propositions, packaging and pricing, validated willingness to pay and worked with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success on go-to-market.
  • Systems and process thinking. You break processes into steps, decisions and handoffs, and understand how systems with different data models and sources of truth affect the reliability of agents.
  • Meaningful AI product experience. You've built and launched AI-powered products or capabilities used by real customers, understand what makes a product agentic, and can discuss context, tools, latency, cost and evaluation, with a view on human-in-the-loop design.
  • Customer centricity and product judgement. You turn interview patterns into opportunities, make tough trade-offs and prioritise ruthlessly.
  • Platform thinking. You weigh customer needs against reusable capabilities, API consistency and long-term platform evolution.
  • Stakeholder alignment. You align Engineering, commercial teams and peers, manage cross-team dependencies and communicate trade-offs with confidence.
  • Autonomy and adaptability. You take ownership, raise risks early and make progress through ambiguity.

Strongly preferred

  • Agentic AI products in production. You've taken an agentic AI product beyond prototype to paying customers, and dealt with reliability, permissions, exceptions, human intervention and evaluation. This is different from AI-powered features such as chatbots, summarisation or copilots.

Nice to have

  • Hospitality technology or hotel operations experience.
  • Experience with PMS, RMS, CRS, channel managers, OTAs or hospitality distribution.
  • Experience in B2B SaaS platforms, ecosystems or integration-heavy products.
  • Experience with AI governance, permissions, identity, orchestration or enterprise AI adoption.
  • Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up.
  • Comfort with AI-assisted engineering processes.

Don't tick every box? Hospitality experience is an advantage, not a prerequisite. A strong zero-to-one B2B product builder from another domain, with real AI product experience and a commercial mindset, can be a better fit than a hospitality specialist without them. We'd still love to hear from you.

Who you are

  • You take high ownership. You answer for product outcomes, not just delivery commitments.
  • You're strategic and hands-on. You can set a product vision and still get into customer discovery, operational processes and detailed product decisions.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. You make progress when the problem or the solution isn't fully defined.
  • You think commercially. You ask what customers will buy and why, not just what Engineering can build.
  • You're customer obsessed. You understand real operational pain and test your assumptions with customers.
  • You're technically curious. You know enough about AI and agentic systems to hold meaningful discussions with engineers and make informed product decisions.
  • You measure what matters. You judge success by customer outcomes, adoption and commercial impact, not features shipped.

What we offer

Culture and growth

  • A diverse and international team. Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique perspectives and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.
  • Growth and development. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility.
  • Autonomy and ownership. Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly, in an environment built on trust and transparency.
  • Competitive and fair compensation. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams.

Perks and lifestyle

  • Flexible and remote work options. We focus on results, not clocking hours. Work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup.
  • Free public transport. Travel across Germany with a fully covered Deutschland Ticket.
  • Paid time off. 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired.
  • Health and wellbeing. Access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership.

Joining Apaleo

How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo is more than taking on a role. It's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions and help redefine the future of hospitality tech.

descriptionHtml:

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across UK, Germany, and Spain.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio.

We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding.

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Motorway

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join Motorway's Product & Engineering team. Motorway is a UK online car-selling platform connecting private sellers with ~7,500 verified dealers through online auctions. You will own a problem area end to end, in either the seller or the dealer side of the marketplace, and be accountable for the outcomes you deliver.

Building is cheaper than it has ever been. The hard part now is choosing the right thing to build. We want PMs with exceptional product sense who find the problems worth solving, back that judgement with evidence, and use the latest technology to solve them in ways that weren't possible a year ago.

What you will do

Find the problems that matter

  • Identify the highest-impact problem areas by combining quantitative analysis with qualitative research, and explain clearly why they matter more than the alternatives

  • See through the hundreds of good ideas to the few that will move the business and create real value for sellers and dealers

  • Own outcome-based goals and metrics, not feature lists

Build with AI, in your work and in our product

  • Use AI to make yourself and your team faster: automate routine PM tasks, analyse data and research quickly, and prototype or vibe code solutions to get customer feedback in days, not weeks

  • Ask how each product could be built differently given what AI makes possible, and bring those ideas to your squad

  • Make your team 2x more effective, not 2x busier

Deliver with rigour

  • Lead a cross-functional squad of engineers, designers and data specialists from discovery through launch and measurement

  • Run experiments that produce learning even when they fail, and act on what you learn

  • Make clear trade-offs between customer needs, technical constraints and business priorities

Bring people with you

  • Communicate the what, the why and the how clearly, through crisp, data-led documents and conversations

  • Work with the people closest to you (engineering, design, data) and with execs and other business units such as Operations, Customer Support, Sales and Marketing

  • Influence without authority and build alignment on difficult decisions

Requirements

  • Proven experience as a product manager, with a track record of shipping products that moved meaningful business metrics, not just delivering features

  • Strong product sense. You can show how you found and prioritised the right problem, and what you chose not to do

  • Comfortable with both qualitative and quantitative evidence: you run user research and also query data, design experiments and interpret results yourself

  • Data-oriented. You use data to understand problems, set goals and measure impact, and can debate approaches with data scientists and analysts

  • AI-forward. You use AI tools regularly in your own work and have hands-on experience prototyping or building with them. You have a point of view on where AI helps and where it doesn't

  • A clear, confident communicator who can work with engineers and analysts day to day and with senior leaders across the business

  • Ability to move between detail and strategy without losing coherence

  • Self-starter with strong ownership, a curious mindset, and the ability to build domain knowledge quickly

  • Experience in marketplaces, consumer products or B2B platforms is helpful but not essential

  • You're excited about changing how people buy and sell cars

Benefits

We offer a fantastic range of benefits to help you thrive:

  • Hybrid work schedule with 2 days per week in our Central London office, with regular social events, office drinks and free snacks to keep you going

  • Great work-life balance

  • Stock options so you can share in Motorway's growth and future success

  • Pension scheme to plan for your future with our provider NEST

  • Strong commitment to your personal development including budget for books, courses, conferences, etc

  • Opt-in comprehensive health insurance through BUPA including dental care and fitness discounts

  • Cycle to work scheme, save big ££ on a new bike and accessories

  • One paid volunteering day a year for you to use as you wish

  • Generous parental benefits including 6 months full paid maternity leave, 4 weeks paternity leave and workplace nursery scheme... and much more!

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Rivia

Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.

Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated.

Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital.

Rivia’s ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end.

 

About the Product Team

You’ll be Rivia's first product hire, reporting to the CTO. Today, everything Product is owned by the Rivia founders and carried out Engineering. Your job is to take it over, build the function, and make shipping high quality products repeatable. As Rivia scales, there is a clear path to leading a PM team.

 

The Role

As Senior Product Manager at Rivia, you own the path from idea to adopted feature. Driving alignment across Engineering, Client Solutions and founders to build products that have relevant impact, from customer discovery, mockups, specs, weekly refinement, launches, and measurement of KPIs.

You’ll own several products across Rivia’s platform. This requires holistic understanding of market and customer needs for complex prioritisation decisions. To do that you’ll need to be deep in the details: talking to customers, experts, writing specs, monitoring usage, keeping delivery moving. You also build the product management function itself, with light processes (PRDs, documentation, releases, prioritization) that a future product team builds on, and you own product coherence: the principles that keep features consistent as the platform grows.

 

What Excites You

  • Shipping products that help bring new therapies to market. Our customers entrust us with their patients, we take that very seriously.

  • Working directly with customers, including clinical research and biotech teams running global clinical trials, to understand problems and turn them into delightful solutions.

  • Defining product management foundation, from first principles, as the first product hire.

  • Joining a team that already works AI-native: agentic features run in production on live trials, customers connect their own agents through the Rivia MCP, and much of the roadmap ahead is AI products. You work the same way, from AI-built mockups to agent-driven analysis.

 

Responsibilities

  • Product Execution: Own the full product lifecycle for your scope: discovery, spec, delivery, and post-launch measurement.

  • Drive Cross-Team Coordination: Align Engineering, Design,w and Clinical stakeholders to hit delivery deadlines. Work closely with GTM to synchronize assets and commercial readiness with each release.

  • Channel Customers need: Run structured feedback loops with customers and internal stakeholders, ensuring their needs are prioritised and our products are usable, reliable and high quality.

  • Oversee a Multi-Product Portfolio: Weigh competing priorities across the product line, deliberately direct your own attention and your teams' bandwidth, and make sure customers experience the products as one coherent whole.

  • Own Product performance: Set KPIs and targets before building, measure feature health after launch, and make kill, iterate, or double-down calls on the data.

  • AI-Powered Product Development: Use AI agents in your daily work, including AI-generated mockups to accelerate discovery, and identify where AI unlocks new value for clinical teams.

  • Product Function Building: Set up light processes (PRDs, documentation, release process, prioritization) that the team actually follows.

 

What Excites Us

  • 7+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS with technical products

  • You have been the first or sole PM at a B2B startup and built the product function around an engineer-led team

  • Has taken at least one product from idea to production with demonstrable adoption

  • Hands-on product analytics: built measurement from zero with Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar

  • Has designed and run product processes (refinement, discovery, launches) that engineering teams actually kept

  • AI-native way of working: uses AI agents in daily product work, with concrete examples

  • Comfortable being the only product person: self-directed, builds the function while running it

  • Clinical trials, drug development, or health data experience is a strong plus. Exceptional PMs without it are welcome.

Bonus

  • Former lead or head of product who wants to build hands-on again

  • Experience shipping for expert or scientific users

 

Our Values

At Rivia, we are committed to excellence, continuous learning, and the success of both our customers and our team. If you are driven to exceed targets, eager to shape the future of clinical trials, and passionate about making a meaningful difference in the biotech industry, Rivia is the place for you.

  • In it to Win it: Approach every challenge with determination, resilience, and a drive, aiming for the best outcomes and solutions.

  • Embrace change: We see change as an opportunity for growth, innovation, and improvement, continuously evolving to stay one step ahead.

  • Why not?: Asking why not, instead of why, allows us to show our curiosity, allowing us to challenge assumptions and explore new possibilities.

  • Find the gap: We are curious and we proactively approach identifying opportunities and solving problems before they arise.

  • Collective accountability: We are one team, on one mission and we are committed to shared responsibilities and mutual support, enabling trust and collaboration.

  • Value add solutions: Know better. Act better. We are dedicated to delivering meaningful and impactful results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own Product Marketing for a Product. You'll define a 2–4 quarter Product Marketing strategy that connects customer needs, market opportunity, and product direction into a clear plan. You'll own Product Marketing across the full product lifecycle from early discovery through launches and iteration. You'll be the go-to person for understanding how your product succeeds in the market.
  • Become the expert on your market. You'll build a deep understanding of your customers, competitors, and category, using research, data, and experimentation to identify opportunities that influence product priorities. You'll bring the voice of the market into day-to-day product decisions and help your squad make better bets.
  • Define positioning customers understand. You'll create clear, differentiated positioning and messaging that helps customers understand why your product matters. You'll work closely with Product, Design, Writers, and Integrated Marketing to ensure that positioning is reflected consistently across the product experience and everything customers see.
  • Influence Product Strategy. You'll work alongside Product Managers, Designers, and Researchers to shape product strategy with customer and market insight. Product teams will seek your perspective before committing to product bets, and you'll help turn customer problems into products people genuinely love.
  • Shape successful launches. You'll design launch strategies that fit the customer problem, partner with Integrated Marketing on campaigns, and coordinate cross-functional launches across Product, Marketing, Operations, and Support. You'll measure what worked, learn quickly, and continuously improve how your product reaches customers.
  • Measure what matters. You'll use customer and commercial data to understand whether your work is making a difference. You'll build business cases for product decisions, measure launches against meaningful outcomes, and use what you learn to strengthen positioning, propositions, and future product decisions.

This is for you if: 

  • You enjoy owning entire products. You're comfortable taking responsibility for Product Marketing across a full product experience, from customer insight through to positioning. 
  • You solve ambiguous problems with evidence. You enjoy understanding customers, identifying market opportunities and turning insight into practical product and marketing recommendations.
  • You know what makes products win. You combine customer insight, market understanding and commercial thinking to build products and propositions people genuinely love.
  • You influence through collaboration. You enjoy working closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, Researchers and Integrated Marketing, bringing people with you through evidence rather than authority.
  • You're always improving and helping others improve. You seek feedback, develop your craft and contribute to making the team stronger through sharing knowledge and helping others. Mentor more junior team members informally.

The Interview Process

Our interview process involves three main stages:

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Growth
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the Role

The next generation of AI companies is being built on APIs. As developers choose the models and infrastructure that will power their applications, Mistral has an opportunity to become the AI lab and provider of choice for those who value performance, openness and control.

We are hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to turn developer adoption into sustained commercial growth. You'll define how the market understands Mistral's developer platform and build the go-to-market strategy for model APIs, and create a measurable path from initial experimentation to production usage and larger commercial relationships. Your objective is to grow self-serve revenue and make product adoption a repeatable source of qualified pipeline across Mistral’s API business.

This is a greenfield opportunity to shape a fast-evolving market, influence product strategy and establish a new growth marketing capability. You'll work closely with senior leadership and teams across Product, Engineering, Science, Sales and Marketing to define our positioning, accelerate adoption and create a scalable path from self-serve usage to enterprise revenue.

You won't inherit a playbook. You'll build one.

What you'll do

Define how Mistral can win developers.

  • Identify the developer audiences, customer problems, and their workloads where Mistral has the strongest opportunity to differentiate.

  • Define positioning and messaging strategy for models, capabilities, and use cases selected as growth priorities.

  • Translate our technical strengths such as model performance, transparent pricing, economics, and deployment choice into clear reasons to adopt Mistral.

  • Build a deep understanding of developer needs and competitive dynamics, using market research, customer insights and technical trends to sharpen our positioning and influence product priorities.

Build the API go-to-market and growth engine.

  • Develop the marketing strategy across the developer journey, from initial discovery and first API call through sustained paid usage..

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Science and Developer Relations to bring technical innovations to market through compelling narratives, campaigns, content and developer-focused programmes.

  • Partner with Sales to identify high-potential accounts and create pathways from experimentation to larger production workloads.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • An experienced product marketer. You have proven experience in product marketing, growth marketing or developer marketing within B2B technology, developer platforms, APIs or AI, with demonstrable impact on product adoption and commercial outcomes.

  • A strategic storyteller. You've taken technical products from ambiguity to market, developing differentiated positioning and go-to-market strategies that help products stand out in competitive markets.

  • Fluent in developer audiences. You understand how developers discover, evaluate and adopt technical products, and know how to build trust, reduce friction and drive sustained engagement.

  • Technically credible. You can navigate API documentation, work with sample code and engage confidently with engineers and product teams. You understand the fundamentals of model performance, latency, inference costs, throughput and context windows, and can translate technical complexity into customer value.

  • Commercially minded and analytical. You connect marketing strategy to business outcomes, understand product-led growth, monetisation, and sales, and you use data to prioritise investments and measure impact.

  • A builder and cross-functional leader. You thrive in greenfield environments, influence senior stakeholders, challenge assumptions constructively and bring teams together around clear priorities. You're comfortable creating new capabilities and scaling what works.

  • Curious. You bring intellectual rigour, curiosity and conviction to complex problems. You're excited by the potential sovereign AI and the opportunity to give developers and businesses greater choice and control.

Nice to have

  • Experience marketing AI APIs, developer platforms, cloud infrastructure or model-serving products.

  • Experience building product-led growth programmes or self-serve-to-enterprise motions.

  • A track record of technical thought leadership, developer community engagement or open-source participation.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

title: Senior Programme Manager -  Technology & AI
descriptionHtml:
About THG 

We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition. 

Our portfolio of leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition. 

From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.  

With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for? 

About THG

We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition.

Our leading retailers and brands, including LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD and Cult Beauty, make up our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition.

From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.

With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for?

Location: Icon 1, WA15 0AF

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Technical Programme Manager to lead the delivery of our most important customer-facing technology programmes, reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer.

THG runs several high-profile ecommerce websites in nutrition and beauty, including myprotein.com and lookfantastic.com. Our websites and mobile apps are how customers find, buy and come back to our brands, and the programmes you lead will shape that experience directly.

You will own programmes from first idea to launch, mainly across our websites and mobile apps. Examples include personalisation, loyalty and digital marketing technology, and some programmes will reach into other parts of the technology estate. The role is an even mix of programme and project management. You will run long-lived programmes that span many teams, and drive individual projects hands-on when they need it. You will work with executives to decide what gets built and in what order, and tell them plainly how delivery is going.

You don’t need to be the architect. Our technology leaders set the technical direction and you will follow their lead. You do need to understand how large websites and apps are built well enough to plan the work, spot risks early and ask the right questions.

As a Technical Programme Manager you will:

Programme Delivery

  • End-to-End Ownership: Own the delivery of large technology programmes across our websites and mobile apps, from scoping and planning through to launch and review.
  • Programme Planning: Build and maintain programme plans, milestones and dependency maps across several engineering and product teams.
  • Hands-On Project Delivery: Run individual projects directly when a programme needs it.

Prioritisation & Product Partnership

  • Executive Prioritisation: Bring options, costs and trade-offs to executives and secure a clear decision on what comes first.
  • Backlog Management: Manage the backlog for your programmes so engineering teams always know what is next and why.
  • Product Collaboration: Work with product managers to turn business goals into well-defined, deliverable pieces of work.

Reporting, Risk & Vendors

  • Honest Reporting: Give executives and stakeholders clear, candid updates on progress, risks and dates.
  • Risk & Dependency Management: Find risks, blockers and cross-team dependencies early, resolve them, and escalate when a decision is needed.
  • Vendor Management: Hold external vendors and delivery partners to their commitments and fit their work into our plans and releases.

Continuous Improvement

  • Ways of Working: Improve how we plan, track and report on delivery across the technology organisation.

A day in the life

Your day is split between the teams doing the work and the leaders deciding what the work should be. You might start with an engineering team, checking progress against the plan and clearing a blocker, then spend time with a product manager breaking a loyalty feature into deliverable stages. In the afternoon you could review a vendor’s delivery plan for a marketing technology integration, then update programme status ahead of an executive review, where you’ll set out where things stand, what is at risk and which decisions you need. You’ll leave with clear priorities and take them back to the teams.

What skills and experience do I need for this role?

Essential Requirements

  • Highly Skilled in technical programme or project management.
  • Experience working directly with software engineering teams.
  • Adept at delivering customer-facing websites or mobile apps.
  • Excellent at managing programmes across several teams, including planning, dependency management and release coordination.
  • Experience running prioritisation and backlog management with senior stakeholders and reporting on delivery to executives.
  • Managing both external vendors or delivery partners.

Desirable Attributes

  • Experience with websites and ecommerce at large scale: high traffic, many markets, or several brands.
  • Experience delivering programmes in personalisation, loyalty or digital marketing technology.
  • Experience delivering native mobile apps alongside web.
  • Experience in retail, particularly nutrition or beauty.
  • A record of bringing clear structure to ambiguous, multi-team programmes.
  • Strong written communication, with the ability to explain a complex programme to executives in plain terms.

title: Senior Projectmanager
descriptionHtml:
Senior Projectmanager

Almere| 32–40 uur per week

Jouw impact

Als Projectmanager ben jij de verbindende factor tussen strategie en uitvoering. Je leidt complexe projecten van A tot Z en zorgt ervoor dat ideeën daadwerkelijk worden gerealiseerd. Denk aan nieuwe proposities, implementaties, systeemkoppelingen en organisatie brede verbetertrajecten.

Je werkt op het snijvlak van business en IT en hebt een directe invloed op hoe zorgorganisaties efficiënter en slimmer kunnen werken. Concrete plannen met zichtbare resultaten waar de organisatie én klanten echt iets aan hebben.

Let op: een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk, is een harde vereiste voor deze functie. Je communiceert dagelijks in het Nederlands met collega’s, stakeholders en klanten en moet complexe projectinformatie helder kunnen overbrengen.

Zo ziet jouw dag eruit

Je start je dag met een kop koffie en een kort praatje met je collega-projectmanagers. Even bijpraten, lachen en je mail doornemen. Daarna duik je al snel de inhoud in: een overleg met de stuurgroep van een nieuw CRM-project staat op de planning. Je presenteert waar het project staat, zorgt dat iedereen gefocust blijft op de doelen, je vraagt aandacht voor de risico’s en mitigerende maatregelen en geeft een doorkijk naar wat er komen gaat. Terug aan je bureau werk je een aantal acties uit en stem je via mail en korte calls af met stakeholders. Niet veel later zit je aan tafel met de directie om een nieuw initiatief te bespreken – strategisch, uitdagend en precies waar jij energie van krijgt. Na een verzorgde lunch maak je een wandeling, speel je een potje tafeltennis of stap je in de racesimulator met collega’s. Daarna is het tijd om weer te schakelen: samen met je projectteam werk je aan een koppeling tussen het softwarepraktijkpakket van Vertimart, wat draait bij de tandartsen en Infomedics ten behoeve van het declaratieproces. Je houdt overzicht, helpt knelpunten oplossen en zorgt dat het team vooruit blijft gaan. Dan kijk je wat er de volgende week op het programma staat en of alles is voorbereid.

Aan het einde van de dag werk je nog wat mails weg, check je je planning voor morgen en sluit je af. Klaar voor een volgende dag vol dynamiek, samenwerking en resultaat.

• Leiden van projecten van initiatie tot oplevering en nazorg

• Aansturen van multidisciplinaire projectteams

• Stakeholdermanagement op operationeel en strategisch niveau

• Bewaken van scope, planning, budget en kwaliteit

• Signaleren van risico’s en tijdig bijsturen

• Vertalen van businessbehoeften naar concrete oplossingen

• Actief bijdragen aan het verder professionaliseren van projectmanagement binnen de organisatie

• Contact onderhouden met de portfoliomanager en de projectmanagers voor lopende en nieuwe initiatieven

• Een dynamische werkomgeving met korte communicatielijnen en een informele cultuur;

• Een rol met zichtbare impact binnen een groeiende organisatie;

• Projecten die ertoe doen binnen de zorgsector;

• Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en verbetering;

• Samenwerking met betrokken en gedreven collega’s;

• Een werkomgeving waar hard werken en plezier hand in hand gaan;

• Een salaris tussen €6000,- en €7000,- bruto per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur), afhankelijk van ervaring en achtergrond. Dit is geen absolute range, wel een goede indicatie;

• Bij goede bedrijfsresultaten een jaarlijkse bonus ter waarde van een maandsalaris;

• Reiskostenvergoeding (€ 0,23 per km) of een NS Business Card met volledige OV-vergoeding;

• Thuiswerkvergoeding;

• Een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met een lage werknemersbijdrage;

• Diverse secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals korting op sportabonnementen via Bedrijfsfitness NL, een fietsleaseplan, workation-mogelijkheden, sabbaticalopties en mantelzorgverlof;

• Een inspirerende werkomgeving, een gezellig team en een dagelijkse verzorgde lunch.

Wie ben jij, en wat breng je mee?

• Aantoonbare ervaring met (ICT-)projectmanagement in dynamische organisaties

• Kennis van en ervaring met verschillende projectmanagement methodes zoals Prince2, Prince2 Agile, AgilePM, PMBOK, IPMA, etc.

• Ervaring met het uitdragen en professionaliseren van projectmanagement is een pré

Wie zijn wij?

MSPS Groep B.V. staat voor Medical Software & Processing Services. De groep bestaat uit verschillende bedrijven die zich samen inzetten om de zorg efficiënter en menselijker te maken. We zijn gespecialiseerd in diensten zoals factoring en clearing van zorgdeclaraties (o.a. Infomedics en Clearing House Apothekers die gezamenlijk namens de zorgaanbieders ieder jaar zo’n €6,5 miljard incasseren bij verzekeraars en zorgconsumenten) en praktijksoftware voor de mondzorg (Vertimart en GSN). Dagelijks profiteren duizenden zorgverleners in mondzorg, paramedie, farmacie, specialistische zorg, GGZ en hulpmiddelen van de inzet en oplossingsgerichtheid van onze ruim 400 MSPS-collega’s, waardoor zij meer tijd hebben voor hun patiënten.

We bieden een financieel sterke en stabiele werkomgeving, met volop kansen voor onze medewerkers om door te groeien. Je werkt in een open en vertrouwde omgeving waar samenwerking en ontwikkeling centraal staan.

Je spreekt eerst telefonisch met de IT Recruiter en daarna met de Afdelingsmanager Architectuur en Project- en Portfoliomanagement en een Product Owner of Projectmanager. title: Senior Propulsion Engineer - Electric Engine (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

As a Senior Propulsion Engineer – Electric Engine, you will drive the development of the electric engine for the VÆRIDION Microliner. You will act as VÆRIDION’s internal technical expert for the complete electric engine, including the motor and controller. You will be responsible for decomposing aircraft-level requirements into engine requirements, guiding technical decisions, and ensuring compliance with applicable certification requirements.

Working closely with the engine supplier, you will critically review and challenge the engine architecture, detailed design, technical analyses, test results and certification evidence. You will maintain a holistic technical overview of the complete electric engine, including the electric machine, engine controllers, power electronics, thermal management, mechanical interfaces, control functions and supporting hardware and software.

As a senior member of the Propulsion team, you will play a key role in technical decision-making, supplier management, testing and certification activities, helping to bring one of the world's most advanced electric aircraft propulsion systems into service.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead the development and certification of the electric engine throughout its complete lifecycle, from requirements definition through testing and certification

  • Act as VÆRIDION’s electric engine subject-matter expert and primary technical counterpart to the external engine supplier.

  • Define, maintain and manage electric engine requirements, interfaces, operating limitations and verification strategies.

  • Review and challenge supplier architectures, designs, calculations, simulation models, and substantiation reports, identifying technical gaps and proposing solutions.

  • Evaluate the electric engine performance across its operating envelope, including efficiency, dynamic response, control stability, thermal limits and performance margins.

  • Contribute to system safety activities, including Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA), Failure Mode Effect Analyses (FMEA) and System Safety Assessments (SSA), in accordance with applicable airworthiness and safety standards.

  • Identify and assess applicable certification requirements, means of compliance and industry standards, including relevant aspects of EASA SC E-19, and ensure that certification considerations are addressed throughout the development cycle.

  • Coordinate the electric engine development and qualification test campaigns, in collaboration with the testing team, including the definition of test plans, objectives, and success criteria.

  • Review and assess test results, identify technical risks and deviations, and coordinate the resolution of issues encountered during testing.

  • Prepare and review technical documentation, including specifications, interface documents, design reviews, qualification reports, and compliance statements.

  • Support prototype build, aircraft integration and ground/flight testing activities throughout the maturation of the propulsion system

 

Your Profile:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related technical field.

  • At least 8 years of relevant professional experience in the development, integration or testing of electric motors, engine controllers/inverters or integrated electric-drive systems.

  • Strong knowledge of electric machines and power electronics, including motor topologies, inverter architectures, operating characteristics & limits, losses & thermal behaviour, motor control strategies & protection functions, and manufacturing processes.

  • Broad understanding of electric engine development, including thermal management, insulation systems, high-voltage systems, EMC, mechanical integrity, reliability & durability, and system integration.

  • Experience defining and managing technical requirements, specifications, interfaces and verification strategies for electric engines or electric-drive systems.

  • Experience collaborating with external development partners, engineering service providers or aerospace suppliers.

  • A high degree of self-motivation, resilience, reliability and precision, combined with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Strong analytical, technical-writing and written communication skills.

  • Excellent verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in another European language is an asset.

  • Passionate about aviation and the electrification of the aviation industry.

  • Previous experience as a Certification Verification Engineer or in a comparable compliance-related role is a plus.

  • Familiarity with EASA SC E-19 and its application to electric or hybrid propulsion systems would be an advantage.

  • Experience in verification, validation and qualification of electric engines, including performance, thermal, endurance and environmental testing, would be a plus.

  • Previous experience working within an EASA Part 21J Design Organisation or an international equivalent is a plus.

  • Knowledge of systems engineering and safety assessment methodologies, such as SAE ARP4754A and ARP4761, would be beneficial.

  • Specialized expertise in thermal management, high-voltage insulation systems, EMC, electric machine mechanics and vibration, or propulsion-system integration is an advantage.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.
