title: Senior QA Specialist
descriptionHtml:
About us

Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 100+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role

Thousands of rental companies run their business on Rentman, and many of them depend on it talking smoothly to the rest of their stack: accounting packages, webshops, calendars, and our public API. When an integration breaks, invoices don’t sync, bookings go missing, and customers notice fast.

As Senior QA Specialist for the Integrations team, you make sure every release reaches those customers without regressions. You own the team’s test strategy and lead the move from manual release-day testing to an automated, shift-left suite. This is a role with real ownership: you shape how the team thinks about quality, and you grow the practice as our integrations platform grows.

What you'll do

  • Join refinement with the Integrations team and write Gherkin (Given/When/Then) acceptance specs that developers turn into tests

  • Test new integrations and API changes end to end: our side, the partner’s side, and everything that can go wrong between them (auth, rate limits, partial syncs, retries, data mapping)

  • Explore beyond the acceptance criteria to find edge cases, and file clear, reproducible bug reports in Jira

  • Build and maintain automated tests in TypeScript, with API and contract tests alongside Playwright E2E tests, and review the tests developers write in pull requests

  • Own the daily automated regression run in GitHub Actions: triage failures the same day and fix flaky tests at the root cause, including ones caused by unreliable third-party sandboxes

  • Run release-day regression and the OWASP ZAP security scan, and give a clear go / no-go call

  • Migrate the remaining legacy tests and decide what’s worth automating and what stays manual

  • Coach developers so they own their tests, and organise QA days with the other product teams

     

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years in QA on web applications

  • Hands-on experience testing REST APIs and integrations with external systems (Postman, Playwright API testing or similar), including authentication flows like OAuth and webhooks

  • At least 2 years writing and maintaining test automation in code (Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, ideally TypeScript/JavaScript), not only record-and-play tools

  • Strong exploratory testing skills, with bug reports developers can act on without follow-up questions

  • You’ve defined a test strategy (what to automate, what to test manually, coverage), not only executed test cases

  • Experience running automated tests in CI (GitHub Actions or similar)

  • You get developers to adopt new habits through pairing, good examples and clear specs, not by policing

     

Nice to haves

  • Experience with complex B2B SaaS, ideally with a public API or integration marketplace

  • Contract testing (e.g. Pact) or mocking third-party services

  • Playwright specifically, and Gherkin / BDD

  • Experience leading a shift-left change

  • Testing integrations with accounting or finance software

  • Basic security testing (e.g. OWASP ZAP)

What you’ll get

  • Competitive salary based on experience, plus 8% holiday allowance

  • A results-based bonus based on company performance (up to a full 13th month's salary)

  • 25 vacation days to recharge

  • Earn an extra day of PTO for each year at Rentman, from your second anniversary up to five years.

  • A 4-week paid sabbatical after 5 years to go on an adventure

  • Flexible WFH policy & work from anywhere for 4 weeks a year

  • Pension plan through BrightPensioen

  • An annual training budget to grow your skills

  • Access to OpenUp for mental well-being and personal growth

  • Your choice of a shiny new Windows, Linux, or Mac

  • Stay active with the team: join the Rentman football team, squash and padel, plus a discounted Urban Sports membership

  • An OV Business card if you live more than 10km from the office

  • An ambitious, inclusive, and diverse international team

  • A flexible, energizing workplace with free lunches, office perks (PS5, ping pong, D&D), legendary karaoke nights, and regular team activities

  • An amazing office in the heart of Utrecht, in the historic Drift 17

Our process

  • Past Experience & Culture Interview with the team, online (60 mins)

  • Final Skills Interview, on-site (60 mins)

Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die Besetzung von Rollen über alle Funktionen und Senioritätsstufen hinweg – von Fachexpert:innen bis Führungspositionen – und gestaltest gleichzeitig aktiv mit, wie Talent Acquisition bei uns strukturell und strategisch weiterwächst.

Wir suchen jemanden, der im Recruiting bereits angekommen ist - mit fundierter Praxis, einem klaren Verständnis für die Mechanik guter Prozesse und dem Ehrgeiz, den Bereich aktiv mitzuprägen. Du bewegst dich souverän zwischen operativer Exzellenz und strategischem Weitblick, zwischen Tempo und Präzision, zwischen Beratung und klarer Kante gegenüber Stakeholdern bis auf C-Level.

Recruiting bei uns ist kein ruhiges Gewässer. Es ist schnell, anspruchsvoll und ergebnisorientiert. Genau das soll dich reizen, nicht abschrecken.

Was du bewegst

Operative Exzellenz

  • End-to-End-Verantwortung für den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess über alle Funktionen und Level, mit strukturierter, kompetenzbasierter Interviewführung mit hohem Anspruch an Qualität und Fairness

  • Sparringspartner:in für Hiring Manager, Leadership und C-Level, von der Anforderungsschärfung bis zur finalen Entscheidung

  • Steuerung mehrerer kritischer Suchen parallel, mit transparenter Kommunikation an Stakeholder und Kandidat:innen und einer Candidate Experience, die auch unter Zeitdruck überzeugt

  • Aktives Sourcing, gezielte Marktbearbeitung und Aufbau strategischer Talent Pools für wiederkehrend gefragte Profile

Planung, Reporting und Steuerung

  • Austausch mit den Hiring Manager:innen über den Bedarf, aktuell rund 30 Hires im kommenden Jahr inklusive Replacements

  • Steuerung des Budgets für Stellenanzeigen und Optimierung der Kanäle nach Performance

  • Definition von Recruiting-KPIs, Steigerung der Funnel-Conversion und konsequentes Nachschärfen bei Engpässen

  • Regelmäßiges Reporting der Recruiting-Kennzahlen insbesondere für Business Reviews

Strategische Weiterentwicklung von TA

  • Weiterentwicklung von Talent Acquisition in enger Abstimmung mit dem Head of People & Culture, strukturell, prozessual und strategisch

  • Entwicklung von Active-Search-Strategien und Aufbau externer Partnerschaften für ein schlagkräftigeres Recruiting

  • Verantwortung für Recruiting-Tools und -Systeme, von der Auswahl bis zur Optimierung, mit sauberen, verlässlichen Recruiting-Daten und definierten Prozessstandards

  • Kontinuierliche Prozessweiterentwicklung, inklusive Prüfung des sinnvollen Einsatzes von KI im Recruiting


DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • Mehrjährige, nachweisbare Recruiting-Praxis, idealerweise über mehrere Funktionen und Senioritätsstufen hinweg, inklusive Steuerung kompletter Recruiting-Prozesse und der Tool-Landschaft

  • Erfahrung im Austausch mit Hiring Manager:innen über Bedarfe und im Reporting gegenüber Senior Stakeholdern

  • Ein fundiertes Verständnis für strukturierte, datenbasierte Prozesse und Active Sourcing

  • Analytisches Denken für Funnel, Kennzahlen und Prozessqualität

  • Sicheres Auftreten im Umgang mit Senior Stakeholdern bis zur Geschäftsführung

  • Souveränität, Verhandlungsgeschick und den Mut, auch unbequeme Empfehlungen klar und respektvoll auszusprechen

  • Die Fähigkeit, operativ tief einzusteigen und gleichzeitig strategisch den Überblick zu behalten

  • Ein „Do-it“-Mindset, Teamfähigkeit, Selbstbewusstsein sowie eine lösungs- und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise

  • Belastbarkeit und einen kühlen Kopf, wenn mehrere kritische Suchen gleichzeitig laufen

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse

NOCH FRAGEN?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter!

DAS BIETEN WIR

  • Office Foodji & Lunchit App: Immer bestens versorgt

  • bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente

  • Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung

  • EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios

  • JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec

  • KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands

  • Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen

  • Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Entwicklungspfade

  • Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland

  • Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür

  • Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam!

ÜBER UNS

Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds.

Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst.

Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür.

Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns.

Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt.

title: Senior Robotic Learning Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
The AI Teams at Agile Robots are looking for a Senior Robotic Learning Engineer (m/f/d), who will architect the full pipeline that turns raw robot and human data into deployed foundation models, from collection through post-training to on-robot deployment.

Your Responsibilities

  • System Architecture: Own how collection, generation, augmentation, annotation, valuation, and evaluation fit together as one coherent data-to-model pipeline, and prioritize engineering investment where it most improves model performance.
  • Model Evaluation & Deployment: Integrate post-training and evaluation frameworks, in simulation and on real hardware, and own the path to reliable, automatic deployment on robotic platforms.
  • Data Valuation & Curation: Develop methods and metrics to assess data quality and value — diversity, coverage, redundancy, task relevance — and use them to guide what gets collected, kept, or discarded.
  • Data Generation: Build synthetic and simulation-based data generation pipelines, including real-to-sim-to-real transfer, procedural task and scene generation, and generative models, to scale training data beyond physical collection alone.
  • Data Collection: Design scalable systems for collecting both robot-generated data (teleoperation, autonomous rollouts, scripted policies) and human data (egocentric video, demonstrations) to train imitation learning and VLA models.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with research scientists, robotics engineers, and infrastructure teams to translate model and research needs into production data and evaluation systems.

Essential Skills

  • Background: Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of formal training and professional experience.
  • Professional Experience: 5+ years in robotics, autonomous driving, machine learning, or data engineering, with demonstrated ownership of systems spanning multiple pipeline stages, not a single component.
  • Robot Learning: Hands-on experience with imitation learning, Vision-Language-Action models, robot foundation models, reinforcement learning, or other learning-based approaches to robotics.
  • Programming: Software engineering proficiency in Python sufficient to build production-grade, reliable systems rather than research prototypes; familiarity with C++ is a plus.
  • Systems-Level Thinking: Ability to reason about how a decision at one pipeline stage — what data is collected — affects outcomes at another, such as model performance or evaluation results, and to design across those boundaries.

Beneficial Skills

  • Simulation: Experience with simulation platforms such as Isaac Sim or MuJoCo for synthetic data generation and sim-to-real transfer.
  • Data Valuation Techniques: Familiarity with active learning, coreset selection, influence functions, or other methods for quantifying training data value.
  • Human Data Collection: Experience with egocentric data collection, AR/VR devices, hand tracking, or teleoperation frameworks for embodied AI.
  • Data Systems: Experience designing and operating large-scale data pipelines — collection, storage, processing, labeling — for machine learning training.
  • Deployment & MLOps: Experience with model serving, edge or real-time inference, or cloud-based deployment infrastructure.

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots is a leading provider of AI-powered robotics solutions. By combining artificial intelligence and robotics, the company makes industries smarter, more flexible, and more efficient. 

Founded in Munich in 2018 by renowned robotics researchers from the German Aerospace Center (DLR), Agile Robots has experienced rapid global growth. Today, more than 3,500 highly skilled robotics and AI enthusiasts are employed worldwide. The company has one of the largest research and development teams in the AI and robotics industry. 

Agile Robots has built a unique portfolio; together with the subsidiaries BÄR Automation, Franka Robotics, idealworks, and Krause Automation, the company covers all areas of AI-driven robotics.

Find out more at: https://www.agile-robots.com/en/

title: Senior Sales Engineer, France
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Senior Sales Engineer at Samsara, you'd be part of a diverse group of both technically and business minded folks working together to bring our unique connected operations technology to customers. Our daily customer engagements include conversations around logistics/supply chain management, fleet management and maintenance strategies, global asset management, system integrations, and regulatory compliance. This means a successful Sales Engineer at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of IoT hardware and sensors, hands-on installation/deployment scenarios, carrier networks, cloud infrastructure, and third-party system integrations (via our open API) to ensure the proper technical solution is presented to our customers.

This is a unique opportunity to support and grow a key market for Samsara in close collaboration with other areas of the business: Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Technical Support, and Customer Success.

This role can be office-based (Paris) or fully remote in France. This role requires travel up to 25% of the time.

In this role, you will:

  • Become an expert on Samsara products: where the rubber of cutting-edge tech (IoT, AI, computer vision) meets the road of driving digital transformation for physical operations.
  • Articulate to prospects how businesses like theirs use Samsara today to solve problems common to their industry.
  • Deliver the work products that get deals done. Think discoveries, demonstrations, value assessments, proof of concept implementations, etc.
  • Write scripts against our open API that solve real-world problems for companies that deliver essential services (for example), and document them for your fellow SEs to use.
  • Open the door for deeper entrenchment into accounts (integration, upsell, cross-sell) by becoming a consultant to your customers.
  • Act as a liaison between Samsara's product and sales teams, translating technical feedback and enrolling the right customers in our beta programs.
  • Partner with sales executives to plan, prepare, and execute transactions in rapid sales cycles.
  • Work in multiple levels of the technology stack.
  • Support sales executives ad-hoc queries and emails.
  • Build relationships with third-party partners, such as software providers, systems integrators, and installation partners.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 4+ years experience working with customers in a pre-sales, customer success, or customer/product support capacity.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders based on your technical sales acumen and a solid understanding of business processes and change management.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Knowledge of MEDDIC/BANT/CoM and/or Value Selling sales concepts.
  • Previous experience managing hardware and/or software product evaluations.
  • Basic understanding of electronics and electrical systems.
  • Experience with the following concepts: technical consulting, cloud software, cloud-connected hardware, computer networking, business systems integration, automation, and control systems.
  • Fluent in French and English
  • Great time management and organizational skills to work on multiple accounts and projects at different stages.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Work experience in task automation scripting and transferring data between systems using Bash, Python, JavaScript, or equivalent language.
  • Work experience building solutions leveraging open APIs.
  • Understanding of vehicle diagnostic systems, including Controller Area Networks (CAN bus) and Power Take Off (PTO) applications.
  • Hobbyist interest in working with things driven by electronic systems (car audio installation/classic car restoration, home automation, building things with Raspberry Pi, Arduino, etc.).
  • Consistent track record of success selling complex technical solutions through strategic sales cycles.
  • Experience working with product teams internally and feature request processes.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

descriptionHtml:
About us

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production.

Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

About the role

As Lead Security Engineer, you'll own application security across our platform, embedding secure practices into how we design, build, and ship software, and setting the direction for a growing security function.

What you'll do

  • Own the application security program end to end: threat modelling, secure design reviews, code review, and vulnerability management.

  • Build security into the SDLC with SAST, DAST, dependency/SCA, and secrets scanning integrated into CI/CD without slowing teams down.

  • Partner with engineering on authentication, authorization, multi-tenancy isolation, and data protection across our APIs and SDKs.

  • Lead penetration testing, bug bounty triage, and incident response for application-layer issues.

  • Support customer security reviews and compliance (SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR) with practical technical controls.

  • Mentor engineers and raise the security bar across the organisation.

title: Senior Security Engineer - Enterprise Security
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

The Senior Security Engineer – Enterprise Security shares ownership of the day-to-day operation of the Samsara security environment. You will keep our network access, device trust, and visibility systems running, tuned, and resilient at enterprise scale in partnership with a global team. Utilizing modern principles, you'll maintain and evolve a modern zero trust program, spend time both on policy design and real-time triage for escalations.

You take security seriously and believe the best solutions are low-friction and built in partnership with others. You are comfortable owning and maintaining production systems for long term success - troubleshooting systemic issues, tuning policies based on real incidents, and continuously improving what is already built. You bring an automation mindset to repetitive work, whether using Python, SOAR platforms, or AI-assisted tools. You enjoy supporting teammates and helping other engineers build their security knowledge.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United Kingdom. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

About this team:

Enterprise Security is a global team spanning the US, EMEA, and India. We work in close partnership with our coworkers as collaborators rather than gatekeepers. Leadership is hands-on and technical, and our culture encourages everyone to contribute across the full stack.

Executive leadership actively champions security as a competitive advantage that builds customer trust and helps win enterprise partnerships. You will see a direct line between the zero trust systems you operate and the security that protects our physical operations partners worldwide. Our on-call rotation for the highest severity incidents is spread evenly across the team for one week out of every ten.

In this role, you will:

  • Co-own the day-to-day operation, triage, and tuning of the Samsara endpoint security environment by responding to escalations, investigating anomalies, and resolving issues
  • Continuously improve existing endpoint visibility tools and workflows in partnership with our Security Operations team, and based on real usage patterns and incident learnings
  • Write clear, concise documentation and runbooks for enterprise security workflows
  • Collaborate with partners across Engineering, IT, and Security to ensure proper implementation of security tools and policies
  • Assist the Security Operations team during security investigations, acting as a technical subject matter expert within your domain
  • Partner with engineering teams to triage and support remediation of vulnerabilities and misconfigurations
  • Mentor engineers on the Security team to grow their domain knowledge, tool-specific skills, and communication abilities
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team)

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in an Enterprise Security role with demonstrated impact
  • Hands-on experience operating and maintaining endpoint security and visibility tools at enterprise scale (e.g. Crowdstrike, osquery, or similar)
  • Exposure to at least one additional enterprise security tool stack beyond endpoint security, such as Secure Access Service Edge (SASE), zero trust systems, email security, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), or Identity and Access Management (IAM)
  • An automation mindset with experience scripting and debugging code with Python (with or without AIassistance) and using SOAR platforms
  • Strong familiarity with common security challenges and the ability to independently evaluate their severity and business impact
  • Track record of delivering impactful work across multiple quarters and collaborating effectively across teams

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Significant breadth across the endpoint security ecosystem, including designing layered controls with EDR tools, passive telemetry, integration with threat intelligence feeds, and operation in cloud and containerized environments.
  • History of building out security programs using modern SaaS security platforms such as Crowdstrike, Mimecast Incydr, and Splunk
  • Experience with infrastructure as code deployments using Terraform
  • Experience with AI-driven automations

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. title: Senior SEO & GEO Manager (m/w/d)/ AI affin, Vollzeit und Teilzeit
descriptionHtml:
Senior SEO & GEO Manager (m/w/d) – mit Option auf Head of SEO & GEO – OTE 130.000 € – Vollzeit – Remote, hybrid oder vor Ort in München oder Wien

Die meisten SEO-Stellen suchen jemanden, der Tickets abarbeitet. Wir suchen jemanden, der uns sagt, welche Tickets es überhaupt geben sollte. Wir suchen den "Unternehmer" innerhalb eines Unternehmen.

-- Bitte lesen, wie man sich unten bewerben sollte --

Über uns

Wir bauen gerade eine zweite Business Unit auf: GEO-SEO für ausgewählte Nischen, die die großen Agenturen nicht beachten. Gemeint ist Sichtbarkeit dort, wo Menschen heute fragen, also bei Google und in ChatGPT, Perplexity und Gemini. Die Nachfrage haben wir in den ersten Verkaufsgesprächen bereits bestätigt.

Zielgruppen z.B.: Tierärzte, Versicherungsmakler, Zahnärzte, kleiner Hotels, etc.

Im ersten Schritt konzentrieren wir uns auf eine, welche wir gemeinsam auswählen.

Ganz wichtig: Du baust von Grund alleine mit deinem Wissen, diese Business Unit auf.

Dahinter steht Joberg, eine "kleine" aber feine Marketing-Agentur. Unser erstes Standbein sind Paket-Mailings, mit denen unsere Kund:innen auf dem Schreibtisch von Entscheider:innen landen. Mit der neuen Unit expandieren wir in den SEO/GEO und vielleicht in der Zukunft in den SEA/GEA Markt. Was dafür noch fehlt, bist du.

Bei uns gibt es flache Hierarchien, kurze Wege und keine Büropolitik. Wir arbeiten konzentriert, haben dabei Spaß und nehmen uns selbst nicht zu ernst. Wir finden, dass ein Job, der Spaß macht, und ein richtig gutes Gehalt sich nicht ausschließen.

Ehrlich gesagt

Es gibt noch keinen Prozess, kein Team und kein Handbuch. Das ist kein Mangel, das ist der Job. Du bist Person Nummer eins in diesem Bereich und trägst 100 % der Verantwortung für die Umsetzung. Den Plan schreibst du. Und wenn du findest, dass wir falsch liegen, sag es. Genau dafür suchen wir dich.

Deine Perspektive

Du startest als Senior SEO & GEO Manager und setzt selbst um. Wenn der Bereich wächst, hast du die Option, dich zum Head of SEO & GEO zu entwickeln und ein eigenes Team aufzubauen. Wie und wann, gestalten wir gemeinsam.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Du setzt SEO, GEO und Bewertungsmanagement für unsere Kund:innen um, von der Analyse bis zum Ergebnis.

  • Du findest heraus, was ein Unternehmen in KI-Antworten nach vorne bringt, und machst daraus eine wiederholbare Methode(Framework/SOP).

  • Du baust das Fulfillment, die automatisierten Workflows mit KI so auf, dass es mit jedem neuen Kunden besser wird und nicht langsamer.

  • Du sagst uns, welche Nischen sich deiner Meinung nach lohnen und welche nicht.

Was du kannst

  • Google kennst du in- und auswendig: Google Business Profile, Search Console, lokale Rankings und AI Overviews.

  • Du weißt, wie ChatGPT, Perplexity und Gemini Quellen auswählen und Unternehmen empfehlen.

  • Du erstellst Websites und Landingpages automatisiert und optimierst sie für SEO und GEO, inklusive strukturierter Daten.

  • Du beherrschst Bewertungsmanagement: mehr echte Bewertungen gewinnen und professionell darauf antworten.

  • Du baust Workflows mit KI und Automationstools, etwa über APIs, n8n oder Make.

  • Du misst Ergebnisse und erklärst sie so, dass Kund:innen sie verstehen.

Woran wir merken, dass du es bist

  • Du lebst KI. Du nutzt sie jeden Tag, beruflich wie privat, und probierst neue Modelle aus, bevor jemand danach fragt.

  • Du bist neugierig und ruhst dich nie auf dem Status quo aus. Was gestern funktioniert hat, stellst du heute infrage.

  • Wir müssen dir nichts erklären. Du erklärst uns Dinge, die wir noch nicht wussten.

  • Du bist digital affin und brauchst niemanden, der dir Aufgaben gibt.

  • Du hast mindestens 3 Jahre SEO-Erfahrung, mit einem deutlichen Anteil Local SEO. Je mehr desto besser

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse.

  • Du bist einfach eine coole, sympathische Person :)

Was du von uns bekommst

  • Eine echte Founding Role mit der Option, Head of SEO & GEO zu werden

  • Ein Gesamteinkommen (OTE) weit über dem Markt, denn wir sind margenstark und teilen den Erfolg

  • Workations: Arbeite auch mal ein paar Wochen von dort, wo andere Urlaub machen.

  • Arbeiten, wo du willst: remote, hybrid oder vor Ort in München oder Wien

  • Flache Hierarchien: keine Freigabeschleifen, eine Entscheidung dauert bei uns ein Telefonat.

  • Budget für die KI-Tools, die du brauchst

  • Start ab Januar 2027 oder wann es für dich passt

Gehalt: Fixum 56.200 € brutto im Jahr. On-Target-Earnings (OTE): 130.000 € im Jahr. Wie sich die OTE zusammensetzen, erklären wir dir im ersten Gespräch.

So bewirbst du dich

Bewerben Sie sich mit dem Button auf dieser Seite.

  1. Deinen Lebenslauf

  2. Ein kurzes Motivationsschreiben, maximal eine Seite: Warum reizt dich genau diese Rolle, und was würdest du in den ersten 90 Tagen anders machen als die meisten? Und wie nutzt du KI heute schon im Alltag?

  3. Ein Vorstellungsvideo von 1 bis 3 Minuten (die Handykamera reicht, schick einfach den Link). Jeder Extra-Aufwand fließt positiv in die Bewertung ein, ist aber kein Muss.

Du hörst innerhalb von 5 Werktagen von uns, auch wenn es ein Nein ist.

  • Du kennst jemanden, der perfekt passt? Schick uns den Kontakt. Führt deine Empfehlung zur Einstellung, bedanken wir uns mit 3.000 €, sobald die Person die Probezeit bestanden hat.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Data Platform, C++)
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

#LI-MM1

We’re looking for a Software Engineer with strong C++ expertise to join the team building and operating Nebius Data Platform — a distributed storage and a processing platform that acts as the company’s “source of truth” and the backbone of many internal (and some external) products.

Nebius Data Platform is a single multi-tenant ecosystem based on YTsaurus — instead of running separate HDFS/Kafka/HBase-style systems, we provide storage, compute, and analytics capabilities inside one platform.

Built on top of the open-source YTsaurus ecosystem, we run and extend our own Nebius distribution and develop significant in-house functionality (core and platform-level). We can design, implement, and roll out features end-to-end on our clusters without waiting for upstream approvals and contribute upstream when it makes sense.

At scale today, this includes~500 servers, ~20k CPU cores and ~10 PB of compressed data in our largest production cluster, supporting workloads ranging from business-critical pipelines and financial transactions to large-scale ML/LLM training datasets and compute.

What’s inside the platform

You’ll work on a system that includes (and ties together):

  • Distributed Storage (Cypress): transactional semantics, tiered storage, erasure coding, replication, and strong reliability expectations.
  • Compute & ETL: a cluster-wide job scheduler (tens of thousands of cores), MapReduce, YQL for SQL-like data processing, and SPYT (Spark over YTsaurus) for modern data engineering.
  • Interactive analytics (CHYT): ClickHouse® instances spun up directly on compute nodes for fast SQL over data in-place.
  • Dynamic Tables: low-latency NoSQL KV with distributed ACID transactions for OLTP-style workloads and feature stores.
  • Orchestracto: workflow orchestration deeply integrated with the platform (Airflow-like, but platform-native).

What you’ll do

We’re looking for engineers who combine strong systems skills with product sense: understanding who uses the platform, why certain capabilities matter, and making pragmatic trade-offs to maximize impact. On our team, engineering work is expected to be connected to real users and outcomes — you’ll regularly align with internal stakeholders, clarify requirements, and help drive prioritization.

In this role, you will:

  • Design and implement new functionality in YTsaurus core (C++) with production reliability in mind.
  • Build and evolve platform-level capabilities: platform architecture and operating model—multi-cluster growth, shared primitives, and a consistent experience that scales with new teams and use cases.
  • Improve end-to-end platform experience for internal (and external-facing) users: APIs, guardrails, debugging workflows, and automation.
  • Own production quality: incident response / on-call rotation, root cause analysis, and turning learnings into durable fixes.

Example projects

  • Roll out sharded YTsaurus masters (incl. Kubernetes operator support) and build automatic balancing of metadata across master cells (consensus groups) to remove control-plane bottlenecks and unlock 10–100x cluster growth.
  • Make CHYT interactive SQL faster and more predictable at high load via performance work like data-skipping / min-max-style indexes and improved execution introspection.
  • Turn Orchestracto into a platform product by defining the building blocks, developer experience, and governance for how teams create and share workflows.
  • Scale and harden Parquet-on-S3 for native YTsaurus workloads by tackling replication/movement, consistent lifecycle semantics, and master-server metadata optimizations for performance and reliability.
  • Design and ship complete, trustworthy audit trails for data changes (who/what/when) across heterogeneous storage and compute paths.

Tech stack

  • Core: modern C++ (C++20, async + multithreaded primitives)
  • Services & tooling: Go and Python (microservices, utilities, integration tests)

What we expect

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience.
  • Strong C++ skills (you’ll write core code).
  • Working knowledge of Python and/or Go (you don’t have to be expert, but should be comfortable navigating them).
  • Experience developing and/or operating high-load, distributed services.
  • Production mindset: ability to use SSH, read logs/metrics/traces, and debug distributed systems behavior.
  • Solid CS fundamentals: algorithms, data structures, concurrency basics.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Big Data systems (YTsaurus/Hadoop/Spark/ClickHouse/Kafka-like ecosystems).
  • Experience with multi-tenant platforms, schedulers, resource isolation, quotas, and reliability engineering.
  • Strong performance engineering skills (profiling, lock contention, latency/throughput tradeoffs).

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership

  • International environment and talented teams

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Senior Software Engineer (Managed PostgreSQL)
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

The role 

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help us build the best Managed PostgreSQL for AI workloads. The service is already in production; the mission now is to make it the obvious choice for teams running AI applications on Postgres — first-class vector search, painless migrations from RDS / Cloud SQL / self-managed clusters, and the operational quality of a mature managed database.

You'll work across the stack: control plane and lifecycle automation in Go, Postgres internals and performance, migration tooling, and the customer escalations where it actually matters.

You're welcome to work from our offices in Amsterdam or London, hybrid or remotely from EU timezones.

Your responsibilities:

title: Senior Software Engineer — ML Inference & Numerics
descriptionHtml:
About Tensordyne 

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

The role

Help make the latest AI models run well on our silicon. You’ll work from model code to measured hardware performance: bring up new architectures, track down accuracy failures, and improve latency, throughput, and memory use.

The bigger challenge is making that work repeatable. You’ll build an agentic harness that can explore implementations, run experiments, check results, and guide the next change. Every investigation should leave behind better software, better tests, and a shorter path for the next model.

We’re looking for an excellent software engineer who understands LLM inference deeply and knows how to put coding agents to work. You’ll own substantial parts of our SDK and work closely with engineers across models, compilers, runtime, and hardware. Your particular focus will be numerical optimization: finding where precision matters, where computation can be cheaper, and how to preserve model quality.

What you’ll do

  • Build the agentic workflows. Give agents the tools to inspect models, change implementations and numerical settings, run emulation and hardware experiments, and diagnose failures. Build the feedback and evaluation that make the results trustworthy.
  • Bring up new models quickly; make them go brrrr. Work with engineers across the stack to take unfamiliar architectures from reference code to validated, performant execution on our accelerator. Turn what you learn into reusable model support and SDK improvements.
  • Optimize numerics. Explore precision, accumulation, and quantization choices across the model. Understand how they interact with kernels, KV caches, memory, and distributed execution, then measure the gains in latency, throughput, and memory use against model quality on silicon.
  • Make numerical quality measurable. Build conversion and emulation software that lets you test numerical choices quickly. Compare activations and outputs against reference models, trace accuracy regressions to their source, and validate changes with end-to-end model evaluations.
  • Ship software that lasts. Own design, implementation, testing, and delivery. Build clear APIs that are easy to use for agents. Make difficult bugs reproducible and keep them from returning. Know when to build fast, and when to build thoroughly.
  • Shape the next chip. Work with hardware architects to test how numerical formats and arithmetic choices affect real models. Turn those findings into better hardware and algorithm designs.

What we need from you

  • You understand LLM inference end to end. You can read a new model’s implementation and reason about prefill, decode, attention, KV caches, MoE, batching, and parallelism. You understand how these translate into compute, memory, and communication on an accelerator.
  • You build excellent software. You’ve owned substantial systems and delivered complex features from design through production. You’re strong in Python, thoughtful about interfaces, and rigorous about abstractions and testing.
  • You are fluent with agentic tooling. You’d rather build the agent that runs the optimization than doing it by hand; and running numerous agents in parallel excites you. You know what is required for agents to work effectively in a large software organization, and you have the judgement when an agentic loop still needs a human.
  • You take ownership and bring others along. You form clear hypotheses, test them, and drive problems to resolution across software boundaries. You communicate clearly through specs, design docs, and reviews that people and agents can act on. You explain complex trade-offs, give direct feedback, and make the people around you better.

If you tick a few of these boxes, we’d love to hear from you.

We’d be thrilled if you had

  • Expertise in improving inference systems like debugging and optimizing the runtime of complex models and reasoning about accuracy-performance trade-offs.
  • Experience with ML compilers, accelerator SDKs, or model compression libraries, particularly for non-NVIDIA accelerators such as TPU, Trainium/Inferentia, Tenstorrent, Groq, or Cerebras.
  • Experience with model quantization, sparsity, codebooks, low-rank factorization or other compression techniques.
  • Contributions to distributed inference or serving frameworks such as vLLM or SGLang.

Why join us

Your code will help determine how quickly we support new models, how efficiently they run, and what we build into our next chip. You’ll own meaningful software, work directly with the people designing the hardware, and see your decisions tested on real silicon.

If you want to build the tools, solve the hard failures, and help set the engineering direction of a new inference platform, we’d like to hear from you.

Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values

  • Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed.
  • Ethics and integrity always. Be open, honest, and respectful of everyone.
  • Think Big. Be ambitious and have audacious goals.
  • Aim for excellence. Quality and excellence count in everything we do.
  • Own it and get it done. Results matter!
  • Make each person better together than they would be as an individual.
  • Embrace each other’s differences, and embrace that there will be differences.

Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams are better equipped to solve complex problems and build exceptional technology. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

title: Senior Systems Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry.
Its offerings include a very energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers.
Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components.
Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.
Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Description of the Team/Project

We are looking for a senior Systems Engineer to join our Program & Systems Engineering department and contribute to the development of our photonic quantum computing systems, including strategic programs such as QBI Phase B and PROQCIMA+.

As our first dedicated Systems Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the technical consistency of our complex systems, bringing together photonics, electronics, mechanics, cryogenics and software. You will own the system technical baseline, working with domain experts who contribute to subsystem expertise and detailed technical inputs.

Working closely with multidisciplinary R&D teams and reporting to the CTO, you will operate as a peer of the Program Manager, with a dotted-line relationship for program priorities. You will own the definition and implementation of systems engineering practices, from requirements definition and system architecture to integration, verification and validation. You will provide technical recommendations and escalate unresolved trade-offs to the CTO, while Program and Project Managers own priorities, budgets and delivery planning.

Your Key Responsibilities:

  • System architecture & requirements: Define and maintain system-level requirements, translate them into subsystem specifications, and ensure consistency and traceability throughout development. Own the system architecture and controlled technical baseline, consolidating contributions from domain experts and requirements from customer projects in coordination with the relevant Project Manager.
  • Interface management: Coordinate technical interfaces between subsystems, identify dependencies, and ensure compatibility across engineering disciplines. Establish Interface Control Documents (ICDs), with a named technical owner on each side of each interface.
  • Verification & validation: Define system-level V&V strategies, acceptance criteria to ensure system performance and compliance with requirements. Own the V&V plan and organize requirements and architecture, design, and integration-readiness reviews, with clear readiness criteria and traceability between requirements and verification evidence.
  • Technical coordination & risk management: Assess design trade-offs and support engineering teams in resolving complex integration challenges. Take ownership of technical risks in the shared risk register and propose mitigation actions. Work with Program and Project Managers to assess cost and schedule implications, escalating unresolved disagreements to the CTO.
  • Change control: Assess the technical impact of proposed changes to requirements, architecture, interfaces and supplier specifications or parts. Support the change-control process chaired by the Program Manager, with cost and schedule assessments provided by the Project Manager, and maintain the approved technical baseline.
  • Roadmap contributions: Provide technical inputs to the integrated multi-year roadmap, including technical dependencies, constraints affecting the critical path and readiness criteria for technical gates. Support Program and Project Managers in aligning technical milestones with resources and budgets.
  • Systems engineering processes: Establish and continuously improve pragmatic engineering methodologies, documentation and tools adapted to a fast-growing R&D environment. Define roles, responsibilities and processes before selecting tools. Prioritize requirements and traceability, interface control, change control, technical reviews and V&V; pilot lightweight processes on one project, obtain CTO approval and support wider adoption.
  • Engineering tools: Own requirements and traceability tools, define needs and lead evaluations and pilots for CTO approval. Build on the existing environment and introduce dedicated requirements management or model-based systems engineering (MBSE) tools only when justified by system complexity or practical limitations.

Requirements

  • Engineering degree or equivalent qualification in systems engineering, physics, electronics, photonics, mechatronics or related fields.
  • Solid experience (+8 years) in systems engineering, system architecture, or multidisciplinary system integration, ideally involving complex hardware and software systems. Experience taking technical responsibility for large, complex systems and establishing a controlled requirements and architecture baseline is particularly relevant.
  • Strong understanding of requirements engineering, interface management, technical risk assessment and verification & validation methodologies, including requirements traceability, ICDs and technical change-impact assessment.
  • Ability to integrate domain experts’ contributions into a coherent system architecture and work effectively alongside Program and Project Managers.
  • Ability to structure systems engineering practices while remaining pragmatic and hands-on in an evolving R&D environment.
  • Experience introducing systems engineering processes or tools in a growing organization. Ability to define process needs first and scale tools accordingly; familiarity with requirements management and MBSE approaches is an advantage.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to challenge technical decisions. Ability to explain technical trade-offs, make clear recommendations, and escalate unresolved issues constructively.
  • Professional proficiency in English.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • A hybrid work model (3-4 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris or 1 to 2 days remotely)
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

Process

  • Hiring Managers Interview (45')
  • Use Case (a live use case or one to be prepared at home and presented afterward)
  • Meeting with the teams
  • 2 to 3 reference check
  • Offer

(This process is provided for guidance only and may evolve depending on the roles)

title: Senior Systems & Infrastructure Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Join SE3 Labs as Senior Systems & Infrastructure Engineer

Join our new Software Platform team and make the devices, networks and compute behind SE3's autonomy run reliably, so our engineers can focus on what they do best.

About SE3

SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.

We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our Software Platform team, help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

Our founding team's research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field.

About the Role

As Senior Systems & Infrastructure Engineer, you'll be a founding member of our new Software Platform team and own everything infrastructure apart from cybersecurity: software distribution to our platforms, device provisioning, networks, our compute cluster and CI. You'll work on-site in Munich alongside our cybersecurity engineer and the CV, robotics and firmware teams, with occasional visits to our second site.

What You'll Work On

  • Over-the-Air Updates: Unify our separate update and software distribution setups for Jetson, NXP and other edge nodes into one reliable system for every platform.

  • Device Provisioning: Provision, configure and maintain Linux-based edge devices, workstations and ground systems, including ARM64 platforms.

  • Deployment Automation: Build reproducible container images, deployments, device configuration, release workflows and recovery procedures, with Bash and Python tooling.

  • Networks & Remote Access: Design and troubleshoot connectivity across networked and remote devices, including routing, SSH, VPNs, firewalls and constrained field links.

  • Compute Cluster & CI: Make our GPU compute and evaluation cluster and self-hosted CI runners reliable, so engineers can depend on them without manual recovery.

  • Monitoring & Documentation: Improve monitoring, service availability, security hygiene and operational documentation, working closely with our cybersecurity engineer.

  • Engineering Standards: Set the infrastructure standards our teams follow, and support firmware, robotics, CV and test teams in the lab and the field.

Your Profile

  • You take ownership across many areas at once and enjoy covering several roles in a small team, from planning a system to fixing it by hand.

  • You hold a degree in Computer Science or a closely related field.

  • You bring around five years of hands-on experience in infrastructure, DevOps or Linux systems engineering, ideally in a small IT or platform team, and you can point to real systems you built and ran.

  • You have distributed and updated software across large fleets of devices, whether laptops, servers or embedded systems.

  • You have strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills, write reliable Bash and Python automation, and understand your systems well enough to catch the edge cases tools miss.

  • You can debug IP networks end to end, including routing, DNS, SSH, VPNs and firewalls, and you're experienced with Docker and container deployment.

  • You speak fluent English; German is a plus. Given the nature of SE3's work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to work on defence-related projects and, where required, obtain the relevant security clearance.

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • Embedded Linux on NVIDIA Jetson or NXP, Yocto/BSP, flashing or hardware bring-up.

  • GPU compute clusters, Slurm or Kubernetes, and self-hosted GitHub Actions runners.

  • Infrastructure automation or observability with Ansible, Terraform, Prometheus or Grafana.

  • ROS 2/DDS, MAVLink or field robotics.

  • Involvement in technical student groups or societies during university.

Perks & Benefits

  • Real Ownership: Participate in SE3's growth through our employee participation programme

  • Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you

  • AI-boosted workplace: We empower every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge

  • 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

  • Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

  • Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece

  • Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

Our Process

  1. Intro Call (30 min): Let's get to know each other.

  2. Technical Interview (60 min): We discuss software distribution, networking and how you approach problems across a broad infrastructure stack.

  3. On-site Interviews: Meet engineers from our CV, robotics and platform teams and work through real infrastructure scenarios together.

title: Senior Talent Partner
descriptionHtml:
Senior Talent Partner, Non-Technical Hiring (up to £80,000 base + early stage equity)

Location: Hybrid (3 days in London office)

About GetGround

At GetGround, our mission is simple: to make property investment safer, faster, and more accessible for landlords. We believe AI can reshape the landlord journey end to end, not just improving single steps, but reimagining the entire experience of property investing. The result will be a future of buy-to-let that looks radically different from the one we know today.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a SeniorTalent Partner to own the full hiring lifecycle across sales, marketing, and corporate functions, at every level and across the UK, Philippines, and UAE. You’ll report to the VP People, and this role is critical to our ability to build a world-class organisation.

This is your chance to build the commercial and operational teams that will take GetGround to new markets and new customers. We’re backed by QED, one of the world’s most prestigious VC funds, with an experienced leadership team that puts real weight on culture and is relentless about hiring, engaging, and retaining world-class talent.

Why this role matters

Every person we hire shapes the future of property investment. The people who sell, market, and run GetGround are the ones who turn our technology into growth. As our Senior Talent Partner, you’ll build the team that builds the business, and you’ll do it with the same innovative, AI-forward mindset that defines our approach to PropTech.

If you’re ready to take full ownership of hiring, experiment fearlessly, and attract exceptional talent to an ambitious mission, let’s talk.

What You’ll Own

  • Taking our hiring velocity, execution, and impact to the next level

  • End-to-end recruitment across sales, marketing, and corporate functions (finance, legal, operations, people and more), from entry-level to executive search

  • Running multiple searches at once across the UK, Philippines, and UAE, adapting your approach to each market’s talent landscape, norms, and hiring practices

  • Building and nurturing talent pipelines for immediate and future hiring needs

  • Partnering with hiring managers to define roles, ideal profiles, and assessment approaches

  • Sourcing creatively across channels and experimenting with AI-powered recruitment tools

  • Delivering a candidate experience that reflects our ambition and values

  • Tracking, analysing, and improving hiring metrics and processes

  • Scaling our talent acquisition strategy as we grow rapidly

Who You Are

You’ll own the hiring strategy for GetGround, and this is your chance to define what excellence in hiring looks like. You are:

A resilient problem-solver. Hiring rarely goes to plan. When pipelines dry up, roles evolve mid-search, or offers fall through, you stay calm and find a way forward.

Creative in your approach. You don’t rely solely on job boards and LinkedIn. You experiment with unconventional sourcing, craft messaging that stands out, and find talent in places others overlook. You know the best candidates often aren’t actively looking, and that a strong talent brand is critical to hiring well.

A market-savvy commercial hirer. You understand what great sales and marketing talent looks like, how to assess it, and what motivates it. You’re equally comfortable hiring an SDR, a Head of Marketing, or a Finance Director, and you adapt your approach to each.

Comfortable across borders. You can run searches across multiple regions and time zones, and you’re curious about how hiring differs between London, Manila, and Dubai.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role:

How do you deliver an AI platform capability that spans multiple engineering teams and an enterprise customer’s go-live date - without compromising quality, reliability or security?

This is the challenge you’ll solve as a Senior Technical Program Manager at Parloa. We’re looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead one of Parloa’s most strategic cross-organizational programs from definition through launch.

Parloa is building an enterprise AI platform powering Fortune 2000 companies with conversational AI. Our Agent Management Platform (AMP) is trusted by global organizations including Booking.com, Allianz and American Express. As we scale rapidly, we’re building an engineering organization optimized for speed, quality and innovation.

This role is about delivering outcomes, not coordinating activity.

You will be accountable for one of the company’s highest-impact programs, bringing together multiple engineering teams and cross-functional partners to deliver a critical business outcome. You will own the integrated execution plan, dependency management, launch readiness, executive communication and decision-making mechanisms that determine whether the program succeeds.

When the program is at risk, you’re expected to know first, understand why, and arrive with well-reasoned options - not just status updates.

This is not a delivery coordination or Scrum facilitation role. Product defines what we build. Engineering owns how we build it. You ensure we successfully deliver across organizational boundaries.

Enterprise customers expect reliability, security and operational excellence - not just feature delivery. You will establish a clear readiness bar for your program, ensure delivery trade-offs are explicit and well understood, and help leaders make informed decisions before deadlines force implicit ones.

Although you won’t write production code, this is a highly technical role. You should be comfortable discussing architecture, rollout strategies, system dependencies, and reliability risks with senior engineers, and be able to challenge assumptions when delivery plans don’t align with technical complexity.

The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity and has successfully delivered complex technical programs across teams they did not directly manage. You are an exceptional written communicator who can simplify ambiguity for executives while earning credibility with engineers. Experience building AI products is valuable, but curiosity, learning velocity and sound engineering judgment matter more than prior domain expertise.

Areas of ownership:

  • Serve as the accountable leader for one strategic cross-organizational program, or two closely related programs, with clear business impact.

  • Build and maintain the integrated execution plan, including milestones, critical path, dependencies and cross-team commitments.

  • Drive end-to-end risk management by identifying leading indicators, removing blockers, tracking mitigations and escalating only when executive decisions are required.

  • Define and continuously raise the quality bar for your program by establishing objective launch criteria across functionality, reliability, security and operational readiness.

  • Lead release readiness across Engineering, Product, Platform, Security, Legal and Commercial teams, ensuring launches are based on measurable readiness rather than feature completion alone.

  • Make delivery trade-offs explicit. Where timelines require compromises, ensure decisions are documented, owned by the appropriate stakeholders and supported by clear mitigation plans.

  • Drive executive decision-making through concise written narratives, data and clear recommendations, replacing fragmented status reporting with a trusted source of truth.

  • Define and monitor delivery metrics that enable objective decisions around scope, schedule, quality and execution risk.

  • Build lightweight mechanisms that improve planning, dependency management and execution across teams, leaving the organization stronger after the program completes.

  • Influence technical and organizational decisions without direct authority, aligning engineering, product and business stakeholders around shared outcomes.

Who you are:

  • 7+ years of Technical Program Management experience, or equivalent experience leading large-scale technical programs with software engineering teams.

  • Proven experience delivering complex cross-functional programs from definition through launch across organizations you did not directly manage.

  • Experience leading release readiness for production systems, including defining objective launch criteria and driving launch decisions.

  • Strong track record of identifying delivery risk early, driving mitigation plans and making effective escalation decisions.

  • Sufficient technical depth to engage credibly with senior engineers on architecture, rollout strategies, system dependencies and engineering trade-offs.

  • Experience defining program metrics and using data to guide execution and executive decision-making.

  • Exceptional written communication skills. You can distill a complex technical situation into a clear one-page narrative for senior leadership.

Nice to have:

  • Experience delivering AI, machine learning or LLM-powered products at scale, ideally in a high-growth engineering organization.

  • Experience building program management mechanisms that became durable organizational practices.

How you work:

  • You make sound decisions in ambiguous situations, balancing imperfect information with the need to keep the organization moving.

  • You learn quickly. You have successfully developed deep expertise in unfamiliar technical domains and enjoy mastering new technologies.

  • You move quickly without lowering standards, making pragmatic decisions while ensuring quality, reliability and security remain deliberate choices rather than accidental outcomes.

  • You challenge assumptions with evidence, communicate difficult messages constructively and fully support decisions once they are made.

  • You introduce only the amount of process necessary. Your mechanisms reduce organizational friction rather than create it.

Our recruiting process:

Recruiter Call → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview → Writing Assignment + Leadership Round → Bar Raiser

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We've grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.

Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data. All our employees are instrumental in ensuring the utmost care, GDPR, and ISO compliance, including ISO 27001, in handling sensitive information.
