title: Stagiaire assistant(e) ingénieur(e)
descriptionHtml:
Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Rejoindre Neolys Diagnostics, filiale d'ALARA Group, c’est participer à une aventure humaine et scientifique passionnante : innover dans le management des risques liés aux rayonnements et faire avancer la médecine personnalisée en oncologie !

Chez nous, rigueur scientifique rime avec bonne humeur ! Tu intégreras une équipe à taille humaine, dynamique, accessible et passionnée, où le travail d'équipe, l'esprit d'entraide et la bonne ambiance sont au centre du quotidien.

Ce que nous t'offrons :

  • L'immersion dans un projet scientifique à fort impact : Au sein de notre laboratoire Neolys Diagnostics, tu contribues directement au développement du test RadioProfile visant à adapter les traitements de radiothérapie pour les patients atteints de cancer.

  • Un accompagnement de proximité : Un encadrement de qualité (Dr. Sandrine Pereira) pour développer tes compétences scientifiques et t'accompagner vers l'autonomie.

  • Une ambiance unique reconnue par nos collaborateurs : Entraide, management horizontal, transparence, événements d’équipe… et bien d'autres éléments qui font la force du groupe !

Tes principales missions :

Sous la responsabilité de la Directrice du laboratoire, tu participeras au développement et à l'optimisation d'un test innovant par RT-qPCR pour mesurer la radiosensibilité tumorale et faciliter le parcours patient :

  • Mise au point expérimentale : Développement et validation du test de détection de la radiosensibilité par RT-qPCR, d'abord sur des lignées tumorales du commerce puis sur une cohorte d'échantillons patients.

  • Culture & analyse : Culture cellulaire, extraction/amplification d'acides nucléiques et analyse des mécanismes moléculaires impliqués dans la radiosensibilité tumorale.

  • Gestion & reporting : Consignation rigoureuse des résultats, analyse des données et participation à la rédaction des synthèses scientifiques.

Ta fierté si tu réussis avec nous ?

Tu contribues concrètement à lever des verrous technologiques majeurs pour accélérer le transfert de nos tests innovants vers la routine clinique, au bénéfice direct des patients !


Ton profil :

Tu prépares un diplôme de niveau Bac+5 (Master 2 ou École d'Ingénieur) en Biologie, Cancérologie, Biotechnologies ou domaine connexe, et tu recherches un stage.

Tu possèdes de solides bases théoriques et pratiques en biologie moléculaire (RT-qPCR, extraction) et en culture cellulaire.

Au-delà de ta rigueur scientifique et méthodique, c'est ton enthousiasme, ta curiosité, ton esprit d'équipe et ton autonomie qui feront la différence !

Prêt(e) à relever le défi et à faire avancer la recherche en oncologie ? Rejoins-nous vite !

Tous nos emplois sont ouverts aux personnes en situation d’handicap.

title: Stagiaire Chargé(e) de projet ERP
descriptionHtml:
Fondé à Paris en 1999, Advancy est un cabinet de conseil en stratégie de premier plan, comptant aujourd'hui plus de 300 consultants répartis dans nos bureaux mondiaux (Paris, New York, Boston, Shanghai, Francfort, Sydney, etc.). En forte croissance, nous modernisons actuellement nos propres outils internes et lançons un projet d'envergure : le déploiement mondial d’un nouvel ERP.

Pour nous accompagner dans cette phase clé, nous recherchons un(e) Stagiaire Chargé(e) de projet ERP pour une durée de 6 mois, à partir de début septembre 2026.

Vos Missions

Rattaché(e) directement au CFO, vous serez au cœur de la transformation digitale du cabinet. Vous participerez activement à l'implémentation de l’ERP sur les modules clés et accompagnerez la transition opérationnelle.

Votre quotidien s'articulera autour des axes suivants :

Assistange au pilotage Projet : coordination entre l’intégrateur et les équipes Advancy ; coordoniation entre les équipes Advancy (Finance, RH) : suivi des points bloquants ; participation aux comités projet

Aide au paramétrage et déploiement des modules :

  • Finance : Assistance au paramétrage, au nettoyage et à la migration des données

  • Core HCM : Assistance au paramétrage, au nettoyage et à la migration des données RH (profils collaborateurs, structures organisationnelles ; gestion des congés et absences).

  • Recette & Tests (UAT) : Élaborer les scénarios de test, identifier les anomalies ; faire le lien avec l'intégrateur et veiller à la conformité de l'outil avec nos processus métiers.

Accompagnement au changement : Participer à la rédaction des guides utilisateurs et aider au support des équipes (RH, Managers, Consultants) lors du lancement.


  • Formation : Étudiant(e) en Master (Bac+4/5) en École de Commerce, IEP ou Université, avec une spécialisation, Systèmes d'Information, ou Management de Projet.

  • Qualités personnelles : Rigueur analytique, sens de l'organisation et esprit de synthèse. Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre aisance relationnelle et votre capacité à travailler en mode projet dans un environnement exigeant et dynamique.

title: Stagiaire Talent & Operations (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
Apprendre, évoluer et accompagner le développement des talents. Contribuer à un impact positif.

Le poste

Au cours de ce stage, vous découvrirez le fonctionnement opérationnel d’un cabinet de conseil : gestion des ressources, processus Talent, gestion de la performance et coordination de projets transverses. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Operations et Talent France, et développerez de solides compétences analytiques, organisationnelles et relationnelles, notamment en gestion des parties prenantes.

Vos missions

Talent management

  • Participer à des projets RH transverses : formation, diversité et inclusion, autres projets transverses.

Excellence operationnelle

Staffing

  • Appuyer la coordination du staffing des consultants et des stagiaires.
  • Maintenir la planification de la charge de travail et les données de staffing.

Reporting

Coordination d’équipe

Pourquoi rejoindre Quantis

Quantis, société du groupe BCG, est un cabinet de conseil de référence en développement durable, qui accompagne les organisations face à des enjeux environnementaux complexes. Depuis vingt ans, notre équipe d’experts collabore avec des organisations du monde entier afin d’intégrer le développement durable dans la stratégie, la prise de décision et l’action. Nous guidons les entreprises de l’ambition à l’action en associant les avancées scientifiques les plus récentes à une vision stratégique, pour les aider à appréhender la complexité, à progresser sur leurs priorités de durabilité et à créer une valeur durable.

Unis par un engagement commun en faveur de progrès concrets, nos plus de 250 professionnels incarnent une culture collaborative singulière, que nous appelons le Quantis Spirit. Nous sommes innovants. Nous sommes orientés vers l’impact. Nous sommes guidés par la science. Nous sommes Quantis.

Pour en savoir plus, découvrez Quantis et notre mission.

Votre profil

Vous réussirez dans cette mission si :

  • Vous souhaitez contribuer à l’action d’une entreprise engagée en faveur du développement durable ;
  • Vous faites preuve d’organisation, d’initiative et de rigueur ;
  • Vous appréciez l’analyse de données et l’amélioration des processus ;
  • Vous savez construire des relations de confiance et communiquer efficacement ;

  • Vous maîtrisez couramment le français et justifiez d’un bon niveau professionnel en anglais.

Unlocking the Potential of All Quantisians

We aim to achieve this by nurturing a culture rooted in collective action, and shared purpose, where diversity is cherished, inclusion is lived, mental wellbeing is supported, and opportunities are open to all.

title: Startup Operations Generalist
descriptionHtml:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the Role

We are growing fast and opening a second lab in London. Every new person, contract, invoice and payroll run lands on someone's desk. You own that desk.

This is the operations generalist seat: finance admin, payroll, people operations, hiring logistics, and whatever else the company needs to run well. You own the machinery so that everyone else spends their time on the lab.

This is not a strategy role and not a pure HR role. It is hands-on, and most of the work is making sure things happen correctly and on time, then making sure they happen without you next time.

What You'll Do

  • Run payroll and people admin. Monthly payroll and the relationship with our payroll provider, contracts, onboarding and offboarding, benefits and pension, leave and absence. Every person gets paid correctly and every new hire has a laptop, accounts and a contract on day one.

  • Run the finance back office. Supplier invoices and payment runs, customer invoicing and collections, expense and card reconciliation, and the monthly hand-off to our external accountants.

  • Keep hiring moving. Interview scheduling, candidate logistics, NDAs, work-trial setup and offer paperwork in Ashby. You make sure the hiring process never stalls.

  • Keep us compliant. Swiss and UK employment rules, permits and visas, insurance, VAT filings, company registers. You are not a lawyer or an accountant, but you know when to call one and you make sure deadlines never surprise us.

  • Own general operations. Office and lab-site logistics, vendor and software contracts, renewals, company-wide tools and access. When something is nobody's job, it is yours until it has an owner.

  • Automate all of the above. Payroll, invoicing, our ATS and our ledger all have APIs. The goal is that each process you take over runs with less manual work every quarter.

What We're Looking For

  • You have run operations at a fast-growing startup. Several years covering some mix of finance admin, payroll, HR and office operations, ideally as the first or second person doing it. You have built processes, not only followed them.

  • Detail-obsessed. A wrong payslip or a missed filing is a real problem for a real person. You check the numbers before anyone asks.

  • AI-native. It's 2026. We run on Claude Code across the company, and you use AI tools and scripts to automate your own work. You check what they produce and stand behind the result. The more software engineering experience you have, the better. If your instinct is that operations is a spreadsheet-and-inbox job, we will frustrate each other.

title: Store Manager, Neueröffnung Berlin (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Wir bei flaconi sind davon überzeugt, dass Vielfalt Kreativität, Innovation und Wachstum fördert. Sie lebt in all ihren Formen der Schönheit. Unser Team ist ein Mosaik von Einzelpersonen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Kulturen und Lebenswegen, die alle durch eine gemeinsame Leidenschaft für Schönheit vereint sind. Unser Engagement basiert auf unseren Grundwerten, insbesondere #trustinpeople. Wir sehen es als unsere Verantwortung an, ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem sich jeder Mitarbeitende ehrlich wertgeschätzt und gehört fühlt und dazu ermutigt wird, seine einzigartigen Perspektiven einzubringen, um ein Gefühl der Zugehörigkeit zu fördern.

flaconi ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit und begrüßt und ermutigt alle qualifizierten Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten jeglicher Herkunft und Identität zur Bewerbung, unabhängig von ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Rasse, Geschlechtsidentität, Migrationshintergrund, nationaler Herkunft, Behinderungsstatus, sexueller Orientierung, Religion oder Alter.

Solltest du spezielle Unterstützung während des Bewerbungs- oder Interviewprozesses benötigen – z. B. Live-Untertitelung, mehr Zeit für das Interview oder die Aufgabe in einem anderen Format – lass es uns einfach wissen, damit wir den Prozess entsprechend anpassen können. Wir werden unser Bestes tun, um dies zu ermöglichen.

flaconi baut die Zukunft des Beauty-Retails!

Als Deutschlands führende Online-Destination für Beauty bringen wir unser Markenerlebnis jetzt direkt in die Top-Einkaufsstraßen – und unser Flagship in Berlin setzt dabei neue Maßstäbe.

Wir schlagen ein neues Kapitel auf! Für unsere Retail-Expansion suchen wir eine visionäre und ergebnisorientierte Persönlichkeit als Store Manager (all genders), die die Eröffnung und den Erfolg unseres neuen flaconi Stores in Berlin verantwortet. 

Deine Rolle

  • Talent Management & Leadership: Du rekrutierst, coachst und motivierst dein Team, lebst die flaconi-Werte vor und schaffst ein inklusives, energiegeladenes Arbeitsumfeld.
  • Sales & KPI Ownership: Du steuerst das Store-Budget, hast Kosten fest im Griff und treibst das Erreichen aller Umsatzziele und Kennzahlen aktiv voran.
  • Operational Excellence & Vertrauensstellung: Du sicherst den reibungslosen Tagesbetrieb. In dieser Vertrauensposition verantwortest du Kassen-, Bestands- und Retourenprozesse sowie die Verwaltung von Schlüssel-, Zutritts- und Systemberechtigungen.
  • Customer Experience & Events: Du garantierst eine erstklassige Customer Journey und unterstützt bei In-Store-Events, Masterclasses sowie Product-Launches zur Community-Bindung.
  • Visual Merchandising: Du setzt unsere VM-Standards makellos um und präsentierst den Store jederzeit als erstklassige Premium-Shopping-Destination.

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre Führungserfahrung im High-End-Retail oder der Beauty-Branche mit (ideal als Store Manager:in oder sehr erfolgreiche:r Assistant Manager:in).
  • Analytik: Du besitzt ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten, kannst Budgets managen und leitest aus Retail-KPIs proaktiv Maßnahmen ab.
  • Retail-Know-how: Du verstehst das operative Geschäft blind – von der Inventur über Compliance bis hin zum Visual Merchandising.
  • Leadership: Du bist ein Kommunikationstalent mit Coaching-Mentalität und weißt, wie man Team-Dynamiken positiv nutzt und Menschen motiviert.
  • Beauty-Passion: Du liebst alles rund um Fragrance, Skincare, Make-up und Haircare und kennst die neuesten Markttrends.
  • Sprachen: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch. Jede weitere Sprache ist ein Plus!
    Was wir dir bieten
  • Unsere Mitarbeiter:innen sind uns wichtig: Wir bieten dir einenunbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag an und übernehmen die Kosten deines Deutschland Tickets
  • Work-Life-Balance: 29 Urlaubstage und die Möglichkeit eines bezahlten Sabbaticals.
  • Leadership Academy: Mit unseren internen und externen Weiterbildungsangeboten kannst du deinen eigenen Karriereweg aktiv gestalten.
  • Dein Wohlbefinden liegt uns am Herzen: Wir möchten dich auch in schwierigen Zeiten unterstützen. Dazu bieten wir dir und deinen Angehörigen Beratungsgespräche mit psychologischen Fachkräften an.
  • flaconi Fitness & Health: Vergünstigungen bei Mitgliedschaften und Zuschuss für deine Bildschirmbrille.
  • Gemeinsam an morgen denken: flaconi bezuschusst deinen Sparbeitrag zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge mit zusätzlichen 20%.
  • Ein komfortabler Arbeitsplatz mit allem, was dazugehört: Hochwertige technische Ausstattung, Obst und Getränke.
  • Weitere Vergünstigungen: Tolle Rabatte in unserem Online-Shop sowie bei Partnerunternehmen, coole Teamevents & Firmenfeiern.

Über flaconi


flaconi ist einer der führenden deutschen Online-Kosmetikhändler mit einem umfangreichen Portfolio von fast 1000 Marken und 50.000 Produkten. Von Drogerie über Bio-Kosmetik bis hin zu Premium und Luxus decken die Online-Shops in Deutschland, Frankreich, Österreich, Polen und der Schweiz alle Produktsegmente ab und bieten eine vielfältige Auswahl an Produkten für eine einzigartige und tägliche Beauty-Routine. 2011 als eine der ersten Online-Parfümerien gegründet, arbeitet flaconi heute mit mehr als 700 Mitarbeitern aus 60 verschiedenen Nationen in der flaconi-Zentrale in Berlin-Charlottenburg und im Fulfillment-Center in Halle. Gestalte mit uns den Erfolg unseres Unternehmens und bewirb dich jetzt online!

flaconi akzeptiert keine unaufgeforderten Lebensläufe aus anderen Quellen (z.B. Personaldienstleister) als direkt von einem Bewerber. 

KI-Hinweis

Wir setzen KI-gestützte Tools ein, um einzelne Schritte unseres Recruiting-Prozesses effizienter zu gestalten und zu unterstützen. Diese Tools helfen unserem Recruiting-Team beispielsweise dabei, passende Kandidaten zu identifizieren, Bewerbungen zu priorisieren oder recruitingrelevante Erkenntnisse zu gewinnen.

Die KI trifft dabei keine Einstellungsentscheidungen. Jede Bewerbung wird von Menschen geprüft und bewertet, und sämtliche Personalentscheidungen erfolgen unter menschlicher Aufsicht und Verantwortung. Unser KI-System wird regelmäßig auf mögliche Verzerrungen überprüft und verfügt über eine ISO 42001-Zertifizierung für KI-Governance. 

Bei Fragen zum Einsatz der KI oder zur Erläuterung der Kriterien können Sie sich jederzeit an unser Talent Acquisition team (

Das angebotene Gehalt wird stets innerhalb dieses Rahmens liegen und basiert auf den Ergebnissen des Rekrutierungsprozesses.

title: Strategic Account Director, Industrials (EMEA)
descriptionHtml:
About Sayari: 

Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue & Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv.

The Role

We are hiring a Strategic Account Director to take Superconductor to tier-1 industrials across EMEA. Some of these accounts already use Sayari. Others are new, and you will win them with your experience, your network, and your existing book of business.

You will be among the first to sell Superconductor into this vertical, with a Forward Deployed Engineer and an established global organization behind you. Targets are multiyear agreements of $2M+, with adoption extended across each account’s adjacent buying centers.

What You Will Do

  • Win new key logos: use your network and book of business to open tier-1 industrial accounts, and take each from first conversation to signed multiyear agreement. Build your own pipeline through your network, targeted outreach, and practitioner communities.
  • Grow existing accounts: take Superconductor into tier-1 customers that already use Sayari, moving them from a single use case to enterprise-wide deployment across the Commercial World Model and Superconductor agents.
  • Map the buying centers: build relationships across supply chain and procurement, trade compliance and sanctions, legal, risk, investigations, and IT. Think Chief Procurement Officers, Chief Supply Chain Officers, Heads of Trade Compliance, Chief Risk Officers, Chief Compliance Officers, and General Counsel.
  • Prove, then scale: work with Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, and the forward-deployed engineers and analysts dedicated to your accounts to get Superconductor workflows into production with top customers, then use those results as references to unlock further budget.
  • Shape the playbook and roadmap: refine how we position and sell into industrials, and bring buyer feedback to Product and Engineering.
  • Forecast accurately: run a structured pipeline (MEDDPICC, Challenger, or Miller Heimann) and give leadership a forecast they can plan against.

What You Bring

  • 15+ years in large-cap industrials (for example aerospace and defence, automotive, chemicals, capital goods, or energy equipment), at or near C-suite level, with a verifiable network in the sector.
  • An existing book of business and relationships with tier-1 industrials that you can bring to Sayari.
  • A record of closing multimillion-dollar, multiyear agreements, through both new key logos and expansion of existing accounts, that you can walk through in named detail.
  • Depth in supply chain, procurement, trade compliance, and risk, including supply chain due diligence rules, forced labour import restrictions, sanctions, and export controls.
  • Executive presence: you can explain data provenance and AI reasoning to non-technical senior stakeholders and be treated as a peer.
  • Command of structured sales methodology in multithreaded deals involving procurement and legal review.
  • Interest in agentic AI and the ability to explain what it can and cannot yet do. You do not need to be technical.
  • Willingness to travel up to 25% across EMEA.

Nice to Have

  • German speaker

Why Sayari

  • Uncapped earnings: commission with accelerators on expansion revenue and no bonus caps.
  • A product that shows its work: agentic AI that traces every finding to a primary source.
  • Seniority: you are the senior domain voice on an established sales team, with room to shape how the vertical is worked.
  Sayari is an equal opportunity employer and strongly encourages diverse candidates to apply. We believe diversity and inclusion mean our team members should reflect the diversity of the United States. No employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on race, color, ethnicity, religion, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability status, veteran status, genetics, or political affiliation. We strongly encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply.

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

Role Summary

Location: London

Hybrid

Full-Time

The Strategic Account Director is a new-business, quota-carrying hunter responsible for landing the largest, most complex enterprise logos in the market. You own the full pursuit — from target identification and outbound generation through multi-threaded, committee-driven sales cycles to signed, revenue-producing contracts. Your prospects run cross-border volume at scale, they are today served by incumbent banks or specialist fintechs, and displacing that incumbent is the job.

This is a role for someone who is energized by the chase: building conviction where none exists, getting into the CFO's and Treasurer's office cold, orchestrating a pursuit team through a long and technical evaluation, and closing seven-figure relationships. You set the bar for how strategic new business gets won at Payoneer.

This is a strategic role. It is deliberately seated centrally under Global Sales so the strategic-accounts motion can be built, proven, and standardized before ownership is distributed to the regions. You will work hand in hand with regional heads of sales for in-market coordination and, over time, help shape how this function scales across the field.

What You'll Do 

  • Hunt and land net-new strategic accounts. Own a new-business quota. Identify, prioritize, and pursue the highest-value target accounts in your territory (typically $500K+/month cross-border volume, up to $10M+/month strategic targets) and convert them into signed, funded customers.
  • Generate your own pipeline. Build top-of-funnel through disciplined, research-led outbound — direct executive outreach, referrals, partner and ecosystem channels, and events. Do not wait for leads; create them.
  • Break into the buying committee cold. Get in front of and build conviction with CFOs, Treasurers, Finance Operations, and Compliance/Risk leaders at target accounts. Multi-thread deliberately so a deal never rests on a single contact.
  • Displace the incumbent. Position Payoneer's speed, global coverage, economics, and platform breadth to unseat incumbent banks and specialist competitors. Run competitive displacement plays and build the business case that moves an entrenched buyer.
  • Own complex, long-cycle deals end to end. Drive multi-stakeholder, technical, compliance-sensitive evaluations from first meeting to close. Own the mutual close plan, procurement, legal, and commercial negotiation.
  • Sell the platform. Lead with value, not features. Land the entry wedge and architect the deal to open cross-border payments plus high-value services (Capital, Treasury/FX, Embedded/Platform Payments, Workforce/EOR, and emerging rails) — maximizing initial contract value and expansion potential.
  • Qualify with discipline. Apply Payoneer's Sandler-based methodology — Up-Front Contracts, Pain Funnel, budget and decision qualification — to every pursuit so you invest team resources only in winnable, real deals.
  • Orchestrate the pursuit team. Direct Solutions/Pre-Sales, Product Specialists, Compliance, and RevOps as a coordinated deal team through the sales cycle, and quarterback executive sponsorship where needed.
  • Forecast honestly and close on time. Own a credible, hygienic pipeline and forecast in CRM. Drive deals to close dates and call your number straight.
  • Set up the win for the long term. Land with a clean handoff to Customer Success and a clear expansion thesis, so every logo you close becomes a growth account.

Who You Are 

  • 8+ years in enterprise B2B sales with a strong bias toward new business / new logo acquisition — not primarily account management or renewals.
  • Consistent, demonstrable record of hitting or exceeding a new-business quota on complex, high-value deals.
  • Proven ability to self-generate pipeline through outbound and to break into cold enterprise accounts at the executive level.
  • Experience closing long-cycle, multi-stakeholder deals with meaningful (six- to seven-figure) contract value.
  • Demonstrated success selling into and navigating executive buying committees — CFO, Treasury, Finance, Compliance/Risk.
  • Strong commercial and negotiation skills, including running procurement, legal, and margin-protective deal structuring to close.
  • Fluency operating in a matrix environment and orchestrating a cross-functional pursuit team.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred

  • Background in payments, fintech, banking, treasury, FX, or cross-border commerce.
  • Track record of competitive displacement against incumbent banks or specialist fintechs.
  • Experience selling a multi-product platform and structuring land-and-expand entry deals.
  • Familiarity with a structured sales methodology (Payoneer uses Sandler).
  • Exposure to compliance-sensitive, regulated sales environments (KYC/AML-aware selling).
  • Strong CRM discipline and data-driven pipeline management (e.g., Salesforce).

#LI-FD1

The Payoneer Ways of Working 

Act as our customer’s partner on the inside
Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further. 

Do it. Own it.
Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do. 

Continuously improve
Always striving for a higher standard than our last. 

Build each other up 
Helping each other grow, as professionals and people. 

If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.

In this role, you will act as the primary point of contact for our largest hospitality customers in France. title: Strategic Accounts Product Representative
descriptionHtml:
Diabolocom is the leading European sovereign cloud contact center (CCaaS) and customer experience management (CX) platform. It helps organizations transform customer experience by augmenting agents' capabilities through AI-human collaboration, automating routine customer interactions, and delivering personalized experiences at scale. Built on proprietary AI, private cloud, and native telecom infrastructure, the platform automates workflows, improves data quality, and empowers customer service and sales teams across every channel.

Backed by more than two decades of experience and twice recognized by Frost & Sullivan for AI technology innovation and customer experience technology leadership, Diabolocom is trusted by more than 400 organizations—including BPCE, Carrefour, Nikon, and Mitsubishi—to power mission-critical customer operations in over 60 countries, helping organizations strengthen customer loyalty and accelerate growth.



About the role

We are looking for a Strategic Accounts Product Representative to strengthen the relationship between our Product organisation and our largest enterprise customers, as well as support major commercial opportunities across our products.

In this role, you will act as the primary Product interface for selected strategic accounts, helping customers understand our Product capabilities, direction and commitments while ensuring their needs are clearly understood and effectively translated into actionable Product insights.

You will work closely with Account Managers, Sales, Product Owners, Engineering and Delivery teams to connect customer expectations with our Product strategy, identify opportunities shared across multiple customers, and provide clear visibility on Product scope, dependencies and roadmap maturity.

This is a highly transversal, customer-facing role at the intersection of Product, business and technology. You will engage with stakeholders ranging from operational teams to senior executives, build a deep understanding of their business challenges, and help our Product organisation make better-informed decisions.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Building trusted Product relationships with strategic customers: Act as their main Product point of contact, in close coordination with Account and Project managers, clearly communicate product capabilities, strategic direction, constraints and trade-offs to stakeholders at every level.

  • Turning customer needs into Product insights: Qualify requests based on customer impact, business value, urgency, recurrence and strategic relevance. Identify common challenges across accounts and work with Product Owners and the Head of Product to surface broader Product opportunities.

  • Ensuring clear and reliable Product commitments: Maintain a consolidated view of Product commitments for strategic accounts, including scope, ownership, dependencies, status and confidence level. Ensure that customer-facing communications reflect internally validated product and delivery plans.

  • Bridging customers and internal teams: Coordinate Product Owners and relevant internal stakeholders to answer complex customer questions, clarify functional scope and address cross-product dependencies. Ensure changes to scope, timing or assumptions are communicated proactively.

  • Leading customer discovery and understanding business needs: Participate in or lead Product discovery workshops with strategic customers to understand their workflows, business challenges and expected outcomes. Challenge solution-driven requests where necessary to identify the underlying business problem.

  • Contributing to major commercial opportunities: Coordinate the Product contribution to strategic tenders, RFPs and major sales opportunities, ensuring that Product information, capabilities, limitations and proposed commitments are accurate and aligned internally.

  • Sharing customer and market intelligence: Develop an understanding of customers' industries, business models and relevant regulatory constraints. Bring these insights back to Product and help Sales, Customer Operations and other teams communicate Product decisions consistently.

    • What we're looking for

    We are looking for someone who combines strong customer-facing skills with a solid understanding of Product and technology. You can navigate complex enterprise environments, understand business challenges, communicate with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and bring structure to discussions involving multiple teams and competing priorities.

    Your experience and skills:

  • Significant experience in a customer-facing B2B technology environment, ideally within a SaaS company, enterprise software vendor or fast-growing technology business.

  • Experience working at the intersection of Product, customers and business, for example in Product Management, Enterprise Product Management, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management or a similar role.

  • The ability to understand complex customer environments, engage with senior stakeholders and build trusted relationships across operational, technical and executive levels.

  • A strong understanding of Product development processes, including discovery, requirements qualification, roadmap management, prioritisation and delivery dependencies.

  • The ability to translate customer requests and use cases into structured business needs, identify recurring patterns and distinguish customer-specific requirements from scalable Product opportunities.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical capabilities, Product direction and trade-offs clearly to different audiences.

  • Strong organisational skills and a structured approach to managing multiple strategic accounts, requests, stakeholders and commitments simultaneously.

  • The ability to influence and coordinate cross-functional teams without direct hierarchical authority.

  • A pragmatic, analytical and customer-oriented mindset, combined with the confidence to manage expectations and communicate when a requested feature, scope or timeline cannot be guaranteed.

  • Excellent written and spoken French and English.

    • Experience with Contact Center solutions, customer experience technology, conversational AI, CRM integrations or enterprise telecommunications would be a strong advantage.

    What you'll enjoy at Diabolocom

  • Strategic impact: Help shape the Product experience for our largest customers.

  • Product and customer exposure: Work closely with enterprise clients across our Engage and AI portfolio.

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product, Sales, Engineering and Customer Operations.

  • International growth: Contribute to the development of an ambitious European technology company.

  • International environment: Collaborate with colleagues and customers across markets.

  • Hybrid working: Enjoy a central Paris office and flexible working arrangements.


    • Recruitment process

    Our recruitment process is designed to help us understand your experience, approach to customer challenges and ability to work across Product and business teams.

    1. Initial call with a Talent Acquisition Manager to discuss your background, motivations and expectations.

    2. Visio with a Product Owner

    3. Visio with a Project manager and a Sales Executive

    4. On-site final interview with the Product team, a Project Manager, a Sales Executive, divided into three parts:

      1. An "In-situation Case Study"

      2. A discussion that will question your choices for the case study

      3. A short discussion with Svetlana, our Head of Delivery Operations

    At Diabolocom, diversity and inclusion are in our DNA. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to color, language, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national or social origin, opinion disability, age. As part of our hiring process, please note that any employment offer or service provider offer will be subject to a background check, including verification of your identity, educational credentials, and previous employment history.

title: Strategic GTM Lead - Insurance DACH
descriptionHtml:
About The Role

Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Strategic GTM Lead for Insurance in DACH: someone who has led client engagements at a top-tier strategy consultancy and now wants to build a market rather than advise on one. You will decide which insurers we go after and why, develop those relationships from first contact to signed partnership, and be the person senior insurance executives trust to think through how AI changes underwriting, claims and operations in their business.

This is not a classic sales role. You will open new strategic insurance accounts and grow them into long-term partnerships, from the first executive conversation to large, account-level commitments. Our Account Executives close individual deals and use cases; you set the direction for the account as a whole. Most of your impact comes from account strategy, executive dialogue, ecosystem work with consultancies and partners, and shaping how Taktile shows up in the German-speaking insurance market. You will work closely with our Head of Insurance, Account Executives, Solution Engineering, Product and Engineering.

What You'll Do

  • Identify and prioritize target accounts across DACH insurers (primary insurers, reinsurers, MGAs, insurance groups) based on a clear thesis: where the business case for AI-driven decisioning is strongest and where we can win

  • Build account strategies for your portfolio: map the organization, its strategic agenda and transformation programs, the buying committee and the path to an executive sponsor, and spot expansion opportunities from day one

  • Grow and retain accounts once they are live: steer the overall relationship, open new business lines and country organizations, and make sure clients see lasting value

  • Lead relationships at every level, from claims and underwriting heads to CIOs, COOs and board members, and move them from first conversation to a defined business case and a strategic commitment to Taktile

  • Design and moderate executive workshops and steering meetings with insurance leadership teams, turning open-ended ambitions ("we need to become AI-native") into concrete, prioritized use cases

  • Shape and land account-level commitments (business case, commercial framework, executive sign-off), working hand in hand with the Account Executives who close individual deals, Solution Engineering and our Head of Insurance

  • Work closely with Product and Engineering to tailor our platform to each client's needs and turn client requirements into concrete solutions

  • Build and work our ecosystem in DACH: strategy and technology consultancies, system integrators and core system vendors who shape insurers' technology decisions

  • Represent Taktile at industry conferences, roundtables and client events, and help design formats of our own that bring insurance executives together

  • Bring market insight back into Taktile: what insurers need, how competitors and incumbents position, and what that means for our product, messaging and pricing

  • Help build the playbook for Taktile's insurance business in DACH as we scale the team

About You

  • 6+ years of total work experience, including 4–6 years at McKinsey, BCG, Bain or a comparable strategy or operations consultancy, ideally leading client teams as Engagement Manager, Project Leader or equivalent

  • Project experience with insurance clients; you don't need to be an insurance specialist, and adjacent work in operations, technical advisory or digital/AI transformation counts

  • A commercial track record: ideally you have sold or expanded projects as an Engagement Manager. Software sales experience is not required

  • Outgoing and client-facing: you enjoy being in front of clients and leading the conversation, rather than working in the background

  • You are comfortable in front of C-level executives: you can structure a difficult discussion, moderate a room of senior stakeholders and hold your own when challenged

  • Strong problem-structuring and business case skills; you can quantify the value of a use case and explain it to a CFO

  • Technical understanding: you can discuss how our platform works with engineers and translate it for business leaders

  • You take ownership of outcomes, not just recommendations, and you are motivated by building revenue and long-term client relationships. High ownership, but a team player, not a lone wolf

  • Fluent in German and English, written and spoken

  • Based in Munich or Berlin (Frankfurt or London possible) and happy to travel frequently across Germany, Austria and Switzerland. This is not a remote role: you will regularly work on-site with clients, for example in workshops

Ideal Qualifications (but not required)

  • Experience beyond consulting, for example in an industry or in-house role

  • Existing network among senior decision-makers at DACH insurers, insurance consultancies or core system vendors

  • Experience in an enterprise software, insurtech or AI company, for example in a commercial, strategy or business development role

  • Hands-on familiarity with how insurers run claims, underwriting or pricing, and with the regulatory context (BaFin, Solvency II, EU AI Act)

  • Experience speaking at industry events or publishing on insurance and AI topics

What We Offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.

  • Make an impact and meaningfully shape an early-stage company.

  • Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo.

  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.

  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package, with a predominantly fixed salary and a performance-based bonus.

  • Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.

  • Use the equipment of your choice including meaningful home office set-up.

Our Stance

  • We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply.

  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears.

About Us

Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents. With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding. Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo. With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. Learn more at taktile.com.

About Your Employment. Taktile operates through regional entities worldwide. Depending on the location of this role, your employment or engagement will be with Taktile LLC (US), Taktile GmbH (Germany), Taktile Ltd (UK), or Taktile SRL (Romania). The applicable entity will be confirmed during the offer process.

Your Privacy. Taktile (“we” or “us”) is the controller of the personal data you provide during this application process. We collect and process your name, contact details, resume/CV, work history, education, and any other information you submit or that we obtain from publicly available sources or references.

How we use your data: We process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy, communicate with you about the recruitment process, comply with legal obligations (such as right-to-work verification), and, with your consent, to consider you for future opportunities.

Legal basis (EU/UK applicants): We rely on (i) pre-contractual steps at your request (GDPR/UK GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)), (ii) legal obligations (Art. 6(1)(c)), and (iii) our legitimate interest in evaluating candidates (Art. 6(1)(f)).

Retention: If your application is unsuccessful, we retain your data for 12 months after the recruitment process concludes, unless you consent to longer retention. Successful candidates’ data becomes part of their employment records.

Your rights: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict the processing of your personal data, to data portability, and to withdraw consent.

Automated decision-making: We use automated tools to assist in screening applications. No hiring decision is made solely by automated means without human review.

International transfers: Your data may be transferred to and processed in the United States, Germany, the United Kingdom, or Romania. Where required, transfers are protected by Standard Contractual Clauses or other approved mechanisms.

title: Supply Chain Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

Achieving this ambitious goal requires more than innovative engineering — it requires a supply chain capable of turning complex technologies into reliable, manufacturable solutions.

As a Supply Chain Engineer, you'll serve as the critical technical link between our Engineering teams and external suppliers, ensuring components, materials, and systems can be sourced, manufactured, and delivered to meet our development needs. You'll own technical sourcing assessments and supplier readiness across one or two assigned technology domains, such as Laser, Targetry, Chamber, or Core Engineering.

Working closely with Engineering, Strategic Procurement, and Quality Management, you'll bring supplier capabilities and manufacturing expertise into the development process early, identifying technical challenges, assessing manufacturability, and addressing supply risks before they become costly delays. This is an opportunity to apply your engineering expertise in a highly collaborative, fast-moving environment where your technical judgment directly influences project readiness and our ability to scale.

What You'll Do

  • Own Technical Sourcing Readiness: Lead technical feasibility and sourcing-readiness assessments across your assigned technology domain, evaluating supplier capabilities, manufacturing processes, and technical requirements from early development through sourcing readiness.

  • Connect Engineering with Suppliers: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for suppliers within your domain, partnering with Engineering and Strategic Procurement to identify, assess, and engage potential suppliers.

  • Drive Early Supplier Involvement: Bring supplier manufacturing expertise into the development process early, identifying manufacturability challenges and opportunities before designs are finalized.

  • Translate Engineering Requirements: Work with Engineering to clarify incomplete or ambiguous specifications, drawings, and technical requirements to ensure they are accurate and ready for sourcing.

  • Develop Supplier Readiness: Build and track technical supplier development and qualification plans in partnership with Supplier Quality, ensuring suppliers have the capabilities and readiness needed to support development milestones.

  • Improve Manufacturability and Cost: Collaborate with Engineering and suppliers to identify opportunities to improve manufacturing processes, reduce complexity, optimize costs, and minimize lead times.

  • Inform Supplier Selection: Provide technical assessments, supplier capability insights, and recommendations to support Strategic Procurement's supplier evaluation and award decisions.

  • Manage Technical Supply Risks: Identify and proactively escalate supplier capacity constraints, long lead times, technical dependencies, and other risks that could impact project timelines.

  • Enable Cross-Functional Alignment: Maintain clear technical documentation, supplier readiness information, and risk assessments to support effective handovers between Engineering, Procurement, and Quality.

Who You Are

  • You have a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • You bring experience in engineering, technical sourcing, supplier development, manufacturing engineering, or a related role within a complex technical or industrial environment.

  • You have a strong understanding of relevant manufacturing technologies, materials, processes, and supplier capabilities within your area of expertise.

  • You can evaluate technical specifications, engineering drawings, and manufacturing requirements, identifying gaps, ambiguities, and potential manufacturability challenges.

  • You have experience assessing supplier technical capabilities, manufacturing capacity, and readiness, ideally within highly engineered products, advanced manufacturing, or complex system development.

  • You understand how to balance technical requirements, manufacturability, cost, and lead-time considerations to support effective sourcing decisions.

  • You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and exercising independent technical judgment, knowing when to resolve an issue directly and when to escalate decisions requiring Engineering, Quality, or commercial approval.

  • You are a proactive communicator who can translate complex technical findings into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • You thrive in cross-functional environments, building trusted relationships with engineers, suppliers, procurement professionals, and quality teams.

  • You demonstrate strong ownership and follow-through, taking responsibility for technical sourcing readiness within your domain and ensuring risks and open issues are addressed early.

  • You enjoy working in a growing organization where you can help establish processes, strengthen supplier relationships, and contribute to building a scalable supply chain.

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

title: Syndikus-Steuerberater/in (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Einleitung

Wir suchen neue Kolleg:innen! Migrando ist ein Legal-Tech-Unternehmen aus Cottbus. Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, den komplizierten und langwierigen Weg zur Einbürgerung effizienter und kundenfreundlicher zu gestalten. Mit unserer Expertise im Ausländerrecht und einem starken Team aus über 60 Kolleg:innen begleiten wir tausende Mandant:innen erfolgreich auf dem Weg zum deutschen Pass. Alle unsere Stellen sind Festanstellungen bei uns vor Ort in Cottbus.

Am besten verschaffst du dir gleich selbst einen Eindruck auf unserer Karriereseite. Denn wir können hier schreiben, was wir wollen, am Ende bleibt es eine langweilige Einleitung.

Wir bieten Dir

Bei uns bist du keine Nummer in einer Großkanzlei, sondern die steuerliche Instanz für eine ganze Unternehmensgruppe. Du arbeitest strategisch, hast direkten Einfluss auf Entscheidungen und bekommst ein Umfeld, das dir dafür den Rücken freihält.

  • Keine operative Fristlast
    Bei uns arbeitest du strategisch, inhaltlich und qualitativ hochwertig, ohne die ständige Fristendichte und den Dauerstress einer klassischen Kanzlei.
  • Gestaltungsfreiheit & direkter Impact
    Du bist Sparringspartner:in auf Augenhöhe für die Geschäftsführung. Deine Expertise findet Gehör, deine Konzepte werden umgesetzt.
  • Attraktives Festgehalt
    Wir schätzen deine Verantwortung und Erfahrung. Deshalb erwartet dich ein faires Bruttogehalt zwischen 5.000 und 8.000 Euro im Monat, je nach Qualifikation.
  • Strukturierte, digitale Prozesse
    Kein Papierkrieg, keine Zettelwirtschaft. Wir arbeiten konsequent mit durchdachten digitalen Workflows und moderner Technik.
  • Kurze Wege und kleine Teams
    Du arbeitest in überschaubaren Teams, in denen man sich kennt. Du musst dich nicht durch Hierarchien hangeln, um gehört zu werden, sondern sprichst direkt mit Kolleg:innen, Teamleads oder der Geschäftsführung. Entscheidungen fallen schnell.
  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit
    Mit deiner Arbeit hältst du ein Unternehmen auf Kurs, das Menschen dabei unterstützt, in Deutschland anzukommen, Sicherheit zu finden und ein neues Kapitel aufzuschlagen.
  • Ergonomischer Arbeitsplatz
    Rückenfreundlicher Stuhl, höhenverstellbarer Tisch, zwei große Monitore, ein hochwertiges Headset, ein leistungsstarker Laptop und eine ruhige Umgebung.
  • Vertrauensarbeitszeit und flexible Teilzeit
    Keine Kernzeiten, keine vorgeschriebenen Zeitfenster. Ob 4-Tage-Woche, 30 Stunden oder ein individuelles Modell: Dein Job soll zu deinem Leben passen, nicht andersherum.
  • Homeoffice nach der Einarbeitung
    Grundsätzlich arbeiten wir im Büro, weil Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort für uns wichtig sind. Nach deiner Einarbeitung ist gelegentliches Homeoffice aber kein Problem, auch spontan.
  • Spontan frei, wenn das Leben dazwischenkommt
    Kranke Kinder, Elternabend, kurzfristiger Arzttermin oder einfach mal eine Auszeit: Wir planen unsere Teams so, dass auch spontane freie Tage möglich sind, ganz ohne Stress oder schlechtes Gewissen. Familie und Gesundheit haben bei uns Vorrang.
  • Altbau-Büro im Herzen von Cottbus
    Unser modernes Altbau-Büro verbindet Charakter mit bester Ausstattung. Mit guter ÖPNV-Anbindung und Mitarbeiterparkplätzen in der Nähe kommst du entspannt an. Im Haus gibt es einen kostenlosen Fitnessraum, und auch dein Hund ist bei uns ausdrücklich willkommen.
  • Team-Events und Feel-Good-Angebote
    Sommerfest am See, Weihnachtsfeier, Halloween-Sause, gemeinsame Lunches oder Afterwork-Dinner: Wir feiern gern. Erscheinen ist keine Pflicht, und früher gehen ist auch kein Problem. Zwischendurch sorgt unsere Feel-Good-Managerin für kleine Auszeiten, von der kurzen Schultermassage bis zu Momenten zum Durchatmen.

Mögliche Aufgabenbereiche

Als Syndikus-Steuerberater (w/m/d) bist du die zentrale steuerliche Ansprechperson für die gesamte Migrando-Gruppe. Du berätst die Geschäftsführung, entwickelst Konzepte und sorgst dafür, dass wir steuerlich sauber und zukunftsfähig aufgestellt sind.

  • Umfassende steuerliche Betreuung der Gruppe
    Du betreust die Migrando GmbH, die Rechtsanwaltskanzlei, die verbundenen Holdings sowie die privaten Steuern der Gesellschafter vollumfänglich.
  • Beratung der Geschäftsführung
    Als strategische:r Berater:in bewertest du die steuerlichen und wirtschaftlichen Auswirkungen geplanter Entscheidungen und gibst klare, fundierte Empfehlungen.
  • Entwicklung steuerlicher Konzepte
    Du erarbeitest Optimierungsstrategien, begleitest Umstrukturierungen und Holding-Aufbauten und stellst sicher, dass wir wirtschaftlich und rechtlich optimal aufgestellt sind.
  • Koordination mit externen Steuerberater:innen
    Du bist die Schnittstelle zu unseren externen Kanzleien, steuerst die Zusammenarbeit und sorgst für Transparenz.
  • Prozessgestaltung & Tax-Compliance
    Du baust interne steuerliche Prozesse auf und optimierst sie, damit Abläufe effizient, korrekt und zukunftsfähig bleiben.

Dein Profil

Für diese Rolle brauchst du das Steuerberaterexamen, alles andere zeigt sich in der Praxis. Uns ist wichtig, dass du Erfahrung mitbringst, strategisch denkst und komplexe Themen verständlich machen kannst.

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Steuerberaterexamen
    Du verfügst über fundiertes Fachwissen, das du jetzt in einem modernen, strategisch arbeitenden Umfeld einsetzen möchtest.
  • Festanstellung vor Ort in Cottbus
    Du möchtest fest bei uns angestellt sein und im Team vor Ort in Cottbus arbeiten. Für freie Mandatsarbeit oder eine reine Remote-Stelle sind wir leider nicht die richtige Adresse.
  • Fundierte Kanzleierfahrung
    Du hast bereits in einer Steuerberatungskanzlei gearbeitet (nicht zwingend in einer Großberatung), kennst die Abläufe aus der Praxis und bringst die nötige Routine für komplexe Fragestellungen mit.
  • Sicheres Wissen im Unternehmenssteuerrecht
    Körperschaftsteuer, Gewerbesteuer, Umwandlungs- und Holdingstrukturen sind für dich kein Neuland.
  • Wirtschaftliches Denken
    Du betrachtest Sachverhalte nie isoliert, sondern erkennst sofort die betriebswirtschaftlichen Auswirkungen deiner steuerlichen Entscheidungen.
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und klare Kommunikation
    Du drückst dich auf Deutsch schriftlich wie mündlich präzise aus und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte so begründen, dass auch Nicht-Steuerprofis sie nachvollziehen und umsetzen können.
  • IT-Affinität
    Digitale Tools wie DATEV, DMS und Cloud-Systeme sind für dich keine Hürde. Du nutzt Technik gern, um Steuerarbeit smarter zu machen.
  • Plus: Erfahrung in der Finanzverwaltung
    Wenn du schon im Finanzamt gearbeitet hast, weißt du, wie die Verwaltung denkt, und kannst Entscheidungslogiken aus erster Hand einschätzen.

title: Talent Lead at AIOS- Remote, $100-200k inc equity
descriptionHtml:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Talent Lead at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team. As Talent Lead at AIOS, your fundamental role is to supercharge our talent (recruiting) function, ensuring that a lack of key hires never blocks growth. You’ll help define what a killer sourcing process looks like while leveraging frontier tooling to increase your throughput and velocity as you recruit best-in-class operators.

You’ll work across a variety of roles: traditional direct-to-consumer Growth roles (Performance Marketing), technical roles (AI + SWE Engineering & Product), and clinical roles — flexing deftly between more junior roles all the way up to the most senior roles in the org.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice — as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday. You’ll have flex in your calendar for kids if you have them — many of our team have kids so we’re kid-friendly.

This is an individual-contributor role — no direct reports, full-cycle sourcing/screening/closing, hands dirty in the trenches. You’ll report directly to Cierra Olsen (Head of Talent).

You’ll also work closely with the rest of the Talent Team: Zoe Wheeler (UK Talent Lead), Mika Mansilla (Founder Associate), and Jordan Pellikan (VP Ops).

Key responsibilities

  • Full cycle: Own searches end to end from sourcing, outbound, screening, interview coordination, calibration, and closing (recent examples: Head of InfoSec, Head of Creative, Senior Media Buyer, Affiliate Lead).

  • Sourcing: Build repeatable sourcing engines for hard-to-fill roles. Run LinkedIn X-ray searches, build target-company lists, and do the outbound headhunting yourself. Our best hires won’t come inbound.

  • Processes: Constantly sharpen our hiring bars (seniority, industry fit, recency, builder pattern) consistently across every search you’re DRI for. Help improve interview processes across the org.

  • Hygiene: Keep pipelines, stages, and candidate communication clean and current in Ashby so nothing stalls and our time to hire continually improves.

  • Calibration: Flag pipeline risk early, bring calibration questions before they become misses, and constantly align with leaders across the org to improve our processes.

  • Closing: Manage candidate experience through to signed offer, including comp conversations.

KPIs

  • Time-to-fill on your owned searches, without sacrificing the bar

  • Sourced (outbound) candidates as a % of your total pipeline — we want you building your own pipeline, not living off inbound

  • Offer-accept rate on closed candidates

  • Ashby pipeline hygiene — stages and candidate status always current

Need to have

  • Excellence: You have 5+ years experience personally recruiting (sourcing, screening, managing, and closing) great candidates across difficult searches. You can point to hires that materially raised the talent bar of the teams they joined.

  • Hunter: You can turn a vague candidate profile into target companies, search strings and a high-quality outbound pipeline. You do not depend on inbound applicants or agencies to fill roles.

  • Senior hiring: You have successfully recruited senior leaders and understand how sourcing, assessing and closing them differs from junior hiring.

  • Judgment: You can distinguish exceptional people from candidates who simply have the right companies, titles or polish on their CV. You develop conviction quickly and can clearly articulate why someone does or does not meet the bar.

  • Range: You can move between very different searches without losing depth. You learn unfamiliar markets quickly enough to recruit credibly within them.

  • Multi-workstream: You can run several searches simultaneously while keeping sourcing quality, candidate communication, follow-ups and pipeline hygiene exceptionally tight.

  • Urgency: You push searches forward without waiting to be managed, surface problems early, and change approach quickly when a pipeline is not working.

  • High bar: You care more about making an exceptional hire than filling a seat, and you are comfortable challenging hiring managers when you do not believe a candidate meets org standards.

Nice to have

  • Startups/Scale-ups: You’ve recruited in a fast-moving startup or scale-up where priorities shift quickly, roles evolve mid-search, and there isn’t always an existing playbook.

  • Technical recruiting: You’ve successfully recruited for Engineering, AI, Data, Product or other technical roles and can credibly assess candidate quality beyond surface-level credentials.

  • Regulated industries: You’ve recruited in healthcare, financial services, or another highly regulated industry where candidate requirements and operating constraints are more complex.

  • AI-native: You actively use AI and automation to improve sourcing, research, outreach, screening, and recruiting operations.

  • Systems builder: You’ve helped build or materially improve recruiting processes, tooling, scorecards, sourcing systems, or interview loops rather than simply operating an existing process.

  • Network: You have an existing network of exceptional operators, builders and leaders you’d be excited to bring into AIOS.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come — it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully — in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status — we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

    🎯 "You just build a f\*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: $100k-$200k/yr, incl equity

  • Kenntnisse des deutschen Gesundheitswesens oder Erfahrung im Vertrieb an Praxen, MVZ oder Kliniken

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau oder in der Skalierung eines Teams, nicht nur in dessen Steuerung

Was wir Dir bieten

title: Technical Product Manager (Data Integrations)
descriptionHtml:
Orcrist is building a next generation data intelligence platform using cutting-edge technologies. We're handling petabyte-scale data with sub-second queries. Our product is a Kubernetes‑based platform delivered as B2B SaaS or as a self‑hosted on‑prem solution, including air‑gapped deployments. We enable customers across defense, law enforcement, and enterprise to turn mission-critical data into actionable intelligence.

Role

Every investigation starts with data. As PM for the Integration team, you make sure analysts in law enforcement and defense have the data they need, when they need it. You own the roadmap for integrating data from commercial vendors, open feeds, social media and messaging platforms, as well as the admin interfaces used to manage these integrations. Your work ensures data arrives current, traceable to its source and ready to use.

This is a largely technical PM role with significant ownership over a platform and admin experience that are still taking shape. You decide what gets built and in what order, working closely with engineers and other product teams to turn provider APIs and data models into scalable integrations and features that support analysts’ investigations. You’ll read API documentation, map provider data to OIP’s data model and write clear, actionable specs that engineers can build from.

What you'll do

  • Own the provider roadmap. We add a source when it answers a question analysts can’t answer today, so you start from the analyst’s problem, not from a provider’s name. You talk regularly with analysts, admins and solutions engineers in law enforcement and defense, and with the upstream teams whose features bring integration requests. You decide which providers come next and what “done” means for each.
  • Write the technical specs. Cover authentication, pagination, rate limits and quotas, incremental sync, deduplication, field mapping, and how failures surface. Every object must carry its provider, fetch time and source URL from the moment it is fetched. Our platform runs as SaaS and on-prem, so you also decide how each source behaves in each distribution.
  • Own the connectors as a product. That covers the contract between connectors and the platform, versioning, and how quickly a new provider goes from evaluation to production. Every connector should make the next one cheaper. Where another team can reach a public source on its own, you give it a safe way to do so instead of putting it in our queue.
  • Own the admin interfaces. That means creating a connection, managing credentials, scheduling, health and status, logs, quota usage and permissions. A source we can’t monitor isn’t delivered, so every live connection needs a health check and clear failure states.
  • Work with partnerships and legal. You collaborate with the Director of OSINT and the Data Acquisition Manager to evaluate vendors, raise licensing and terms-of-service questions before we build, and turn the legal framework (storage, retention, redistribution) into product requirements. You also give the people negotiating contracts technical findings and cost per call.
  • Manage the teams around you. Upstream, you work with the teams building user-facing features, such as graphs and maps, who bring integration requests from their intelligence domain. You help them find the analyst question behind each request and decide whether a shared connector can serve several of them. Downstream, you work with the foundation teams for ontology, machine learning and processing, so incoming data arrives in a shape they can use. You forecast the load of every high-volume source before it goes live.
  • Shape person-focused investigation tools. You own how analysts go from a first lead about a person to a reviewed set of linked online identities. That includes how results are presented and reviewed, and how to avoid paying for the same lookup twice.
  • Measure the integration layer. Track sync success rate, data freshness, time to onboard a provider, active connections, and time to resolve a failed connection.

About you

  • 5+ years as a Product Manager in B2B SaaS, with experience owning a technically complex area end-to-end, such as an integration platform, an API product, or data pipelines.
  • You are comfortable in API documentation. You can discuss OAuth versus API keys, polling versus webhooks, pagination and rate limits with engineers as an equal, and you can try an endpoint yourself in Postman or curl.
  • You have designed admin or configuration interfaces for technical users: connection setup, status and error states, audit trails.
  • You write specs and acceptance criteria that are specific enough to build and test against.
  • You are data-fluent and define quality metrics for reliability and coverage, not just feature delivery.
  • You are comfortable with the legal side of third-party data: licensing, terms of service, GDPR, and provenance requirements.
  • You work well across teams, since integrations touch engineering, partnerships, customer success, and every product that consumes the data.
  • Eligible to work in Germany and willing to travel to Berlin and across DACH for workshops and customer visits.

Nice-to-haves

  • You have built or managed a connector framework, integration marketplace, or iPaaS product.
  • Familiarity with OSINT as a practitioner or product builder, and a sense of where existing collection tools fall short.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, on-prem, or air-gapped deployment constraints and what they mean for integration architecture.
  • Familiarity with entity resolution or link analysis, and how ingested data feeds them.
  • German language (B1+) 
  • Experience working directly with law enforcement or defense users in Germany or the DACH region.

What we offer

  • Real ownership, real impact: Own a critical layer of the platform that every customer relies on. Much of the integration platform and its admin experience is still taking shape, so you identify the problems, set priorities, decide what gets built, and see it through.
  • Remote-first, Germany-wide: Work from wherever you do your best work, with regular team gatherings in Berlin and other off-site locations.

  • Get rewarded for impact: Performance bonuses are tied to agreed objectives and key results.
  • A warm welcome: Every new team member gets a welcome goodie bag.
  • Good people, good times: From summer and Christmas parties to regular team gatherings, we make time to celebrate together.
  • A mission that matters: Work on challenges with tangible impact on public safety and national security.

Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

Du musst nicht vom ersten Tag an alles wissen. Mit Deinen fundierten Grundlagen und Deiner Motivation, unterstützen wir Dich, Dich in Themen wie die Telematikinfrastruktur und API/Konnektoren, einzuarbeiten.

Deine Aufgaben

Dein Profil

descriptionHtml:

Die docu-fix GmbH in Offenbach am Main digitalisiert dokumentenbasierte Geschäftsprozesse. Wir führen DocuWare, digitale Workflows und Schnittstellen bei unseren Kunden ein und betreuen sie im laufenden Betrieb. Für unseren Bereich Technischer Service & Implementierung suchen wir dich.

Du arbeitest etwa zu gleichen Teilen im Support und in der Implementierung und sicherst beides durch saubere Dokumentation ab.

Implementierung (ca. 40 %)

  • Du setzt die im Projekt abgestimmten Anforderungen und Workflows um.

Dokumentation und Qualitätssicherung (ca. 15 %)

  • Du hältst Störungen und Lösungswege im Ticketsystem und in der Wissensdatenbank fest.
